title: Self-Portrait Show and Tell
description:
Callum was excited to share his self-portrait with his friends. The teacher marveled at his self-portrait and asked, “Callum, can you show your friend where your nose is?” Callum looked at his self-portrait and pointed to the nose. “What is your face showing? It looked sad or perhaps, angry?” The teacher asked. Callum replied, “It's making a sad face! Not angry but sad.” 

“The self-portrait looked so much like you; who did it with you?” The teacher commented. Callum thought for a while and replied, “My mama and papa! We looked in the mirror and draw my face." “Aw, your papa and mama did it with you? That’s really sweet!” Callum beamed brightly as his friends applauded him for his sharing.
interpretation: Callum showed the ability to understand and comprehend the teacher's spoken language and questions. Then, he confidently expressed himself with four-five words in a sentence to communicate the features of his self-portrait to his friends.

title: 我的博物馆
description: 在学习绘本故事《奥莉薇》 的过程中， 孩子们对有奥莉薇去的博物馆很感兴趣。 Miles对于博物馆很好奇， 我们一起收集了一些关于博物馆的信息。 当我问他：“ 如果你有一个博物馆， 会是什么博物馆呢？” 他认真的想了想， 告诉我说：" 我要有一个蛇的博物馆。” 于是我接着问， “那这个博物馆里都有什么呢？你能画出来给我看吗？” Miles听了很开心， 他迅速地拿出一张纸， 开始画了起来。 画完之后他主动在其他小朋友们面前做了分享与说话， 他告诉朋友们：“ 这是蛇博物馆。 这是一条条的蛇。 我画了很多蛇， 因为我喜欢。 这个博物馆会在2025年5月3日开， 它是在滨海湾。 ”
interpretation: 通过Miles制作的海报， 可以看出他能够将自己的想象通过绘画的方式表现出来， 是创作能力的体现。 同时， 他能够使用简单的华语以小段话的方式表达出来， 说明他具有良好的沟通与表达能力， 能够自信地使用华语。

learning_goals.title: 运用观察和想象力创作平面和立体的艺术作品：通过其它的媒介（如：蜡或墨汁）或不同素材来探索画的特性。
描述和讨论他们对各种艺术品的所见、所闻和所感。

title: 认照片
description:
教师准备了若干幼儿们的照片，鼓励幼儿在照片中挑选出自己的照片，学习说：“这是我！”并说出其他照片上面有谁，说出同伴的名字。
      赞杰坐下来看了看照片，很快就递给老师看，老师询问他：“这是谁的照片？”赞杰拍了拍自己，老师说：“是赞杰的对吗？赞杰可以说，我，这是我的照片！”赞杰听后重复道：“我，这是我的照片。”随后老师指向其他的照片询问道：“那这是谁的照片？”赞杰回答道：“義腾（英文）的！”老师反问道：“義腾？是義腾的吗？”赞杰点了点头，说：“是，義腾的。”接着他分别认出了敏瑄和芸希的照片，并尝试说：“这是敏瑄的！”“这是芸希的！”
interpretation: 赞杰能够在若干照片里辨认出自己的照片，并愿意与老师互动，告知老师是谁的的照片，说出同伴的名字，体现了他有自我意识，能够认识同伴，乐意重复老师学习华语表达。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of others (saying out the names of their peers) 培养对他人的认识，如：说出同伴的名字等。
Foster sense of self-concept and identity 培养自我概念和认同感，如：能使用代词“我”。

围绕绘本《逃家小兔》幼儿们掌握了句式：如果你变成、、我就变成、、在创意美术的延申课程中，幼儿们继续围绕句式“如果你变成……，我就变成……”展开丰富的想象，设计并制作了一本独特的剪贴画小书。他们挑选多种颜色的彩纸，运用剪、贴、画等方式，将自己的奇思妙想变成具体的图画和文字。
 鈞澤说：“如果你变成鸟，我就变成树。”他用篮色和绿色的彩纸剪出想要的图案，让画面生动有趣。
 通过这次活动，幼儿不仅锻炼了动手能力，还培养了想象力和表达能力。在翻阅自己制作的小书时，他们脸上洋溢着自豪和喜悦。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 倾听：能认真有礼貌地倾听别人讲话，能辨别声调、语调的不同，有良好的倾听习惯。
语言学习成果（听）- 倾听：能听出一段话的要点。
语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解3个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（听）- 欣赏文学作品：喜欢倾听故事，在语言的引导下能对故事展开想象，体会故事描述的情景和表达的感情。
语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：能够积极主动地用华语表达，态度自然。
语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能清楚连贯地表达事情经过。
语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能针对某一个话题展开讨论。
语言学习成果（说）- 仿编故事：在理解故事的基础上，根据故事书提供的线索展开想象，并能独自仿编故事。
语言学习成果（说）- 说华语：能熟练自如地讲华语。

title: 作品分析——《生气的脸》
description:
《生气的脸》活动围绕绘本《菲菲生气了——非常、非常的生气》展开，帮助幼儿认识和表达“生气”这一情绪，并通过语言与艺术创作加深理解。活动开始时，教师展示生气表情的照片，引导幼儿观察并描述表情特征，如皱眉和撅嘴。随后，幼儿通过照镜子模仿生气表情，并用华语表达自己的观察。接着，幼儿使用马克笔在纸盘上绘制“生气的脸”，再通过双面胶、吸管、扭扭棒等材料进行装饰，进一步展现情绪感受。最后，幼儿展示作品并参与整理材料，培养责任感。活动提升了幼儿的语言表达能力和创造力，帮助他们更好地理解和管理情绪。


  黄子睿在创作过程中，首先使用纸盘作为作品的基础背景。他使用黑色马克笔绘制脸部的基本轮廓，包括眉毛、眼睛和嘴巴，并通过夸张的线条表现生气的情绪。之后，他进一步丰富作品，选择了彩色扭扭棒和吸管进行装饰。他用橙色扭扭棒制作嘴巴和眉毛，使五官更加立体，同时用蓝色和绿色的吸管装饰额头，增强作品的视觉层次感。
interpretation: 子睿作品以纸盘为基础，通过马克笔、吸管和扭扭棒进行创作，表现“生气的脸”。作品中，眉毛和嘴巴使用直线描绘，线条粗细均匀，五官特征清晰。眉毛位置略向下倾斜，表现情绪特征。吸管以绿色和蓝色为主，分布在纸盘的上方，用于表现头部装饰，排列整齐，增加了整体的结构感。红色扭扭棒用于嘴部装饰，呈现曲线，突出了嘴巴的表情特征。整体作品在五官与装饰元素的结合上展现了明确的层次感。幼儿在创作时模仿生气表情，通过皱眉和张嘴的行为为作品增添了真实性，使用材料时动作协调，能够自主完成主要部分。

learning_goals.title: 描述和说明他们在艺术作品中的想法和构思，开始有意识地把各种艺术元素组织在一起，创造出艺术视觉表现，如：用颜色表达情感；用线条营造动感；用模板创作各种图案。
谈论他们朋友的作品。

title: Bus
description: The teacher introduced a new storybook titled "We All Go Traveling By" to the children. Davi listened attentively as the teacher read the story. When the bus appeared in the book, Davi immediately pointed at it and identified it, and his teacher acknowledged his response. As the story continued, Davi continued to point at the bus every time it appeared. At the end of the story, the book showed various pictures of transportation, and Davi pointed at each one, looking at his teacher. The teacher would then identify each  transportation as Davi pointed them out.
interpretation: This observation shows that Davi demonstrates interest in the storybook as he listens attentively to his teacher and identifies the bus in the story. Davi is also developing his language skills, as he points at the pictures and seeks the teacher's help in identifying them.

learning_goals.title: Foster language and expression through songs, stories and rhymes 通过歌曲、故事和儿歌，培养幼儿的理解和用简单的字、词表达的能力。

domains.title: The Thinking and Communicating Self 思考与沟通

title: Peek a boo friends
description: The children were introduced to a learning material called "Peek-a-Boo Friends." They were encouraged to open the lid and guess who was inside. Davi was given a peek-a-boo friend board, opened the lid, and saw Laoshi’s picture. He looked at the teacher, and the teacher explained who the person inside the lid was. Davi then opened another lid and found a photo of his friend. He looked at the teacher, who asked if it was his picture. Davi simply looked at the teacher, took another board, and when he finally discovered his own picture, he smiled and pointed at it.
interpretation: This observation shows that Davi is developing a sense of self as he explores the peek-a-boo board, actively searching for his own picture. It also demonstrates his ability to recognize that the person in the first few pictures was not himself.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (responding to their names) 培养自我意识，如：回应自己的名字等。

domains.title: Psycho-social Self 心理-社会行为

title: scribbling
description: Davi was invited to participate in a scribbling experience. He immediately sat down in the chair, and was given a piece of paper and a basket of crayons. Without hesitation, Davi took a pink crayon with his left hand. He then began to scribble with an upward and downward motion, using a digital pronate grasp (with his palm facing down and little finger facing the ceiling, holding the crayon with all of his fingers resting against the palm). Afterward, Davi picked up a white crayon with his left hand, then shifted it to his right hand, maintaining the same grasp. He continued by scribbling in a sideways motion.
interpretation: Davi’s scribbling expereince fosters his fine motor skills. He used his left hand to hold the crayon with a grip where his fingers wrapped around it, showing control. When he switched to his right hand, he was able to use the same grip, which shows that he’s developing coordination between both hands.

learning_goals.title: Foster fine motor development ( pick up objects using pincer grasp, hold crayon to scribble, fasten/unfasten zippers/buttons, screw, unscrew bottle caps, etc.) 发展精细动作，如：用大拇指、食指及中指（三指）抓物品、拉拉链、扣纽扣、拧瓶盖等。

title: 幼儿作品--蛇年大吉
description:
老师邀请哲恩参与手工制作--蛇年大吉的活动。老师提供材料：纸盘、彩色颜料、毛笔、胶水、裁剪好的舌头、假眼睛、彩色圆形贴纸若干。请哲恩选择自己喜欢的颜色，绘画在纸盘上。纸盘上的颜色干后，老师帮助裁剪出蛇的形状，邀请他选择自己喜欢的材料，粘贴蛇的假眼睛、舌头和花纹。
通过手工活动蛇年大吉，哲恩进一步了解蛇的名称和样子。并且可以说：“蛇”，模仿出蛇发出：“嘶嘶”的声音。同时可以选择自己喜欢的颜色，涂画在纸盘上。最后在老师的引导下，粘贴好小蛇的眼睛、舌头和圆形贴纸当作小蛇的花纹。增强了自身的绘画能力的同时，又促进手眼协调能力和手部精细动作的发展。

title: Create my Snake!
description:
In the images, he is seen using a paintbrush with a firm grip, carefully selecting colours from the watercolour palette to apply onto a paper plate to decorate his snake. His brush strokes appear deliberate, indicating a growing control over fine motor skills and an emerging ability to express himself through art. Morgan shows focus and concentration as he experiments with different colours and brush movements, illustrating an awareness of artistic techniques and an appreciation for aesthetic expression. Additionally, Morgan is observed attempting to cut along a drawn outline on a paper plate to transform it into a paper snake. As he move his thumb and index finger in a pinching movement, he tried to cut along the curved line. However, his cuts would make it through the paper plate, resulting in cutting small pieces of paper plate out. Morgan did not give up and decided to paste his pieces of paper plate onto another A4-sized paper in a shape of a snake.

Morgan engages positively in shared creative activities alongside his peers. While working on his craft, he appears focused on his task, yet remains comfortable in the presence of others, demonstrating a balance between independent creativity and social awareness. His engagement with art suggests a sense of confidence and enjoyment, which contributes to his overall emotional well-being.
interpretation: Morgan demonstrates a strong engagement in artistic activities, displaying both curiosity and intentionality in his creative process. He also displays his budding ability to use scissors with some control. His hand-eye coordination  are evident as he attempts to follow the lines, suggesting a developing confidence in crafting and manipulating materials. His engagement in these tasks highlights his enthusiasm for creative exploration and his ability to execute artistic ideas with intentionality.

learning_goals.title: Experiment with a variety of tools (e.g: hands/fingers/feet, roller, sponge, paint brush) for drawing, printing and painting.
Represent things in the environment through artwork.

title: Train Structure Exploration
description:
Eva approached the netted rope bridge inside the train structure at the Tiong Bahru Park with a look of curiosity and determination. She carefully placed one hand on the rope and leaned forward, peeking through the gaps to see the sand far below. “I am so tall now! I see Teacher Debra!” she told the teacher, her voice tinged with excitement. The teacher assured her it was safe, encouraging her to explore. Eva tested the ropes by pressing them gently with her foot. “It is wriggly and wobbly!” she exclaimed, giggling as she felt the ropes shift slightly under her weight. She then crouched down, using her hands to feel the texture of the rope, and commented, “Look! I can stay on it. I am not falling down.” The teacher explained that the ropes are braided tightly to make them strong, sparking Eva’s fascination as she observed how the individual strands were intertwined.

As Eva leaned over the edge to look at the ropes below, she spotted something colorful. “There’s something red down there!” she said, pointing eagerly. She adjusted her position, stretching her arm slightly to try and reach it through the netting. Although she couldn’t grab it, her interest didn’t wane. “See, Aria. Our friends are there,” she cheered as she continue looking through the netting.

Eva demonstrated strong social and emotional competencies through her curiosity and engagement with her surroundings. She expressed excitement and enthusiasm in sharing her discoveries with her teacher and peers, showing effective communication skills. Her willingness to explore the rope bridge, despite its wobbly nature, reflected her resilience and ability to manage emotions in new situations.
interpretation: From this observation, Eva displays her curious observations and verbalising them to her teachers and friends around her. She also beginning to connect the data that she had gather during her observations and share them with her peers cheerfully. With more guidance, Eva can make more meaningful connections to her prior knowledge and surroundings around her.

learning_goals.title: Observe and talk about living things, non-living things, places and events.
Encourage children to look out for interesting things and the changes occuring in their immediate environment.

title: 幼儿作品——可爱的小手
description:
老师邀请彩绚参与可爱的小手印画活动。老师提供彩色颜料、毛笔、卡纸、假眼睛、棉棒、胶水、纸盘、装饰材料若干。请她选择喜欢的颜色挤在纸盘上，使用毛笔涂画在小手上。然后，在印画在卡纸上，待印画的小手干了后。彩绚使用棉棒沾取胶水，选择喜欢的装饰品粘贴在小手上，独一无二的可气的小手就制作好了。老师与她击掌庆祝，她微笑回应老师。老师把她制作好的小手，裁剪好挂在作品区展示。
通过制作印画可爱的小手活动，彩绚可以进一步加深了解认识自己的小手。可以尝试说出：“手。”同时独立使用棉棒沾取胶水，粘贴自己喜欢的装饰材料，促进手眼协调和手部精细动作的发展。

description: 在常规喂奶时间里，依璇熟练地用双手握住奶瓶，偶尔还会调皮地换成单手，一边稳稳地抓着奶瓶，一边轻轻握住枕头的边缘，舒适地依偎在柔软的枕头上，享受着安静而满足的喝奶时光，直到把奶喝得一滴不剩。

title: 二月份：听见名字，快乐回应 ( PTC )
description: 在常规活动中，当老师轻柔地呼唤依璇的名字时，依璇立刻敏锐地做出反应，迅速转过头来，专注地望着老师的脸。小小的眼睛里闪烁着好奇的光芒，仿佛在认真聆听。随着老师的动作变化，幼儿也兴奋地模仿起来，有时张开小嘴，像是在学着发声，有时又低下头，似乎在思考或害羞地笑。这样的互动，如同一场默契的交流，让依璇在温暖的陪伴中，逐渐认识自己的名字，也享受着与成人沟通的乐趣。

title: 二月份:摸一摸，拿一拿 （PTC ）
description: 老师轻轻地将一个小篮子放在筠心面前，篮子里装着松果和小小的纸圆筒，等待着小手去探索。筠心好奇地伸出手，仔细挑选着，捏起一颗松果翻看，又轻轻放回。接着，筠心又拿起纸圆筒，试着摇一摇、敲一敲，感受不同的触感。忽然，筠心眼睛一亮，抓起整个篮子，兴奋地倾斜着，似乎想看看里面的东西会不会全部倒出来。小小的动作中，流露出满满的专注与好奇。

learning_goals.title: Foster fine motor development (grasping, holding to small objects, pushing small objects, pinching small objects, etc.) 发展精细动作，如：能用五指抓物品。
Foster hand-eye coordination (stretch to grasp objects, transfer things from one hand to another, etc.) 发展手眼协调能力，如：能伸手去抓东西；将物品从一只手转移到另一只手等。

title: 流水
description: 邀请恩熙坐在浴盆里后，老师把放入了舀水容器的水盆放在她的前面对她说：“恩熙，看！盆里有清清的水，它没有动！老师把它用水勺舀起来，举高，倒！…”在水流下来的时候，恩熙抬头定睛看向水柱，稍后，她也分别看了老师用玩具洒水器和小帆船等为恩熙展示了水流下的水柱。当老师做完水流展示之后老师把装了水的花洒递给恩熙，她伸出左手接了过去，接着抬起手臂转动手腕在眼睛的注视下倒了一些水出来。她在持续了约3-4分钟的活动期间反复多次的拿着花洒等玩具倒出了水。
interpretation: 综合来看，恩熙在这一过程中通过观察、模仿、尝试和重复操作，逐步建立了对水流特性的基本理解。这一探索性的游戏体验提升了她的认知能力

learning_goals.title: Foster beginning science concepts through free exploration (water play) 通过自由探索初步发展婴幼儿对科学概念的感知，如：玩水。

title: 吸管插洞洞
description:
老师邀请幼儿们一起参与吸管插洞洞活动。老师提供好打好孔的纸箱和吸管若干，请他们一只手抓住吸管，插入洞洞中。
老师对幼儿们说：“谁要参加吸管插洞洞游戏啊？”章易看着老师拍拍自己。老师笑着对章易说：“我，我要玩。”他看着老师说：“玩。”老师表扬他：“说的很好！”老师拿出吸管和洞洞箱，请章易动手操作。章易右手五指抓握住吸管，另一只手把住箱子。用力向下插入洞洞中，吸管不见了，章易低头看向洞洞中，并尝试中手指向下抠洞洞。章易又拿出一根吸管单手抓住，继续在相同的洞洞向下插。当插入很多根吸管后，章易看向老师伸出双手表示没有。老师鼓励章易说：“吸管没有了、没有。”章易说：“没”，老师表扬他：“真棒！”老师把洞洞箱抬起来，下面有好多插进去的吸管。章易发出：“哇”的感叹声。双手捡起地上的吸管，继续插入参与插洞洞的游戏。
interpretation: 章易可以积极主动参与吸管插洞洞的活动，并尝试学习用语言和动作表达自己的想法。可以单手五指抓握吸管，成功的插入洞洞中。章易在探索过程中，逐渐由五指过度到三指抓握吸管插进洞洞中，说明章易手指精细动作发展良好。

title: 二月，探索大自然。PTC
description:
老师自制一个触觉与视觉的探索物，让他可以用手去摸纽扣，看一看小鱼塘里的鱼、海藻。。。
刚开始他只是趴在很远的地方看着老师，老师鼓励他爬过来探索小鱼塘，后来他爬过来；探索小鱼塘里的鱼、海藻。。。还会很仔细看它。
最后他会爬过去探索干花，时不时会用眼神与老师交流。
他不只达到勇于探索新的材料，还达到社会行为发展的目标，真棒!

title: Rainbow Sort and Choice
description: After learning about the colours of the rainbow, the children were invited to choose two colours they liked and sort objects in those colours into the corresponding rainbow sections. Alternatively, they could work with a partner to create their rainbow bridge using materials from the class, such as markers and Legos.
interpretation:
Zacchaeus quickly chose his two favourite colours, red and orange. He picked a yellow cup and a green train toy and proudly showed the teacher, saying, “Yellow and Green!” Without any prompting, he sorted the objects into the correct rainbow sections. He was able to place most of the objects in the seven colors of the rainbow without assistance. As he worked, Zacchaeus repeated the colour names aloud and carefully checked to make sure each object matched the correct colour. When unsure, he would place an object in a color section and compare it to see if it matched. During pair work, Zacchaeus helped his friends identify the correct colours in different shades of pink with the teacher’s guidance.

This demonstrates Zacchaeus’s strong colour recognition skills and his ability to work both independently and cooperatively by communicating. He approached the task confidently and methodically, showing a clear understanding of the activity.

title: Spot Me!
description:
At the discovery space, Emma was encouraged to spot a series of items with the teacher. The teacher asked, "Emma, can you point to something green?" Emma looked at the tray of items and pointed to a green spoon. Next, the teacher asked if she could point to something blue. Again, Emma looked at the tray of items and pointed to a blue crayon. 

The teacher praised her for spotting the items and readied her for another tricky question. "Emma, can you find something red?" Emma promptly pointed at the red straw. "And can you find another thing that has the same colour as the red straw?" the teacher asked. Emma looked through the trays of items and pointed to the red train. She said, "Nah, they are the same colour, red." The teacher nodded to acknowledge and thanked her for helping to spot the items.
interpretation: Emma was able to distinguish between the colours of the items. She could classify the items by colours and see them in their likeness and differences through colours. While doing so, she understood and comprehended the teacher's spoken language and questions.

title: Spot Me!
description:
At the discovery space, Jerich was encouraged to spot a series of items with the teacher. The teacher asked, "Jerich, can you point to something red?" Jerich looked at the tray of items and pointed to a red train and a red cover. 

The teacher praised him for spotting the items and readied him for another tricky question. "Jerich, can you find something yellow?" Jerich promptly pointed at the yellow play dough mould. Same!" The teacher nodded to acknowledge and thanked him for helping to spot the items.
interpretation: Jerich was able to distinguish between the colours of the items. He could classify the items by colours and see them in their likeness and differences through colours. While doing so, he understood and comprehended the teacher's spoken language and questions.

title: 唱早安歌
description: 在晨间活动中，老师鼓励幼儿们坐到出席板前一起唱早安歌，方凯听到老师唱儿歌：“小朋友们坐过来，坐过来。”时，方凯便走到出席板前坐了下来，老师说：“太阳公公在哪里？”方凯便跟随老师一起将双手向上举高做出太阳的形状，方凯跟随老师一起哼唱早安歌，并做出相应的动作，唱完儿歌时，方凯和同伴一起笑着拍手并发出“耶耶耶”的声音，当老师说：“早安，小朋友们。”方凯回应老师说：“早安，liuliu。”之后，老师出示幼儿的图片进行点名，当老师拿出方凯的图片问幼儿：“这是谁啊？林？”方凯笑着举手说：“林方凯，到。”老师将方凯的照片递给他后，方凯将自己的照片粘贴到了出席板上。在老师拿出其他幼儿的照片时，方凯也会跟随老师一起说出其他同伴的名字，并与朋友说早安。
interpretation: 方凯能够愿意加入晨间活动，在唱早安歌时，能够展现出高兴的情绪，在老师点名时，方凯能够给予老师回应，并能够愿意与其他同伴进行互动，说早安等。

title: 小小设计师——彩纸服装设计
description:
教师提供了多种彩纸、剪刀、胶水及黑色画纸作为背景，引导幼儿以“设计服装”为主题进行创作。教师还通过展示范例激发幼儿的创作兴趣，并给予灵活的创作空间。
 
  姝慧先观察了桌子上的材料，低声说：“so many colour paper ，how can I use it？”她看着其他小朋友的作品，有些困惑，但很快就询问教师：“吴老师，我可以用这个纸做裙子吗？”老师鼓励她自己尝试，姝慧点了点头，开始专注于自己的创作。姝慧开始尝试剪裁彩纸。她用手比划着说：“我要做long dress！”随后，她挑选了粉色，红色和蓝色的彩纸，把它们剪成了不同的形状，然后贴在黑纸上。过程中她对旁边的朋友说：“好看吗？”当姝慧完成裙子的部分后，她开始设计上衣。上衣设计好后，她看了看桌子上的材料问老师：“吴老师，我可以做鞋子吗？”老师说：“当然了，你是一个小设计师。”姝慧便又开始设计她的鞋子。
interpretation: 姝慧在活动中表现出强烈的好奇心和创造力，她对材料的使用和搭配有自己的见解，并通过语言表达了设计理念。通过教师提供的多种彩纸，设计出了独具特色的衣服。她在“小小设计师”活动中表现出主动探究的精神，深入了解了与设计相关的知识，并将所学内容与自己的创意相结合。这不仅让她学习了新的技能，还在实践中体验到了设计的乐趣和成就感。

title: 游戏-能干的小兔子
description:
教师向幼儿展示红萝卜教具，请幼儿说说这是谁最爱吃的食物。教师带领幼儿回顾兔子的外形特征以及兔子的动作。引领幼儿来到活动场地，将提前剪好的红萝卜散放在地上，教师带领幼儿玩游戏-能干的小兔子。
  于扬手挎篮子，认真寻找藏起来的胡萝卜。她专注地探索四周，仔细检查每个可能的藏匿点。当轮到她藏胡萝卜时，她特意选择隐秘的地方，并兴奋地告诉朋友们：“你们一定找不到！我藏得超级超级难！”当朋友们寻找时，她会在一旁偷偷观察，并适时给予提示，如：“再往前一点，你就会看到了！”当朋友找到她藏匿的胡罗卜时，她会为朋友拍手欢呼。
interpretation: 于扬在本次游戏中展现了强烈的好奇心和探索精神，她能够清晰表达自己的想法，并通过语言调动游戏氛围，使活动更具挑战性和趣味性。

认识人类行为对环境带来的后果：开始意识人与他们居住环境的关系。

title: 跳圈识字
description:
活动过程：教师出示生气、菲菲、我、画画等词语卡片，带幼儿复习这些词语，随后教师用呼啦圈布置了游戏场地，并将词语卡片分别放进每个呼啦圈中，幼儿站在中心，教师说开始时，幼儿分别向不同方向跳进呼啦圈中，并大声说出呼啦圈中的词语。
当轮到峻郗游戏时，峻郗和另一位朋友一起站在呼啦圈围的中心位置，当老师说：“开始！”峻郗单脚着地，开始跳，他看了看身边的呼啦圈，选择了其中一个跳了进去，然后他从地板上拿起呼啦圈中的词语卡片，并对着老师说：“伤心。”老师表示鼓励后，峻郗回到中心的位置，老师再次说：“开始”，峻郗先看了看身边的呼啦圈中的词语，并单脚跳进了其中一个呼啦圈，他再次捡起呼啦圈中的词语卡片，并说：“哭”。接着他再次回到中间位置，并继续游戏。
interpretation: 在整个活动中峻郗通过单脚跳跃完成指令，体现了身体协调性与大运动技能的发展，他能够准确的找到自己认识的词语并准确的读出“哭”、“伤心”等词语，展现了他良好的语言认读能力。他通过聆听老师指令并作出回应反馈，表现出对语言规则的理解。同时他能够遵守游戏规则，体现了规则意识和任务执行能力，在活动中他能够和朋友共同游戏并能够选择和朋友不同的呼啦圈，展现了他良好的社交能力。

title: 故事接龙游戏
description:
活动过程：教师请幼儿从神秘故事袋中随机抽取图片，鼓励他们仔细观察图片后用自己的语言进行讲述，然后请其他幼儿根据他们的讲述，参照故事中菲菲情绪变化的顺序为他们排序。
当轮到峻宇从神秘袋中抽取故事卡片时，峻宇接过神秘袋，一只手伸进神秘袋，并拿出一张故事卡片，他看了看故事卡片并说：“菲菲生气了，然后用力关上门，并跑了出去。”当所有的朋友都抽完故事卡片后，峻宇拿着自己的那张卡片和朋友们一起讲故事排序，并讲述出自己那张卡片的内容。
接着游戏进行到第二轮，再次轮到峻宇抽取卡片，峻宇抽出一张卡片，看着卡片上的内容说：“菲菲不生气了，她走回了家。” 最后所有的朋友都抽取卡片后，峻宇再次和朋友们进行了故事排序，并说出了自己卡片上的故事内容。
interpretation: 在整个活动过程中，峻宇能够用完整的句式”菲菲生气了，然后用力关上门，并跑了出去“等展现了他较强的语言组织能力和词汇量，他能够清晰描述故事情节，可见他熟悉故事内容，能够记住故事内容。在集体排序中他能够找到自己的正确的位置，说明他逻辑思维清晰，同时他能与同伴协作完成任务可见他良好的社交能力和团队协作精神。

title: 故事接龙游戏
description:
活动过程：教师请幼儿从神秘故事袋中随机抽取图片，鼓励他们仔细观察图片后用自己的语言进行讲述，然后请其他幼儿根据他们的讲述，参照故事中菲菲情绪变化的顺序为他们排序。
当轮到诚越从神秘袋中抽取故事卡片时，诚越接过神秘袋，一只手伸进神秘袋，并拿出一张故事卡片，他看了看故事卡片，想了想，老师说：“诚越你来讲述下图片上的内容。”诚越听到后说：“菲菲跑出去，然后她走啊走。”说完后他看了看老师，老师表示赞扬，当所有的朋友都抽完故事卡片后，诚越拿着自己的那张卡片和朋友们一起讲故事排序。
接着游戏进行到第二轮，再次轮到诚越抽取卡片，诚越抽出一张卡片，看着卡片上的内容说：“菲菲很生气，她大喊。” 最后所有的朋友都抽取卡片后，诚越再次和朋友们进行了故事排序，并在老师的提醒下说出了自己卡片上的故事内容。
interpretation: 在整个活动过程中，诚越能够用完整的句式”菲菲跑出去，她走啊走““菲菲很生气，她大喊”等展现了他较强的语言组织能力和词汇量，他能够清晰描述故事情节，可见他熟悉故事内容，能够记住故事内容。在集体排序中他能够找到自己的正确的位置，说明他逻辑思维清晰。

title: Work Sample #1: Fan-tastic New Year!
description:
To foster children’s creative expression and enhance their fine motor skills, the children were invited to create their version of a Chinese New Year fan. They used different materials such as crepe papers, pompoms, markers, pipe cleaners and straws to express their ideas. While creating a functional and decorative fan, this activity also aimed to foster cultural awareness.

Avery shared, "I draw a tree in a house."

learning_goals.title: Experiment with a variety of techniques (e.g: crayon etching, cotton-bud painting, and splatter painting).
Experiment with elements to create artworks (e.g: mix paints to get different colours or shades of colours, use shapes and lines to create patterns).
Describe and explain ideas in their artworks (e.g: lines to represent motion).

title: 动物形状配对
description: 在区角活动中，老师为幼儿介绍不同的动物以及动物形状配对的玩具，并鼓励幼儿尝试将不同形状的小动物头与身体进行配对。方凯看到后便走了过来，方凯拿起地毯上的椭圆形大象，老师问道：“你拿的是什么动物？应该跟哪一个动物配对？”方凯看了看墙上的小动物后，便将椭圆形大象头粘贴到了对应的大象身上，老师表扬说：“方凯很棒，这是大象。”方凯听了便跟随老师一起说出：“大象。”之后方凯又继续粘贴了猴子和斑马，方凯粘贴完斑马后，指着斑马对老师说：“zebra。”老师说：“嗯，是的，华文是斑马。”方凯跟随老师说出了：“斑马。”老师表扬说：“方凯很棒，能够正确的进行配对。”方凯全部完成配对后，再次跟随老师逐一说出动物的名称，完成活动。
interpretation: 方凯能够根据动物的颜色，以及不同的形状等完成正确的动物形状配对，并能够跟随老师说出不同的动物名称等。

learning_goals.title: Foster problem solving during independent and group activities (puzzles, sequencing activities etc.) 通过拼图游戏、排序等活动，初步培养解决问题的能力。
Foster sustained involvement and concentration in chosen activities 通过幼儿所选择的活动，培养持续参与和专注力。
Foster an understanding of the connection between pictures, objects and print 培养对于图片、物体与词语之间关系的理解。

domains.title: The Thinking and Communicating Self 思考与沟通

title: Nature Size Parade
description:
After collecting nature items at D'Resort, the children were invited to talk about them and sort them by size—big and small. Naomi and her friends were holding their own nature items and taking turns to share about them. When it was Naomi's turn, she showed the flower to everyone, and then I invited her to describe it. Naomi looked at her flower and began describing it by saying, "The flower is yellow," and she added "White" when she saw the inner part of the flower. I asked Naomi how many petals there were, and she counted the petals and told me, "Five."

After describing the flower, Naomi and her friend were invited to put together their nature items and observe which ones were small and which ones were big. Without any hesitation, Naomi and her friend said that the yellow flower was big and the purple flower was small.

Naomi displayed strong observation skills and social-emotional competence. She was able to articulate her thoughts and feelings about the nature item with clarity. Naomi demonstrated confidence in sharing her observations and participated actively in the sorting activity, showing her ability to engage in cooperative play and express herself effectively.

learning_goals.title: Observe and talk about living things, non-living things, places and events.

title: Funny Nature Hair
description:
The children visited Pasir Ris Park, and as part of their activity, they were invited to create art using dried leaves and twigs to represent the hair on their portrait. While Naomi was busy placing the leaves on her portrait, I asked her how it was going. She shared with me, "I put leaves as my hair." I then asked her what the colours of her hair were now. Naomi replied, saying, "Yellow and brown," while pointing to the leaves that were yellow and brown. Naomi continued adding some twigs and told me, "I put this because my hair is black."

Naomi was happy while creating her funny nature-inspired hair portrait. She demonstrated social-emotional competence by expressing her creativity and joy in the activity. Naomi was also able to communicate her ideas by sharing what natural materials she was using and describing the colours of the leaves. This shows her ability to express herself and engage in social interactions, reflecting her emotional awareness and confidence in the task.

learning_goals.title: Talk about their own artworks (e.g: what the artwork is about and the lines, colours and shapes used).

title: 户外散步
description: 在户外散步活动中，老师边走边唱儿歌：“走走走走走，我们小手拉小手，走走走走走，一起去散步。”泽阳听了后便笑着将手伸向老师说：“拉手。”老师拉起泽阳的手说：“泽阳真棒，你看黎莎还没有朋友一起拉手散步，你要不要和黎莎拉手一起散步啊？”泽阳一边看向莎莎，一边便将小手伸向黎莎并对她说：“莎莎。” 黎莎也将小手伸向泽阳，两人拉手后，笑着看着老师，老师鼓掌说：“哇，泽阳愿意跟朋友一起拉手散步，真棒！”。老师继续边走边唱儿歌“走走走走走”。泽阳也拉着莎莎的手，跟着老师一起笑着唱：“走走走走走走。”泽阳在散步过程中会与不同的朋友一起拉手散步，直到活动结束。
interpretation: 泽阳能够与老师建立良好的依恋关系，能够在老师的鼓励下，愿意参与散步活动，并愿意与同伴拉手，能够展示出高兴的情绪等。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (responding to their names) 培养自我意识，如：回应自己的名字等。
Foster sense of others (identifying others to their names) 培养对他人的认识，如：指认同伴等。
Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。
Foster social skills at all times – routines, interactions and activities 在常规活动、互动和体验中，初步培养社会交往技能。

domains.title: Psycho-social Self 心理-社会行为

title: Nature Photography
description:
At D'Resort, the children were exploring their surroundings. They were invited to look around and capture photos of things they could touch, smell, hear, and see. Max, holding a camera, walked around, and when he saw the ants, he called me over and said, "Teacher Chari, I saw ants. The ants are hiding." He led me and showed me where the ants were. I asked Max, "What do you observe about the ants?" Max said, "Those are black ants. They are walking very fast." I then told Max to capture a photo of the ants. Max walked around again and took photos of the flowers. Max shared with me that there were so many flowers in the garden. I asked Max how he felt when he saw the flowers. Max smiled as a response.

Throughout the activity, Max displayed self-awareness and strong confidence in exploring his environment using his senses, as well as expressing his observations and thoughts clearly, which shows his ability to articulate his feelings and ideas appropriately.

learning_goals.title: Use senses and simple tools (e.g: magnifying viewer/glass, mirror, pulley, magnet, torchlight) to examine living and non-living things.

title: Reach for the Star
description:
The activity "Reach for the Star" was introduced to the children to help them demonstrate body movements and coordination. Max began the activity by stepping and hopping over the obstacles. Once he reached the last obstacle, Max jumped very high to reach the star. He raised his right hand as he jumped again and touched the star.

Max demonstrated body movements and coordination as he participated in the activity. Self-confidence was observed, as Max confidently jumped and reached for the star, indicating a strong belief in his abilities. He also showed positive emotional involvement and enjoyment.

learning_goals.title: Coordinate movements to perform simple tasks.

title: 舀取鸡蛋
description: 在区角活动中，老师带领幼儿一起寻找鸡蛋，并鼓励幼儿将鸡窝里的鸡蛋转移到鸡蛋盒里，老师为幼儿示范后，为幼儿提供了不同的汤匙，泽阳看了看所有的汤匙，拿取了较大的汤匙，然后蹲在了装满鸡蛋的鸡窝旁边，用右手握住汤匙的尾部，眼睛看向鸡窝里的鸡蛋，泽阳向外向上旋转右手手腕，将鸡蛋舀取到了汤匙里。之后，泽阳眼睛一直盯着汤匙里的鸡蛋，并向右转动身体，面朝鸡蛋盒的方向，他向内向下旋转右手手腕，使汤匙里的鸡蛋掉落到鸡蛋盒里的其中一个洞中，完成了鸡蛋的运输，之后泽阳持续的尝试用不同大小的汤匙运输鸡蛋，直到将大部分的鸡蛋都运输到了鸡蛋盒里。
interpretation: 泽阳能够手眼协调的使用汤匙转移鸡蛋，有较好的协调性和手眼协调能力。

learning_goals.title: Foster fine motor development ( pick up objects using pincer grasp, hold crayon to scribble, fasten/unfasten zippers/buttons, screw, unscrew bottle caps, etc.) 发展精细动作，如：用大拇指、食指及中指（三指）抓物品、拉拉链、扣纽扣、拧瓶盖等。
Develop eye-hand coordination (roll a ball, pick up soft blocks and stack, self-feed, put simple things together and take them apart) 发展手眼协调能力，如：滚球，叠放软积木，喂食，把简单玩具连在一起再拆开等。

title: 和朋友拉手唱歌
description: 在音乐律动活动中，老师带领幼儿一起跳舞，老师播放儿歌《划小船》，并鼓励道：“小朋友们找一个朋友一起划小船吧，黎莎听到后看了看周围的朋友，当她看到旁边的朋友们开始拉手划小船时，老师问她：“黎莎，你想要和哪个朋友一起划小船呢？”黎莎看了看老师没有回答。这时，坐在黎莎旁边的方凯向黎莎伸出了双手，并对黎莎说：“拉手。”老师协助询问黎莎：“你想要跟方凯一起拉手划小船么？”听完，黎莎眼睛看向方凯，笑着将身体转向方凯，跟方凯一起拉手，面对面的随音乐划小船。两人拉手一起前后摇晃身体，当老师说：“划呀划呀划呀划呀，划到哪里去？”的时候，黎莎和方凯松开了双手，看着彼此笑了起来，之后两个人再次拉手划小船，音乐结束时，老师拍手说：“哇，黎莎和方凯一起划小船，真棒！”。黎莎看着老师和方凯一起笑着鼓掌。
interpretation: 黎莎能够在老师的引导下和同伴一起拉手，随音乐互动，能够愿意加入活动，并展现出高兴的情绪。

learning_goals.title: Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。
Foster social skills at all times – routines, interactions and activities 在常规活动、互动和体验中，初步培养社会交往技能。
Foster sense of well-being 通过建立与培育师和同伴间的良好关系，初步培养幼儿的幸福感。

domains.title: Psycho-social Self 心理-社会行为

title: Numicon Size Tower
description:
The Numicon toys were given to the children, and they were invited to create their own tower by placing and lining them up on the floor. Max chose and took some Numicon pieces. At first, he was figuring out how to build a tower, and after some time, he tried to stand the Numicon pieces together to form the tower. Max faced difficulty standing the Numicon pieces, but he didn't give up. I suggested to Max that he could line up the toys on the floor, and Max responded by saying, "I want to make a tall tower." Max held the pieces of Numicon and shared with me that it was his tower, and that he had used different colours of Numicon. I asked him what I could do in his tower, and he said, "There is a big swimming pool inside," and, "You can swim inside."

At the end of our conversation, I asked Max if he liked his tower. Max replied with a "yes" and added that it was because there was a swimming pool inside.

Max displayed perseverance as he worked to stand the Numicon pieces to create his tower. Max was also engaged in social interaction with his teacher by sharing and describing his creation, using different colours of Numicon and explaining what could be found inside the tower.

learning_goals.title: Be aware of nature, objects, and art works around them.

title: Sorting Treasure Hunt
description:
A box filled with treasures was presented to the children, and they were invited to sort the treasures by colors or shapes. After demonstrating an example of what to do, the children began sorting the treasures.

When I called on Max, he stood up and looked into the box to choose a treasure. He selected the yellow duck and showed it to us. I asked Max to share something about the duck, and he responded, "It's a yellow duck." Then I asked him where he wanted to put it— in the box for colour or in the box for shape. Max decided to place it in the box for colour. I asked him why, and he replied, "Because the duck is yellow."

Max displayed his understanding of sorting, confidently making the connection between the colour of the duck and the category he chose. Self-awareness and confidence were observed as Max showed awareness of his choices and actions when he selected the yellow duck and explained his reasoning for placing it in the colour box.

learning_goals.title: Sort two categories of objects (e.g: balls/books)

title: 拆红包
description: 在新年活动中，老师出示不同样式的新年红包，让幼儿进行探索，黎莎看到后便走了过来，老师将红包递给黎莎，并向黎莎介绍红包以及示范怎样打开红包，怎么将物品放入和取出，黎莎看了看便从盒子里拿出一个红包，左手握住红包底部，右手拇指、食指捏住红包开口处的其中一侧，将红包口打开，之后左手拇指、食指、中指从地上拿取一片圆形木头（做金币），眼睛看向红包口，左手将圆形木头放到了红包里。完成后，老师鼓励黎莎将红包里的物品取出来，黎莎左手握住红包口，右手捏住红包的一侧纸，向外撕拉，将红包撕开。最后，她用左手握住红包上端，眼睛看向红包底部的物品，右手将红包里的物品逐一的全部取了出来。之后，黎莎重复进行装红包和拆红包的活动，直到活动结束。
interpretation: 黎莎能够手眼协调的往红包里放入物品，并能双手协调的将红包撕开，取出红包里的物品。

learning_goals.title: Foster fine motor development ( pick up objects using pincer grasp, hold crayon to scribble, fasten/unfasten zippers/buttons, screw, unscrew bottle caps, etc.) 发展精细动作，如：用大拇指、食指及中指（三指）抓物品、拉拉链、扣纽扣、拧瓶盖等。
Develop eye-hand coordination (roll a ball, pick up soft blocks and stack, self-feed, put simple things together and take them apart) 发展手眼协调能力，如：滚球，叠放软积木，喂食，把简单玩具连在一起再拆开等。

title: Things I can do now
description:
The journal question was, "What can you do now that you couldn't do when you were a baby?" The children were invited to share their thoughts and ideas. Max expressed his fondness for Paw Patrol by saying, "I like Paw Patrol. I watch Paw Patrol." I asked Max, "How do you know about Paw Patrol?" He paused and thought for a moment, and after some time, I asked him if he was watching Paw Patrol on television. Max exclaimed, "Yes."

Following this, Max and the other children were invited to draw in their journals what they had shared. Max made markings in his journal and proudly told me that it was the Paw Patrol character.

At the end of the activity, I asked Max if he liked what he had drawn, and he smiled in response.

Max demonstrated enthusiasm as he eagerly shared his thoughts during our discussion. He was able to use lines and shapes to represent and express himself through his drawing. Social interaction was observed throughout the activity as Max engaged with his teacher.

learning_goals.title: Use letter-like shapes, symbols and letters to convey meaning.

title: Obstacle
description:
The obstacle course was set up, and the children were invited to explore it. Ethan began by carefully stepping on each cone and stone, taking his time to maintain his balance. Once he reached the end of the stones, he jumped and continued walking towards the arch. He climbed onto the arch slowly, making sure not to lose his balance. When he reached the other side, Ethan confidently descended, proud of his accomplishment. Next, he carefully climbed down the arch, ensuring it remained steady.

Ethan displayed great confidence in his abilities and finished the obstacle course with impressive body control and balance.

learning_goals.title: Move with balance and control.

title: Nature Photography
description:
At D'Resort, the children were exploring their surroundings. They were invited to look around and capture photos of things they could touch, smell, hear, and see. Ethan, holding a camera, walked around, and when he saw the red chili plant, he immediately took a photo of it. I asked him, "What is that, Ethan?" He replied, "I saw this," referring to the red chili. I asked him what colour the chili was, and he replied, "Red." Ethan walked around again and captured a photo of a pink flower he saw. I asked him what he could say about the flower. Ethan said, "The flower is pink." I then asked, "What is the smell of the flower?" Ethan shook his head, as the flower had no strong smell.

Throughout the activity, Ethan displayed self-awareness and strong confidence in exploring his environment using his senses, as well as expressing his observations and thoughts clearly, which shows his ability to articulate his feelings and ideas appropriately.

learning_goals.title: Use senses and simple tools (e.g: magnifying viewer/glass, mirror, pulley, magnet, torchlight) to examine living and non-living things.

title: Numicon Colour Match and Sort
description:
A Numicon set was introduced to the children, and the concept of sorting was explained. An example was demonstrated to help them understand the activity. Ethan and his friends were invited to sort the Numicon toys by colour. Ethan selected the plate with green paper, indicating that he needed to look for the green Numicon toys. Once the Numicon toys were laid out in front of them, Ethan and his friends began sorting. Ethan carefully searched for the green Numicon pieces and placed them on his plate. As his friends were with him, Ethan waited for his turn to take the toys.

Ethan displayed an enthusiastic attitude while doing the activity and demonstrated a clear understanding of how to sort the toys by colour.

Ethan’s careful search for the green Numicon pieces suggests self-regulation, as he is able to focus and take his time to complete the task accurately, despite the presence of his peers.

learning_goals.title: Sort one category of objects from an assortment of objects.

title: Things I can do now
description:
The journal question was: "What can you do now that you couldn't do when you were a baby?" The children were invited to share their thoughts and ideas. Ethan, along with his peers, shared about their favorite toys and television shows they enjoy watching, indicating that they are now able to play and watch TV. Ethan said, "I like dinosaurs," and I asked him, "How do you know about dinosaurs?" He paused and thought for a moment. After some time, I asked him if he had been watching a program about dinosaurs, to which he nodded in agreement.

Following this, Ethan and the other children were invited to draw in their journals what they had shared. Ethan made markings in his journal and proudly told me that it was a dinosaur. He pointed to various parts of his drawing, indicating the eyes, sharp teeth, and tail of the dinosaur.

At the end of the activity, I asked Ethan if he liked what he had drawn, and he smiled in response.

Ethan demonstrated enthusiasm as he eagerly shared his thoughts during our discussion. He was able to use lines and shapes to represent and express himself through his drawing. Social interaction and emotional regulation were observed throughout the activity as Ethan interacted with his teacher and took time to think about what he would say.

learning_goals.title: Use letter-like shapes, symbols and letters to convey meaning.

title: Music Medley
description:
Ethan and his peers were exploring the scarf and ribbon, following the beat of the song introduced by the teacher. Ethan was holding a scarf and moving it up and down. He lifted the scarf to observe its slow movements in the air.

At the end of the activity, a ribbon was given to them. While holding the ribbon, Ethan waved it at me and said, "Rainbow!" He moved it side to side quickly when the beat of the music became faster.

The activity exposed Ethan to musical instruments and body movements that accompany music. Ethan was able to move around and use the musical materials provided to him.

Ethan actively participated in the activity, interacting with the music and the materials. His engagement showed a positive emotional attitude toward the activity.

learning_goals.title: Create movement using imagination in response to music.

title: Five Senses
description:
The 'Talking Tub' activity was introduced to the children, and each child was invited to select an object. Liv took a photo of ear and she happily shared, “I got ear.” Liv and Gemma showed the photo of ear and mouth. I asked Liv, “How many ears do we have?” Liv answered “I have two ears.”. I asked everyone, “What is the use of ears?” Liv said, “to hear”

After discussing body parts, the children were encouraged to explore the other objects in the tub. A tissue with a mint scent was handed to each child. Liv smelled the tissue and made a disgusted face. I asked her, "You don't like the smell?" Liv shook her head and said, "I don't like the smell."
At the end of the activity, I asked the children about the five senses. When I asked about the body parts we use to hear, Liv stood up and pointed to the photo of an ear.

Liv was actively engaged in discussions and exploration of the objects in the tub. She observed the scent of the tissue and expressed her preference through facial expressions and verbal communication. Liv demonstrated her ability to recognize and express her emotions in a social setting by showing her personal preference. She expressed her dislike for the mint-scented tissue by making a disgusted face and verbally saying, "I don't like the smell.”

learning_goals.title: Observe and talk about living things, non-living things, places and events.

title: Match and Celebrate Pairs
description:
A box with different objects was presented to the children, and the concept of pairing was explained by demonstrating an example. Each child was invited to choose the item they liked, and Liv chose a cup. I asked Liv, "What is a cup for? How do we use it?" Liv demonstrated how she uses a cup to drink.

I called Liv to stand in front and told her to see who among her friends was holding the item that could be paired with her cup. Without hesitation, Liv said it was Naomi. Liv and Naomi stood next to each other and demonstrated how a cup and a pitcher are used as a pair.

Liv displayed an understanding of the concept of pairing related objects. She demonstrated an enthusiastic attitude and interacted positively with her teachers and friends.

Liv interacted positively with Naomi and I. This positive engagement reflects her ability to communicate effectively and build relationships.

learning_goals.title: Pair related objects (e.g: a cup to a saucer, a fork to a spoon)

title: Self-Portrait
description:
The children were invited to create a self-portrait by drawing their faces and using playdough. Liv chose a green marker to draw her face. While adding details to her drawing, she shared her thoughts by saying, "My eye here," "This is my face," and "I have long hair." She then manipulated the playdough and attached it to the head of her portrait. I asked her, "Is that your hair?" and she said yes.

Once Liv had finished making her self-portrait, I asked her if she liked it. She smiled sweetly and posed for me to take her photo with her portrait.

Liv displayed confidence and self-awareness in creating her own portrait. She was able to identify her drawing, and using simple sentences, she shared her thoughts clearly.

learning_goals.title: Use expanded vocabulary and language for a variety of purposes.

title: Obstacle Course
description: The children were introduced to an obstacle course that included tasks like balancing, alternating feet, climbing slopes, stepping down stairs, and crawling under barriers. As they navigated the course, they developed their balance, coordination, and strength, while also practicing problem-solving and perseverance in a fun and engaging way.
interpretation:
Ethan demonstrated strong adaptability and confidence as he navigated through the obstacle course with minimal guidance. Despite a slight fall on the taller steps, he quickly adjusted by using his arms to balance himself. He continued determined, trying the stepping stones again after a bit of encouragement. Ethan showed great courage in facing new obstacles, particularly those involving heights. When stepping down stairs, he bent lower and placed his hand on the side of the steps to maintain balance and prevent falling.


As Ethan crawled under the lower bridge, he saw his peers moving slower. He pressed his palms and knees into the mat for balance and lifted his head to look around, careful not to bump into anyone. His ability to adjust his movements and problem-solve shows his growing confidence and physical awareness as he continued to make progress through the course at his own pace.

learning_goals.title: Be aware of what the body can do and develop their locomotor skills.

title: Obstacle Course
description: The children were introduced to an obstacle course that included tasks like balancing, alternating feet, jumping across hoops, stepping up stairs, and crawling through the tunnels. As they navigated the course, they developed their balance, coordination, and strength, while also practicing problem-solving and perseverance in a fun and engaging way.
interpretation:
Yi Xuan showed growing adaptability and confidence while navigating the obstacle course with minimal guidance. After slightly missing the first few alternating foot steps, Yi Xuan observed the left-right pattern and adjusted her movements, extending her legs further to reach each step. She demonstrated persistence and courage, particularly when tackling obstacles like jumping across hoops. She used her hands to help pull herself up and secure her footing, while also staying mindful of the hula hoops to avoid falling.


When crawling through the tunnel, Yi Xuan noticed that her peers were moving faster. She adapted by bending her body higher to make herself more comfortable and used her knees to push herself faster. Her ability to adjust her movements and problem-solve shows her growing confidence and physical awareness, as she continued to make progress through the course at her own pace.

title: Obstacle Course
description: The activity "Reach for the Star" was introduced to the children to help them demonstrate body movements and coordination.
interpretation:
Elliott participated eagerly in the 'Reaching for the Stars' activity. When it was his turn, he immediately approached the star, but was guided and prompted to first try the stepping stones. Observing the stones carefully, he used his eyes and legs to coordinate, alternating his feet from left to right as he moved across. Initially, he took one step at a time with his right foot, but progressed to alternating his feet for the last stone.


Upon reaching the jumping station, he took a step forward, bent his body almost fully, and then used his legs to spring upward, stretching his arms to reach the star. Although he only tapped the side of the star, he was encouraged to try again. His eyes tracked the star's movement, following it from left to right. Elliott then positioned himself and made another attempt to jump and reach the star. This shows that Elliott displayed good coordination and focus. He followed instructions, improved his balance on the stepping stones, and adjusted his movements to reach the star. His persistence and attention to detail were evident as he made efforts to improve with each attempt.

learning_goals.title: Be aware of what the body can do and develop their locomotor skills.

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
艾雯小朋友的作品是一个以纸盘为基础制作的生气表情脸谱，整体造型简单但极具表现力。
主要使用了一次性纸盘作为脸部基础。通过黑色纸剪裁出眉毛、眼睛和嘴巴，并粘贴在纸盘上，形成五官。绿色的小绒球被巧妙地用作鼻子，增添了趣味性。眉毛呈斜向下倾斜的粗黑条状，表现出生气时紧皱的眉头。
圆形黑色眼睛简单直接，增强了表情的清晰度。嘴巴采用下弯的弧形设计，展现出生气或不满的情绪，颜色搭配简洁明了，黑色与白色形成强烈对比，突出了面部表情的特点。绿色的鼻子点缀使作品更具童趣和创意，增加了视觉上的亮点。纸盘边缘有均匀的裁剪痕迹，可能是为了增强质感或便于固定。
总体来看，艾雯小朋友的作品成功地表现出了“生气”的情绪，具有强烈的情感表达能力，同时展现了孩子的创造力和动手能力。这种艺术活动不仅锻炼了孩子的手工技能，还帮助他们更好地理解和表达情绪。

语言学习成果（写）- 写前准备：喜欢涂涂画画，能画出较直、横的线，基本能控制笔的方向。
感知和描述艺术的基本元素：线条、颜色、形状、质地。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
家悦小朋友的作品是一个表达“高兴”情绪的表情脸谱，采用简单但富有表现力的设计方式，成功传递了开心的情绪。
他主要使用了一次性纸盘作为脸部基础，白色背景使五官更清晰。
通过黑色纸剪裁出眉眼和嘴巴，并粘贴在纸盘上，形成完整的面部表情。
选用一个红色的小绒球作为鼻子，为作品增添了活泼的色彩点缀。眉眼采用上扬弧形设计，形成“笑眼”，给人一种愉悦和开心的感觉。嘴巴呈上弯的弧形，展现出开怀的笑容，使整个表情更加生动。红色鼻子不仅增加了色彩的对比度，也让脸谱显得更富童趣。他在颜色搭配简单但有效，黑白对比突出表情特征，红色点缀增强趣味性。作品整体造型简洁而富有感染力，成功传达了高兴的情绪。纸盘边缘有均匀的剪裁痕迹，可能是为了便于操作或增强手感。
家悦小朋友的脸谱作品充分展现了“高兴”的表情，设计简洁但具有较强的情感表现力。通过弧形的笑眼和微笑的嘴巴，成功营造出开心、愉快的氛围。这不仅锻炼了孩子的手工能力，也帮助他们通过艺术方式表达情绪，增强对表情与情感的理解。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
靖炜小朋友的作品是一个表现“高兴”情绪的表情脸谱，整体造型简洁大方，富有艺术感。
他以一次性纸盘作为脸谱的基础，白色背景突出了五官的颜色和形状。
黑色剪纸制作的眼睛呈细长形，带有弧度，增添了一种优雅的神韵。
选用了红色的小绒球作为鼻子，使整体形象更加生动有趣。嘴巴采用鲜艳的红色剪纸，呈现出上扬的微笑，突出了愉快的情绪。
他把眼睛设计成细长的弧形，呈现出一种温和、微笑的神态，让整体表情显得柔和而开心。嘴巴的弧度明显上扬，展现出喜悦和满足的表情，使作品充满欢乐感。红色鼻子的点缀增加了趣味性，同时使整体色彩搭配更加协调。他的作品颜色对比鲜明，黑色的眼睛、红色的嘴巴和鼻子，在白色底色上形成了清晰的视觉效果。造型简单但富有表现力，成功传递了“高兴”的情绪。作品整体风格优雅，眼睛的设计赋予脸谱一种温柔、快乐的特质。
靖炜小朋友的脸谱作品以简洁的设计成功表达了“高兴”的情绪，眼睛的形状使作品具有独特的个性，嘴巴的微笑则传递出温暖和欢乐的氛围。这样的艺术创作不仅培养了孩子的动手能力，也帮助他们通过视觉艺术来理解和表达情感。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
楷钧小朋友制作的生气表情脸谱作品非常有创意，充分展现了情绪的表达能力和动手能力。
他的作品采用了白色纸盘作为脸的基础，利用简单的剪裁和粘贴技法来塑造表情。五官的设计使用了黑色纸片和一颗黄色小球，构造简洁但表达明确。他把眉毛贴成两条黑色纸条呈向下倾斜的“八”字形状，表现出愤怒的情绪。两个黑色圆形，简洁明了的做眼睛，凸显了情绪的集中表达。他用黄色的小球做鼻子增添立体感，同时让作品更具趣味性。他把嘴巴贴成弯曲向下的黑色弧线，清楚地表现出生气或不满的表情。他的作品色彩简单但对比强烈，黑色五官与白色底板形成鲜明的视觉效果，使表情更加突出。纸盘边缘的剪裁增加了一些装饰感，使整体造型更有层次。通过动手制作，培养了他的手工能力、创造力和对情绪的认知表达。
整体而言，楷钧小朋友的生气表情脸谱作品非常生动，通过简单的材料和构图精准地传达了“生气”的情绪，是一件富有创意和表现力的儿童手工艺术作品。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
灵昀小朋友的开心表情脸谱作品生动有趣，充分展现了快乐的情绪表达。
她的作品使用白色纸盘作为脸的基础，简单但富有表现力。五官由黑色纸片和一个粉色小球组成，运用了剪裁和粘贴技法，使表情更加立体生动。
她把 眉毛贴成两条黑色弯曲的眉毛，呈现出自然的弧度，增加了表情的亲和力。一只眼睛为弯弯的弧形，另一只眼睛呈“眯眼”状态，类似眨眼的效果，使得脸谱充满活力和调皮感。她使用粉色小球作为鼻子，增加了一抹温暖的色彩，同时提升了作品的立体感。大大的弧形微笑，向上弯曲，展现出明显的开心情绪，传递出快乐的氛围。
她的作品色彩对比鲜明，黑色的五官与白色纸盘形成强烈对比，粉色鼻子作为点缀，增添趣味。通过简单的线条和形状，准确表现出开心和调皮的表情。整体观感轻松愉悦，感受到快乐情绪。她的作品不仅锻炼了灵昀的动手能力，还帮助她通过艺术表达自己的情绪。这样的手工活动能增强她对情绪的认知，引导她理解和表现不同的情感状态。
灵昀小朋友的开心表情脸谱充满欢乐气息，表达生动，是一件优秀的儿童手工艺术作品。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
书雅小朋友作品使用了白色纸盘作为基础，并通过剪纸与粘贴的方式呈现了一张笑脸。五官的设计夸张且生动，充分展现了儿童对表情的理解与表达。
她在组织五官时，眉毛采用黑色剪纸制作，呈现上扬的弧度，表现出开心和愉悦的情绪。眼睛以半弧形的剪纸表现闭合的微笑眼神，传递出愉快和满足的感觉。鼻子使用了粉色的小棉球，增添了作品的立体感，同时增加了可爱的元素。嘴巴选用黑色剪纸制作了一个张开的笑嘴，使整体表情更具感染力，给人一种热情友好的感觉。她的作品的颜色较为简洁，以黑色、白色和粉色为主，黑色用于五官，粉色则点缀在鼻子上，既增强了视觉对比，又赋予了作品可爱和童趣感。整体作品表达了欢乐、友好和幸福的情绪，反映了她在创作过程中愉悦的心理状态。她通过简单的形状和夸张的表情传递了积极的情感，展现了孩子对世界的美好想象和对快乐的理解。从粘贴的精细程度来看，她具备一定的动手能力，能较好地控制材料，并有意识地安排五官的位置，表现出较强的空间感知能力和创造力。
书雅小朋友的作品构思清晰，表现力强，通过简单的材料创造出了富有感染力的表情脸谱，展现了她对情绪的理解以及初步的艺术表达能力。该作品不仅反映了孩子积极阳光的内心世界，也锻炼了她的手部精细动作和美术创造能力，值得肯定和鼓励。

title: Rainbow Sorting Garden
description:
The children had the opportunity to participate in an activity in which they were provided with matching “flower pots” labelled by two attributes, such as 'red circles', ' pink circles', 'blue triangles', 'yellow triangles', etc.

Kelsey began by selecting two coloured papers of varying attributes and said, "I take pink circle and yellow triangle because I like pink and yellow." Next, she drew various flower designs on it. 

After drawing, the children placed their flower drawings in a small container. When it was Kelsey's turn to “plant" two flowers in the corresponding pots, she picked a yellow triangle paper and placed it in the middle pot. Next, she grabbed a yellow triangle from the container before placing it into the first pot. She then said, "I am done!"
interpretation: Through this activity, Kelsey can confidently sort objects according to two attributes; the colour and shape of the paper cutouts. In addition, Kelsey can also take responsibility for her own actions, such as learning to make choices independently.

learning_goals.title: Sort objects according to two attributes (e.g: colour and shape, colour and size).

title: 火山爆发实验
description:
在《菲菲生气了》绘本中，菲菲的愤怒情绪像火山一样爆发。教师让幼儿一起探索了火山，作为故事延伸的活动。老师拿出火山模型和实验材料，并介绍实验操作步骤，鼓励幼儿猜测会发生什么？随后，教师提供食用小苏打、醋和红色食用色素，让幼儿亲手操作并观察火山喷发的过程。通过活动激发幼儿对“火山爆发”实验操作的好奇心和兴趣，并通过实验操作，提问、探索等方式加深他们对火山爆发原理的理解。

在分享猜测实验会发生时，Varvara会积极地举手问：“The water will come out？”在实验开始前，她好奇地问老师红色的液体是什么？老师让她闻一闻，她闻后露出有点抗拒的表情。老师告诉她那是“醋”，她便跟着老师重复了一遍。随后，她小心翼翼地将红色的醋倒入火山模型中，手部动作稳定而谨慎，一直看着模型观察会发生什么？当火山“喷发”时，她兴奋地笑了起来，发出“哇”的惊叹声，并笑着大声地说出“火山”这个词。
interpretation: 通过观察可以发现，Varvara对实验过程充满好奇，也会主动猜测实验结果。尤其是在亲手操作时表现得十分专注。她不仅认真地完成每个步骤，还积极参与互动。此外，她愿意尝试用华语与老师交流，她能用简单的华语描述自己的观察，如“火山”，“红色”，展现了她对实验的理解以及表达。

learning_goals.title: 表现对事物奥秘的好奇心和兴趣：提问并探究问题的答案。

title: 问卷调查-生气了该怎么办
description:
幼儿阅读了绘本《菲菲生气了》后，教师引导他们思考问题，并通过不同方式获取信息来寻找答案。随后，幼儿进行了一次调查访问，走到校园里向老师和阿姨们提问，询问他们生气时的应对方法，并将得到的答案记录在问卷上，整理每个人的消气方法。

雯禧在活动中始终表现得很积极，她会主动举手，表示想向阿姨或老师们提问。当轮到她发问时，她需要老师在旁引导，例如，老师会提醒她：“可以问阿姨会因为什么事情而生气？”她会先复述问题，然后向阿姨提问。聆听回答时，她专注地思考，并用绘画的方式将听到的内容记录在纸上。当老师问她画了什么时，她用英文回答：“angry cannot hit people。”
interpretation: 雯禧愿意主动表达，并积极参与问卷调查，能够用绘画的方式将听到的答案记录在问卷上。虽然在提问时仍需老师协助，但她能通过聆听、绘画和语言表达来记录信息，一直专注在调查任务中，当他不会用华文表达时，也能继续尝试，表示她有思考，并有专注性。未来可以鼓励她多尝试用华语沟通，以提升语言运用能力。

learning_goals.title: 通过绘画或书写作简单的观测记录：用说、画、写的方式来记录他们观察和调查发现的结果。

title: 生气的脸
description:
阅读绘本《菲菲生气了》后，教师提供了不同颜色的纸、剪刀、胶水和马克笔。活动开始前，幼儿先观察“生气”时的五官变化，并尝试用表情展现“生气”的样子。本次活动引导幼儿通过手工制作“生气的脸”，他们需要思考如何运用剪纸和拼贴来表现生气的情绪，如皱起的眉毛、张开的嘴巴等，同时练习剪贴技巧，提高手眼协调能力。

恩萱先用马克笔在纸上画出眼睛和嘴巴，再沿着线条剪下，然后用长条纸折出鼻子。剪裁时，她双手稳稳握住剪刀，动作熟练。在制作眉毛时，她尝试用黑色长条纸放在眼睛上方，反复调整后，最终选择了两个向内倾斜的眉毛角度，并贴上。完成拼贴后，她小心翼翼地撕下双面胶，将褐色纸贴在背景色纸上。最后，她剪裁出不同颜色的纸条，为作品设计了头发。作品完成后，她主动拿起作品向老师展示，说：“黄老师，你看！”当老师问她做了什么时，她回答：“生气。”老师再问她关于嘴巴为何要剪裁成那样？她便哈哈大笑起来，但并没有回应老师的问题。
interpretation: 恩萱通过作品表达了自己对“生气”情绪的理解。她将眉毛斜贴在眼睛上，展现了生气的表情，表明她能够通过艺术创作传达情感。从活动表现来看，恩萱在制作过程中展现了专注力和创造力，剪贴技巧比去年更为熟练。在语言表达方面，她能够用完整的句子描述自己的作品，并尝试用华语表达想法。

learning_goals.title: 通过艺术作品表达自己的经历和感受，如：个人活动、实地考察、旅游。

title: 新年手工 – 摇摆蛇
description:
在新年到来之际，教师和幼儿分享今年是蛇年。并鼓励幼儿们制作了一条彩色的摇摆蛇。教师提供了彩色纸、剪刀、胶水、纸盘和马克笔等材料。幼儿需要使用剪刀剪出不同形状的纸条，并运用自己想象力和创造力将这些纸条创作出小蛇手工。

Kiaan小心地使用剪刀剪裁彩色纸，确保每一片纸条的大小合适。在粘贴时，他首先把胶水涂抹在纸盘上，再根据自己的喜好将彩色纸条贴在上面。遇到没有粘好地方时，他会看着老师指着贴不好的地方说：“这个不可以”，然后自己重新涂抹胶水，确保纸条固定在纸盘上。过程中，老师注意到Kiaan在剪裁蛇头和眼睛时，虽然尝试按照线条剪裁，但最终没有完全做到。不过，Kiaan依然保持积极态度，对自己的作品感到非常满意。最后，他兴奋地展示自己的作品，并说：“我做好了！很多颜色的Snake。”
interpretation: 在制作过程中，Kiaan在制作过程中展现了专注力。他能用简单的句子表达了自己的观察，并解释了他制作的作品。当遇到不熟悉的词汇时，他会尝试用肢体动作表达，或者用英文来取代。他可以使用不同形状的纸条创作出蛇形手工。

learning_goals.title: 运用不同的素材实践创造艺术作品，如：混合颜料得到不同的颜色或色调、使用形状和线条创作图案。

title: 如果妈妈不在家
description:
在阅读《朱家故事》后，教师引导幼儿展开想象：如果妈妈不在家，自己的房间会变成什么样子？教师提供图画纸、马克笔和彩色笔等绘画工具，让幼儿将自己的想法记录下来，并在大家面前分享。

亮杰站在白板前，手里拿着麦克风，向朋友们介绍自己的作品。他的关注点不在“妈妈不在家”，而是“爸爸不在家”。他等到大家安静后，才开始说：“我的妈妈在家，是爸爸不在家。”然后，他笑着补充：“我的房间很 neat（整齐的意思），我和妈妈一起收。”接着，他指着自己的作品说：“这个是床，玩具在下面。”分享时，他的声音响亮，脸上带着笑容。
interpretation: 通过观察可以发现，亮杰会和妈妈一起收拾房间，体现了对家庭事务的积极参与和责任感。在与朋友分享作品时，他的声音洪亮且清晰，能够用华语流畅地表达自己的想法，展现了自信心。遇到不会的词汇时，他会自然地用英文代替，显示出他在语言表达上的灵活性。尽管他对主题的理解与原本的设定有所不同，但他能够清楚地解释自己的想法，并且积极分享。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能用完整的较连贯的语言说话。

title: 粘土手工-奥莉薇
description:
教师提供了多种彩色的轻粘土，引导幼儿以轻粘土捏制奥莉薇（小猪塑像和）和为小猪设计服装为主题进行创作。活动中她表现出极大的热情和对艺术创作的好奇心，并给予灵活的创作空间。

title: 作品介绍——纸杯兔子
description:
幼儿制作的纸杯兔子手工作品，通常结合简单的材料和有趣的创意，让孩子们在动手过程中感受乐趣，同时锻炼他们的手眼协调能力和创造力。以下是对纸杯兔子作品的介绍：
幼儿使用一次性纸杯（兔子的身体），作为兔子的身体，可根据喜好装饰颜色或图案。用卡纸剪出两只长长的兔耳朵，可以用粉色或其他颜色点缀耳朵内侧。
1.	粘贴五官：
o	眼睛可以用卡纸剪出圆形贴上，或直接画上去。
o	鼻子可以使用小绒球，增加立体感。
o	嘴巴可以用笔画上或剪纸贴出微笑的形状。
2.	添加兔子尾巴：在纸杯背面粘上一个小棉球作为兔子的尾巴，使整体造型更加可爱。
3.	个性装饰（可选）：可以给兔子加上胡须、蝴蝶结，甚至画上衣服或小配件，使其更具个性。
作品特点：
•	造型可爱：圆圆的纸杯身体搭配长耳朵和绒球鼻子，整体形象俏皮生动。
•	色彩丰富：孩子们可以自由搭配颜色，展现自己的创意。
•	简单易做：手工步骤简单，适合四岁幼儿操作，并能培养他们的精细动作能力。
•	表达个性：不同的表情、颜色和装饰让每只纸杯兔子都独一无二。
•	动手能力：通过剪、贴、画等步骤，锻炼幼儿的手部肌肉发展。
•	创造力：鼓励孩子发挥想象，自由设计兔子的表情和装饰。
•	情感表达：手工制作带来的成就感能增强孩子的自信心，同时也能培养他们对小动物的喜爱。
这类纸杯兔子手工活动，以实现“来创造“领域的“通过艺术品表现环境中的事物。”学习成果。   
不仅是孩子们的一次趣味创作体验，也能让他们在游戏中学习，提高他们的艺术感知和实践能力！

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：尝试用华语与人交谈。
语言学习成果（写）- 写前准备：喜欢涂涂画画，能画出较直、横的线，基本能控制笔的方向。
语言学习成果（写）- 笔画：基本能控制笔的方向，并写出一些基本的笔画。
使用多种材料以获得感知经验和探索体会。
感知和描述艺术的基本元素：线条、颜色、形状、质地。
运用不同的绘画工具（如：马克笔、蜡笔、颜料、粉笔、面团）进行艺术创作。
通过艺术品表现环境中的事物。

title: 粘土手工-奥莉薇
description:
教师提供了多种彩色的轻粘土，引导幼儿以轻粘土捏制奥莉薇（小猪塑像和）和为小猪设计服装为主题进行创作。活动中她表现出极大的热情和对艺术创作的好奇心，并给予灵活的创作空间。
 炜衡做好奥莉薇的身体后，拿起红色轻粘土，并仔细搓揉成奥莉薇的裙子形状。他问老师：“吴老师，你喜欢红色吗？”老师回复他：“我喜欢红色，要过新年了，我们都会穿红色的衣服呀。”他又说到：“是，我也是有红色的衣服。”炜衡继续专注的做着，他用不同颜色来装饰衣服。他给奥莉薇的裙子增加了多个黄色的小点缀，并说到：“这个黄色很好看，我做了很多的小小的这个放在上面。”老师说：“真的很漂亮，黄色很亮，奥莉薇可以穿这个跳舞。”炜衡笑嘻嘻地说：“ 是，奥莉薇穿这个跳舞很好看。”
interpretation: 炜衡在活动中展现出对创意和艺术的热爱。无论是轻粘土捏制还是对于服装设计，他都充满了想象力，并通过丰富的语言表达出自己的想法。这些活动不仅帮助他发展了精细动作和审美能力，还培养了他的主动探究的精神，深入了解了与设计相关的知识，并将所学内容与自己的创意相结合。这不仅让他学习了新的技能，还在实践中体验到了设计的乐趣和成就感。

title: 作品介绍——纸杯兔子
description:
幼儿制作的纸杯兔子手工作品，通常结合简单的材料和有趣的创意，让孩子们在动手过程中感受乐趣，同时锻炼他们的手眼协调能力和创造力。以下是对纸杯兔子作品的介绍：
幼儿使用一次性纸杯（兔子的身体），作为兔子的身体，可根据喜好装饰颜色或图案。用卡纸剪出两只长长的兔耳朵，可以用粉色或其他颜色点缀耳朵内侧。
1.	粘贴五官：
o	眼睛可以用卡纸剪出圆形贴上，或直接画上去。
o	鼻子可以使用小绒球，增加立体感。
o	嘴巴可以用笔画上或剪纸贴出微笑的形状。
2.	添加兔子尾巴：在纸杯背面粘上一个小棉球作为兔子的尾巴，使整体造型更加可爱。
3.	个性装饰（可选）：可以给兔子加上胡须、蝴蝶结，甚至画上衣服或小配件，使其更具个性。
作品特点：
•	造型可爱：圆圆的纸杯身体搭配长耳朵和绒球鼻子，整体形象俏皮生动。
•	色彩丰富：孩子们可以自由搭配颜色，展现自己的创意。
•	简单易做：手工步骤简单，适合四岁幼儿操作，并能培养他们的精细动作能力。
•	表达个性：不同的表情、颜色和装饰让每只纸杯兔子都独一无二。
•	动手能力：通过剪、贴、画等步骤，锻炼幼儿的手部肌肉发展。
•	创造力：鼓励孩子发挥想象，自由设计兔子的表情和装饰。
•	情感表达：手工制作带来的成就感能增强孩子的自信心，同时也能培养他们对小动物的喜爱。
这类纸杯兔子手工活动，以实现“来创造“领域的“通过艺术品表现环境中的事物。”学习成果。   
不仅是孩子们的一次趣味创作体验，也能让他们在游戏中学习，提高他们的艺术感知和实践能力！

title: 作品介绍——纸杯兔子
description:
幼儿制作的纸杯兔子手工作品，通常结合简单的材料和有趣的创意，让孩子们在动手过程中感受乐趣，同时锻炼他们的手眼协调能力和创造力。以下是对纸杯兔子作品的介绍：
幼儿使用一次性纸杯（兔子的身体），作为兔子的身体，可根据喜好装饰颜色或图案。用卡纸剪出两只长长的兔耳朵，可以用粉色或其他颜色点缀耳朵内侧。
1.	粘贴五官：
o	眼睛可以用卡纸剪出圆形贴上，或直接画上去。
o	鼻子可以使用小绒球，增加立体感。
o	嘴巴可以用笔画上或剪纸贴出微笑的形状。
2.	添加兔子尾巴：在纸杯背面粘上一个小棉球作为兔子的尾巴，使整体造型更加可爱。
3.	个性装饰（可选）：可以给兔子加上胡须、蝴蝶结，甚至画上衣服或小配件，使其更具个性。
作品特点：
•	造型可爱：圆圆的纸杯身体搭配长耳朵和绒球鼻子，整体形象俏皮生动。
•	色彩丰富：孩子们可以自由搭配颜色，展现自己的创意。
•	简单易做：手工步骤简单，适合四岁幼儿操作，并能培养他们的精细动作能力。
•	表达个性：不同的表情、颜色和装饰让每只纸杯兔子都独一无二。
•	动手能力：通过剪、贴、画等步骤，锻炼幼儿的手部肌肉发展。
•	创造力：鼓励孩子发挥想象，自由设计兔子的表情和装饰。
•	情感表达：手工制作带来的成就感能增强孩子的自信心，同时也能培养他们对小动物的喜爱。
这类纸杯兔子手工活动，以实现“来创造“领域的“通过艺术品表现环境中的事物。”学习成果。   
不仅是孩子们的一次趣味创作体验，也能让他们在游戏中学习，提高他们的艺术感知和实践能力！

title: 粘土手工-奥莉薇
description:
教师提供了多种彩色的轻粘土，引导幼儿以轻粘土捏制奥莉薇（小猪塑像和）和为小猪设计服装为主题进行创作。活动中她表现出极大的热情和对艺术创作的好奇心，并给予灵活的创作空间。
  诗雅认真地聆听教师的讲解，她先捏出奥莉薇的主体，在捏耳朵的时候，她很注重耳朵大小和位置。老师问她：“诗雅捏的耳朵很好，可以帮助朋友一下吗？”她回答：“好。”诗雅接过朋友的粘土开始制作起来。诗雅继续地创作，在选择衣服颜色时诗雅在紫色和蓝色之间想了一会儿，最后她选了蓝色作为衣服的颜色。在捏奥莉薇鼻孔的时候，她选了紫色作为奥莉薇的鼻孔。她看着即将完成的小猪雕塑，看向朋友们的，她又拿起了黄色制作成皇冠，橙色制作成蝴蝶结。
interpretation: 诗雅在活动中展现出对创意和艺术的热爱。无论是轻粘土捏制还是对于服装设计，她都充满了想象力，并通过丰富的语言表达出自己的想法。这些活动不仅帮助她发展了精细动作和审美能力，还培养了她的主动探究的精神，深入了解了与设计相关的知识，并将所学内容与自己的创意相结合。这不仅让她学习了新的技能，还在实践中体验到了设计的乐趣和成就感。

title: 作品介绍——纸杯兔子
description:
幼儿制作的纸杯兔子手工作品，通常结合简单的材料和有趣的创意，让孩子们在动手过程中感受乐趣，同时锻炼他们的手眼协调能力和创造力。以下是对纸杯兔子作品的介绍：
幼儿使用一次性纸杯（兔子的身体），作为兔子的身体，可根据喜好装饰颜色或图案。用卡纸剪出两只长长的兔耳朵，可以用粉色或其他颜色点缀耳朵内侧。
1.	粘贴五官：
o	眼睛可以用卡纸剪出圆形贴上，或直接画上去。
o	鼻子可以使用小绒球，增加立体感。
o	嘴巴可以用笔画上或剪纸贴出微笑的形状。
2.	添加兔子尾巴：在纸杯背面粘上一个小棉球作为兔子的尾巴，使整体造型更加可爱。
3.	个性装饰（可选）：可以给兔子加上胡须、蝴蝶结，甚至画上衣服或小配件，使其更具个性。
作品特点：
•	造型可爱：圆圆的纸杯身体搭配长耳朵和绒球鼻子，整体形象俏皮生动。
•	色彩丰富：孩子们可以自由搭配颜色，展现自己的创意。
•	简单易做：手工步骤简单，适合四岁幼儿操作，并能培养他们的精细动作能力。

•	情感表达：手工制作带来的成就感能增强孩子的自信心，同时也能培养他们对小动物的喜爱。

title: 绘本阅读：《五颜六色的毛毛虫》
description: 上午的阅读时间，瑞泽在书架选择了《五颜六色的毛毛虫》这本书，老师在旁边辅助瑞泽坐下阅读，瑞泽先是观察绘本封面，用手指点点书面的毛毛虫，然后翻开书页到绘有“红红的苹果”这一页，老师在旁边小声解说，让瑞泽知道自己看的是什么，瑞泽停留一下后接着翻到“橙色的胡萝卜”这一页，老师告诉瑞泽午餐会有胡萝卜可以吃，瑞泽看着老师然后把手指放进嘴巴，好像忍不住要吃了，最后瑞泽翻到吃了五颜六色的食物后的大毛毛虫这一页，瑞泽先是短暂的观察，之后开心的拍手大笑。阅读过程中从瑞泽的表情和动作可以看出，瑞泽能初步的理解绘本彩绘的内容，例如“胡萝卜”，“午餐”，瑞泽会伸手进嘴巴，看到大大的五颜六色漂亮的毛毛虫会开心大笑，初步理解艺术是美好开心的表达。

title: 作品分析——《生气的脸》
description:
《生气的脸》活动围绕绘本《菲菲生气了——非常、非常的生气》展开，帮助幼儿认识和表达“生气”这一情绪，并通过语言与艺术创作加深理解。活动开始时，教师展示生气表情的照片，引导幼儿观察并描述表情特征，如皱眉和撅嘴。随后，幼儿通过照镜子模仿生气表情，并用华语表达自己的观察。接着，幼儿使用马克笔在纸盘上绘制“生气的脸”，再通过双面胶、吸管、扭扭棒等材料进行装饰，进一步展现情绪感受。最后，幼儿展示作品并参与整理材料，培养责任感。活动提升了幼儿的语言表达能力和创造力，帮助他们更好地理解和管理情绪。

  陈熙恩在创作过程中，先使用纸盘作为脸部的基础背景，运用橙色马克笔勾勒出两道直直的眉毛、圆形的嘴巴以及虚线状的眼泪，初步表现出生气的表情。接下来，她选择了彩色扭扭棒和吸管进行装饰，使作品更加丰富。她用红色扭扭棒制作嘴巴，使其更加突出；眉毛部分使用蓝色、红色、黄色和绿色的吸管进行装饰，以强化情绪表达；同时，她还使用了紫色的扭扭棒作为眼泪，进一步突出生气和委屈的情绪。整个过程中，陈熙恩认真观察自己的生气表情，并尝试通过不同材料呈现，能够专注创作，并在完成后向同伴展示自己的作品。
interpretation: 陈熙恩的作品以纸盘为基础，充分利用马克笔、扭扭棒和吸管等多种材料，表现出“生气的脸”主题。她用橙色马克笔绘制脸部五官，其中直直的眉毛向下倾斜，突出了愤怒的情绪；嘴巴则用红色扭扭棒勾勒出圆形，呈现出张开、愤怒的状态，使表情更具表现力。此外，她用紫色扭扭棒代表眼泪，增强了作品的情绪表达，展现了生气中带有委屈的感受。在额头部位，她使用蓝色、红色、黄色和绿色吸管进行装饰，使作品更加立体和生动，同时增添了层次感和视觉冲击力。整体而言，该作品在表情特征、色彩搭配和材料运用上具有较强的表现力，能清晰传达生气的情绪。幼儿在创作过程中能够结合观察与想象，充分表达自己的情绪认知，并展现了良好的动手能力和创造力。

learning_goals.title: 描述和说明他们在艺术作品中的想法和构思，开始有意识地把各种艺术元素组织在一起，创造出艺术视觉表现，如：用颜色表达情感；用线条营造动感；用模板创作各种图案。
谈论他们朋友的作品。

title: 作品分析——《生气的脸》
description:
《生气的脸》活动以绘本《菲菲生气了——非常、非常的生气》为引导，帮助幼儿认识和表达“生气”这一情绪，并通过语言和艺术创作加深理解。活动开始时，教师展示生气表情的照片，引导幼儿观察并描述表情特征，如皱眉、撅嘴等。随后，幼儿通过照镜子模仿生气的表情，并用华语表达自己的观察。接着，幼儿使用马克笔在纸盘上绘制“生气的脸”，并利用双面胶、吸管、扭扭棒等材料进行装饰，使作品更加立体生动。最后，幼儿展示作品并参与整理材料，培养责任感。本次活动不仅提升了幼儿的情绪认知能力，也增强了他们的语言表达能力和创造力，使他们能更好地理解和管理自己的情绪。

  陈卓毅在创作过程中，先使用纸盘作为基础背景，并运用蓝色马克笔简单绘制了一张表情温和的笑脸。随后，他尝试使用不同材料进行装饰，在另一张作品中，他用橙色扭扭棒制作了两个圆形的眼睛，突出表情的特征，并选择黄色和绿色的吸管作为嘴巴，摆放成横向结构，使表情呈现出略微生气的情绪。整个过程中，他表现得十分专注，认真挑选合适的材料，并尝试调整其位置以达到最佳效果。他能够按照自己的理解进行创作，并在完成后向同伴展示自己的作品。
interpretation: 陈卓毅的作品展现了对情绪表达的理解和材料运用的探索。他先尝试用蓝色马克笔绘制了一张笑脸，表现出不同的情绪变化。随后，在“生气的脸”作品中，他使用橙色扭扭棒制作眼睛，颜色明亮，增强了面部特征的表现力。嘴巴部分由黄色和绿色的吸管组合而成，横向排列，营造出生气的表情效果。整体作品在色彩运用上较为简洁，注重面部的主要元素，虽然表情并未表现出明显的愤怒感，但能通过眼睛的颜色和嘴巴的排列方式展现情绪特征。整体而言，他在创作过程中能够自主选择材料，并大胆尝试不同的表达方式，展现了一定的创造力和情绪认知能力。

learning_goals.title: 描述和说明他们在艺术作品中的想法和构思，开始有意识地把各种艺术元素组织在一起，创造出艺术视觉表现，如：用颜色表达情感；用线条营造动感；用模板创作各种图案。

title: 不一样的体验
description: 祥宏背部直挺的坐在软底上，手里还在玩着小玩具，转换不同的玩法，左手换右手，敲敲打打，手部不停的动作同时身体也在尽量维持平衡。祥宏在达到月领6个月，老师会参照婴幼儿发展里程碑，来让祥宏尝试独立坐着和脊柱的支撑能力，祥宏从开始 不可以坐直到现在可以坐3到5分钟，进步很快，并且身体发展达到6个月幼儿的发展需求，同时可以和老师互动，加油祥宏！

title: 作品分析——《生气的脸》
description:
《生气的脸》活动围绕绘本《菲菲生气了——非常、非常的生气》展开，帮助幼儿认识和表达“生气”这一情绪，并通过语言与艺术创作加深理解。活动开始时，教师展示生气表情的照片，引导幼儿观察并描述表情特征，如皱眉和撅嘴。随后，幼儿通过照镜子模仿生气表情，并用华语表达自己的观察。接着，幼儿使用马克笔在纸盘上绘制“生气的脸”，再通过双面胶、吸管、扭扭棒等材料进行装饰，进一步展现情绪感受。最后，幼儿展示作品并参与整理材料，培养责任感。活动提升了幼儿的语言表达能力和创造力，帮助他们更好地理解和管理情绪。


  明凯的作品以纸盘为基础，通过马克笔、吸管和扭扭棒进行创作，表现“生气的脸”。初稿中使用蓝色马克笔描绘五官，其中嘴巴以弯曲的锯齿状线条表现“龇牙”特征，圆形的眼睛位置对称，突出了眼部的强调。装饰阶段，明凯使用黄色吸管和蓝色扭扭棒增强了眉毛的立体感。眉毛通过横向排列表现出明显的愤怒特征。整体作品在表情特征和材料搭配上清晰直观，明凯在创作时模仿了龇牙动作，面部紧绷，进一步凸显了作品情绪的真实性。
interpretation:
蔡明凯的作品以纸盘为基础，运用马克笔、吸管和扭扭棒等材料，成功表现了“生气的脸”主题。他使用蓝色马克笔勾勒五官，其中嘴巴采用弯曲的锯齿状线条，表现出“龇牙”的愤怒表情，使整体情绪更加鲜明。眼睛部分呈圆形，对称分布，突出了眼部的特征，使面部结构更加完整。

在装饰环节，他选择了黄色吸管和蓝色扭扭棒，使作品更加立体。其中，黄色吸管和蓝色扭扭棒被用于眉毛区域，增强了怒气的表现力。眉毛的横向排列方式，使表情更具张力，进一步强化了“生气”这一主题。

整体来看，该作品在色彩搭配、材料运用和情绪表达上较为突出，清晰地展现了生气的情绪特征。蔡明凯在创作过程中模仿了龇牙的表情，并通过面部紧绷的动作来增强作品的情绪真实性。他能够利用不同的材料突出五官特征，并结合个人观察进行表达，展现了较强的创造力和情绪理解能力。

title: 故事接龙游戏
description:
活动过程：教师请幼儿从神秘故事袋中随机抽取图片，鼓励他们仔细观察图片后用自己的语言进行讲述，然后请其他幼儿根据他们的讲述，参照故事中菲菲情绪变化的顺序为他们排序。
当轮到恩雨从神秘袋中抽取故事卡片时，恩雨接过神秘袋，一只手伸进神秘袋，并拿出一张故事卡片，她看了看故事卡片并说：“我知道，这个是菲菲一直走一直走，她一边走一边哭。”说完之后她将卡片展示给其他朋友看，并将神秘袋交给了下一个朋友，当所有的朋友都抽完故事卡片后，恩雨拿着自己的那张卡片和朋友们一起讲故事排序，并讲述出自己那张卡片的内容。
接着游戏进行到第二轮，再次轮到恩雨抽取卡片，恩雨再次抽出一张卡片，这次抽到了和上次一样的卡片，她看着卡片说：“于老师，一样的”，老师说：“没关系，你可以再说一次。”于是恩雨看着图片说：“菲菲一直走一直走，一边走一边哭。”最后所有的朋友都抽取卡片后，恩雨再次和朋友们进行了故事排序，并说出了自己卡片上的故事内容。
interpretation: 在整个活动过程中，恩雨能够用完整的句式”菲菲一直走一直走，她一边走一边哭“等展现了她较强的语言组织能力和词汇量，她能够清晰描述故事情节，可见她熟悉故事内容，能够记住故事内容。在集体排序中她能够找到自己的正确的位置，说明她逻辑思维清晰，同时她能与同伴协作完成任务可见她良好的社交能力和团队协作精神。

title: 故事接龙游戏
description:
活动过程：教师请幼儿从神秘故事袋中随机抽取图片，鼓励他们仔细观察图片后用自己的语言进行讲述，然后请其他幼儿根据他们的讲述，参照故事中菲菲情绪变化的顺序为他们排序。
当轮到荣全从神秘袋中抽取故事卡片时，荣全接过神秘袋，一只手伸进神秘袋，并拿出一张故事卡片，他看了看故事卡片，一边指着卡片上的图案，一边说：“菲菲玩玩具，姐姐过来想要抢走她的玩具。”说完后他将神秘袋传递给下一个朋友，当所有的朋友都抽完故事卡片后，荣全拿着自己的那张卡片和朋友们一起讲故事排序，并讲述出自己那张卡片的内容。
接着游戏进行到第二轮，再次轮到荣全抽取卡片，荣全抽出一张卡片，看着卡片上的内容说：“菲菲不生气了，她走回了家。” 最后所有的朋友都抽取卡片后，荣全再次和朋友们进行了故事排序，并说出了自己卡片上的故事内容。
interpretation: 在整个活动过程中，荣全能够用完整的句式”菲菲玩玩具，姐姐过来想要抢走她的玩具““菲菲不生气了，她走回了家。”等展现了他较强的语言组织能力和词汇量，他能够清晰描述故事情节，可见他熟悉故事内容，能够记住故事内容。在集体排序中他能够找到自己的正确的位置，说明他逻辑思维清晰，同时他能与同伴协作完成任务可见他良好的社交能力和团队协作精神。

title: 跳圈识字
description:
活动过程：活动过程：教师出示生气、菲菲、我、画画等词语卡片，带幼儿复习这些词语，随后教师用呼啦圈布置了游戏场地，并将词语卡片分别放进每个呼啦圈中，幼儿站在中心，教师说开始时，幼儿分别向不同方向跳进呼啦圈中，并大声说出呼啦圈中的词语。
当轮到恒宇游戏时，凯仁和另一位朋友一起站在呼啦圈围的中心位置，当老师说：“开始！”凯仁听到老师的指令后看了看身边的呼啦圈，他选择了一个红色的呼啦圈，并从中心单脚一跃跳进了呼啦圈中，他跳进去后，老师走到他什么问：“凯仁，呼啦圈里是什么词语？”凯仁说：“高兴。”老师说说对了！接着凯仁从呼啦圈中飞快跳回到中心位置。等待另一位朋友也回到中心的位置，接着老师说：“开始”，凯仁看了看周围的呼啦圈，然后飞快的跳进了一个绿色的呼啦圈，并对老师说：“哭”。接着他再次回到中间位置，并继续游戏。

当轮到雨熹游戏时，云琋和另一位朋友一起站在呼啦圈围的中心位置，当老师说：“开始！”云琋听到老师的指令后很快单脚跳，跳进了一个绿色的呼啦圈中，老师走过来，问云琋呼啦圈中的词语是什么，云琋看了看地板上的词语，然后看着老师说：“菲菲”，老师说对！接着云琋笑着跳回到中心的位置，等待另一位朋友也回到中心的位置后，老师再次说：“开始”，云琋马上单脚跳进了一个蓝色的呼啦圈，并对着老师说：“于老师，这个是害怕！”。接着她再次回到中间位置，并继续游戏。
interpretation: 在整个活动中云琋通过单脚跳跃完成指令，体现了身体协调性与大运动技能的发展，她能够准确的找到自己认识的词语并准确的读出“菲菲”、“害怕”等词语，展现了她良好的语言认读能力。她通过聆听老师指令并作出回应反馈，表现出对语言规则的理解。同时她能够遵守游戏规则，体现了规则意识和任务执行能力，在活动中她能够和朋友共同游戏并能够选择和朋友不同的呼啦圈，展现了她良好的社交能力。

title: 比高矮
description:
活动过程：在比高矮的活动中，教师利用班级内的物品引导幼儿比高矮，并引导幼儿学习句式：xx比xx高，xx比xx矮，接着教师鼓励一名幼儿，邀请其他两位幼儿背对背进行高矮比较，并鼓励幼儿幼儿使用句式来描述比较结果。
教师请航瑞来进行高矮比较，航瑞站起来，教师问航瑞：“你想请哪两个朋友来进行比较呢？”航瑞说：“我想请凯仁和欣芮。”于是凯仁和欣芮站起来，航瑞说：“你们要背对背站着。”凯仁和欣芮走过来背对背站着，航瑞仔细看了看他们两个，并说：“凯仁高，凯仁比欣芮高。”想了想接着又说：“欣芮比凯仁矮。”老师其他的朋友是否赞同航瑞说的话，朋友们都表示赞同。
interpretation: 本次活动在数学领域方面，航瑞通过观察同伴背对背站立的高矮差异，掌握了“相对比较”的逻辑思维，能准确判断并表达“凯仁比欣芮高”，体现了对物体属性（高度）的量化分析与比较能力。语言领域上，他主动运用“xx比xx高/矮”的句式，完整、清晰地描述结果，展现了语言组织与逻辑表达的进步。社交方面，航瑞能自信邀请同伴、发出指令，其他幼儿积极配合并认可结论，反映出合作意识与集体互动中的规则遵守。活动融合了数学推理、语言表达与社会协作，促进幼儿多领域综合发展。

教师请雨熹来进行高矮比较，雨熹站起来，教师问雨熹：“你想请哪两个朋友来进行比较呢？”雨熹说：“我想请梓勤和许文恺。”于是梓勤和文恺站起来，老师请梓勤和文恺背对背站着，雨熹看着她们，又看了看老师，老师问：“雨熹，你来看一看，谁比谁高？”雨熹仔细看了看站在一起的朋友并说：“梓勤高。”老师说：“恩对的，那你来说一说谁比谁高呢？”雨熹缓慢的说：“梓勤比文恺，高。”老师说：“说的对，很好。”老师继续问雨熹：“那么谁比谁矮呢？”雨熹想了想慢慢说：“文恺比梓勤矮。”老师问了其他朋友：“雨熹说的对吗？”朋友们说：“对！”接着老师请雨熹和他的朋友们坐下。
interpretation: 本次活动在数学领域方面，雨熹通过观察同伴背对背站立的高矮差异，掌握了“相对比较”的逻辑思维，能准确判断并表达“梓勤比文凯高”，体现了对物体属性（高度）的量化分析与比较能力。语言领域上，她主动运用“xx比xx高/矮”的句式，完整、清晰地描述结果，展现了语言组织与逻辑表达的进步。社交方面，雨熹能自信邀请同伴、发出指令，其他幼儿积极配合并认可结论，反映出合作意识与集体互动中的规则遵守。活动融合了数学推理、语言表达与社会协作，促进幼儿多领域综合发展。

title: 比高矮
description:

教师请荣全来进行高矮比较，峻宇站起来，教师问荣全：“你想请哪两个朋友来进行比较呢？”荣全看了看朋友，想了一下说：“我想请境睿和航瑞。”于是境睿和杭瑞站起来，老师请境睿和航瑞背对背站着，荣全看着他们，然后走到他们身边，他伸出手比了一下两个朋友，又看了看老师，老师问：“荣全，谁比谁高？”荣全说：“境睿高”，老师说：“没错，那么谁比谁高呢？”荣全说：“恩，境睿高比航瑞。”老师说：“很好，那么你跟我一起说境睿比航瑞高。”荣全听到后说：“境睿比航瑞高。”接着老师继续问荣全：“谁比谁矮呢？”荣全说：“航瑞矮，”老师说：“你跟我一起说航瑞比”荣全说：“航瑞比境睿矮。”老师说：“对了！你说了一个完整的句子！”
interpretation: 本次活动在数学领域方面，荣全通过观察同伴背对背站立的高矮差异，掌握了“相对比较”的逻辑思维，能准确判断谁高和谁矮，体现了对物体属性（高度）的量化分析与比较能力。语言领域上，他能跟着老师说出“xx比xx高/矮”的句式，完整、清晰地描述结果，展现了语言组织与逻辑表达的进步。社交方面，荣全能自信邀请同伴、发出指令，其他幼儿积极配合并认可结论，反映出合作意识与集体互动中的规则遵守。活动融合了数学推理、语言表达与社会协作，促进幼儿多领域综合发展。

title: Scoop and transfer
description: In developing the children’s fine motor skills, they were invited to scoop and transfer the pompom balls from the plate into the holes of the egg carton. Jaylen sat on the floor and picked up the plastic spoon with his right hand. He carefully moved the spoon to pick up a pompom ball from the plate, balancing it on the spoon as he moved his hand toward the egg carton. Jaylen repeated the process by scooping and transferring the pompom balls into the egg carton with a steady hand. Each time, he adjusted his grip on the spoon and carefully placed the pompom ball neatly inside the egg carton. Once Jaylen had transferred all the pompom balls, he smiled at the teacher.
interpretation: In this activity, Jaylen displayed his developing fine motor skills, particularly in the areas of hand-eye coordination and hand dexterity. The task of using a spoon to scoop and place the pompom balls required him to coordinate his hand and eye movements carefully, which helped strengthen his control and dexterity over small muscle movements. Moreover, the act of transferring the pompom balls into the egg carton helped to develop his spatial awareness as he ensured that the balls were placed in the holes of the egg carton. This activity supports the development of essential skills that would benefit Jaylen in other tasks requiring fine motor precision and coordination. Jaylen also showcased great perseverance as he was able to persist and complete the task of scooping and transferring the pompom balls.

interpretation: This activity demonstrated Levelle’s developing hand-eye coordination and fine motor skills. Moreover, Levelle’s ability to transfer the pompom balls into the egg carton suggested growing concentration and an understanding of the task at hand. This activity supports the development of essential skills that would benefit Levelle in other tasks requiring fine motor precision and coordination. Levelle also displayed great perseverance as she was able to persist and complete the task of scooping and transferring the pompom balls.

老师对幼儿们说：“谁要参加吸管插洞洞游戏啊？”彩绚看着老师。老师笑着对彩绚说：“你要玩吗？”彩绚看着老师点点头。老师鼓励彩绚说：“我要玩。”彩绚模仿老师的动作拍了拍自己，表示我。老师拿出吸管和洞洞箱，请彩绚尝试动手操作。彩绚开始一只手呈五指抓握吸管，尝试插入洞洞箱，在发展很难插入，她会低头看向洞洞中，在尝试向下插入吸管。在反复的穿插吸管过程中，彩绚从最初五指抓握吸管，逐渐可以三指抓握吸管插入洞洞中。当吸管插光了后，彩绚会看向老师，双手张开发出：“噢”的声音。老师看向彩绚，询问彩绚：“怎么了？是要吸管吗？”彩绚微笑的点头。老师鼓励彩绚说：“还要、我还要吸管。”彩绚用小手拍了拍自己的胸口回应老师，又低头继续参与插洞洞的游戏中。
interpretation: 彩绚可以积极参与吸管插洞洞的活动，可以尝试使用动作点头、拍拍自己的胸口表示自己的想法。并可以一只手抓住吸管，另一只手从五指抓握，逐渐变成三指抓握吸管向下按压插入洞洞中，手指精细动作发展良好。

title: 吸管插洞洞
description:

老师对他们说：“谁要参加吸管插洞洞游戏啊？”哲恩看着老师说：“Jaylen玩”。老师笑着对哲恩说：“我要玩、哲恩要玩。”哲恩重复说：“我、要玩。”老师表扬哲恩说的很好。老师介绍材料吸管和洞洞箱，哲恩可以模仿老师复述说出词语：“洞洞、吸管。”在动手操作过程中，哲恩小朋友可以左手右手交替或同时抓握吸管，进行穿插洞洞游戏。手指从最初五指逐渐到三指、二指捏住吸管，向下插入洞洞中。在用力向下插的过程中，吸管不见了。哲恩会用手扣扣刚刚插入的洞洞，并低头观察洞洞。当吸管没有时哲恩会用因为讲：“no more ”老师鼓励哲恩说：“没有了，我还要吸管。”哲恩慢慢的复述说：“没有，我、还要、吸管。”老师又给他一把吸管，表扬他：“说的很好！”哲恩微笑的继续参与插洞洞的游戏中。
interpretation: 哲恩可以积极参与吸管插洞洞活动，并可以使用语言和动作表达自己的想法。也可以双手同时、交替插入吸管进行游戏。在游戏的过程中，手指呈五指、三指、二指抓握吸管。灵活转变、左右手同时交替尝试，表明了哲恩手指精细动作发展良好。

title: 叠高搭建积木
description: 在区角活动中，老师邀请幼儿一起来做搭建积木的游戏，方凯看到后走了过来，方凯看了看老师搭建的三块小积木，便用右手从旁边五指抓握了一块红色的方块积木，眼睛看向老师搭建的三块积木，右手稳稳的将手里的红色积木放到了上面。然后方凯用左手抓起一块积木递到右手，并举高右手再次以同样的方式将紫色的方块积木搭建上去。最后，方凯又拿起一块蓝色的方块积木，但他坐着无法进行叠加，老师说：“啊，方凯搭建的这么高。”方凯笑了笑，站了起来，站稳后，方凯用右手将蓝色的方块积木叠加上去，老师为方凯拍手，方凯笑着将搭建好的所有积木推倒，然后再次重新搭建，方凯重复搭建、推倒、再搭建，直到区角活动结束。
interpretation: 方凯能够手眼协调的进行搭建活动，能够将三个以上的积木垒起来。

title: 动物拼图板
description: 在区角活动中，泽阳走到图书角落，将动物拼图板拿了出来，老师问泽阳：“你要玩动物拼图嘛？”泽阳点头回答老师说：“要。”泽阳坐下来后将所有的动物从拼图板里拿了出来，然后拿起公鸡的拼图板块，看了看拼图板，老师说：“泽阳，这是公鸡，你找找公鸡在哪里？”泽阳跟随老师说出了：“鸡。”老师鼓励泽阳说出：“公”和“鸡”。泽阳逐一跟随老师说出：“公”、“鸡”。并在拼图板上找到了对应的公鸡图片，将公鸡板块放了回去，完成了配对。之后，泽阳分别将动物图板牛、羊、猪以及马逐一进行正确的配对，并能够跟随老师复述说出所有的动物名称，老师给予泽阳鼓掌，泽阳笑着回应老师后，又选择了其他的拼图板进行拼图活动。
interpretation: 泽阳能够进行图配图的拼图活动，并能够跟随老师逐字说出动物名称。

title: Rainbow Sorting Garden
description:
The children had the opportunity to participate in an activity in which they were provided with matching "flower pots" labelled by two attributes, such as "red circles," "pink circles," "blue triangles," "yellow triangles," etc.

Kelsey began by selecting two coloured papers of varying attributes and said, "I take pink circle and yellow triangle because I like pink and yellow." Next, she drew flower designs on it.

After drawing, the children placed their flower drawings in a small container. When it was Kelsey's turn to "plant" two flowers in the corresponding pots, she picked a yellow triangle paper and placed it in the middle pot. Next, she grabbed a yellow triangle from the container before putting it into the first pot. She then said, "I am done!"
interpretation: Through this activity, Kelsey can confidently sort objects according to two attributes; the colour and shape of the paper cutouts. She can also take responsibility for her own actions, such as learning to make choices independently.

learning_goals.title: Sort objects according to two attributes (e.g: colour and shape, colour and size).

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
雨蒽小朋友用纸盘制作了一张“难过”的表情脸谱，整体造型简单明了，能够清晰地传达出悲伤的情绪。通过对五官的设计与摆放，她成功表现出了一个哭泣、难过的面部表情。
她选择黑色纸剪出“X”形的眼睛，象征着紧闭或挤压的状态，增强了脸谱的情绪表达。这种眼神设计生动地展现了痛苦或委屈的感受。嘴巴使用黑色纸剪成向下弯曲的弧形，呈现出典型的悲伤嘴型，直观地表达了“难过”的情绪。两个黄色小绒球贴在脸颊一侧，象征着滑落的泪水，增强了作品的情感表现力。通过简单的形状与颜色搭配，雨蒽小朋友巧妙地表达了情绪，展现了自己的观察能力与创造力。黑色的眼睛和嘴巴与白色纸盘形成鲜明对比，使表情更具冲击力。黄色小球的使用不仅丰富了作品的层次感，还增加了趣味性和独特性。在制作过程中，她能更好地理解“难过”这种情绪，并通过手工艺术进行表达。拼贴的过程锻炼了她的手部精细动作，提升了手眼协调能力。
雨蒽小朋友的作品富有创意，充分展现了“难过”的表情特点，细节处理得当，能有效传达情绪。这个脸谱不仅是一次成功的手工尝试，也是一种对情绪的艺术表达，让孩子在动手过程中学习和成长。

title: 模拟参观美术馆
description:
教师在学校内装饰美术馆区域，带领幼儿模拟参观美术馆。鼓励幼儿观察与表达自己对画作的喜好。
  于扬手持一张记录表和一支绿色记号笔，在“美术馆”的墙上认真观察挂着的几幅画作。她先停在一幅《向日葵》的画前，一边看一边诉说着：“这些花是太阳花，颜色是黄色的。我在花店也是看到过。”于扬随后走到一幅静物水果画前，指着画描述到：“我喜欢这幅画，因为这个看起来很好吃，有橙子，柠檬。”老师问：“你为什么喜欢这幅画呢？”她回答：“因为我喜欢吃橙子，橙子酸酸甜甜的，有时候呢，我也是会去机器那边买鲜榨的橙汁喝。”于扬最后在记录表上圈出水果画，并用绿色记号笔画了一颗小爱心，开心地举起来给老师看，说：“我还是喜欢这个水果画。”
interpretation: 通过此次活动，于扬展现了良好的观察力、表达能力和对艺术的热情。她能够细致地观察画作的细节，并准确描述画作的内容和色彩。她能够使用连贯的语言，态度自然得表达了对画作的喜好，能够清楚地说明原因，展现了较强的逻辑思维和语言组织能力。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
姝雅小朋友使用纸盘制作了一张“难过”的表情脸谱，整体设计突出了悲伤、愤怒或委屈的情绪，表情十分生动。通过五官的夸张处理，使观者能够一眼识别出脸谱所表达的情感。
她选择黑色三角形纸剪出向下倾斜的粗眉，增强了表情的愤怒感和压迫感。眉毛的角度较大，进一步突出了一种强烈的不满或委屈的情绪。眼睛呈现半闭状态，黑色的弧形眼线表现出愤怒或不开心时的眯眼神态。选用红色纸剪出向下弯曲的嘴巴，并加上几条竖线，表现出紧绷或咬牙切齿的状态。这样的嘴型不仅表达了难过，还带有一丝愤怒或委屈的感觉。纸盘的圆形提供了稳定的结构，使五官布局清晰易懂。颜色对比鲜明，黑色和红色的搭配突出情绪张力，强化了悲伤的表达。她通过眉毛的斜度、眼睛的眯起以及嘴巴的下弯，姝雅小朋友成功塑造了一个愤怒又悲伤的表情，表现力极强。使用简单的几何形状（如三角形眉毛、弧形眼睛和嘴巴）来构建表情，充分体现了孩子的创造力。姝雅小朋友通过手工制作，更加直观地认识和表达“难过”这一情绪。
姝雅小朋友的作品构图明确，表情设计富有戏剧性，成功展现了“难过”这一情绪。她通过简洁而夸张的线条和色彩搭配，使作品充满表现力和创意。这不仅是一次艺术体验，更是一次对情绪认知的深刻探索。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：尝试用华语与人交谈。
语言学习成果（写）- 写前准备：喜欢涂涂画画，能画出较直、横的线，基本能控制笔的方向。
感知和描述艺术的基本元素：线条、颜色、形状、质地。
通过艺术品表现环境中的事物。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
思彤小朋友的这幅难过表情脸谱作品采用了简单的材料和剪贴手法，成功表达出悲伤的情绪。
她的作品以一次性纸盘为基础，适合儿童手工制作，轻便易操作。她选用黑色和红色卡纸剪贴出表情元素，眉毛向上倾斜并弯曲，呈现出忧愁的状态，符合人类悲伤时的眉部变化。眼睛由黑色弯曲的纸条组成，微微下垂，传递出伤心的感觉。嘴巴大大的张开、向下弯曲的红色形状，象征哭泣或哀伤的表达，使整体情绪更加强烈。颜色选择简单但有效，黑色和红色的组合能突出情绪表达。 通过手工制作脸谱，思彤可以学习如何用不同的形状和颜色表达情感。

title: 我的博物馆
description: 在学习绘本故事《奥莉薇》 的过程中， 孩子们对有奥莉薇去的博物馆很感兴趣。 俊懿对于博物馆很好奇， 我们一起收集了一些关于博物馆的信息。 当我问他：“ 如果你有一个博物馆， 会是什么博物馆呢？” 他认真的想了想， 告诉我说：" 我喜欢大大的恐龙骨头。” 于是我接着问， “那这个博物馆里都有什么呢？你能画出来给我看吗？” 俊懿听了很开心， 他迅速地拿出一张纸， 开始画了起来。 画完之后他主动在其他小朋友们面前做了分享与说话， 通过老师和朋友的协助， 他自信地分享到：“ 这是恐龙博物馆。 里面有恐龙， 我喜欢恐龙。这个博物馆要在2025年2月26日开， 在学校。”
interpretation: 通过俊懿制作的海报， 可以看出他能够将自己的想象通过绘画的方式表现出来， 是创作能力的体现。 同时， 他能够使用简单的华语以小段话的方式表达出来， 说明他具有良好的沟通与表达能力， 能够自信地使用华语。

learning_goals.title: 运用观察和想象力创作平面和立体的艺术作品：能够使用各种类型的纸张来创作一个艺术的作品。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
彦丰小朋友的悲伤表情脸谱作品通过简单的剪贴手法，成功表现了悲伤的情绪。
他使用黑色纸片剪裁出眉毛、眼泪和嘴巴，并粘贴在纸盘上，使表情清晰可见。眉毛向上倾斜的眉毛呈现出忧愁的状态，增强了表情的悲伤感， 眼睛下方的多个小黑色纸片象征眼泪流淌，细节丰富，使表情更具感染力。 嘴巴向下弯曲的嘴巴，传递出明显的伤心情绪，符合人类自然的悲伤表情。
他的作品整体设计简洁但有效，利用黑白对比，使表情清晰易懂。眼泪的细节增强了悲伤情绪的表达，使人物形象更加生动。
通过手工制作，彦丰可以学习如何用形状和颜色表达情绪。帮助他识别和理解悲伤的情绪。
彦丰小朋友的作品精准地传达了悲伤情绪，设计简单却富有表现力，特别是眼泪的细节处理，让表情更具情感冲击力。这是一个成功的情绪表达作品，值得鼓励和赞赏！

description:
翊枫小朋友的惊讶表情脸谱作品通过简洁的设计和精心的细节处理，成功地展现了“惊讶”这一情绪。
翊枫的作品使用一次性纸盘作为底座，方便制作，增强立体感。他采用黑色剪纸拼贴出眉毛、眼睛和嘴巴，并增加一个蓝色的圆形鼻子，使整体更具个性。纸盘边缘做了均匀剪切，可能是为了增强视觉效果，使脸谱更具立体感或表现某种动态感。眉毛呈上扬倾斜状，表现出惊讶时眉毛上挑的特征，增加了表情的戏剧性。眼睛圆形大眼睛中加入白色高光，使眼神更加生动，突出了惊讶的情绪。嘴巴呈现“O”型张开，符合人们在惊讶时自然的嘴部反应，增强了情感表达。鼻子采用蓝色毛球作为鼻子，与其他黑白元素形成对比，使脸谱更有趣，增加了童趣感。
他的作品设计简洁，能够清晰地传达惊讶的情绪。颜色搭配合理，黑白主色调加上蓝色鼻子，使整体形象更具辨识度和趣味性。此作品能够帮助他通过简单的形状和颜色学习如何表达和识别不同的情绪。鼓励翊枫发挥创造力，在有限的材料中进行个性化设计。
翊枫小朋友的惊讶脸谱作品精准地展现了惊讶的神态，特别是大眼睛、高挑的眉毛和张开的嘴巴，强化了情绪的表现力。同时，蓝色鼻子的点缀为作品增添了趣味性和个性化特点，整体创意十足，值得肯定和鼓励！

interpretation: 通过靖萱作的海报， 可以看出她能够将自己的想象通过绘画的方式表现出来， 是创作能力的体现。 同时， 她能够使用简单的华语以小段话的方式表达出来， 说明他具有良好的沟通与表达能力， 能够自信地使用华语。

learning_goals.title: 运用观察和想象力创作平面和立体的艺术作品：能够使用各种类型的纸张来创作一个艺术的作品。
描述和讨论他们对各种艺术品的所见、所闻和所感。

title: Work Sample 2: Journaling
description: The children were invited to express their thoughts about what they enjoy about being three years old by drawing in their journals.
interpretation:
Elliot used orange coloured pencils to draw long and short rectangles. He drew lines and connected them to form the shapes. When asked about the shapes, he said, "A bolster is a rectangle and it's long." For the long rectangles, he made the lines tall and filled the paper, while the short ones were smaller.


Through gestures and long phrases like "This is long" and “I am drawing a Bolster that I hug when I go to sleep”, Elliott showed how he communicates to interact with others. When asked about his drawing, he said, "I like that I can use and know which is long and short bolster." without prompts. This shows his strong confidence to express himself in a few complete sentences and ability to recognise his own likes.

title: Work Sample 2: Journaling
description: The children were invited to express their thoughts about what they enjoy about being three years old by drawing in their journals.
interpretation:
Kai En used blue and red crayons to draw lines moving up and down. For his jungle drawing, he crossed the lines to make it look "messy and crowded." He made the lines tall and filled every part of the paper, saying, “The jungle is taller than me!”

When asked about his picture, Kai En said, "I like that I can go into the jungle."


He also shared that now that he’s bigger, he feels braver to try new things, like going to the jungle. He was able to speak his ideas in short phrases progressing to sentences such as, “I like blue and red. Like fire.” This shows his ability to identify his own likes and preference of communication with others to express himself.

learning_goals.title: Represent ideas and stories through pictures, dictation and play.

title: Work Sample 2: Journaling
description: The children were invited to express their thoughts about what they enjoy about being three years old by drawing in their journals.
interpretation:
Olivia used different coloured pencils and pencils to draw shapes like circles and filled them with colour to express her ideas. She pointed to the largest circle, explaining, “That’s me and I am reading a black storybook.”

Through gestures and short phrases like "book" or by pointing to herself, Olivia demonstrated how she communicates to interact with others. When asked about her drawing, she said, "I like that I can read more books now!" This shows her ability to identify her own likes, as she enjoys being in class to read books, and express her personal feelings in the process.

title: Work Sample 2: Journaling
description: The children were invited to express their thoughts about what they enjoy about being three years old by drawing in their journals.
interpretation:
Matthias used pencils, coloured pencils, and markers in red, yellow, purple, blue, black, and brown to draw animals and plants in the jungle. He drew shapes like squares, rectangles, and circles and filled them with color. For his jungle drawing, he crossed lines to make it "messy and crowded."


Through gestures and short phrases like "Jungle" and “Lines”, Matthias showed how he communicates to interact with others. When asked about his drawing, he said, "I like that I can go into the jungle." He was also able to reason why he chose jungle, saying “I’m bigger now.” The above demonstrates his ability to identify his likes, as he enjoys going to the jungle and expressing his feelings.

title: Work sample 2: Self-portrait
description: The children were invited to create a self-portrait by drawing their face and using playdough.
interpretation:
Shuo-yun used a brown marker to draw his face and blue playdough to shape his hair. As he worked, he pointed to different parts of his drawing and said simple words like "face," "eyes," and "nose." After finishing his self-portrait, Shuo-yun smiled happily and repeatedly said, "Like like," showing his excitement and pride in completing his artwork.

Shuo-yun displayed joy and self-awareness in creating his self-portrait. Even with simple one-word phrases, he clearly expressed his satisfaction with his work.

title: Work Sample #2: Math Sensory Art (Texture Collage)
description:
Children were introduced to various textured materials and explored sorting them into different texture categories before creating a texture collage. These materials included felt, glitter paper, coloured paper, reflective paper, and corrugated board.

As the children grouped the materials based on texture, they also observed variations in colour and shape, allowing them to make independent choices about their favourite materials. This tactile experience and exploration not only fostered the children's aesthetic and creative expression but also encouraged autonomy in sorting objects based on observable features such as colour, shape, and texture.

Avery shared, "I make a house. I got smooth heart shapes."

title: 作品分析 -- 《我最爱的画面》
description: 教师展示《猜猜我有多爱你》绘本图片，引导幼儿观察并讨论画面内容，鼓励幼儿选择喜欢的场景并用绘画表达，练习正确握笔的姿势，最后分享作品。
interpretation:
雅旋的作品展现了三岁幼儿典型的绘画特点。图画布局简单而富有童趣，大兔子和小兔子的形象占据了画面的主要部分，显示出她对主题的专注。构图虽然稚嫩，但通过线条的运用，她成功地表达了两只兔子手臂张开的情景。色彩方面，她使用了较为鲜艳的颜色，表现出幼儿对色彩的敏感和喜爱。线条的应用较为自由，显示出她在这个年龄阶段的创造力和想象力。


她的创作主题明确，通过大兔子和小兔子的形象，表达了她对绘本故事的理解和情感。画面中的兔子形象生动，整体构图充满了童真和趣味。她还添加了一些简单的背景元素，如草地或太阳，进一步丰富了画面的内容。


在作品分享环节，她解释道：“大家好，我是黄雅旋，今天我分享我的功课，这是大兔子和小兔子跳跳！”她能够用完整的句子描述自己的作品内容，并乐意与他人分享自己的构思和创意，展示了她的语言能力和自信心。

运用各种不同的工具（如：手/手指/脚、滚桶、海绵、油漆刷）绘画和涂色。

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
Diyansh小朋友的惊讶表情脸谱作品通过简洁的设计和精心的细节处理，成功地展现了“惊讶”这一情绪。
他的作品展示了一张惊讶的脸，主要通过圆形大嘴巴和圆睁的双眼来表现。眼睛由白色和黑色圆形剪纸组成，使其看起来十分生动。小红色的毛球作为鼻子，为作品增添了立体感和趣味性。作品主要材料是纸盘，边缘有均匀的剪裁，可能用于装饰或增强立体感。使用了彩色卡纸（黑色、白色、红色）进行五官的拼贴。鼻子采用了柔软的小毛球，增加了触感的丰富性。颜色搭配合理，红色嘴巴和鼻子形成亮点，黑白对比的眼睛增强了表情的突出性。
总的来说，这是一幅富有创意的手工作品，充分体现了他对表情的理解和表达。Diyansh 很好地运用了简单的材料和对比色彩，使作品生动有趣！

title: 幼儿作品分析——表情脸谱
description:
Kaitlyn小朋友制作的生气表情脸谱作品非常有创意，充分展现了情绪的表达能力和动手能力。
她的作品表达了愤怒的情绪，主要通过眼睛、眉毛和嘴巴的形状表现出来。眉毛两条倾斜向下的黑色粗眉，形成强烈的愤怒感。眼睛呈尖角状，类似于“怒目”，增强了愤怒的神态。嘴巴向下弯曲的嘴角，传达出明显的不满或生气的情绪。五官使用 黑色卡纸 剪贴，形成鲜明的对比，突出面部表情。眉毛的倾斜角度、眼睛的形状和嘴巴的弧度 都精准地传达了生气的感觉。她的作品呈现出清晰、直接的情绪表达，符合儿童直观的观察方式。
Kaitlyn 的作品通过简单的黑白剪纸，精准地表达了生气的表情，充分展现了孩子对情绪的理解和创造力。这是一幅成功的幼儿艺术作品，值得鼓励！

title: Hula Hoop Bean Bag Toss
description: During outdoor play, Cavill noticed the teacher setting up hula hoops, cones, and bean bags on the ground. He ran towards the bean bags, and picked them up one by one. Holding a bean bag in his hand, he positioned himself a short distance from the hula hoop and threw it inside. He watched as it landed, then quickly moved around the space to collect more bean bags. Each time he threw, he adjusted his position and distance from the hoop. When his bean bag landed inside, he smiled and immediately looked around for more bean bags to continue the activity. He turned to the teacher and said, “I want more bean bags.”
interpretation: This observation shows Cavill’s ability to coordinate his hand movements and control his throwing force to aim at a target. He demonstrated spatial awareness by adjusting his distance from the hula hoop and moving around the play area to locate more bean bags.

在作品与分享环节，她指着画面解释道：“大家好，我是林芷涵，今天我分享我的功课，Daddy rabbit and baby rabbit put out his hands,i am the baby rabbit ！”她能够在老师的引导下，用较完整的句子描述自己的作品内容，并乐意与他人分享自己的构思和创意，展示了她对华语学习的兴趣。

interpretation:
