title: Jump and Land
description:
In this Kidzercise activity, Maia and her peers participated in a jumping challenge that involves jumping over obstacles for distance, and jumping for height. After a short warm-up session, the children were guided through proper jumping technique which focuses on using both feet to jump and land while bending their knees to soften the impact. The children were also encouraged to swing their arms to propel their bodies forward.

Maia was eager to try the jumping challenge and stepped forward alongside a peer. At first, she carefully observed her partner, as if trying to understand the technique before starting on her own. Eventually, she took the lead, and her peer began following her movements.

Maia swung her arms for momentum, but the timing didn’t quite match how she bent her knees. Although she was bending them, her movements weren’t fully coordinated. Before pushing herself forward, she hesitated, taking a long pause. She then swung her arms again, preparing herself. When she finally felt ready, Maia propelled herself forward with her arms and landed on both feet, but her knees remained locked, causing her body to lean forward slightly.

She then swung her arms again, preparing herself. When she finally felt ready, Maia propelled herself forward with her arms and landed perfectly with her knees bent, maintaining good balance and control.
interpretation:
Maia demonstrated growing confidence and control when jumping off with both feet during the Kidzercise activity. It took some time for Maia to find the right rhythm, but with repeated attempts, she gradually gained better momentum. As she continued practicing, her movements became more fluid, showing her growing confidence and understanding of the jumping technique. 


With guidance, she adjusted her technique by bending her knees before takeoff and upon landing, which helped her absorb impact more effectively. She also incorporated arm swings to generate momentum and improve her jump distance.

learning_goals.title: Be aware of what the body can do and develop their locomotor skills.
Move with balance and control.

title: Read and Sequence
description:
During the Lit Attack activity, the children engaged in reading a passage with decodable words and worked collaboratively to interpret its meaning. Wei En continued reading the third sentence after her group members had read the first two sentences: "Jen and her pet went to the vet." She read the sentence slowly but fluently, without any pauses, then continued listening attentively as her peers read the rest of the passage.

After the group finished reading, they looked at the pictures to match them to the sentences. Wei En waited patiently as her peer matched a picture to the first sentence. While doing so, she was observed scanning the second sentence. She then looked at the images and picked up a picture of a hen standing in the rain. As her groupmates read the sentence aloud, Wei En handed them the picture and placed it in the second box to match the sentence they were reading. She continued working collaboratively, checking each picture her peers picked up to ensure it matched the correct sentence.

When they were left with one picture, the group realized they might have placed an earlier picture incorrectly. Wei En suggested, "I think this number 10 is wrong. It should be in box number 4. The bed is here because they went home and went to bed, right?"
interpretation:
Wei En demonstrated strong decoding skills and growing confidence in reading during the Lit Attack activity. She read her sentences fluently, maintaining focus and accuracy without pauses. Wei En also exhibited active listening as her peers read, indicating her engagement and understanding of the task.


During the picture-matching activity, Wei En’s ability to scan the text and independently select the correct image showed her developing comprehension skills. Her careful observation and logical reasoning helped the group identify and correct an error in sequencing. Her explanation, “The bed is here because they went home and went to bed,” reflects her deepening understanding of how the text connects to visual representations and her growing ability to self-correct and problem-solve.


Wei En’s participation during this experience highlights her progress in decoding, interpreting meaning, and applying comprehension strategies during group tasks.

title: My ‘Not a Box’ Project
description:
After reading the story Not a Box, the children were invited to create their own "not a box" structures using different pieces of cardboard. Prior to the activity, the children were challenged to transform 2D cardboard pieces into 3D structures. We watched a video and learned 10 different ways to connect cardboard pieces. While creating their structures, the children used various techniques depending on their design goals.

Wei En was inspired to recreate an aquarium. She carefully selected her materials, gathering a few cardboard rolls and a large rectangular piece to use as her base. She worked independently for a while before pausing to observe how a friend connected his cardboard roll to his base.

Noticing her friend's approach, Wei En began cutting several tabs at the bottom of her cardboard roll. She paused again, watching closely, before folding the tabs outward and pressing the roll onto her base. To secure it, she used tape to fasten the tabs down. She repeated this process for the rest of her cardboard rolls.

The next day, Wei En returned to her work and began cutting small shapes, carefully pasting them onto the sides of the cardboard rolls. As she worked, she explained, "These are all the aquarium tanks. And these are the fishes."
interpretation:
Wei En’s engagement in this activity reflects her curiosity, adaptability, and problem-solving mindset. She demonstrates an interest in how materials can be manipulated to create meaningful structures. Her ability to incorporate new techniques suggests an openness to learning and a willingness to experiment with different methods. Her approach also highlights critical thinking and perseverance.


Additionally, Wei En’s work reveals her imaginative and representational thinking. She assigns meaning to her creation, transforming simple materials into a conceptual aquarium. This demonstrates an ability to translate abstract ideas into tangible forms.


By encouraging projects that allow for open-ended exploration, we can continue to nurture Wei En’s curiosity, confidence, and ability to think critically about how things are designed and constructed.

learning_goals.title: Experiment with open-ended materials.
Exercise creativity, innovation, imagination and seeing things differently while problem solving or performing a task.

title: 站起来
description: 下午的自由活动期间，在自然角落附近玩耍着的恩熙爬到塑胶盒前面对着塑胶盒坐了下来。她抬头看向塑胶盒的上方，接着她先后抬起左手臂和右手臂手掌掌心朝下使用五指一起抓握的手势掌握住了盒子的边缘，紧接着她还是先左后右的方式先后抬起左腿和右腿从坐姿转换成跪姿。在左手依旧抓握着盒子边缘的情况下她单独抬起右手臂将手肘搭到了盒子上方，然后双手臂和双腿一起有力至膝盖离开地面用双脚掌撑地挺直了身体，最后，她先迈动右腿和左腿向前走了一小步站在了盒子前。恩熙历时了约7-8秒钟从坐姿转换到跪姿，再转换到站姿。
interpretation: 首先，恩熙主动展开和享受了活动。这个过程中，恩熙展现了出色的身体协调性和平衡能力。从坐姿到跪姿再到站姿，她通过依次抬手、抬腿、支撑、挺直身体等一系列有序的动作，成功完成了站立的转换。这一系列动作不仅考验了她的核心力量和四肢协调性，还展现了她对自身动作的控制能力。

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (rolling over, sitting, crawling, standing, etc.) 发展粗大动作，如：翻身、坐、爬、站立等。

title: 神奇的布卡
description: 上午的自由活动时间，老师协助刚刚喝完了奶的奕程坐稳在了婴儿椅上。接着，老师一边对他说：“奕程，这个布卡会唱歌。”一边轻轻抓捏着有声布卡，将它递到奕程的手前。在老师的抓捏声中，他低头看向了布卡，随后依次伸出右手和左手，两手一起抓握住了布卡。紧接着，他的手指微微张开又合拢，不断地抓捏着布卡。老师微笑着立即鼓励他：“奕程，你把布卡抓出了声音，真棒！抓一抓，它就会发出声音，对不对？”老师说完后，奕程抬起头，张开小嘴笑了起来，随后，他又反复地抓捏了布卡约10秒钟后，他突然挥动右手臂，把手里抓着的布卡甩了出去。在接下来的活动中，老师分别又给了他绒布和纤维网，他也都伸手拿了过去，使用了相同的方式一边看，一边抓捏了它们。
interpretation: 奕程在抓捏布卡的过程中，持续保持专注，并反复尝试大约10秒钟，说明他能够在短时间内集中注意力。在接下来的活动中，他对绒布和纤维网也展现出相同的探索方式，说明他在运用前一次经验来理解新的材料，这体现了他的持续参与能力。

learning_goals.title: Develop focus and concentration  through sustained involvement in routines, transitions and experiences 通过常规活动、互动和体验，初步培养婴幼儿的持续参与-注意力。

title: Artwork Sample: Making a ladybug!
description:
As children’s interest revolved around creepy crawlies, children were invited to participate in a ladybug making activity. 
Children engaged in the painting of their ladybug, where they were able to make independent choices for the colours of their ladybug. Children used paper plates to form the wings of the ladybug and used a paintbrush to paint the acrylic paint onto their paper plate. 
Next, as children understood there were dotted patterns on the ladybug’s wings, they used a sponge tool to stamp the ladybug’s dots on its back using black acrylic paint. 

This activity allows children to choose their own colours and explore different effects through painting and stamping. Making art a fun, hands-on, and meaningful experience. Additionally, fostering creativity and self-expression to bring their ladybug to life. 

“My ladybug!” Allysa said as she was done with the first round of painting the ladybug’s wings.

title: 新年红
description: 老师轻轻地扶着奕程，让他舒适地躺在游戏区的枕头上，然后拿起一根红色的缎带，在他的小手上方轻轻晃动，温柔地对他说：“奕程，看看这是什么？这是红色的带子，来，试着伸手抓住它吧！”在老师的话语声中，他的目光先停留在正上方的缎带上，凝视了约 2-3 秒钟后，小手缓缓举起，微微张开手指，尝试抓握。就在他成功握住带子的那一刻，老师笑着夸奖道：“奕程，真棒！你一把就抓住了红色的带子！红色象征着新年的喜庆，奕程一定会过一个红红火火的新年哦！”手中依旧掌握住带子的奕程小脸上漾起了一丝微笑。随后，老师拿起一个红色的网袋苹果，将它轻轻举到奕程面前。这一次，他依旧用相同的方式伸手抓握。当老师松开手后，他独自紧紧握住苹果，目不转睛地观察了 4-5 秒钟，直到苹果从小手中滑落。最后，他依然带着笑意，双手握着一个红包灯笼，玩耍了一会儿。
interpretation: 整个过程奕程的脸上带着微笑，他的情感状态是积极的，享受和物品互动的过程。通过游戏和互动，奕程在情感上体验到了愉悦和满足感。通过物品的探索，他逐步培养了对物品的喜爱。

Children engaged in the painting of their ladybug, where they were able to make independent choices for the colours of their ladybug. Children used paper plates to form the wings of the ladybug and used a paintbrush to paint the acrylic paint onto their paper plate. 
Next, as children understood there were dotted patterns on the ladybug’s wings, they used a sponge tool to stamp the ladybug’s dots on its back using black acrylic paint.

This activity allows children to choose their own colours and explore different textures through painting and stamping. Making art a fun, hands-on, and meaningful experience. Additionally, fostering creativity and self-expression to bring their ladybug to life.

title: 丢字卡游戏
description:
教师带领幼儿复习学过的字卡，爬山、捕鱼、园丁、大石头、追、抓、躲。然后将这些字卡贴到玻璃窗上。教师出示沙包，为幼儿演示投掷沙包击打玻璃上的字卡。之后，教师将幼儿分组，幼儿成功击打到字卡后需要读出字卡上的内容才能将字卡撕下。
家乐来到起始线站好，他捡起一个沙包，说道：“谢老师，我好了。”教师发出‘开始’指令后，家乐往前投掷沙包。他来到玻璃窗前，指着一个字卡，说：“我打到了这个。”教师问他字卡上的内容是什么。他看了看，说：“是捕鱼。”说完，他取下字卡。他将字卡交给组员并说：“我有一个了。”然后，他回到起始线，又进行了一次投掷。他来到玻璃窗前，告诉教师：“我打这个旁边。”教师问他是哪个字卡，他说：“是大石头。”说完，他取下了字卡。
interpretation: 家乐对认读字卡有兴趣，能够听懂3个指令并按照游戏规则进行投掷游戏，能够读出一些击中的卡片上的词语。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解3个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（读）- 文字：对认读汉字有兴趣。

title: Playing soccer!
description:
To support children's gross motor development, they were invited to kick a soccer ball between two poles while imagining themselves as players in a soccer match. To help with balance, they were encouraged to stretch their arms out like airplane wings. The teacher provided verbal guidance, such as “Swing your leg back” and “Now, kick the ball with your foot”, to support their movements and coordination.

Avery stood behind the ball with her hands partially extended at her sides. She shifted her weight to the left and lifted her right leg backward. Though she wobbled slightly, she quickly swung her right leg forward and struck the ball with the front of her foot.

Given another opportunity, Avery chose to stand further behind the ball. This time, she ran a short distance while swinging her arms and kicked the ball with her right foot as she ran. When she successfully kicked the ball between the poles, the teacher cheered, “Goal! Good job, Avery!” Feeling a sense of accomplishment, Avery smiled and giggled excitedly.
interpretation: Avery was able to demonstrate a good sense of balance and coordination , which helped support her development in her ability to kick. Her ability to stand on one leg while preparing to kick demonstrates balance, a fundamental skill for controlled movements. Additionally, her coordination was evident as she synchronized her leg movement with her eye focus on the ball, ensuring accuracy. Hence, these combined skills contribute to her gross motor development in supporting her to engage in more complex physical activities such as kicking. Avery's level of engagement was evident through her high level of vitality during the activity.

title: 坐立练习
description: 老师抱着奕程坐在柔软的枕头前，接着坐在他对面，帮助他双手撑在前方的软垫上，保持身体稳定。等奕程坐稳后，老师轻轻松开了手，微笑着对他说：“奕程，好棒哦！你看，你自己坐着了，而且坐得好稳！真是太棒了！”在老师的夸奖声中，奕程抬起头，张开小嘴露出了笑容看向老师。在老师的注视下，他面带微笑，抬起右手，轻轻地从软垫上松开，微微挺直身体，向右侧张开了手臂。接着，他又松开了左手，抬起后向左侧伸展。没有任何支撑的奕程独自坐了约4到5秒钟，随后开始向一侧倾斜，老师迅速伸手扶住了他。
interpretation: 总的来说，奕程的身体动作展现了他在身体控制、协调性的发展过程。他在老师的支持下逐步学会了如何保持坐姿、如何协调手臂动作，并且尝试独立完成短暂的平衡。这一过程体现了他在探索和学习身体运动技能时的逐步进步，同时也反映了他对自我身体控制的日益增强。

title: 翻翻乐
description:
早期阅读时间，教师带领幼儿学习了绘本《毛毛虫》，学习词语蜻蜓、蚊子、蝴蝶、瓢虫等。教师邀请两位幼儿一起进行游戏。幼儿可以参考字图卡，也可以直接使用字卡进行游戏。幼儿先将两套卡片摆放在地板上，记忆一下字卡的位置然后将字卡翻过来盖上。幼儿进行猜拳，获胜的一方可以进行两次翻卡活动。若翻到一样的字卡，则能将字卡收起。幼儿继续游戏，直到字卡全部被收集。
媖绮和同伴一起将字卡摆放在地板上，她们一起看了看字卡。然后将字卡翻过来盖上。媖绮和同伴一起猜拳，她们一起说道：“石头、剪刀、布。”媖绮出了剪刀，同伴出了石头，媖绮对同伴说：“你先。”同伴翻开了两张卡片，说道：“蝴蝶。”媖绮说：“你对了，你有两个卡片了。”她们又开始猜拳，这一次媖绮赢了，她翻开两张卡片，读道：“蜻蜓。”说完，她笑着将卡片收到自己身边。她们又继续猜拳，几轮后，媖绮又赢了，她翻开两张卡片，说：“我知道在哪里，是蜜蜂。”她们又继续游戏，直到卡片都被收集完毕。
interpretation: 媖绮对认读字卡有兴趣，能够听懂3个游戏指令并按照规则进行翻翻乐游戏，能够将字卡和图片配对，能够认识一些字卡。

语言学习成果（读）- 文字：对认读汉字有兴趣。

title: Playing soccer!
description:
To support children's gross motor development, they were invited to kick a soccer ball between two poles while imagining themselves as players in a soccer match. To help with balance, they were encouraged to stretch their arms out like airplane wings. The teacher provided verbal guidance, such as “Swing your leg back” and “Now, kick the ball with your foot”, to support their movements and coordination.

Kieran stood behind the ball, extending his arms for balance and focusing his eyes on the ball. He took a step forward with his left leg and kicked the side of the ball with the side of his right foot. As the ball didn’t go far, the teacher encouraged him, saying, “Nicely done, Kieran! Would you like to try again? This time, kick the ball with the front of your foot.” Kieran nodded and repositioned himself behind the ball.

For his second attempt, he extended his arms for balance and kept his eyes on the ball. Stepping forward with his left leg, he kicked the ball with the front of his right foot, using more strength. The teacher clapped and cheered, “Yay! You did it!”, and a smile spread across Kieran’s face.
interpretation: Kieran showed a good sense of balance, coordination and adaptability, which contributed to his gross motor development of kicking. He displayed good balance by being able to shift his weight from center to the left by taking a step forward. He also showed good coordination as he was able to synchronise his leg movements while also keeping his focus on the ball. Additionally, he adapted efficiently after heeding the teacher’s suggestion by using the front of his foot to kick the ball. Kieran displayed keen engagement throughout the activity as he was able to follow instructions provided by the teacher.

title: Pegging Socks
description: After listening to the story "A Pair of Socks" by Stuart J. Murphy, Gracie was engaged in an interactive activity to help her practice matching sock pairs. She was provided with a variety of sock cutouts and encouraged to find the matching pairs. Once she identified the matching socks, she used the pegs to pin them onto a "clothesline." Gracie was able to systematically coordinate her actions—first, she placed the pair of socks near the clothesline, then used one hand to reach for the peg, bring it to the clothesline, and open it to peg the socks. After Gracie finished pegging the given socks; she eagerly requested more socks and pegs, showing a clear enthusiasm for the activity and a desire to continue practicing her fine motor skills.
interpretation:
This hands-on activity provided opportunities for developing her fine motor skills. Specifically, as Gracie uses her pincer grasp to open the pegs, she is strengthening the small muscles in her fingers and hands. This skill is essential for future tasks such as writing and drawing. The act of pinching the peg and accurately attaching it to the clothesline requires hand-eye coordination, which is crucial for overall motor development.


Additionally, the activity involves Gracie in a fun, tactile experience, encouraging her to practice precise movements and control. As she handles the pegs, she is also enhancing her grip strength and dexterity, which will benefit her ability to perform other everyday tasks with increased ease and confidence. This fun, hands-on task supports her overall fine motor development while reinforcing the concept of matching pairs.

To help with balance, they were encouraged to stretch their arms out like airplane wings. The teacher provided verbal guidance, such as “Swing your leg back” and “Now, kick the ball with your foot”, to support their movements and coordination.

Si Rui stood behind the ball, holding his hands out for balance. When the teacher said, “Ready… Go!”, he lifted his right leg and kicked the ball with the front of his foot. Noticing his shyness and hesitation, the teacher encouraged him, saying, “Wow! You did it! Shall we try it one more time?” Si Rui smiled and nodded before eagerly retrieving the ball for another attempt.

This time, he extended his arms for balance, stepped forward with his left foot, and lifted his right leg to kick the ball with more strength.
interpretation: Si Rui demonstrated a good sense of balance and coordination through this activity, which contributed to his gross motor development of kicking. He showed good balance as he was able to shift his body weight and balance with one leg, while raising the other to kick the ball. Si Rui also displayed coordination by aligning his leg movements along with keeping his focus on the ball, showing good eye-foot coordination. Si Rui had an increasing level of engagement throughout the activity, which was accompanied by the teacher's encouragement.

description:
教师准备了宽的纸条，请幼儿挑选自己喜欢的颜色，握住画笔，将画笔伸进颜料碗里，蘸取颜料，移动画笔到纸上，按住画笔左右移动，将颜色刷满整个纸张，制作蛇的身体。
       当老师询问赞杰想要什么颜色时，赞杰告诉老师说：“我要红色！”他右手握住画笔，左手按在纸上，将画笔移到纸上，从右向左移动，画出了线条，直到到达纸的边缘，老师引导他可以尝试从左往右移动，他重新将画笔放进颜料碗里，将画笔落在了左边，按住移动到右边，就这样多次重复，涂满了整个纸张。
interpretation: 赞杰可以两手配合完成涂色的动作，并尝试从不同的方向移动画笔涂满纸张，体现了他的手眼协调能力较好。

title: 粘贴画《宝宝的脸》
description: 教师为幼儿提供镜子、空白的脸谱，五官图片、各种环保材料制作的头发和胶水等材料。教师出示空白的脸谱和镜子，引导幼儿观察镜子中的自己和空白脸谱，鼓励班级幼儿说一说或指一指空白脸谱宝宝缺少了哪些部位？（五官和头发）教师出示各种材料和胶水，为幼儿进行讲解和示范如何帮助可爱的宝宝制作和粘贴缺失的五官和头发。教师鼓励引导幼儿选择材料进行粘贴，展现出自己心中的“宝宝的脸”。在活动过程中，教师与幼儿讨论他们选择头发的颜色和五官的名称及数量，如：绿色的头发、黑色的头发、两只眼睛，一个鼻子等。当作品完成后，他们笑着欣赏自己的作品，然后展示给教师和同伴看。每一幅作品都充满了幼儿对美的理解和表达。在这个过程中，幼儿们不仅提高了自己的动手能力和审美能力，还体验到了粘贴画艺术创作的乐趣。同时也锻炼了幼儿的手眼协调能力。

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work etc.) 通过美术活动，如：粗蜡笔涂鸦、水彩画、撕贴画、拼贴等，培养幼儿对艺术的兴趣。

title: I can Draw !
description:
Devan and his peers were invited to draw out what they remembered about their family outing. 

Devan started to draw circles and various lines. Teacher then asked him what he was drawing. Devan replied that he drew him and Daddy cycling in the park. Devan then begun to point out the various parts of his drawings and shared that his favorite activity was cycling and that he can cycle on his own. 

Devan begun to color his drawings once he had completed his drawing. When he was done, he turned to the teacher and said "I am done!"
interpretation:
Through the activity above, Devan displayed his ability in being able to express his experiences and opinions through his drawings.


He was also able to describe what he drew within his drawings and what it represented.

learning_goals.title: Represent experiences and feelings (e.g: personal event, field trip) through artworks.
Describe and explain ideas in their artworks (e.g: lines to represent motion).

title: 涂色
description:
教师准备了宽的纸条，请幼儿挑选自己喜欢的颜色，握住画笔，将画笔伸进颜料碗里，蘸取颜料，移动画笔到纸上，按住画笔左右移动，将颜色刷满整个纸张，制作蛇的身体。
       当老师询问峻宇想要什么颜色时，峻宇告诉老师说：“我要绿色这个！”他右手握住画笔，伸进颜料碗蘸取颜色，随后左手按在纸上，将画笔移到纸上，从左向右移动，画出了多个线条，有的是直线，有的是弯曲的线，接着他在纸上点圆点，点了几个圆点之后他重新将画笔放进颜料碗里，将画笔落在了左边，按住移动到右边，就这样多次重复，涂满了整个纸张。
interpretation: 峻宇可以两手配合完成涂色的动作，并尝试从不同的方向移动画笔涂满纸张，画直线、画曲线、画圆点，体现了他的手眼协调能力较好。

title: Pegging socks
description: After listening to the story "A Pair of Socks" by Stuart J. Murphy, Jordan was engaged in an interactive activity to help him practice matching sock pairs. He was provided with a variety of sock cutouts and encouraged to find the matching pairs. Once he identified the matching socks he used pegs to pin them onto a "clothesline." Jordan was able to systematically coordinate his actions—first, he placed the pair of socks near the clothesline, then used one hand to reach for the peg, bring it to the clothesline, and open it to peg the socks.
interpretation:
This hands-on activity provided opportunities for developing his fine motor skills. Specifically, as Jordan uses his pincer grasp to open the pegs, he is strengthening the small muscles in his fingers and hands. This skill is essential for future tasks such as writing and drawing. The act of pinching the peg and accurately attaching it to the clothesline requires hand-eye coordination, which is crucial for overall motor development.

Additionally, the activity involves Jordan in a fun, tactile experience, encouraging him to practice precise movements and control. As he handles the pegs, he is also enhancing his grip strength and dexterity, which will benefit his ability to perform other everyday tasks with increased ease and confidence. This fun, hands-on task supports his overall fine motor development while reinforcing the concept of matching pairs.

title: 合作运球
description:
教师在地上贴了一条直线，将三把椅子分别间隔一段距离摆放并排成一行，鼓励幼儿两人一组分别握住球的两端沿着直线行走，并沿着椅子走S型路线到达终点，弯腰将球投放到筐子里。
     赞杰与同伴分别站在直线的两侧，握住皮球，老师询问：“准备好了吗？”赞杰和同伴回答道：“好了！”老师说：“出发！”随后赞杰和同伴侧着身体，赞杰一边看着直线，一边移动双脚，到达椅子的位置后，他侧着身体拐过椅子，转弯两次，到达了筐子的位置，他和同伴一起弯腰蹲下，将皮球放进了筐子里，开心的和朋友击掌！
interpretation: 赞杰可以和同伴合作沿着直线和曲线前进，将皮球放进筐子里完成任务，体现了他的大肌肉力量较强，有一定的空间感。

interpretation: Matteo's ability to carefully pinch and transfer the pom-poms with the tongs demonstrates his developing fine motor skills. His precise control and hand-eye coordination reflect his progress in tasks requiring dexterity and focus, aligning perfectly with the objective of fostering fine motor development. This activity highlights his growing ability to perform tasks that require precision and patience.

title: Pegging socks
description: After listening to the story "A Pair of Socks" by Stuart J. Murphy, Zhao De was engaged in an interactive activity to help him practice matching sock pairs. He was provided with a variety of sock cutouts and encouraged to find the matching pairs. Once he identified the matching socks he used pegs to pin them onto a "clothesline." Zhao De was able to systematically coordinate his actions—first, he placed one sock near the clothesline, then used one hand to reach for the peg, bring it to the clothesline, and open it to peg the sock. Then he proceeded to do the same to peg the other matching sock. While doing so, he made the following comments- “See I can.” “So many socks.”
interpretation:
This hands-on activity provided opportunities for developing his fine motor skills. Specifically, as Zhao De uses his pincer grasp to open the pegs, he is strengthening the small muscles in his fingers and hands. This skill is essential for future tasks such as writing and drawing. The act of pinching the peg and accurately attaching it to the clothesline requires hand-eye coordination, which is crucial for overall motor development.

Additionally, the activity involves Zhao De in a fun, tactile experience, encouraging him to practice precise movements and control. As he handles the pegs, he is also enhancing his grip strength and dexterity, which will benefit his ability to perform other everyday tasks with increased ease and confidence. This fun, hands-on task supports his overall fine motor development while reinforcing the concept of matching pairs.

title: Pollen transfer
description:
In this activity, the children used tongs to carefully transfer "pollen" (represented by small yellow pom-poms) into bee hives, which tapped on their fine motor skills. By carefully manipulating the tongs to pick up and place each pom-pom, the children were able to focus on the precision and control required for the task. This helped strengthen their hand-eye coordination, as they had to focus on both their hand movements and the positioning of the pom-poms.

Stephy approached the task step by step as she used the tongs to transfer the pom-poms. First, she carefully positioned the tongs around the pom-pom, using her right hand to pinch the tongs open. Then, with her left hand, she guided the pom-pom into the tongs, making sure it was securely placed in the middle. As she started to lift the pom-pom, Stephy used her fingers and thumb from her left hand to reinforce the grip, pressing gently on the handles to ensure the pom-pom wouldn’t slip out. She then carefully moved the tongs toward the bee hive, adjusting her grip with both hands to maintain control and precision as she placed the pom-pom into the hive.
interpretation: Stephy demonstrated a thoughtful approach as she used the tongs to transfer the pom-poms. She needed both hands to successfully complete the task by using one hand to pinch the tongs around the pom-pom and the other to carefully guide the pom-pom into place.By using both hands effectively, Stephy displayed her ability to coordinate fine motor skills and enhance her grip strength, reinforcing her developing hand-eye coordination and dexterity.

title: 制作颜色水
description:
教师引导幼儿观察不同颜色的色素，随后教师示范将棉签插进色素瓶里蘸取颜色，再将棉签放进水里，当水和颜色混合在一起时，请幼儿观察水的变化，随后幼儿挑选自己喜欢的颜色，轮流操作。
      当老师询问赞杰想要哪一个颜色时，赞杰指着红色和绿色的色素瓶说：“红色、绿色。”随后他拿着棉签将棉签插进红色的色素瓶里，将棉签取出来放进水里，搅拌了几下，水立马变红，老师询问：“赞杰，水变成什么颜色了？”赞杰回答：“红色。”老师询问：“你还想在这个水里加入另外一个颜色吗？”赞杰回答道：“要！”随后他将绿色加了进去，水变成了棕色，老师询问道：“赞杰，水变颜色了吗？”赞杰回答道：“有！”老师询问道：“你知道这是什么颜色吗？”赞杰摇了摇头，老师回应道：“棕色！水变成棕色了，是不是？”赞杰重复道：“棕色！水变成棕色了！”
interpretation: 赞杰能够积极参与制作颜色水的活动，并选择自己喜欢的颜色，混合在一起，耐心操作，观察水的变化，与老师一起重复词汇，体现了他有较强的好奇心，愿意了解色素的属性。

title: 好玩的绒球
description: 下午以关系为本的课程活动时间，教师继续带领班级幼儿一起玩“好玩的绒球”游戏。教师对班级幼儿说：“小朋友们，谁要过来玩这个有趣的游戏，把这些漂亮的绒球塞进彩色洞洞里面呀？”看到这些色彩鲜艳的绒球，Davi眼睛瞬间亮了起来，和同伴一起笑着跑到教师身边坐了下来。教师拿了一篮子绒球和一个带有不同颜色洞洞的纸盒给Davi。只见Davi迫不及待的伸出左手用大拇指、食指及中指伸进篮子捏起一个蓝色的小绒球，然后迅速把绒球塞进了盒子上的一个洞洞里。教师夸奖他说：“Davi做的真棒，你拿起一个蓝色的小绒球，把它放到洞洞里了。”Davi听到教师夸奖他，他笑着抬起头看向教师，然后继续伸出左手从篮子里抓起一把不同颜色和大小的绒球。教师提醒他说：“Davi，不要着急，要一个一个把小绒球塞到洞洞里哦！”Davi抬起头看了看教师，又看了看手中的绒球，然后他伸出右手用大拇指、食指及中指精准的从左手的绒球中捏住一个黄色大绒球拿了起来。他右手捏着黄色的大绒球放到洞洞边上尝试把绒球塞进洞洞里。第一次尝试没有成功，Davi的小眉头皱了起来，眼神里透露出一丝疑惑。他没有放弃，而是更加用力地用手指按压绒球。教师鼓励他说：“Davi别着急，再试试看，试试调整一下绒球的位置。”Davi听到教师的话，小眼睛专注地盯着洞口和绒球，小脑袋微微倾斜，调整着绒球的位置。调整好后Davi放开绒球伸出食指用力的按压下去，黄色的大绒球顺利的进入了洞洞里。Davi笑着抬起头，指着那个洞洞让给教师看。教师拍手夸奖他：“Davi好厉害，成功的把黄色大绒球按进洞洞里了！”Davi笑着继续玩这个游戏，他乐此不疲地重复着抓绒球、塞洞洞的动作，操作越来越熟练，还会一边玩一边发出“嗯嗯”的声音，仿佛在给自己加油鼓劲，直到快把盒子塞满了才停止。
interpretation: Davi能够熟练运用大拇指、食指和中指抓握绒球，这表明他的精细动作和手部小肌肉群已经有了较好的发展，具备了一定的抓握能力。在将绒球塞进洞洞的过程中，他能够根据绒球和洞洞的位置进行尝试和调整，体现了手眼协调能力正在逐步发展。他能用食指用力将绒球按进洞洞里，可以看出他手指小肌肉力量发展的很好。在活动过程中遇到困难时，Davi 没有轻易放弃，而是通过自己的努力去尝试解决问题，这反映出他具有一定的坚持性和探索精神。同时他也表现出了快乐、自信享受与轻松。

title: 我会画形状
description:
教师在地上张贴了一张大纸，鼓励幼儿在空间里挑选自己喜欢的物品，将物品放在纸上，一手按住物品，一手握住画笔，尝试将自己挑选的物品的轮廓画出来。
赞杰在空间里选择了一个杯子，老师询问赞杰：“赞杰，你拿的是什么呀？”赞杰回应道：“杯子（英文）。”老师说：“是杯子吗？”赞杰点了点头回应道：“是，杯子！”随后他坐了下来，将杯子侧放在纸上，一只手按住杯子，一只手握住水彩笔将杯子的轮廓画了下来，赞杰指给老师说：“陈老师，你看！”老师回应说：“是圆形吗？”赞杰点了点头说：“圆形！”随后老师鼓励他将杯子立起来试试看，赞杰听后将杯子立起来画出了杯子的轮廓，并将两端接口处用线连了起来，老师鼓励道：“哇，赞杰，杯子立起来后，画的圆更圆了！”赞杰点了点头说：“是！”随后跟老师击掌说：“我真棒！”
interpretation: 赞杰能够挑选出自己喜欢的杯子，并尝试不同的角度画出杯子的形状，体现了他对物品的形状、大小有一定的认识。

title: 我的身体
description:
教师引导幼儿观察图片上的身体部位，认识各个身体部位名称后，请幼儿照镜子指一指，说说身体部位的位置，并跟老师重复说出它们的名称。
      含饴对着镜子看了看自己，老师发出指令：“含饴，鼻子在哪里？”含饴立马找到了鼻子的位置，老师引导说：“含饴，跟陈老师说，鼻子！”含饴重复道：“鼻子！”随后老师又问道：“耳朵在哪里？”含饴立马找到了耳朵的位置，跟着老师说：“耳朵！”接着老师又问道：“头发在哪里？”含饴摸了摸自己的头发，跟着老师说：“头发。”最后含饴也一一指出了嘴巴、眉毛、膝盖、肩膀、脚等部位的位置，并跟着老师说出它们的名称。
interpretation: 含饴能够跟着老师的指令，指出五官和其他身体部位的名称，并愿意跟着老师重复说出它们的华语名称，体现了他对身体部位有一定的认识。

        敏瑄在空间里选择了一把铲子，老师询问敏瑄：“敏瑄，你拿的是什么呀？”敏瑄看向老师，老师说：“是铲子吗？”敏瑄点了点头回应道：“铲子~”随后坐坐了下来，将铲子放在纸上，一只手按住铲子手柄，一只手握住水彩笔将杯子的大致轮廓画了下来，随后指给老师看，老师回应说：“哦，原来铲子的形状是这样啊！长长的~”敏瑄看着老师重复说：“长长的~”随后老师鼓励她再去挑选物品，她选择了杯子，画出了杯子的形状，抬起手看，老师引导说：“你看，杯子是圆形的呢！”敏瑄重复道：“圆形！”随后她也画出了鱼的形状，跟老师击掌说：“我真棒！”

title: 我的身体
description:
教师引导幼儿观察图片上的身体部位，认识各个身体部位名称后，请幼儿照镜子指一指，说说身体部位的位置，并跟老师重复说出它们的名称。
       麗颖对着镜子看了看自己，老师发出指令：“麗颖，眼睛在哪里？”麗颖立马找到了鼻子的位置，老师引导说：“麗颖，跟陈老师说，我的眼睛！”麗颖重复道：“我的眼睛！”随后老师又问道：“嘴巴在哪里？”麗颖立马找到了嘴巴的位置，跟着老师说：“我的嘴巴！”接着老师又问道：“小脚在哪里？”麗颖将脚踩在镜子上，跟着老师说：“我的小脚。”最后麗颖也一一指出了鼻子、眉毛、膝盖、肩膀、脚等部位的位置，并跟着老师说出它们的名称。
interpretation: 麗颖能够跟着老师的指令，指出五官和其他身体部位的名称，并愿意跟着老师重复说出它们的华语名称，体现了她对身体部位有一定的认识。

title: Pegging socks
description: After listening to the story "A Pair of Socks" by Stuart J. Murphy, Louka was engaged in an interactive activity to help him practice matching sock pairs. He was provided with a variety of sock cutouts and encouraged to find the matching pairs. Once he identified the matching socks he used pegs to pin them onto a "clothesline." Louka was able to systematically coordinate his actions—first, he placed one sock near the clothesline, then used one hand to reach for the peg, bring it to the clothesline, and open it to peg the sock. Then he proceeded to do the same to peg the other matching sock. While doing so, he made the following comments- “See blue and yellow.” “I wearing blue and yellow.”
interpretation:
This hands-on activity provided opportunities for developing his fine motor skills. Specifically, as Louka uses his pincer grasp to open the pegs, he is strengthening the small muscles in his fingers and hands. This skill is essential for future tasks such as writing and drawing. The act of pinching the peg and accurately attaching it to the clothesline requires hand-eye coordination, which is crucial for overall motor development.

Additionally, the activity involves Louka in a fun, tactile experience, encouraging him to practice precise movements and control. As he handles the pegs, he is also enhancing his grip strength and dexterity, which will benefit his ability to perform other everyday tasks with increased ease and confidence. This fun, hands-on task supports his overall fine motor development while reinforcing the concept of matching pairs.

description: 上午游乐场时间，在教师的带领下颖杰和同伴一起来到游乐场玩耍。进入游乐场后，颖杰笑着跑到三轮车旁，小手熟练地抓住车把。教师问：“颖杰，你要骑三轮车吗？”颖杰笑着点点头说：“嗯！”只见他用左手抓着车把，然后抬起右脚跨过车座敏捷地坐到了三轮车上。教师问他：“颖杰要骑车出发了吗？”颖杰点点头，抬起右手挥了挥跟教师说：“拜拜！”他把小脚稳稳地踩在地面上，腰背部也挺直着，保持着身体的平衡。然后颖杰开始快速地走起来，小脚丫交替着用力，带动着三轮车向前行进。速度越来越快，不一会儿就从快走变成了小跑。他的眼睛专注地看着前方，小脸上洋溢着自信和快乐的笑容。当遇到需要转弯的地方时，颖杰灵活地转动车把，身体也跟着微微倾斜，三轮车就顺利地拐过弯去。当遇到迎面有同伴走过来时，他会双手用力抓住车把，挺直腰背，双脚同时用力踩在地上使三轮车停下来，避免与同伴相撞。等同伴走过去后，他继续带动三轮车向前走，然后逐渐加速跑起来。教师在一旁关注着颖杰的表现，大声鼓励道：“颖杰，你骑得太棒啦！看到同伴会停下来让路你做的真好！加油！”颖杰听到教师的夸奖，脸上的笑容更加灿烂了，还回头向教师挥了挥手，然后又加快速度向前骑去。
interpretation: 通过观察可以看出颖杰对骑三轮车很有兴趣，他能手握车把，抬起小脚平稳地骑在三轮车上面。颖杰的双手握住车把控制方向，双脚交替蹬地提供动力，腰背部挺直保持身体稳定，各个部位的肌肉相互配合，共同完成骑行动作。他坐在三轮车上可以快速地走和跑，这表明他的腿部肌肉力量和粗大动作发展良好。在转弯时，颖杰能够灵活地转动车把并调整身体的倾斜角度，保持三轮车的平衡，顺利完成转弯动作。通过这个活动，颖杰的粗大动作和四肢、腰背部肌肉的协调运动能力都得到了很好的锻炼。在整个活动过程中颖杰展现出了高度的快乐、自信和活力。

title: Word Hunt Activity
description:
Hwee Jeanne was introduced to the vocabulary words in the guided reading book as titled "I am". She read out words such as eating, drinking, reading, sleeping, and riding with the teacher before she began a word hunt activity.

During the word hunt activity, "Hwee Jeanne, can you use the finger pointer to find the word 'sleeping'?" asked the teacher. Hwee Jeanne looked around the given words and picture cues in front of her. She moved the finger pointer with her right hand in the left direction, and landed the finger pointer on the word 'sleeping', and said "Here, Ms Clarissa." "Good job, Hwee Jeanne! Can you find the word 'drinking'?" said the teacher. Hwee Jeanne moved the finger pointed upwards, and pointed to the word 'drinking', and said "Over here, Ms Clarissa." "Nice, can you find the word 'eating'?" replied the teacher. Hwee Jeanne moved her finger pointer to the word beside 'drinking', and said "Ok here." "Yes, Hwee Jeanne. Alright, now where is the word 'riding'?" Hwee Jeanne looked down, and moved her finger pointer downwards of the word 'drinking', and said "Right here." "That's correct, Hwee Jeanne! Now where is the word 'reading'?" said the teacher. Hwee Jeanne looked down again, and moved her finger pointer to the word next to 'riding', and said "Reading here." "Well done, Hwee Jeanne! You have found all the words that you needed to find! You may go play now." said the teacher. "Yay, I can play!" replied Hwee Jeanne, and she went off to play at the Kidzercise centre.
interpretation: Hwee Jeanne displayed her understanding of alphabet knowledge and phonological awareness whereby she was able to find and point to the vocabulary words in the word hunt activity when being told to by referring to the picture cues.

learning_goals.title: Alphabet Knowledge: Begin to develop knowledge about letters.
Phonological Awareness: Understand that language is made up of words, syllables, rhymes and individual sounds.

title: 丢球活动
description:
描述：
        教师向幼儿展示球和盒子，邀请幼儿进行投球的游戏。教师鼓励幼儿从托盘上拿起一个纸球，在固定的位置上将球扔进盒子里面。
        教师告诉晟德要从椅子上拿起一个纸球，然后将纸球扔进盒子里面。晟德走到椅子的前面，他用他的右手拿起一个纸球，他走到胶带前，身体向前倾，抬起胳膊将球抛进了盒子里面，教师看到后，对晟德竖起大拇指说道：“晟德，你能够将球扔进盒子里面，你很有力气哦。”晟德看着教师说道：“是的。”晟得继续用右手拿球用同样的方法将球扔进盒子里面，他对教师说：“张老师你看，我丢球。”
interpretation:
诠释：

      晟德在进行活动的过程中能够用右手拿起纸球，展现出晟德手部的抓握能力，他也能够在固定的位置将球扔进盒子里面，展现出各身体部位能够相互协调。他也够用简单的句子与教师进行对话。

title: Throwing beanbag
description: Andrea walked toward the wall where pictures of a sandwich and a pizza were pasted. She was encouraged to choose which one she would like to eat, and after deciding on the pizza, Andrea was asked to throw a beanbag toward the picture. With focus, she lifted her arm, aimed carefully, and made an overhead throw. The beanbag soared through the air, landing near the pizza picture, and Andrea excitedly called out, “See, Teacher Michelle.” She then continued to use the remaining beanbags, aiming and throwing them at the pizza picture.
interpretation:
This activity provides a fun way to help Andrea develop her gross motor skills by practicing an overhead throw. As she lifted her arms and aimed, Andrea engaged the large muscles in her arms, shoulders, and torso, improving her coordination and strength. The act of throwing the beanbag also enhances hand-eye coordination as Andrea learns to judge the distance and angle needed to hit the target.

Additionally, this activity supports balance and body awareness as Andrea adjusts her posture and uses her whole body to generate the force needed for the throw. By combining physical movement with decision-making, Andrea not only practices gross motor skills but also builds confidence in her ability to control her movements while having fun.

title: Family Science Fun: Making Ice Cream Together
description:
The children had the opportunity to participate in a hands-on science experiment that replicated a fun family activity: making ice cream. The experiment demonstrated how liquids turn into solids through freezing. 

Averie began by pouring cream into a small resealable bag. Then, she added sugar and vanilla to it. Lastly, she added some ice cubes and salt to a bigger resealable bag and placed the bag with the liquid in it. 

Averie said, “This bag is so cold! The ice can help to freeze my ice cream. " As she shook the bag for a few minutes, she looked at the liquid mixture freezing and said, “I think my ice cream is frozen already!” 

She opened the resealable bags and removed the bag with the ice cream. She picked up a cup and a spoon and slowly scooped the ice cream from the bag. As she was eating her ice cream, she said, “Wow, Teacher Yani, this is so yummy! I like it! It is so creamy and sweet!”
interpretation: Through this activity, it is evident that Averie is willing to try something new and different. She confidently explored the idea of freezing through the ice cream-making experiment. She could make connections in which the ice cube combined with salt would freeze the ice cream mixture to make ice cream. In addition, Averie could also develop her self-awareness by creating a positive self-concept, as she confidently carried out simple tasks.

learning_goals.title: Willing to try out something new and different.

title: These Are My Friends
description:
Arissa approached the Pee-Ka-Boo wall with curiosity, her small hands reaching out to touch the recycled wet wipes lids. She examined them closely before attempting to pry one open with her fingers. Using only her left hand, she struggled to lift the lid, making several attempts but was unsuccessful. Arissa then paused, looking up at her teacher and after a brief moment of observation, she refocused on the task, this time using both hands. With additional effort, she successfully pried the lid open.

As soon as the lid flipped open, Arissa's eyes lit up upon seeing the picture hidden beneath. She gently pointed at the image and softly said, "Liam." She then turned her head, scanning the classroom. Spotting Liam sitting nearby, drinking from his water bottle, she confidently pointed at him and repeated, "Liam." 

Encouraged by her success, Arissa eagerly turned back to the Pee-Ka-Boo wall, ready to explore more hidden images. She reached for another lid, using both hands to lift it this time. As the lid popped open, she peered at the picture inside and, without hesitation, exclaimed, "This Noelle!" She then turned her gaze toward the classroom, searching for Noelle among her peers. Arissa appeared delighted each time she made a correct identification.

Arissa's participation in the "These Are My Friends" activity demonstrated her growing ability to recognize and identify her peers by name. She actively engaged with the Pee-Ka-Boo wall, using problem-solving skills to open the lids and confidently naming her classmates upon seeing their pictures. Her effort to locate Liam and Noelle in the classroom reinforced her understanding of social relationships. This activity supported her sense of others by strengthening her ability to associate names with familiar faces, fostering social awareness and a sense of others.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of others (identifying others to their names) 培养对他人的认识，如：指认同伴等。

description:
描述：
        教师向幼儿展示全班小朋友的照片，和小朋友们一起复习他们的华文名字。然后介绍活动流程，教师将照片藏在课室不同的位置，请幼儿找到自己的照片，并说出自己的华文名字。
       歆淯和她的朋友们坐在一起复习他们的华文名字，然后教师请歆淯和她的朋友们闭上眼睛，教师去藏好照片，歆淯开始找照片，歆淯在桌子上找到了一张照片，教师问歆淯：“歆语，这是你的照片吗？”歆淯回答教师说：“不是黄歆淯（说出她朋友的名字），”歆淯继续寻找她自己的照片，她在桌子下面又找到了一张照片，她拿着照片走向教师，笑着对教师说：“是黄歆淯，”教师回应歆淯说：“你很厉害哦，找到你的照片啦！”
interpretation:
诠释：

     歆淯在活动过程中，能够自由在班级里面探索找到自己的照片，找到照片后能够说出自己的名字，表明歆淯具有自我意识。她也能够用简单的句子与教师进行沟通。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (telling others their names) 培养自我意识，如：说出自己的名字等。
Foster language and expression through conversations, songs, stories and rhymes 通过谈话、歌曲、故事和儿歌，促进幼儿的理解和用短句表达能力的发展。

title: Family Science Fun: Making Ice Cream Together
description:
The children had the opportunity to participate in a hands-on science experiment that replicated a fun family activity: making ice cream. The experiment demonstrated how liquids turn into solids through freezing. 

Joanna began by pouring cream into a small resealable bag. Then, she added sugar and vanilla to it. Lastly, she added some ice cubes and salt to a bigger resealable bag and placed the bag with the liquid in it. 

Joanna said, “This bag is very cold... Got ice so I can make ice cream." As she shook the bag for a few minutes, she looked at the liquid mixture freezing and said, “I think my ice cream is still freezing.” 

After some time, she opened the resealable bags and removed the bag with the ice cream. She picked up a cup and a spoon and slowly scooped the ice cream from the bag. While eating her ice cream, she said, “Wow, ice cream so yummy!"
interpretation: Through this activity, it is evident that Joanna is willing to try something new and different. She confidently explored the idea of freezing through the ice cream-making experiment. She could make connections in which the ice cube combined with salt would freeze the ice cream mixture to make ice cream. In addition, Joanna could also develop her self-awareness by creating a positive self-concept, as she confidently carried out simple tasks.

learning_goals.title: Willing to try out something new and different.

description: 上午活动时间，老师将悦宁和家人的家庭照片放在颜色感官袋后面，鼓励悦宁通过触摸、按压、用卡片推动感官袋中的颜料并发现藏在袋子后面的家人照片.悦宁张开双手手掌放在感官袋上向下按压，随后她的左手捏着卡片向上向下来回刮着感官袋中的颜料，悦宁笑着看着老师：“Re RE.”老师：“悦宁看见Red 红色呀.”悦宁笑着点点头接着她伸出右手手指着感官袋后面的照片：“Emma Emma。”老师：“悦宁看见自己的照片啦！在哪里呢？”悦宁看向老师又接着用食指点了点自己的照片,老师：“悦宁太厉害了，那你再找找看还能看见谁呢？”悦宁继续重复刚才的动作用手捏着卡片推开感官袋上的颜料，直到将颜料从照片上移开，照片呈现出来,悦宁：“Emma 妈妈、爸爸。”悦宁指着照片看着老师和朋友笑。悦宁拿起家人的照片将它放在感官袋后面继续重复着用双手按压着感官袋的动作。
interpretation: 悦宁在探索感官袋的活动中能够通过用手推动颜料找到藏在颜料后的家人照片，并能尝试用自己的语言介绍家人：“Emma妈妈、爸爸！”同时她愿意并主动将双手放在感官袋上按压、推动颜料并尝试用自己的语言“Re re”介绍自己看到感官袋的颜色，以上的行为和语言都展现她对于老师准备的教具充满好奇心和探索精神。

description: 在课室里，活动时间，老师提供成人、幼儿图片及他们的脚印图片给耀曦，鼓励耀曦进行配对游戏。老师说：“耀曦看看大脚印是谁的？小脚印是谁的？再把脚印放到他们图片的下面。”耀曦看了看老师的脚印图片，首先拿起一对大脚印放到了成人图片的下面，说：“是爸爸、妈妈的。”接着又看了看剩下的两对脚印图片，拿起一对较大的脚印图片放到小朋友图片的下面，接着拿起最小的一对脚印放到宝宝图片的下面。。”老师问：“宝宝的脚印是大的还是小的？”耀曦指着图片说：”宝宝是小的。”老师说：耀曦真棒！脚印配对了。“
interpretation: 在《大小脚印》的配对活动中，耀曦愿意参加活动，能够从脚印大小比较，正确配对成人、幼儿、宝宝的脚印，并能说出大小脚印是谁的，展现出耀曦对大小和形状数学概念有较好理解，有一定的观察力和比较能力。从对话中展现出耀曦的语言表达能力在进一步的发展中。

title: Let’s Draw and Colour
description:
Arissa was engaged in an activity with her peers, fully absorbed in the act of colouring and drawing. She picked up the crayon with her right hand, using a firm grip as she leaned forward to begin colouring. Her small fingers wrapped tightly around the crayon and with focused determination, she moved it in circular motions, covering the surface with confident strokes.

After a while, Arissa paused and sat up, glancing at the selection of crayons in front of her. Her eyes settled on the blue crayon, and she reached for it eagerly. Holding the crayon in her hand, she looked down at it for a moment before identifying the colour aloud, saying, "Blue." She then resumed her task, returning her attention to the paper as she scribbled vigorously with the blue crayon. As Arrisa resumed colouring, she demonstrated versatility in her grip, frequently alternating between a palmar grasp and a digital pronate grasp.

Arissa's colouring activity highlights her developing fine motor skills, including hand strength, coordination, and grip variations. The act of scribbling helped her strengthen the muscles in her hands and fingers while promoting control over her wrist and forearm movements. Her ability to alternate grips also indicates progress in her fine motor skills development.

description: 在课室里，活动时间，老师提供成人、幼儿图片及他们的脚印图片给恩雪，鼓励恩雪进行配对游戏。老师说：“恩雪看看大脚印是谁的？小脚印是谁的？放到图片的下面。”恩雪看了看脚印图片，先把小脚印放到宝宝的图片下面，接着把大脚印放到成人照片的下面，最后把中脚印放到小朋友的下面。老师说：“恩雪你说说这些脚印都是谁的？”恩雪指着大脚印说：“爸爸、妈妈的脚印。”指着小脚印说：“宝宝的脚印。”指着中脚印说：“小朋友的脚印。”老师说：“恩雪太棒了！脚印配对正确，有也能告诉老师这些脚印是谁的。”恩雪笑眯眯地看看老师。
interpretation: 在《大小脚印》的配对活动中，恩雪能够积极参加活动，能够从脚印大小比较，正确配对成人、幼儿、宝宝的脚印，并能说出大小脚印是谁的，展现出恩雪对大小和形状数学概念有较好理解，有较强的观察力和比较能力。从对话中展现出恩雪的语言表达能力在进一步的发展中。

title: Throwing beanbag
description: Liam walked toward the wall where pictures of a sandwich and a pizza were pasted. He was encouraged to choose which one he would like to eat, and after deciding on the pizza, Liam was asked to throw a beanbag toward the picture. With focus, he lifted his arm, aimed carefully, and made an overhead throw. The beanbag soared through the air, landing near the pizza picture. He then continued to use the remaining beanbags, aiming and throwing them at the pizza picture.
interpretation:
This activity provides a fun way to help Liam develop his gross motor skills by practicing an overhead throw. As he lifted his arms and aimed, Liam engaged the large muscles in his arms, shoulders, and torso, improving his coordination and strength. The act of throwing the beanbag also enhances hand-eye coordination as Liam learns to judge the distance and angle needed to hit the target.

Additionally, this activity supports balance and body awareness as Liam adjusts his posture and uses his whole body to generate the force needed for the throw. By combining physical movement with decision-making, Liam not only practices gross motor skills but also builds confidence in his ability to control his movements while having fun.

title: Family Science Fun: Making Ice Cream Together
description:
The children had the opportunity to participate in a hands-on science experiment that replicated a fun family activity: making ice cream. The experiment demonstrated how liquids turn into solids through freezing. 

Matthew began by pouring cream into a small resealable bag. Then, he added sugar and vanilla to it. Lastly, he added some ice cubes and salt to a bigger resealable bag and placed the bag with the liquid in it. 

Matthew said, “The ice and salt can help to freeze the ice cream. It is very cold you know." As he shook the bag for a few minutes, he looked at the liquid mixture freezing and said, “I think the ice cream is ready.” 

After shaking the bag for another minute, he opened the resealable bags and removed the bag with the ice cream. He picked up a cup and a spoon and slowly scooped the ice cream from the bag. As he was eating his ice cream, he said, “The ice cream is really yummy and nice. I like the ice cream!”
interpretation: Through this activity, it is apparent that Matthew is willing to try something new and different. He confidently explored the idea of freezing through the ice cream-making experiment. He could make connections in which the ice cube combined with salt would freeze the ice cream mixture to make ice cream. In addition, Matthew could also develop his self-awareness by creating a positive self-concept, as he confidently carried out simple tasks.

title: 幼儿作品分析——绘画“我自己”
description:
这是Theia创作的人物画像，整体展现了儿童画的典型特点，富有童趣和创造力。
Theia在基本构图方面，画中的人物由基本的圆形和直线组成，展现了孩子对人体结构的基础理解。头部比例较大，符合她的绘画的认知特点，会强调自己感兴趣的部分（如脸部）。她画眼睛时，用黑色笔迹重叠涂画，表现出对眼睛的关注，微笑的嘴巴表明这是一幅积极、愉悦的作品，展现了Theia的快乐情绪。绘画身体是长条形，手脚呈现简单线条，手部有一定细节，画出了手指，说明她对肢体结构有一定观察。
Theia在颜色与线条方面，主要使用蓝紫色调，可能是她喜欢的颜色，或是当时能找到的画笔。线条较为自由、流畅，展现了她在绘画过程中的自信和表达欲望。头发以多个线条表现，右侧部分更浓密，可能是她在尝试刻画不同的发型或层次。画出了耳朵，并且右耳部分特别强调，可能是她对耳朵有特殊的关注或印象。
Theia 的作品展现了4岁幼儿绘画的典型特征，如强调头部、五官明显、线条自由等，同时也透露出她细腻的观察力。她对人物的描绘已经超越了简单的涂鸦阶段，进入了有意识表达和细节刻画的阶段，说明她的认知发展和手眼协调能力正在稳步提升。这幅画展现了她的创造力，也传递出她的快乐和对世界的美好感受！

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（写）- 写前准备：喜欢涂涂画画，能画出较直、横的线，基本能控制笔的方向。
感知和描述艺术的基本元素：线条、颜色、形状、质地。
通过艺术品表现环境中的事物。

title: Patterned Fabric Showcase
description:
Prior to this activity, the children were introduced to different fabric patterns from various cultures, such as stripes, florals, and geometric designs. They compared groups of fabrics based on attributes like “bright-colored with geometric shapes” versus “soft-textured with floral patterns.” The children closely observed these patterns and discussed their characteristics.

Building on these observations, the children were invited to create their own three-dimensional art, using fabric patterns as inspiration to explore textures and layering. They then engaged in making 3D collages, applying what they had learned about patterns and design.

Kadie was actively engaged in the collage-making process. She carefully selected pieces of patterned scrap paper for her design. After choosing her materials, she was observed cutting them into long rectangles.

At one point, she looked up and shared, “I’m making a pattern of long and short rectangles.” Kadie continued working independently, carefully placing each piece of patterned paper onto her paper. She filled up half of the space, arranging the prints in a neat and organized way. She continued her pattern of long and short rectangles, making sure they fit well together.

As she worked, Kadie paused at times to look at different prints, holding them up before deciding where to place them. She moved some pieces around before sticking them down and stayed focused and kept adding to her collage, filling more of the paper with her chosen patterns.
interpretation: Kadie’s creative expression during this activity was evident in her thoughtful approach to designing her collage. She demonstrated a clear understanding of patterns by intentionally creating a sequence of long and short rectangles, showcasing her ability to plan and organise her work. Kadie carefully selected patterned paper, arranged the pieces with precision, and adjusted them as needed to achieve her desired effect. Her focus on creating a cohesive design reflects her growing ability to express herself through art, experimenting with different materials and patterns to bring her vision to life.

title: 我的身体
description: 在课室里，活动时间，老师提供幼儿的身体整体图片和身体局部图片，鼓励凯翔将局部图片黏贴到相应位置的整体图片上。老师说：“凯翔，请你把这些小的身体部位图片粘到大图片上。”凯翔看了看，首先将头部图片粘好，接着把手掌反向粘上，粘好身体部分，又把手臂、大腿粘上，把脚粘成了反向，完成人体拼图;接下来他开始粘贴脸部，他把一只眼睛、鼻子粘正确位置，又把嘴巴和另一只眼睛粘到正确位置。他看看老师，老师说：“凯翔看看你的图片都放对了吗？”凯翔说：“对了。”老师说：“凯翔粘的很好，但你看看手和脚的方向对了吗？”凯翔在老师的提示下重新粘对了手脚方向。最后指着图片告诉老师：眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴，手，脚。老师称赞：“凯翔做的很棒！”
interpretation: 在《我的身体》的局部整体拼图配对活动中，凯翔能够独自操作，拼图过程中能观察到拼图块的关键特征，准确粘出五官在头部的正确位置，在身体粘贴部分偶尔出现失误，在老师的提示下能够加以纠正，展现出凯翔解决问题的能力进一步提高；凯翔能够说出五官和身体部位的部分名称，展现出凯翔的认知和听说能力在进一步的发展中。

title: 展示与分享 - 我能做到！
description:
在学习绘本《朱家故事》的过程中，幼儿学习了解了家庭责任的重要性，我们鼓励幼儿在家里学会分摊家务，于是教师和幼儿一起讨论制定了一份“家庭任务”。幼儿选择适合自己的家务，父母则帮忙拍照，与幼儿一起制作成简报。完成后，幼儿在班上与朋友分享自己的做家务经验。这项活动不仅让幼儿体验自己做家务，也让他们在课堂上练习用华语表达自己的想法和经验。  

在分享过程中，延愷显得较为安静，说话声音很小。他用指读笔指着简报上的内容，介绍自己在家里做的事情，例如：擦地板、做巧克力蛋糕和帮忙买东西等，过程中大多数是用英文讲述。当他说到自己帮忙把买来的食物提回家时，语气突然变得兴奋，声音也提高了，说道：“I help mummy do this.” 他明显流露出自信。老师引导他复述华语句子“我帮妈妈拿东西”，他也乐意复述老师说的话。
interpretation: 延愷能够尝试在家里做不同的家务没有放弃，这显示了他的责任感和坚持性。在介绍时大部分使用英文，但他愿意站在大家面前分享经验，并用指读笔指示自己所讲的内容，同时也乐意尝试复述华语句子，这是一大进步。接下来，可以继续鼓励他尝试运用更多华语词汇，让他在熟悉的情境中慢慢建立信心。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：乐意用华语与人交谈。

title: Family Science Fun: Making Ice Cream Together
description:
The children had the opportunity to participate in a hands-on science experiment that replicated a fun family activity: making ice cream. The experiment demonstrated how liquids turn into solids through freezing. 

Tong An began by pouring cream into a small resealable bag. Then, she added sugar and vanilla to it. Lastly, she added some ice cubes and salt to a bigger resealable bag and placed the bag with the liquid in it. 

Tong An said, “The bag is very cold. I know that the ice and salt can freeze the ice cream right?" Her teacher smiled and nodded. As she shook the bag for a few minutes, she looked at the liquid mixture freezing and said, “I think my ice cream still haven't freeze yet.” 

After some time, she opened the resealable bags and removed the bag with the ice cream. She picked up a cup and a spoon and slowly scooped the ice cream from the bag. As she was eating her ice cream, she said, “Wow, Teacher Yani, this is so yummy! I like it! It is so creamy and sweet!”
interpretation: Through this activity, it is evident that Tong An is willing to try something new and different. She confidently explored the idea of freezing through the ice cream-making experiment. She could make connections in which the ice cube combined with salt would freeze the ice cream mixture to make ice cream. In addition, Tong An could also develop her self-awareness by creating a positive self-concept, as she confidently carried out simple tasks.

title: 分享小书
description:
昱恒创编制作好的小书，他自信地向老师和朋友们展示，并介绍故事情节。故事内容如下：
 大家好，这是我制作的小书。昱恒打开了小书的第一页他说：“奥莉薇起床后，他会去洗脸、刷牙，把睡衣脱下来，换上干净的衣服。然后呢他要准备吃早餐了，妈妈给它准备了牛奶和面包，也许还有火腿吧。”朋友对他说：“奥莉薇喜欢吃三明治吧？”他说到：“也许是的，但是她的妈妈没有给她做三明治，她就吃我画的这些东西。”他翻到第二页继续讲：“天气很好，奥莉薇穿上泳衣去海边玩。她喜欢躺在沙滩上晒太阳。”昱恒翻到第三页说到：“回家后，它太累了，直接躺在床上呼呼大睡，哈哈哈。”
interpretation: 昱恒在本次活动中表现出较强的语言表达能力和创意，能够清晰描述自己创作的故事。他的叙述逻辑连贯、表达自然，展现了良好的语言发展基础。通过后续的细节引导和情节丰富训练，昱恒的语言表达能力和创造力将会得到进一步提升。

title: 大球和小球
description:
描述：
        教师向幼儿展示大球小球，大圆和小圆。邀请幼儿进行大球和小球分类的活动，幼儿从盒子里面找出大球放在大圆里面，从盒子里面找出小球放在小圆里面。
        晟德走到装有大球和小球的盒子前坐下，教师告诉晟德：“晟德你要拿起大球放在大圆里哦，拿起小球放在小圆里哦。”晟德回答教师：“好的。”晟德从盒子里面拿起一个大球，他放在一个小圆里，教师提醒晟德好好看一下，他将大球拿起来，放在大圆里面，教师对晟德说：“这是对的。”晟德又从盒子里面拿出一个小球，将小球放在小圆里面，他看向教师，教师回应晟德说：“你放的是小球，是对的哦。”晟德复述教师的话“小球”。晟德继续从和盒子里面拿出球放进对应的圆里面，活动完成后，他告诉教师：“我好了。”教师拿起大球问晟德：“这是什么球？”晟德回答：“大球。”教师向晟德竖起大拇指。
interpretation:
诠释：

      在活动过程中，晟德能够大球放在大圆里面，将小球放在小圆里面，展现出晟德能够进行分类活动，也能够说出与之相对应的数学词汇。他也能够说出简单的句子与教师进行沟通。

learning_goals.title: Develop understanding of basic Numeracy concepts and vocabulary by likenesses and differences (in size, shape, texture, etc.) 通过分类与配对的活动，发展对于大小和形状的数学概念，并能用相应的数学词汇表达。
Foster language and expression through conversations, songs, stories and rhymes 通过谈话、歌曲、故事和儿歌，促进幼儿的理解和用短句表达能力的发展。

title: 我的身体
description: 活动时间，老师提供幼儿的身体整体图片和身体局部图片，鼓励静恩将局部图片黏贴到相应位置的整体图片上。老师说：“静恩，请你把这些小的身体部位图片粘到大图片上。”静恩看了看，首先将头部粘到相应位置，然后粘上身体和手，接着是腿、脚和手臂，静恩完成人体拼图;接下来开始粘贴脸部，她把一只眼睛、鼻子粘正确位置，随后也在正确位置粘上和嘴巴。老师说：“静恩看看你的图片都放对了吗？”静恩看看老师没有说话，老师引导她把手掌、脚掌和嘴巴的方向调整正确。最后静恩指着图片告诉老师粘贴了眼睛、nose、嘴巴、手、脚、arm、leg.老师说：“静恩真棒！身体局部图片，都放对位置了。”
interpretation: 在《我的身体》的局部整体拼图配对活动中，静恩能够独自操作，拼图过程中能观察到拼图块的关键特征，准确粘出五官在头部的正确位置，身体局部的正确位置，但在粘贴时部分偶尔出现方向失误，在老师的提示下能够加以纠正，展现出静恩解决问题的能力进一步提高；静恩能够用华英参杂说出五官和身体部位的部分名称，展现出静恩的认知和听说能力在进一步的发展中。

title: 翻翻乐
description:
早期阅读时间，教师带领幼儿学习了绘本《毛毛虫》，学习词语蜻蜓、蚊子、蝴蝶、瓢虫等。教师邀请两位幼儿一起进行游戏。幼儿可以参考字图卡，也可以直接使用字卡进行游戏。幼儿先将两套卡片摆放在地板上，记忆一下字卡的位置然后将字卡翻过来盖上。幼儿进行猜拳，获胜的一方可以进行两次翻卡活动。若翻到一样的字卡，则能将字卡收起。幼儿继续游戏，直到字卡全部被收集。
玫柔和同伴来到活动场地，她们一起将字卡放置到地板上排列整齐。教师邀请她们记忆字卡的位置。她们看了一会儿，玫柔告诉教师：“我好了。”教师邀请她们将卡片翻过来盖上。准备好后，教师邀请她们进行猜拳。玫柔和同伴一边说：“石头，剪刀，布。”一边猜拳，玫柔出了剪刀，同伴出了布，玫柔说：“我赢了，我先。”她翻开两张卡片，读道：“蚂蚁。”她将卡片收起来，再次和同伴猜拳。她又赢了，她再次翻开两行卡片，她说：“是一样，蜜蜂。”
interpretation: 玫柔对认读字卡有兴趣，能够听懂3个游戏指令并按照规则进行翻翻乐游戏，能够将字卡和图片配对，能够认识一些字卡。

title: 翻翻乐
description:
早期阅读时间，教师带领幼儿学习了绘本《毛毛虫》，学习词语蜻蜓、蚊子、蝴蝶、瓢虫等。教师邀请两位幼儿一起进行游戏。幼儿可以参考字图卡，也可以直接使用字卡进行游戏。幼儿先将两套卡片摆放在地板上，记忆一下字卡的位置然后将字卡翻过来盖上。幼儿进行猜拳，获胜的一方可以进行两次翻卡活动。若翻到一样的字卡，则能将字卡收起。幼儿继续游戏，直到字卡全部被收集。
馨琪和同伴一起将卡片整齐摆放到地板上，教师邀请她们记忆卡片的内容和位置。她和同伴看了会儿，说：“我看好了。”教师邀请她们将卡片翻过来盖上。馨琪和同伴一边猜拳，一边说：“石头，剪刀，布。”第一轮馨琪输了，同伴找到两张一样的卡片并收了起来。馨琪说：“我也知道那个，是蚊子。”说完，她们又开始猜拳，这次馨琪赢了。她翻开第一张卡片，读道：“瓢虫。”她又翻开第二张卡片，她说：“是蚂蚁，不一样。”她将卡片盖起来，继续猜拳。两轮后，她又赢了。她翻开两张卡片，她笑着说：“是蜜蜂，一样的。”
interpretation: 馨琪对认读字卡有兴趣，能够听懂3个游戏指令并按照规则进行翻翻乐游戏，能够将字卡和图片配对，能够认识一些字卡。

title: Playing soccer!
description:
To support children's gross motor development, they were invited to kick a soccer ball between two poles while imagining themselves as players in a soccer match. To help with balance, they were encouraged to stretch their arms out like airplane wings. The teacher provided verbal guidance, such as “Swing your leg back” and “Now, kick the ball with your foot”, to support their movements and coordination.

Allysa stood behind the ball and kicked it with her left leg. With a quick return on the same leg, she extended her arms to regain balance. The teacher encouraged her, saying, “Good job! Would you like to try again?” Allysa giggled and nodded.

On her next attempt, she kicked the ball with her left leg but wobbled slightly. Noticing her struggle with balance, the teacher suggested she hold onto the wall for support. Allysa explored this suggestion and appeared more stable, allowing her to focus on accurately bending her leg to kick the ball.
interpretation: Allysa displays a developing sense of balance and coordination. Allysa had the awareness to extend her arms out whenever she needed to regain her stability. However, she might still present some wobbles and sways while trying to shift her body weight from right to left. Allysa is also starting to develop eye-foot coordination, as she is able to manoeuvre her legs while also tracking the ball with her eyes. Allysa maintained a keen participation throughout the activity through her eagerness to retrieve the ball and have another opportunity to practice.

title: 趣味识字
description:
幼儿正在参与语言斗领域《趣味识字游戏》教学活动， 教师出示所学过的字卡,与幼儿一起读一读，激发幼儿对活动的兴趣。教师先读出一个字词，第一位幼儿便要找出该字卡并指出来。教师继续读出字卡，直至这位幼儿读对点完为止。
当老师引导他认读“刷牙”时，楷钧看着图片上的牙刷，主动开口说出了“刷牙”两个字，并用手做出刷牙的动作，展现出良好的理解能力。遇到“鳄鱼”这个词时，他观察到卡片上的图片，先是皱了皱眉头，然后开心地说道：“鳄鱼，大大的嘴巴！”展现了他对该词语的形象认知。
在认读“怕怕”时，他的表情生动，仿佛感受到了害怕的情绪，并用手捂住眼睛，模仿出害怕的样子，表现出对词义的深刻理解。他整个活动过程中，他乐于开口表达，积极与同伴交流，表现出浓厚的学习兴趣和良好的语言表达能力。
interpretation: 楷钧在趣味识字活动中表现得很专注，他能够通过观察卡片上的图片和文字，正确识别“牙医、鳄鱼、怕怕、刷牙”等词语。在活动过程中，他仔细地看着每张字卡，尝试理解字词的含义，并结合图片进行判断。他乐于开口表达，积极与同伴交流，表现出浓厚的学习兴趣和良好的语言表达能力。

title: 拼图-我的身体
description: 记录与描述:在课程时间，我们进行了身体为主题的拼图游戏，通过幼儿对五官和身体部位的认知将身体部位图片放在正确的位置，老师将分别印有男孩和女孩的拼图板放在地板上，分别指着两张图片说：“这是男孩，这是女孩，看这是它们的眼睛！”老师分别指了指两张图片中的眼睛；老师：“这是眼睛。”幼儿们：“眼睛。”老师用这种方式分别带领幼儿一起识别了两张图片中的眼睛、嘴巴、鼻子、耳朵和手脚。嘉豪在老师讲解的时候，一直关注着老师指的内容重复老师的话，老师拿出身体部位的图片放在地板上说：“谁想来试试呀？” 嘉豪一直观察着同伴们的操作，老师将身体部位的图片铺开在地上对他说：“嘉豪来试试吧？”他拿起了眼睛的图片，放在了对应的圆圈中，然后看向老师，老师说：“很棒呀？嘉豪这是什么？”嘉豪指了指自己的眼睛，老师说：“这是眼睛。”嘉豪小声的说：“眼睛。”接着老师递给嘉豪一张嘴巴的图片问：“这是什么呀？”嘉豪看了看图片，指了指自己的嘴巴。老师说：“很棒！这是嘴巴，那放在哪里呢？”嘉豪用手指指着图片中的嘴巴，然后左手食指沿着虚线一直找到对应的圆圈，将图片放了上去。接着他继续拿着身体部位的图片在拼图卡片中寻找正确的位置，直到全部还原后，又尝试用另一项拼图卡进行还原。
interpretation: 嘉豪能够参与老师的活动，持续不断地进行活动，说明他对拼图感兴趣，他在游戏中表现出很好的理解能力，他能够在自己身上找到身体部位图片，说明他能够将图片和实物结合在一起。

description: 在课程时间，我们进行了身体为主题的拼图游戏，通过幼儿对五官和身体部位的认知将五官贴片放在正确的位置，老师将分别印有男孩和女孩的拼图板放在地板上，分别指着两张图片说：“这是男孩，这是女孩，看他们的眼睛！”老师分别指了指两张图片中的眼睛；老师：“这是眼睛。”幼儿们：“眼睛。”老师用这种方式分别带领幼儿一起识别了两张图片中的眼睛、嘴巴、鼻子、耳朵和手脚。Isla在老师讲解的时候，一直在观察，并且重复老师的话，老师拿出五官的图案说：“谁想来试试呀？” Isla在观察了两位同学操作之后，老师将材料放到她的面前，她开心的坐下来，拿起地上的鼻子的图片放在对应的格子中，然后抬头看老师，老师对她说：“太棒啦！这是什么？”她看了看老师，老师又慢慢的说了一边，她说：“nose!”老师说：“鼻子。”她重复了老师的话。老师又问：“你的鼻子在哪里呢？”Isla继续看着老师，老师用手指了指自己的鼻子，又指了指她说：“你的鼻子在哪里？”这时她笑着指了指自己的鼻子。老师对她伸出大拇指说：“你真棒。”她开心的拍了拍手，低头拿出其他的五官图片，将它们一个一个的放在正确的位置，每放一个都要叫老师来看她的操作，就这样她一个一个的将五官的图片放在了正确的位置，在老师的提醒下找到了自己身上对应的身体部位，将这些图片一遍又一遍的拿下来，再重新放上去。
interpretation: Isla能够参与老师的活动，持续不断地进行活动，说明她对活动感兴趣，她能够根据老师的解说和自己的观察完成游戏，说明她能够理解老师的话，她在活动时多次为自己的成就感到高兴，说明她通过游戏获得了成就感，她能够在找到鼻子的图片时指出自己的鼻子说明她能够将图片和实物结合在一起。

title: 拼图-我的身体
description: 在课程时间，我们进行了身体为主题的拼图游戏，通过幼儿对五官和身体部位的认知将五官贴片放在正确的位置，老师将分别印有男孩和女孩的拼图板放在地板上，分别指着两张图片说：“这是男孩，这是女孩，看他们的眼睛！”老师分别指了指两张图片中的眼睛；老师：“这是眼睛。”幼儿们：“眼睛。”老师用这种方式分别带领幼儿一起识别了两张图片中的眼睛、嘴巴、鼻子、耳朵和手脚。老师邀请Arya坐下来，在经过简单的交谈过后，老师将材料放到他的面前，他拿起地上的图片开始观察，他将几个图片双手握住，右手抽出一张脚的图片开始观察，左手将其他图片丢在地上，老师指了指图片摊开手问：“这是什么？”在重复几次后他小声回答：“feet。 ”老师说：“脚。”Arya：“脚。”老师又问：“你的脚在哪里呢？”Arya看着老师，老师举起了脚又问了他一遍，他举起了自己的脚说：“脚。”老师竖起大拇指说：“太棒了，这是脚。”老师拿出眼睛的图片对他说：“眼睛。”他指了指自己的眼睛重复老师说的话。我们用这样的方式将所有的身体部位图片都认了一遍，Arya也都找到了对应的身体部位，老师对他说：“下面我们看看小人的五官在哪里呢？”老师拿出脚，指了指小人，他指了指小人的脚，并将图片放在对应的圆圈中，老师对他说：“太棒啦！你一下子就找到啦！”他开心的拍了拍手，低头拿出其他的五官图片，将它们一个一个的放在正确的位置，每放一个都指一指自己对应的身体部位，就这样他一个一个的将五官的图片放在了正确的位置。
interpretation: Arya能够参与老师的活动，持续不断地进行活动，说明他对活动感兴趣，他能够根据老师的解说和自己的观察完成游戏，说明他能够理解老师的话，他在活动时为自己的成就感到高兴，说明他通过游戏获得了成就感，他能够在找到身体部位图片时指出自己身上对应的部分，说明他能够将图片和实物结合在一起。

title: 颜色排序
description:
教师带领幼儿观察一些不同风格的绘画作品，鼓励他们细心观察。通过讨论，引导他们注意颜色的不同层次。例如，画面中有些部分使用了明亮的色调，而其他部分则使用了较深的颜色。从而引出颜色深浅的概念。教师出示色块，请幼儿观察这些颜色，带领他们从深到浅或从浅到深排列这些色块，教师邀请幼儿选择一种排序方式，将6张深浅不一的色卡按照选择的方式进行排序。
Abhigyan来到活动场地，教师问他想要尝试哪种排列顺序，他说：“从深到浅。”教师问他哪个白板写有从深到浅。他指着其中一块白板说：“是这个。”教师将色卡递给他，邀请他开始排序。他拿起黑色的卡片放在最前面，然后将白色卡片放在后面，中间留出一些空位。他依次将深蓝、深绿、粉色和黄色摆放到中间。他一边摆放，一边说：“蓝色、绿色、pink、yellow黄色。”教师告诉他pink是粉色。他复述道：“粉色。”
interpretation: Abhigyan通过观察绘画作品学习颜色的变化，学会了区分颜色的深浅。还通过动手实践，将色卡按照要求排序，加深了对颜色深浅的理解，逐渐培养了对艺术作品色彩运用的感知力。

interpretation: 慧凌能够参与老师的活动，持续不断地完成游戏，说明她很喜欢拼图游戏，她在游戏中展现出了良好的语言能力，理解老师的话，可以表达自己的想法，她在活动时多次为自己的成就感到高兴，说明她通过游戏获得了成就感，她能够在找到嘴巴的图片时指出自己的嘴巴说明她能够将图片和实物结合在一起。

title: Throwing balls
description: Louka was engaged in a fun throwing game as he had to aim and throw the balls at the target- hanging hula hoop with the sticky side of the tape facing out. This setup encouraged him to use an overhead throwing motion to propel the balls forward. This activity is a fantastic way to develop his gross motor skills, particularly the overhead throw.
interpretation: The overhead throw is an essential gross motor skill that requires coordination, strength, and balance. By engaging in this activity, Louka is in the process of strengthening his upper body muscles, particularly in the shoulders, arms, and core. It also enhances hand-eye coordination as he aims at the target and refines his depth perception. Additionally, stepping forward while throwing helps him to develop balance and weight transfer, fundamental for overall motor development.

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, climb on playground equipment, bend, kick，throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作：走、跑、攀爬、弯腰、踢、投掷等。

title: 我的身体
description: 活动时间，老师提供幼儿的身体整体图片和身体局部图片，鼓励睿萱将局部图片黏贴到相应位置的整体图片上。老师说：“睿萱，请你把这些小的身体部位图片粘到大图片上。”睿萱看了看，首先把头像粘到身体大图上，再粘手臂和腿到相应位置，接着把手和脚粘到相应位置，睿萱完成人体部分，老师说：“睿萱看看你都贴对位置和方向吗？”睿萱又看了看人体拼图，把手和脚转了转方向，老师说：“睿萱现在就完全正确了。”她笑眯眯看看老师，继续粘贴脸的部分,她先正确粘贴了两只眼睛，又粘上鼻子，最后粘嘴巴。老师说：“睿萱真棒！全部都完成了。”老师说：“请告诉老师眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、手脚都在那里呀？”睿萱指着图片告诉老师：“眼睛、nose、嘴巴、手、脚、arm、leg。老师说：“睿萱真棒！身体部位都放对位置了。
interpretation: 通过观察：在《我的身体》的局部整体拼图配对活动中，睿萱能够独自操作，拼图过程中能观察到拼图块的关键特征，准确粘出五官在头部的正确位置，身体局部的正确位置，但在粘贴时部分偶尔出现方向失误，在老师的提示下能够加以纠正，展现出睿萱解决问题的能力进一步提高；睿萱能够用华英参杂说出五官和身体部位的部分名称，展现出睿萱的认知和听说能力在进一步的发展中。

title: 趣味识字
description:
幼儿正在参与语言斗领域《趣味识字游戏》教学活动， 教师出示所学过的字卡,与幼儿一起读一读，激发幼儿对活动的兴趣。教师先读出一个字词，第一位幼儿便要找出该字卡并指出来。教师继续读出字卡，直至这位幼儿读对点完为止。
靖炜在趣味识字活动中展现出浓厚的兴趣，他认真观察字卡，并积极参与认读。在认读“牙医”时，他先是看着卡片上的图片，随后自信地指出并说出“牙医”这个词，当看到“鳄鱼”一词时，他略微思考后，兴奋地说出“鳄鱼大嘴巴”，并用手比划出鳄鱼张开嘴巴的样子。在认读“牙齿”时，他仔细观察图片后，用手指着自己的牙齿，说道：“我的牙齿也要刷干净！”他用手做出刷牙的动作，并笑着说道：“我要刷牙。”











搜索
interpretation: 靖炜通过所学的字卡，能够根据口令跳到相应的字卡上，仿说：牙医、生气、害怕等词语。展现了他能够完全理解一个口头指令，并完成仿说词语的任务。他善于运用语言表达自己的理解，同时积极与同伴互动，展现出良好的语言表达能力。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：尝试用华语与人交谈。
语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能用短句表达自己的要求、愿望和意见。

title: 颜色找朋友
description:
描述：
        教师向幼儿介绍蓝色和红色的呼啦圈，班级里面红色和蓝色的物品，邀请幼儿进行颜色分类的活动，将红色的物品放进红色的呼啦圈里面，将蓝色的物品放进蓝色的呼啦圈里面。
         教师向轩伊示范如何进行活动，教师拿起一个红色的物品放进红色的呼啦圈里面，又拿起一个蓝色的物品放进蓝色的呼啦圈里面。轩伊开始做活动了，她拿起一个红色的积木块，将红色的积木块放在红色的呼啦圈里面，教师指向呼啦圈里的积木问轩伊：“轩伊，这个积木是什么颜色的呀？”轩伊回答教师：“颜色。”教师纠正轩伊说道：“这是红色的。”轩伊复述教师的话“红色。”轩伊又拿了一个蓝色积木和放大镜放在蓝色的呼啦圈里面，教师继续问轩伊同样的问题，轩伊回答教师：“蓝色。”教师对轩伊竖起大拇指。
interpretation:
诠释：

      在进行活动过程中轩伊能够进行颜色分类，找到红色和蓝色的物品，将其放在对应的呼啦圈里面。轩伊也能够用简单的词汇与教师进行沟通。

learning_goals.title: Develop understanding of basic Numeracy concepts and vocabulary by likenesses and differences (in size, shape, texture, etc.) 通过分类与配对的活动，发展对于大小和形状的数学概念，并能用相应的数学词汇表达。
Foster language and expression through conversations, songs, stories and rhymes 通过谈话、歌曲、故事和儿歌，促进幼儿的理解和用短句表达能力的发展。

敏绮认真观察字卡上的图片和文字，并运用指示棒指出相应的词语。在认读“牙医”时，她先仔细端详图片，然后用清晰的语音说道：“牙医看牙齿。”当学习到“鳄鱼”时，她看到图片中的鳄鱼后，兴奋地说道：“鳄鱼有大牙齿！”并用手比划出大嘴巴的样子。在认读“牙齿”时，她指着自己的牙齿，并笑着说：“我要刷牙，牙齿白白的。”
interpretation: 敏绮在趣味识字活动中表现得很专注，她能够通过观察卡片上的图片和文字，正确识别“牙医、鳄鱼、怕怕、刷牙”等词语。在活动过程中，她仔细地看着每张字卡，尝试理解字词的含义，并结合图片进行判断。她乐于开口表达，表现出浓厚的学习兴趣和良好的语言表达能力。

title: 感官袋
description: 下午活动时间，老师将昊霆和家人的家庭照片放在颜色感官袋后面，鼓励昊霆通过触摸、按压、用卡片推动感官袋中的颜料并发现藏在袋子后面的家人照片.昊霆站在感官袋前，他伸出右手食指按压着感官袋，昊霆：“ReRe.”老师：“昊霆是说看见Red 红色的颜料对吧？”昊霆：“Yeah!”昊霆笑着将整个右手放在感官袋上按压。昊霆：“Grenn.”老师：“昊霆还看见很多绿色的颜料呀！”昊霆点点头，他伸出双手捏着卡片向上向下来回刮着感官袋中的颜料，直到将颜料从照片上移开，照片呈现出来,昊霆：“Mummy。”老师：“昊霆看见妈妈的照片，妈妈在哪里呀？”昊霆伸出右手食指指着照片，接着他重复用卡片向前向后来回刮动着颜料，直到家庭照片全部显露出来，昊霆笑着拍着手将右手食指指着照片：“Daddy mummy 哈哈！”昊霆笑着继续伸出小手按压着感官袋。
interpretation: 昊霆在探索感官袋的活动中能够通过用手捏着卡片刮动颜料找到藏在颜料后的家人照片，并能尝试用自己的语言介绍家人：“Daddy mummy！”同时他愿意并主动将双手放在感官袋上按压、推动颜料并尝试用自己的语言“Re re、Grenn”介绍自己看到感官袋的颜色，以上的行为和语言都展现他对于老师准备的教具充满好奇心和探索精神。

learning_goals.title: Foster curiosity and interest in a well-planned environment 通过精心创设的环境和互动，培养好奇心和探索精神。

description:
幼儿正在参与语言斗领域《趣味识字游戏》教学活动， 教师出示所学过的字卡,与幼儿一起读一读，激发幼儿对活动的兴趣。教师先读出一个字词，第一位幼儿便要找出该字卡并指出来。教师继续读出字卡，直至这位幼儿读对点完为止。
思彤她先是仔细看着图片，随后轻声念出“牙医”两个字，并补充说道：“牙医会帮我看牙齿，我不怕。”当学习到“鳄鱼”时，她看着图片，睁大眼睛惊喜地说道：“鳄鱼的牙齿好大！”并用双手张开比划出大嘴巴的样子，在认读“牙齿”时，她主动指出自己的牙齿，并说：“我有刷牙，牙齿会白白的。”在学习“刷牙”时，她一边做刷牙的动作，一边开心地念出：“刷牙，刷干净！”

title: Patterned Fabric Showcase
description:
Prior to this activity, the children were introduced to different fabric patterns from various cultures, such as stripes, florals, and geometric designs. They compared groups of fabrics based on attributes like “bright-colored with geometric shapes” versus “soft-textured with floral patterns.” The children closely observed these patterns and discussed their characteristics.

Building on these observations, the children were invited to create their own three-dimensional art, using fabric patterns as inspiration to explore textures and layering. They then engaged in making 3D collages, applying what they had learned about patterns and design.

Inspired by the fabric designs, Emma began collecting the materials she needed for her collage. She selected a piece of pink corrugated paper and carefully cut out triangular shapes. She then arranged the triangles in a row at the top of her paper. Satisfied with the placement, she glued them down. Noticing she had more triangles left, Emma created a second row, this time inverting the triangles to face downward. She continued pasting until the second row was complete.

Emma worked independently as she continued creating her patterns. By the fourth row, she incorporated numbers into her design, repeatedly writing "892," with each digit in a specific color—8 in red, 9 in black, and 2 in green.

She also combined cutout shapes with hand-drawn designs using markers, adding another layer of pattern and detail to her artwork. To end her design, Emma pasted colorful corrugated paper cut into squares, arranging them in an ABC color pattern of red, black, and grey.
interpretation:
Emma demonstrated confidence and independence in her creative process as she explored patterns, shapes, and textures in her collage. She carefully selected materials and experimented with different ways to arrange her cutout shapes, showing an emerging understanding of design and composition.


As she worked, Emma experimented with pattern repetition by arranging her triangles in rows and later inverting them to create contrast. She extended her exploration by incorporating numbers in a deliberate color sequence, showing her ability to make artistic choices and connect different elements in her work.


Emma also combined cutout shapes with hand-drawn details, layering materials to add depth and texture. Her final step of arranging squares in a repeating color pattern demonstrates her growing ability to observe and recreate visual sequences. 


Through this process, Emma engaged in problem-solving, fine motor skill development, and creative expression. Providing opportunities to continue exploring textures, layering, and patterns will further support her confidence in artistic expression.

description:
幼儿正在参与语言斗领域《趣味识字游戏》教学活动， 教师出示所学过的字卡,与幼儿一起读一读，激发幼儿对活动的兴趣。教师先读出一个字词，第一位幼儿便要找出该字卡并指出来。教师继续读出字卡，直至这位幼儿读对点完为止。
彦丰在认读“牙医”时，他仔细看着图片，思考了一下后，自信地说道：“牙医帮我牙齿。”随后，他用手指着自己的牙齿，表现出对词语的理解。当学习到“鳄鱼”时，他看到图片后，兴奋地说：“鳄鱼的牙齿好大！”并用双手张开，比划出鳄鱼张嘴的样子，在认读“牙齿”时，他主动指出自己的牙齿，并说：“我有刷干净，不能有虫虫。”在学习“刷牙”时，他模仿刷牙的动作，并开心地念道：“刷刷刷，刷牙！”

title: Patterned Fabric Showcase
description:
Prior to this activity, the children were introduced to different fabric patterns from various cultures, such as stripes, florals, and geometric designs. They compared groups of fabrics based on attributes like “bright-colored with geometric shapes” versus “soft-textured with floral patterns.” The children closely observed these patterns and discussed their characteristics.

Building on these observations, the children were invited to create their own three-dimensional art, using fabric patterns as inspiration to explore textures and layering. They then engaged in making 3D collages, applying what they had learned about patterns and design.

Inspired by these fabric designs, Leanne carefully collected materials for her collage. She selected glittery papers in her favorite colors and began cutting them into long rectangular strips. As she worked, she arranged a sequence, placing a purple rectangle, followed by a pink one, then a long purple strip that stretched across the paper.

As she placed the long piece, Leanne observed, “I want to make a purple and pink pattern, but there’s no space.” The teacher suggested cutting the long purple strip into smaller pieces and alternating them with the pink ones as she had planned. Leanne considered the suggestion and then adjusted her design, continuing her pattern with the revised arrangement.

She proceeded to the following rows independently, using purple and red strips, followed by black and pink. Leanne also introduced variations by reusing scraps that a friend had left behind, carefully cutting them into matching shapes to maintain the pattern.

Upon completing her collage, Leanne overheard the teacher suggesting to another friend that they could fill the remaining white spaces on their paper. Inspired by this, she picked up markers and began adding small details to fill in the gaps between her collage pieces.
interpretation:
Leanne engaged in thoughtful artistic decision-making as she explored patterns, colors, and textures in her collage. She demonstrated an emerging understanding of sequencing and design by arranging her materials into a repeating pattern of purple and pink. 


When she encountered a challenge with spacing, she reflected on the teacher’s suggestion and adapted her approach, showing flexibility and problem-solving skills in her creative process.

Leanne worked independently to extend her design, incorporating new color combinations and repurposing leftover materials. Her ability to modify and refine her collage demonstrates her growing confidence in experimenting with composition and pattern continuity.


Additionally, Leanne was inspired by a peer’s experience and took initiative to add small details with markers, further enhancing her artwork. This shows her ability to observe, reflect, and apply new ideas to her own creative process. 


Through this experience, Leanne strengthened her fine motor skills, artistic expression, and ability to make intentional design choices.

title: 新闻《昂首挺胸走对路》
description:
新闻时事分享时间，教师为幼儿介绍了新闻《昂首阔步走对路》。教师为幼儿介绍了错误的走路姿势会让自己或者膝盖受伤。并列举出了三种错误的姿势：走路不看前方；左右摆动手臂；拖着鞋子走路。然后对鞋子也有一定的要求，鞋子不能太软或者太硬，太硬会磨破皮，太软稳定性不好容易跌倒。最适合走路的鞋子鞋跟与前脚掌的高度不应该超过2厘米。
教师邀请礼宣和同伴一起踮脚在课室里行走，让他们感受鞋跟太高对走路带来的影响。两圈后，教师邀请幼儿回到自己的位置，举手分享自己的感受。礼宣分享道：“我的脚很痛。”教师问他通过这篇文章，要如何正确的走路保护自己不受伤。他接过便利贴后，开始画了起来。他告诉教师：“我画spider man的鞋子。”教师问他这双鞋能怎样帮助他正确的走路，他指着作品说：“这里亮亮的。”教师追问他有灯会怎样帮助到他。他想了想，说：“可以看得到。”教师问他是在光线暗的环境里看到地面吗，他答道：“是的。”
interpretation: 礼宣能够针对走路中的错误姿势或者行为进行讨论。能够理解文章内容，绘制出自己所学到的如何走对路。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能针对某一个话题展开讨论。
描绘简单调查的发现：使用图画和简单的说明作记录。

title: 《好玩的面团》
description: 在操作区，老师出示面团、饼干形状模具，鼓励昊霆和朋友一起用不同形状的模型在面团上按压出来，制作形状小饼干。昊霆右手抓握拿着“星形”模具，他抬头看着老师：“Star.”老师：“昊霆拿了一个星星了呀！”昊霆笑着说：“Yeah 。”接着他将右手向下将星星模具放在面团上，手掌张开捏住模具向下压，接着他又用手抓握起模具，昊霆：“wow!。”老师：“昊霆的小手很厉害，可以印出一个星星的饼干，你还想印什么形状吗？”昊霆：“This。”接着他继续用右手抓握起三角形模具，将模具放在面团上方，拇指在下四指并拢在上向下按压模具，将三角形印在面团上。昊霆：“老师、老师More more。”老师：“老师看到了，昊霆印出了一个三角形的饼干，太棒了！”昊霆笑着继续重复刚才的动作，用其他模具在面团上进行按压。
interpretation: 在《好玩的面团》中昊霆能够用右手抓握起模具并按压在面团上，同时他也能尝试用语言表达自己看见的物品：”Star 、老师、老师More more 。“在整个活动过程中他能够用双手揉捏和搓面团，展现他的精细动作的技能和小手控制力正在增强，我们也会继续通过各种精细动作活动、美劳创作活动持续发展昊霆的小肌肉能力。

learning_goals.title: Foster fine motor development ( pick up objects using pincer grasp, hold crayon to scribble, fasten/unfasten zippers/buttons, screw, unscrew bottle caps, etc.) 发展精细动作，如：用大拇指、食指及中指（三指）抓物品、拉拉链、扣纽扣、拧瓶盖等。

title: 《好玩的面团》
description: 在操作区老师出示面团、饼干形状模具，鼓励悦宁和朋友一起用不同形状的模型在面团上按压出来，制作形状小饼干。悦宁右手抓握拿着“星形”模具，她抬头看着老师：“老师、Star.”老师：“悦宁拿了星星了呀！”悦宁笑着说：“Emma Emma do。”接着她将星星模具放在面团上，手掌张开捏住模具向下压，随后她又用手抓握起模具，悦宁：“Star。”老师：“悦宁好厉害呀，可以印出一个星星的饼干，你还想印什么形状吗？”悦宁：“No more star。”悦宁将形状模具放在一旁，双手拿起面团来回捏，她从面团上捏、揪下一大块面团，随后放在桌子上手掌来回搓面团，将面团搓成长条状。悦宁笑着举起长面团递给老师。老师：“哇！看看悦宁做的是什么呀？是面条吗？”悦宁笑着说：“Noodle.”悦宁继续和朋友一起探索面团。

title: 我的身体
description: 活动时间，老师提供幼儿的身体整体图片和身体局部图片，鼓励许与将局部图片黏贴到相应位置的整体图片上。老师说：“许与，请你把这些小的身体部位图片粘到大图片上。”许与看了看，首先将头部粘到相应位置，然后粘上身体，手和脚，接着把手臂和腿部粘好，老师说：“许与看看你的小图都粘对方向了吗？”许与看看了发现手和脚方向错了，她重新调整正确。接着开始脸部的图片粘贴，她先粘上一只眼睛，接着另一只眼睛，把鼻子放在眼睛中间，最后粘上嘴巴。老师说：“许与请告诉老师，眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、手、脚都在那里呀？”许与指着图片告诉老师：“眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、手、脚，腿、。“老师说：”许与做的，说的都很棒！”许与笑眯眯地看着老师。
interpretation: 在《我的身体》的局部整体拼图配对活动中，许与能够独自操作，拼图过程中能观察到拼图块的关键特征，准确粘出五官在头部的正确位置，在身体粘贴部分偶尔出现失误，在老师的提示下能够加以纠正，展现出许与解决问题的能力进一步提高；许与能够说出五官和身体部位的部分名称，展现出许与的认知和听说能力在进一步的发展中。

learning_goals.title: Foster problem solving during independent and group activities (puzzles, sequencing activities etc.) 通过拼图游戏、排序等活动，培养幼儿在个人或小组活动中解决问题的能力。

title: Fingerprint Exploration
description: Children explored the process by using their fingers to press onto ink pads and then transfer the imprint onto paper, discovering the effects of this hands-on activity.
interpretation:
Excited to try fingerprinting on a blank paper, Jaea first decided to try the black ink pad. After pressing her fingers onto it, she observed her hands turning black and noted, "They're all black and dirty." Her teacher reassured her that it would wash off. Jaea pressed her finger onto the paper, then tilted it upwards to examine the imprint. After noticing the small lines, she used a magnifying glass for a closer look.


She experimented with different fingers using her sense of touch to feel the ink on her fingers and saw how it transferred to the paper, observing that her thumb made a larger print while her pinky left a smaller one. She used both red and black ink pads and noticed the different patterns she could create. This sparked her curiosity, and she became eager to experiment with all her different fingers to create fingerprints, fascinated by the patterns she could make such as difference between fingerprint and handprints or mixing the ink colours.


Through this activity, Jaea demonstrated her ability to use her senses and simple tools, like the magnifying glass, to explore both living and non-living things. Her growing interest in investigating objects and her ability to communicate her findings show her developing cognitive, sensory, and fine motor skills.

learning_goals.title: Use senses and simple tools (e.g: magnifying viewer/glass, mirror, pulley, magnet, torchlight) to examine living and non-living things.

title: 吸管插洞洞
description:
老师邀请幼儿们参与吸管插洞洞活动。老师提供好打好孔的纸箱和吸管若干，请他们一只手抓住，插入洞洞中。
老师对幼儿们说：“谁要参加吸管插洞洞游戏啊？”勇霖看着老师点头。老师笑着对勇霖说：“我、我要玩。”勇霖模仿老师的动作，用手拍拍尝试说：“我。”老师拿出吸管和洞洞箱，请勇霖动手操作。左手抓握住一把吸管，右手五指抓握一根吸管向下按压进洞洞箱中。在用力向下插的过程中，吸管不见了。勇霖低头向下观察洞洞，并又拿出一根吸管，五指抓握吸管上端向下按压，继续在相同的洞洞尝试插入。当吸管插光后。勇霖看向老师说：“more 。”老师鼓励勇霖说：“还要、我还要吸管。”勇霖看着老师尝试说：“还要”，在老师的鼓励下，勇霖发出了：“还、要”的音，只是声音有点小是分开的。老师表扬勇霖：“说的很好！”并与勇霖击掌庆祝。勇霖微笑的回应老师，并低头继续参与吸管插洞洞的游戏中。

title: Pollen transfer
description:
In this activity, the children used tongs to carefully transfer "pollen" (represented by small yellow pom-poms) into bee hives, which tapped on their fine motor skills. By carefully manipulating the tongs to pick up and place each pom-pom, the children were able to focus on the precision and control required for the task. This helped strengthen their hand-eye coordination, as they had to focus on both their hand movements and the positioning of the pom-poms.

Owen used his left hand to pinch the tongs during the activity. He carefully gripped the tongs with his thumb and fingers, adjusting the amount of force he exerted to hold the pom-pom securely without squeezing it too tightly. As he moved the pom-pom toward the hive, Owen displayed maintained a steady grip while controlling the tongs with just the right amount of pressure.
interpretation: Owen's ability to regulate the force exerted on the pom-pom ensured it stayed safely in the tongs as he carefully carried it over and placed it inside the hive. This task highlighted Owen’s developing fine motor skills, hand-eye coordination, and ability to control small movements with precision.

title: 我的身体
description: 活动时间，老师提供幼儿的身体整体图片和身体局部图片，鼓励睿彤将局部图片黏贴到相应位置的整体图片上。老师说：“睿彤，请你把这些小的身体部位图片粘到大图片上。”睿彤拿起了手臂图片看了看，粘上手臂位置，接着粘上了手掌，身体，然后粘上腿和脚。接下来睿彤开始粘贴脸部，她先把两只眼睛粘到正确位置，再粘上嘴巴，最后粘上鼻子。睿彤完成了粘贴配对。老师说：“睿彤看看你的图片方向都放对了吗？”睿彤重新调整好图片方向。老师说：“彤彤真棒！全部都粘对了。你能告诉老师眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、手脚都在那里呀？”睿彤默默地看看老师没有回答。
interpretation: 在《我的身体》的局部整体拼图配对活动中，睿彤能够独自操作，拼图过程中能观察到拼图块的关键特征，准确粘出五官在头部的正确位置，在身体粘贴部分偶尔出现失误，在老师的提示下能够加以纠正，展现出睿彤的认知和解决问题的能力进一步提高。

title: Guided Reading
description: The children were introduced to book awareness and learned how to use a book during the guided reading activity. They began to recognise sight words like "I," "am," and "like," and applied reading techniques such as using pictures for word prediction and pointing to each word while listening to the audio.
interpretation:
Jaea showed keen engagement in reading while listening to the audio. During the activity, she initially observed the teacher closely. Understanding that it was a reading activity, she was introduced to placing the book on the table instead of holding it up. She was gently guided to point to the words one by one, rather than following her finger across the page. With a bit of encouragement, she was able to read the words more clearly and with more volume while listening to the audio.


Jaea can read 3 word sentences and recognised words like “playing” after hearing the audio a few times. When asked how she knew, she replied, “because the girl (in the picture) is holding a toy,” showing her comprehension of the book's theme about school activities. While she initially got confused between painting and writing due to the image of paper, with guidance on different materials, she could recognise the differences more clearly. This reflects her developing listening, word recognition, and comprehension skills, as she connects visuals with text and demonstrates an understanding of the read-aloud content.

learning_goals.title: Comprehension: Comprehend and respond to stories and other texts read aloud.

title: Rainbow Sort and Choice
description: After learning about the colours of the rainbow, the children were invited to choose two colours they liked and sort objects in those colours into the corresponding rainbow sections. Alternatively, they could work with a partner to create their rainbow bridge using materials from the class, such as markers and Legos.
interpretation:
Elliott confidently chose his favourite colour, pink, and began the activity with enthusiasm. He first selected a blue cup and proudly showed it to the teacher, exclaiming, "I found a blue cup!" Without any prompting, he sorted the objects into the correct rainbow sections, placing at least one object in each of the seven colours of the rainbow. As he worked, Elliott repeated the colour names aloud and carefully checked to ensure each object matched the correct colour. With minimal guidance from the teacher, he was able to find the colours he needed from the box and sort them accordingly. For instance, on his third attempt, he searched for "red" and, upon finding it, told the teacher, "I found a red block!"


This shows Elliott’s strong colour recognition skills, his ability to work independently, and his cooperative attitude. He approached the task with confidence and methodical precision, demonstrating a solid understanding of the activity.

title: 从头动到脚
description: 教师讲述绘本《从头动到脚》邀请静恩和朋友一起围坐在身边聆听故事。当老师讲到海豹拍手的画面时，静恩和朋友一起指着书本说：“Seal。”老师说：“海豹。”她也跟着说：“海豹。”老师接着读：“我是海豹，我会拍手。你会吗？”静恩拍着小手说：“我会。”老师说：“我们一起说，这个我会，我会拍手。”静恩和朋友跟着老师一起说：“这个我会，我会拍手。”就这样静恩跟着老师边听故事，边学着图片里的动物做动作，并重复里面的句子：这个我会。
interpretation: 在《从头动到脚》讲故事活动中，静恩指着图片说：“Seal”，静恩能识别动物并说出英文单词“Seal”，说明她有一定的词汇量。由于处于双语环境，经常中英文混合使用，当老师用中文说出“海豹”，她能够立即模仿，显示她的模仿能力和语言学习能力。之后，她回应“我会”，并和老师一起重复更长的句子“这个我会，我会拍手”，这表明她能逐渐从单词过渡到简单句子，静恩的语言表达能力正在进一步发展中。

title: Pollen transfer
description:
In this activity, the children used tongs to carefully transfer "pollen" (represented by small yellow pom-poms) into bee hives, which tapped on their fine motor skills. By carefully manipulating the tongs to pick up and place each pom-pom, the children were able to focus on the precision and control required for the task. This helped strengthen their hand-eye coordination, as they had to focus on both their hand movements and the positioning of the pom-poms.

Si Rui picked up the tongs with his right hand and positioned them over the pom-pom. He pinched the tongs closer to the tips, adjusting his grip to gain better control of the pom-pom. With careful precision, Si Rui lifted the tongs and moved them toward the hive, ensuring the pom-pom remained securely inside. As he approached the hive, he maintained his grip near the tips of the tongs, which allowed for more accuracy and stability. Si Rui placed the pom-pom into the hive, then released the tongs smoothly.
interpretation: Si rui's adjustment of the grip demonstrated his ability to refine his technique, enhancing his control over the task, and reflecting his developing fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
