title: Playdough caterpillar
description:
In this activity, children used playdough to extend a caterpillar cut-out on paper, adding texture and shape to the image. As the children pressed down on the playdough to make small round balls, they were able to feel its soft, squishy texture, which helped engage their tactile senses while observing the various sizes of round balls that they can make.

Muzhuo made both big and small round playdough balls. At first, he was a little hesitant to describe the size of the balls, unsure of the words to use. When he made a large ball, he looked at it and pointed to the big ball he had just created. The teacher gently encouraged him by saying, "Yes, that's a big ball! Can you make a small one now?" Muzhuo then proceeded to roll a smaller ball and said, "This... small!" Muzhuo made more balls, experimenting with different sizes.
interpretation: Muzhuo was able to develop an understanding of basic numeracy concepts by comparing the big and small playdough balls that he had made. He had used numerical vocabulary to describe the playdough balls when he used the words ‘big’ and ‘small’. With more exposure, Muzhuo would be able to enhance his language skills relevant to basic numeracy concepts through various concrete activities.

learning_goals.title: Develop understanding of basic Numeracy concepts and vocabulary by likenesses and differences (in size, shape, texture, etc.) 通过分类与配对的活动，发展对于大小和形状的数学概念，并能用相应的数学词汇表达。

title: 拔萝卜
description:
在晨间活动时，老师带领幼儿们一起唱早安歌，一起签到问好。我们一起倾听音乐《拔萝卜》，并邀请他们一起牵手互动玩拔萝卜的游戏。他们在游戏互动中，建立与朋友们良好的关系。老师和他们打招呼问好，并请他们来粘贴自己的名牌。
当老师询问：“郑章易、郑章易在哪里？”他能听懂老师的话语，看向老师拍拍自己的胸口。老师请鼓励他说：“我、我在这。”他微笑的看着老师尝试说出：“我”。老师表扬他：“说的很棒！”老师请他找到自己的名牌，粘贴到学校里。章易可以正确的找到自己名牌，独立的粘贴在学校里。
在音乐游戏《拔萝卜》活动中，老师邀请幼儿们牵手拉个圆圈，章易主动的伸出双手牵住朋友，并跟随音乐左右晃动双手。在音乐中出现“嘿呦嘿呦”时，他会看向老师，模仿老师摆动手臂的动作。当音乐结束老师说：“萝卜成功拔出来了”，章易微笑着和老师拍手庆祝。
interpretation: 章易可以积极参与拔萝卜音乐活动，并可以尝试使用动作和语言表达自己的想法。章易能够认识自己的名字，独立粘贴好自己的名牌。在游戏过程中他能听懂老师的话语，表现出热情和友好，主动与朋友牵手互动。从活动中，章易表现自我意识发展良好，可以回应自己的名字。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (responding to their names) 培养自我意识，如：回应自己的名字等。

title: 铃鼓响起来
description: 在课室里，活动时间，老师邀请幼儿围成圆圈，提供每位朋友一个铃鼓，鼓励恺励和朋友们一起听歌曲，尝试用铃鼓伴奏，恺励右手拿着铃鼓，左手拍打铃鼓跟着歌曲敲击铃鼓，老师播放了《泥娃娃》《我的身体》《我的多变心情天气》《身体音阶歌》，等歌曲恺励一直跟随老师和歌曲一起进行活动，特别是播放到歌曲《泥娃娃》时，恺励跟着歌曲一边敲鼓，一边大声唱着歌曲。当播放《身体音阶歌》时，她手拿铃鼓跟着，歌曲的每个部位代表音符，从脚到头，从头到脚地律动和表演着，就这样恺励和朋友们跟着老师，开心结束了《铃鼓响起来》的活动。
interpretation: 从《铃鼓响起来》的活动中，恺励能够和朋友一起尝试运用铃鼓进行活动，在听到自己喜爱的歌曲时，能够大声唱出，跟着歌曲进行律动，并且能够持续不间断地完成活动，展现出恺励对音乐与律动感兴趣和主动性。

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest and enjoyment in music and movement (through musical instruments, moving and singing along with the music, etc.) 通过使用小的打击乐器，如：摇铃、敲击手鼓、节奏棒，培养幼儿对音乐与律动的兴趣和喜好。

title: 幼儿作品——金蛇贺岁
description:
蛇年即将到来，老师邀请詠皓一起来认识蛇并进行艺术作品创作。首先，老师向詠皓展示了玩偶蛇，鼓励詠皓仔细观察蛇的身体特征：两只眼睛、长长的舌头、圆圆的头部、细长的身体，没有腿……老师引导詠皓通过细致观察，掌握蛇的基本特征。然后，詠皓开始创作春节装饰——金蛇贺岁：詠皓先使用画刷蘸取金色颜料在红纸上画出蛇的身体，然后捏取眼睛和舌头，并选择合适位置进行黏贴，完成创作。在创作的过程中，詠皓锻炼了手部精细动作，提高手眼协调能力，增强了动手能力。

最后老师邀请詠皓展示自己的作品，詠皓展示并分享：“我的蛇很长，这么长。”

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work etc.) 通过美术活动，如：粗蜡笔涂鸦、水彩画、撕贴画、拼贴等，培养幼儿对艺术的兴趣。

title: Cleaning My Face
description: After mealtime, Harver observed her friends at the Health and Hygiene corner and decided to join them. She stood in front of the mirror, pointed at her reflection, and reached for a piece of tissue from the table. Holding the tissue, she wiped her nose and said, “I clean my nose.” She then took another tissue and wiped her forehead. After completing the cleaning, Harver gathered all the used tissues, crunched them up in her hands, and threw them into the bin. She turned around, looked at the teacher, and said, “Harver all done.”
interpretation: This observation shows Harver’s growing awareness of personal hygiene. She demonstrated independence in using a tissue to clean her face, disposing of the used tissue properly. She recognised the need for cleaning and took the initiative to complete the task herself.

learning_goals.title: Foster personal care skills，hygiene and safety, healthy eating habits (hand washing, cleaning up, dressing，toileting, personal safety, eating a variety of food, etc.) 培养个人自理能力、卫生和基本的安全意识、良好的饮食习惯，如：餐前洗手、脱衣服、如厕、食用多样化的食物等。

title: 骰子表情包
description:
老师邀请幼儿友一起玩游戏。老师介绍骰子表情包，请他们观察骰子上的表情。尝试投掷骰子，并模仿投中的表情。老师鼓励他们，照镜子镜子观察自己的表情。
老师询问幼儿们：“谁要参加骰子表情包游戏啊？”翰毅大声说：“maius”老师鼓励他说：“我要玩、翰毅玩。”翰毅很快的说出：“我要玩，翰毅玩。”老师表扬他：“真棒！”翰毅双手抓住骰子的两边向上投掷，当骰子上出现很多表情时，翰毅低头观察。老师询问：“翰毅你喜欢哪个表情？”他指着图片上张嘴巴，手在嘴巴前扇风的图片。老师示范图片上痛苦的表情，并解释当吃到辣辣的食物，嘴巴感到痛痛，就可以做出这样的表情。他微笑的模仿老师，伸出双手在嘴巴前摆动。当老师询问：“你能模仿这个表情吗？”翰毅低头看老师指的表情，双手掐腰、嘴巴紧闭身体挺直，跺脚发出：“哼”的声音，非常形象的做出生气的动作。老师微笑着表扬翰毅：“模仿的很形象，老师一下就看出来你很生气。”翰毅微笑的继续尝试投掷骰子，选择自己喜欢的表情模仿。
interpretation: 翰毅可以积极参与骰子表情包活动。并能使用语言、动作和表情，表达自己的想法。能听懂老师的话语，形象的模仿出自己喜欢的表情，积极与老师和朋友互动。

learning_goals.title: Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。

title: Cleaning My Face
description: After mealtime, Cavill noticed a few friends wiping their mouths at the Health and Hygiene corner after having yogurt during tea break. Observing their actions, he walked over to the mirror and looked at his reflection. He saw traces of yogurt stained on his mouth and picked up a tissue. He wiped his mouth while looking into the mirror, ensuring that the stain was gone. After checking his reflection again, he smiled happily. He turned to the teacher and said, “My mouth is clean,” before throwing the used tissue into the bin.
interpretation: This observation highlights Cavill’s growing awareness of personal hygiene. He was able to recognise when his face needed cleaning, independently use a tissue to wipe his mouth, and check his reflection for cleanliness. These actions demonstrate his ability to manage self-care routines and develop healthy hygiene habits.

title: 大鹅，生日快乐
description:
随着幼儿能力的不断增强，老师设置了难度更大的冒险之旅，并为其增添上情景：大鹅的生日到了，于是，老师邀请幼儿来为大鹅送上生日礼物。幼儿需要跳过“阶梯路”，走过曲折的“小桥”、爬过“山洞”，才能抵达大鹅的家，为大鹅送上生日礼物和生日祝福。在活动进行前，老师先引导幼儿观察场地布置，然后进行示范和讲解不同动作的技巧：双脚跳、双手展开保持平衡的走、爬行。然后邀请幼儿轮流进行尝试。
詠皓听到老师提问谁要参加后，大声的说：“我！”。詠皓被邀请为大鹅送礼物，他站在起点，模仿老师的样子，双腿微蹲，双脚起跳，落地时有一点不稳，他很快控制住自己的身体，并准备再次起跳。很快，他来到了“小桥”前，他站在“小桥”一端，张开手臂保持平衡向前走，他走到转弯上坡处开始左右摇晃，于是他停了下来，看向老师，请求老师的帮助。在老师的鼓励下，他再次尝试后再次请求帮助。他握住老师的一根手指后，笑着开始继续向前走，并且走的越来越快。来到由凳子和呼啦圈组成的山洞后，他快速的爬了过来，并且一边爬一边活动头部躲过头顶的呼啦圈。终于来到了目的地，他选择了一个小礼物给大鹅，并在老师的提醒下对大鹅说：“生日快乐！”
interpretation: 在活动的过程中，詠皓表现出了积极参与的兴趣和热情，同时他通过跳、爬等动作展现出了不断进步的粗大动作和肢体协调能力；通过走平衡木展现出了不断进步的平衡能力和肢体协调能力。

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, climb on playground equipment, bend, kick，throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作：走、跑、攀爬、弯腰、踢、投掷等。
Develop a sense of balance (walk along a non-linear pathway/line/balance beam with little or no support, jump from a low platform and maintain balance) 发展平衡感，如：锻炼手部、腿部肌肉的力量及协调运动能力。

title: 寻找彩色影子
description:
阳光明媚、天气晴朗，老师邀请幼儿们一起参与寻找彩色影子的活动。老师提供彩色的望眼镜，并示范如何进行游戏。鼓励他们使用自己喜欢的颜色望眼镜，观察大自然。
老师拿出彩色望眼镜，对他们说：“老师这里有很多彩色望眼镜，你们喜欢什么颜色的？”章易看向老师前面的彩色望眼镜，拿起蓝色的看了看又放下了，最终选择了紫色的望眼镜。
章易带着望眼镜看向花坛里的小草，老师询问他：“你看到什么？”章易指了指小草，并把望眼镜放在小草上方。他看了一会儿小草,又低头观察地上掉落的小花。老师询问他:“小花好看吗？”他点点头、并把望眼镜分享给老师。老师对他说:“谢谢你，小花变得好漂亮呀!花瓣变成紫色了。”章易又拿回望眼镜,低头观察。最后他和朋友躺在地上看天空上和白云。
interpretation: 章易可以积极的参与寻找彩色光影活动。并可以尝试使用动作表达自己的想法。通过使用彩色望眼镜观察小草、小花、白云和天空，初步培养了章易对大自然的兴趣和好奇心。

learning_goals.title: Cognitive Development - Natural Environment 认知 - 自然环境

Foster a beginning interest and curiosity in the natural environment through observation，exploration and play 通过观察、探索和游戏，初步培养对自然环境的兴趣和好奇心。
- Weather and weather changes 天气
- Floral 植物
- Fauna 动物

title: Bean Bag Toss
description: During outdoor time, Joshua noticed the teachers setting up the throwing activity and eagerly joined in. He quickly identified a yellow bean bag as his preferred choice and ran to pick it up. Using a forward throw, he tossed the bean bag across the line and watched where it landed before running to retrieve it. He repeated this action several times, each time observing the distance and placement of his throw. Throughout the activity, Joshua cheered for himself, jumped with joy, and remained focused on the game.
interpretation: This observation highlights Joshua’s development in gross motor skills, particularly in his ability to use a forward throw with control and coordination. His engagement in retrieving and repositioning himself for each throw demonstrates his spatial awareness and ability to track the movement of objects.

title: Bean Bag Toss
description:
During outdoor play, Diane eagerly joined the throwing activity the moment she saw the teachers setting up the game. As she ran towards the bean bags, she said, “I want yellow, I want yellow,” and picked up a yellow bean bag from the floor. Using a forward throw, she tossed the bean bag across the line and stood still to observe where it landed. She clapped for herself when she saw that the bean bag had crossed the line and hit the wall.

Diane then looked around for more yellow bean bags on the floor. She gathered a few and threw them towards the wall one after another. Each time, she observed where they landed before retrieving them and repeating the process.
interpretation: This observation highlights Diane’s developing gross motor skills, particularly her ability to coordinate her arm movements for forward throwing. Her repeated attempts and adjustments demonstrate spatial awareness, control, and persistence in refining her throwing technique.

title: Shark Ball Tossing Game
description:
Jing Xi saw a friend playing the Shark Ball Tossing game and wanted to join. She said, “I want, I want. It is my turn,” and eagerly picked up a ball. She initially stood at a distance from the shark and attempted to toss the ball forward, but it did not land in the shark’s mouth. After noticing this, she adjusted her position by moving closer and continued throwing the ball.

Despite missing a few times, Jing Xi remained focused and quickly retrieved the ball each time to try again. When the ball successfully landed in the shark’s mouth, she cheered by jumping up and clapping for herself.
interpretation: This observation highlights Jing Xi’s development in gross motor skills, particularly her ability to coordinate her arm movements for forward throwing. Her repeated attempts, adjustments in distance, and focus on the target show her determination and growing accuracy in aiming.

title: 穿线活动——好饿的毛毛虫
description:
在分享完绘本《好饿的毛毛虫》后，老师邀请幼儿参与到穿线活动中。活动伊始，老师精心准备了绘本中出现的各种食物道具，这些道具的展示立刻吸引了幼儿的注意力。老师通过逐一展示各类食物，并邀请幼儿说出它们的名称，激发了他们对故事内容的回忆和兴趣，进一步加深了他们对绘本情节的理解。随后，老师拿出一条首端为小毛毛虫造型的长绳子，向幼儿展示了毛毛虫吃掉各种水果的过程。在此过程中，老师一边向幼儿展示穿线的动作和技巧，一边引导幼儿用语言描述：“毛毛虫吃了……”鼓励幼儿边穿线边说出毛毛虫所吃过的不同食物。
詠皓在看完老师的示范后，快速来到老师旁边的小椅子上坐下等待老师的邀请。老师邀请詠皓进行活动，并且将首端为毛毛虫造型的绳子拿给詠皓。詠皓用左手拿住“毛毛虫”，右手拿取桌面上的食物道具。他右手拿住食物道具举到眼睛前面，左手将毛毛虫从食物道具中间的洞穿过去后放手，然后左手绕后拿住“毛毛虫”并将绳子拉出来。穿好一个食物道具后，他立马准备穿下一个，直至桌面上所有的食物道具都被穿起来。然后他用手摸了摸穿好的厚厚一沓的食物道具，抬头告诉老师：“我好了”。
interpretation: 詠皓积极的参与活动，并且在活动中顺利完成了穿绳任务。在穿绳的过程中，他展现出了不断进步的专注能力、手眼协调能力和左右手协调配合的能力，也展现出了完成任务后的成就感。

learning_goals.title: Develop eye-hand coordination  (roll a ball, pick up soft blocks and stack, self-feed, put simple things together and take them apart) 发展手眼协调能力，如：滚球，叠放软积木，喂食，把简单玩具连在一起再拆开等）。

description:
阳光明媚、天气晴朗，老师邀请幼儿们参与寻找彩色影子的活动。老师提供彩色的望眼镜。并示范如何进行游戏，鼓励他们使用自己喜欢的颜色望眼镜，观察大自然。
老师拿出彩色望眼镜，对他们说：“老师这里有很多彩色望眼镜，你们喜欢什么颜色的？”勇霖拿起紫色的望眼镜，看向老师和朋友。
勇霖带着望眼镜边走边看，他看到了楼下的开过的小汽车，指着楼下的方向，发出：“啊”的声音。老师引导他说：“小汽车。”勇霖走向花坛，观察花坛里的小草，老师询问他：“你看到什么？”他指了指小草。老师鼓励他说：“小草。”勇霖尝试小声的发出：“小”的音。老师表扬他：“很棒!要大胆的说。”勇霖把彩色望眼零靠近小草，低头观察。不一会儿，他换了一个橙色的望眼镜，抬头看向老师的方向。老师询问他：“你看到什么了？”他继续抬头观察。老师鼓励勇霖说：“老师。”

title: Count and Match Numicons
description: Pictures of numicons and numicons pieces were spread on the table. Children were tasked to pick a numicon piece, count the number of holes and find the matching numicon picture. Harrison took a numicon piece and started counting by pointing in a random direction, “1…2…4…6…” “Let’s count together, starting from here,” his teacher encouraged him by pointing at the hole for him, “1…2…3…4…5…6…7…8!” They counted together. Harrison then tried counting on his own and picked the corresponding numicon picture and matched them up. “Yea! I’m done!” Harrison cheered and his teacher praised him for the good effort.
interpretation: In this activity, Harrison needed some guidance in counting the holes in the numicon pieces but he persevered and was able to count again together with his teacher. He was able to match the numicon pieces to the picture and placed them accurately too! Way to go, Harrison!

learning_goals.title: Match identical objects or pictures.
Count reliably, one object at a time up to a collection of 5 or more.

title: My Emotion Colour
description: Children were invited to think of an emotion and a colour that represents that emotion. They were invited to tear the coloured paper into smaller pieces to do an emotion collage. Harrison pointed to yellow and mentioned, “I want yellow for feeling happy.” “Sure, Harrison, you may have the yellow paper.” his teacher responded. Harrison took the paper and started tearing into smaller pieces. He then pasted the pieces onto a blank paper. Upon completing, Harrison shared with his teacher, “ I choose yellow for happy. I feel happy when I go to the playground.”
interpretation: Harrison showed his thought process by choosing a coloured paper and a corresponding emotion. He was able to tear the paper into smaller pieces and paste them onto the paper, ensuring that the pieces are within. Harrison smiled in satisfaction and was proud to talk about his artwork to his teacher.

learning_goals.title: Talk about their own artworks (e.g: what the artwork is about and the lines, colours and shapes used).

title: Through the Needle’s Eye
description: Two hoops - one at lower height and one at a higher height above the ground were set up. Children were to go through the ‘Needle’s Eye’ without touching it. Harrison stood near the first hoop and bent his body over, two hands over the hoop. He continued to lift one foot at a time and brought his legs over. He continued using the same bending over method for the second hoop and hi-5 his teacher when he completed.
interpretation: This activity displayed Harrison’s ability in his non-locomotor skills. He was able to balance himself while bending his body over and brought his legs over without falling. Even at a higher height, Harrison did it without touching the hoop or toppling. Doing a high five with his teacher showed his sense of accomplishment too. Good job Harrison!

learning_goals.title: Perform one non-locomotor skills at a time such as balancing, bending, twisting, stretching, rocking, swaying, turning, pushing, or pulling.

title: 摇摆的小水母
description:
老师邀请幼儿们一起参与摇摆小水母活动。老师提供材料好的水母纸板和毛根棒若干，请幼儿们一只手抓握纸板，另一只手抓握毛根插入纸板上的洞洞中。
老师对幼儿们说：“谁要参加摇摆小水母活动啊？”紫萱微笑着看向老师说：“levelle”老师鼓励紫萱说：“我、我要玩。”紫萱看着老师拍拍自己说：“我。”老师夸讲她：“说得好！”老师出示材料，请紫萱自由选择。紫萱右手五指抓握水母纸板，左手大拇指、食指、中指、呈三指头抓握毛根，向下插入纸板中的洞洞里。在紫萱双手配合和反复尝试下，紫萱成功插满了毛根。老师夸奖她：“真厉害！”并与她击掌庆祝，她微笑着回应老师。

title: 小手拍拍
description:
老师邀请幼儿们一起参与小手拍拍的活动。在游戏中请幼儿们认识自己的身体部位和名称，并找一找都在哪里。
当老师询问：“嘴巴在哪里？”紫萱看着老师指出自己的嘴巴。在老师询问：“紫萱耳朵在哪里？”紫萱看着老师指自己的耳朵，并尝试说出：“耳”的词汇来。老师夸奖她：“真厉害！能够准确的找到自己的五官在哪里。”她微笑的看向老师。当老师出示人脸粘贴板时，请紫萱来贴一贴。紫萱拿起五官的图片，并尝试粘贴到人脸上。老师询问她：“这是什么？”紫萱指了指自己的眉毛。老师鼓励紫萱说：“眉毛、弯弯的眉毛，”紫萱微笑的看着老师说出：“眉。”老师夸奖她：“很棒！”

domains.title: Psycho-social Self 心理-社会行为

title: These Are My Friends
description:
Noelle stood upright and reached out with her right hand to grasp the edge of the recycled wet wipes lid. She attempted to pull it open but was unsuccessful on her first try. Adjusting her grip, she tried again and successfully pulled the lid down on her second attempt.

As the lid opened, Noelle focused her attention on the picture hidden beneath. She paused briefly before saying, "I see Arissa." Turning around, she scanned the room and reached out to Arissa, who was standing behind her. With her right hand, Noelle pointed toward Arissa and excitedly said, "See, Arissa here."

Her teacher acknowledged her identification, responding, "Yes, you have identified Arissa. Would you like to say 'hello' to her?" Noelle nodded and, with a smile, extended her hand to offer Arissa a high-five.

Noelle demonstrated her growing ability to recognize and identify peers by name, reinforcing her sense of others. She correctly named Arissa upon seeing her picture and actively sought her out in the classroom, showing social awareness. Her engagement in a social exchange, like offering a high-five, highlighted her emerging confidence in peer interactions.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of others (identifying others to their names) 培养对他人的认识，如：指认同伴等。

domains.title: Psycho-social Self 心理-社会行为

title: Water and Pipette Transfer
description:
Noelle gazed at the three colored liquids before her, pausing thoughtfully as she considered her choice. After a moment, she confidently decided, saying, "I want blue." Reaching forward, she carefully picked up the dropper filled with blue liquid. She observed closely as she squeezed the dropper, watching in wonder as the blue liquid squirted into the container. Her eyes widened with amazement as she pointed at the container and excitedly told her teacher, "Look, blue inside."

Encouraged by her discovery, Noelle picked up the dropper filled with yellow liquid. She positioned her right hand over the container and confidently announced, "I squeeze," as she pressed the dropper. She watched attentively as the yellow liquid dripped into the container, joining the blue. As the colors mixed, Noelle’s expression transformed into excitement. "Wow, look!" she exclaimed, her voice filled with wonder as she noticed the liquid turning green.

Fascinated by the changes, Noelle continued her exploration, eagerly selecting different coloured liquids and squeezing them into the container. She observed the interactions between colours, watching as they mixed and changed. Throughout the activity, she remained engaged, demonstrating curiosity and delight in the process.

Noelle’s thoughtful selection of colours, her careful handling of the dropper, and her keen observation of the liquid’s transformation indicate a growing interest and curiosity in the natural environment. Her amazement at the colour changes and her eagerness to share her discoveries with her teacher highlight her developing sense of exploration. By using the dropper to transfer liquids, she not only engaged in hands-on experimentation but also developed an understanding of cause-and-effect relationships.

title: Let’s Kick The Ball
description:
Noelle was fully engaged in a gross motor activity as she played with a ball. She began by reaching out both hands toward her teacher, saying, “Noelle ball... I want ball,” clearly requesting the ball. Once handed the ball, Noelle took it in both hands and walked towards an open space, showing initiative in setting up her play area. She squatted down to gently place the ball on the floor, before stepping back and focusing on it with interest.

Noelle then raised her left leg and swung it forward, skilfully kicking the ball. She watched intently as the ball rolled forward, showing curiosity and concentration. Delighted by the movement, Noelle moved toward the ball and kicked it again, laughing with joy as the ball rolled away. She ran after it eagerly, continuing to kick it around the space. With excitement, Noelle exclaimed, “I kick the ball,” demonstrating a sense of pride and enjoyment in her physical accomplishment.

Through this activity, Noelle demonstrated important gross motor skills, including balance, coordination, and control as she kicked the ball and moved around the space. Her ability to follow a sequence of actions—requesting the ball, positioning it, and kicking it—shows developing body awareness and motor planning. Noelle’s enthusiasm and verbal expression also reflect her enjoyment of the activity and growing confidence in her physical abilities.

title: My Name Is Liam
description:
Liam sat on the floor with his teacher and peers, participating in the attendance activity. He watched attentively as his teacher held up pictures of his peers, waiting for his turn. When his teacher held up his picture, Liam immediately sat up straight, eager to respond. His teacher asked the group, “Look, who is this?” One of his peers quickly replied, “Liam.” His teacher confirmed, “Yes, this is Liam’s picture. Where is Liam?” Liam then reached out with his right hand and pointed to his photo, saying, “Liam” in a soft, clear voice.

After receiving his photo from the teacher, Liam examined it carefully, looking at the image. His teacher gently asked, “What’s your name?” Liam paused for a moment, looked back at the photo, then smiled and responded, “Liam,” showing a sense of pride in recognizing himself. Liam then stood up, attempting to attach his photo to the attendance chart, indicating his understanding of the task and his growing sense of self.

Liam’s response to his name and the recognition of his picture demonstrates his developing sense of self and awareness. His ability to connect his name with his photo, as well as his active participation in the task, indicates his growing recognition of his identity in the group setting.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (responding to their names) 培养自我意识，如：回应自己的名字等。

title: Let’s Kick the Ball
description:
Liam walked towards his teacher eagerly and reached out for the green ball. “Ball…ball,” Liam said repeatedly while giggling. After examining the ball, Liam dropped the ball on the floor. He looked at the ball attentively before moving his right leg back. He swung his leg back and forth before kicking the ball. “Go,” he exclaimed excitedly as he watched the ball roll forward.

Liam then took a few steps toward the ball and bent down to pick it up. He held the ball in both hands for a moment, inspecting it closely before dropping it again. He took a few more steps back, positioning himself with his right leg slightly raised, and kicked the ball once more. “Go!” he repeated, his voice full of enthusiasm.

This time, the ball rolled further across the floor, and Liam quickly ran after it, giggling. He reached the ball, placed both hands on it, and pushed it forward again, watching it move with fascination. He repeated this several times, alternating between kicking and pushing the ball. Each time, he seemed to become more excited, laughing and saying “Go!” as the ball rolled away.

Liam's engagement in this simple but purposeful action demonstrated growing coordination, balance, and the beginnings of spatial awareness. His excited reaction, coupled with his ability to kick the ball with intent, showed his increasing confidence in mastering this gross motor skill.

title: Water and Pipette Transfer
description:
As Liam sat in front of the different colored liquids, his teacher asked, "Which color would you like?" He glanced at the options before fixing his gaze on the red liquid. Pointing at it, he confidently said, "This." His teacher encouraged him further, asking, "What color is this?" Without hesitation, Liam responded, "Red."

Reaching out his right hand, Liam took the dropper from his teacher. He held it close to his face, examining the red liquid inside with curiosity. After a moment, he leaned forward toward the container and shook the dropper, expecting the liquid to pour out. When nothing happened, he paused and looked up at his teacher with a puzzled expression. Sensing his confusion, his teacher gently guided him, saying, "Squeeze the dropper, Liam." He nodded in understanding and pressed the dropper with his fingers. This time, he watched as the red liquid successfully dripped into the container. His face lit up with excitement as he pointed and exclaimed, "Red!"

Encouraged by his success, Liam eagerly responded to his teacher’s next prompt, "Which color would you like next?" He carefully placed the previous dropper down and selected the dropper with the blue liquid. With growing confidence, he continued his exploration, fully immersed in the experience, eagerly observing how the liquid moved and transferred from one place to another.

Liam displayed curiosity and engagement as he explored the dropper and colored liquids. His close observation, problem-solving when the liquid did not drip, and excitement upon success indicate a developing understanding of cause and effect. His willingness to continue exploring different colors and respond to his teacher’s prompts demonstrates growing confidence and interest in scientific exploration. This activity supported his ability to observe, experiment, and learn through play, fostering his early curiosity about the natural environment.

title: Leroy’s Lunchtime Conversations
description:
Leroy reached out his right hand, wrapping his fingers around the spoon with a firm grip. With careful control, he scooped up a portion of rice, vegetables and fish before moving the spoon toward his open mouth. Leroy continued to feed himself, alternating between different foods with confidence and independence. 

After a few mouthfuls, Leroy paused, his attention momentarily shifting to his teacher. Looking down at his bowl, Leroy pointed at the carrot and said, “Carrot”. His teacher responded, “Yes, Leroy. That is a carrot. Carrot is good for your eyes.” Leroy looked up, meeting his teacher’s gaze, absorbing the new information. The conversation continued with the teacher asking, "What else are you having for lunch today?" Leroy paused briefly, carefully scanning his bowl. After a moment’s thought, he replied, “Fish,” confidently naming the next food item.

After finishing his meal, Leroy stood up from his chair and returned his bowl to the designated area.He then turned his attention back to the teacher, walking over to her and pointing at a piece of fruit on the counter, saying, “Banana.” The teacher smiled warmly and responded, “Yes, that’s a banana. Would you like some?” Leroy nodded, his face brightening with recognition.

Leroy’s interactions with his teacher during lunch were rich in moments of connection, curiosity, and communication. He demonstrated confidence in his independence while seeking validation and further interaction with his teacher. The teacher’s thoughtful responses helped foster a nurturing environment where Leroy felt secure and encouraged to explore both his autonomy and his relationship with adults.

learning_goals.title: Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。

title: 小手拍拍
description:
老师邀请幼儿友一起参与小手拍拍的活动。在游戏中请幼儿们认识自己的身体部位和名称，并找一找都在哪里。
当老师唱小手拍拍小手拍拍，手指生出来眼睛在哪里用手指出来。哲恩可以跟随老师的一起做拍手的动作，并可以唱出歌词：“小手拍拍，”准确的指出自己的眼睛。当老师询问他：“鼻子在哪里？用手指出来。”哲恩能跟随老师找到自己鼻子。当老师询问他：“耳朵在哪里？用手指出了。”哲恩双手指向自己的耳朵，并能说出：“耳朵。”老师表扬他：“真厉害，准确的找到自己的鼻子。”当老师出示五官粘贴板，请他们一起来找一找嘴巴在哪里？他能快速找到嘴巴，并把嘴巴放在了自己的嘴巴上，展示给朋友们。

title: Navigating The Obstacle
description:
Leroy eagerly watched his peers navigate the obstacle course, standing still and focusing as they completed each task. When it was his turn, Leroy excitedly stood up and said, “Leroy try,” showing his eagerness to participate. He approached the first challenge, the stepping stones, with a focused expression. Leroy carefully stepped onto each stone, pausing to regain his balance before moving forward. He successfully completed the stepping stones, a clear demonstration of his ability to balance and assess his movement.

As Leroy approached the next obstacle, a set of cones, he hesitated slightly before lifting his right foot to step over the first pole. Unfortunately, he lost his balance and placed both feet down to steady himself. After a brief moment, Leroy adjusted his stance, extending both arms to gain balance. This strategy proved successful as he lifted his foot again, crossing the first pole slowly but steadily. Leroy giggled with excitement as he completed the task and looked ahead at the next challenge.

At the final pole, Leroy used the same method, adjusting his balance with both arms outstretched. He crossed the last pole with confidence and a broad smile on his face, successfully completing the obstacle course with minimal support from his teacher.

This observation demonstrates Leroy’s developing gross motor skills, particularly his balance, coordination, and ability to navigate physical challenges. His careful approach to the stepping stones, along with his strategic use of arms for balance, shows an emerging ability to control his body movements. Leroy’s persistence in overcoming obstacles, even after initially losing balance, reflects his growing confidence and determination in using his body effectively. His successful completion of the obstacle course with minimal teacher support highlights his progress in gross motor development, particularly in walking, balancing, and adjusting movements for better control and stability.

title: 3D Apple Tree
description:
"Green...Green!" Leroy exclaimed excitedly as he watched his teacher pour green paint onto the tray. Sitting down on the chair, he listened attentively as the teacher introduced the activity. Once ready, Leroy leaned forward and eagerly reached for the recycled tissue box wrapped in bubble wrap.

Using both hands, he picked up the box with ease and directed it toward his paper. At first, he dropped it onto the paper and pressed it down with his right hand. Then, adjusting his technique, he lifted the box with both hands and began stamping, creating patterns and prints across the paper.

After covering his paper with green paint, Leroy reached for another art tool. He dipped it into the red paint and began creating small red dots on his paper. "This my apple," he said with a big grin. Leroy remained engaged throughout the activity, carefully adding details to his artwork and exploring the materials with excitement.

Leroy displayed a strong interest in art throughout the activity. His excitement upon seeing the green paint and his willingness to participate demonstrated a natural curiosity and enthusiasm for creative expression. By actively engaging in stamping and color application, Leroy explored different artistic techniques, showing an openness to experimenting with materials.

title: Reading A Book
description:
With a book in his hand, Asher walked over to his teacher and tapped her leg, offering the book while mumbling words, making his request known. His teacher asked, "Would you like to read the book together?" Asher eagerly nodded his head and said, "Book," showing his enthusiasm for the activity. The two of them walked over to the library area, where Asher sat down beside his teacher, ready to begin reading the book.

As his teacher read aloud, Asher listened attentively, his focus clearly on the story. When he spotted a lion in the book, Asher excitedly pretended to be a lion, saying, "Roar!" His teacher responded, "Is that the sound of a lion?" Asher roared again, clearly enjoying the interaction. The playful exchange continued as Asher eagerly pointed out the various animals in the book. When a hippo appeared, Asher pointed at it with interest and curiosity. His teacher noticed his engagement and explained, "That is a hippo. Hippos love to be in the water."

Asher pointed to the hippo’s eyes, then to his own eyes, clearly making a connection. His teacher responded, “Yes, the hippo has two eyes just like you. Can you spot the hippo’s nose?” Asher then pointed at the hippo’s nose and followed up by pointing to his own nose, showing an increasing awareness of body parts and similarities between himself and the animals.

Asher actively engaged with his teacher, making connections between the story and his own experiences. His interactions with his teacher reflected a growing bond, demonstrating trust and curiosity as he explored the book. The back-and-forth exchange between Asher and his teacher, where his teacher prompts him with questions like “Can you spot the hippo’s nose?” encourages Asher’s thinking and comprehension skills while providing opportunities for him to practice verbal communication.

title: Handwashing
description:
After their tea break, Asher joined his peers as they walked to the toilet area, prepared to wash their hands. As they arrived, the children took turns sitting outside the toilet, waiting for their name to be called. Asher patiently sat with his peers until his teacher called him. Responding promptly, Asher stood up and walked over to the teacher, who was ready to guide him through the handwashing routine. 

Upon reaching the wash area, Asher walked to an empty basin and leaned forward slightly to adjust the tap with his right hand, ensuring that the water was at the right temperature. He then placed both hands under the running water, thoroughly wetting them. 

Asher then dispensed a small amount of soap into his palms, rubbed them together, and made sure to lather both the front and back of his hands. After scrubbing for a brief moment, he rinsed the soap away, ensuring that no soap bubbles remained. Asher demonstrated care in the process, checking his hands to ensure they were thoroughly rinsed. Once satisfied, he turned off the tap using his hands, picked up a piece of tissue from the dispenser, and dried his hands completely. Finally, he disposed of the tissue in the dustbin.

Through this activity, Asher showed that he is learning to take care of his own hygiene. He waited patiently for his turn to wash his hands, showing he understands the importance of taking turns. When it was his turn, Asher carefully adjusted the tap and  made sure his hands were clean by washing them with soap, scrubbing both sides, and rinsing them well. He also dried his hands and threw the tissue away in the bin, showing he knows how to clean up after himself. This shows Asher is starting to understand good hygiene habits and how to keep himself safe and healthy.

learning_goals.title: Foster awareness of personal hygiene and safety，healthy eating habits (hand washing, cleaning up, dressing，toileting, personal safety, eating a variety of food, etc.) 培养个人自理能力、卫生和基本的安全意识、良好的饮食习惯，如：洗手、穿衣、食用多样化的食物等。

title: Making a Castle
description:
While exploring the learning corners, Lucas picked the magnetic tiles to play with. Shortly after, his friend joined him and watched Lucas slowly placing the tiles to make a base. 

His friend asked, "What are you making?" Lucas then replied, "I want to make a castle!" His friend then asked, "Can I join you?" Lucas replied, "Sure, you can!"

His friend smiled and passed him some tiles. Lucas took it and carefully placed it to make the structure of the house. When Lucas was done with his structure, he said, "Thank you for helping me Cayven!"

Through this interaction with his friend, Lucas can also develop an awareness of the need to show appreciation and care for others as he thanked his friend for helping him.

title: Exploring The Sensory Board
description:
Noticing Adele engaging with the sensory board, her teacher approached to interact with her. "You seem interested in the sensory board. What can you feel?" her teacher prompted. Adele shifted her gaze toward her teacher and used a non-verbal cue by pointing at the board.

"You're touching a ribbon. Does it feel hard or soft?" her teacher asked. Adele moved her palm against the ribbon, exploring its texture. "It feels soft, doesn’t it?" her teacher prompted further. Adele looked at her teacher and nodded in agreement.

Her teacher continued, "Can you spot the leaves?" Adele examined the sensory board before reaching out to touch the leaves. "Yes, you've spotted the leaves. They are green in colour," her teacher affirmed. Adele touched the leaves again and softly repeated, "Green." Her teacher responded with encouragement, "Yes, green! Good job repeating my words." Adele grinned in response, clearly enjoying the positive interaction.

"Can you spot something else that is green in colour?" her teacher asked. Adele pointed at the green pom-pom. "The pom-pom is soft," her teacher shared. Adele nodded and repeated, "Soft."

Adele’s exploration of the sensory board provided an opportunity for meaningful interaction and relationship-building with her teacher. Adele’s grinning response to the teacher’s encouragement suggests that she felt proud and validated in her efforts. This emotional expression reflects her growing self-esteem and a sense of accomplishment as she engages in meaningful interactions. Her willingness to continue exploring and responding to prompts further illustrates her increasing comfort and confidence in participating in shared activities with adults.

description:
Adele took small, deliberate steps as she approached the stepping stones. As she stepped onto the first stone, she slowed her pace, focusing intently on maintaining her balance. She extended her arms slightly to the sides for stability, shifting her weight from one foot to the other as she navigated across the uneven surface. Her core muscles engaged as she adjusted her posture with each step, showcasing developing balance and coordination.

After successfully completing the stepping stones, Adele confidently moved toward the next obstacle. She raised her hands and attempted to shift her weight onto one foot, demonstrating emerging unilateral balance. With concentration, she bent her knee and lifted one foot at a time to step over the pole, engaging her lower body strength and gross motor control. Each time, she used her arms to counterbalance, maintaining coordination and fluidity in her movements.

Adele’s ability to navigate both obstacles with controlled movements and purposeful balance highlights her growing gross motor skills. By engaging in activities that involve walking on uneven surfaces, shifting weight, bending, and lifting her legs, she is strengthening her muscle control, stability, and coordination—essential foundations for more complex physical activities such as running, jumping, and climbing.

description:
Engrossed in exploring her surroundings, Adele walked around the area with her viewfinder, attentively examining the plants and flowers around her. She walked over to the grass patch, watching closely as the butterfly flew around a flower before eventually flying away.

Resuming her exploration, Adele discovered a small flower with yellow petals hidden between the grass. Using her right hand, she pointed at the flower before bending her knees and attempting to touch it. When she successfully touched the flower, Adele grinned, displaying her joy and excitement in the discovery.

Her ability to spot the butterfly and follow its movement reflects her growing attention span and interest in living things within her surroundings.

Adele’s discovery of the yellow flower highlights her exploratory nature. Her actions—pointing at the flower, bending her knees, and attempting to touch it—illustrate her eagerness to engage with and learn about her environment through sensory experiences.

title: 骑自行车
description:
描述：
        教师和幼儿一起来到游乐场，向幼儿介绍游乐场里的自行车，邀请幼儿进行骑车的活动。
        教师向歆淯介绍如何骑自行车，然后请歆淯自己骑车。歆淯走到自行车前，她用左手握住自行车的把手，然后抬起右腿跨坐在自行车上，教师对歆淯说：“歆淯，你准备好骑车了吗？”歆淯回答教师说：“准备好了。”然后歆淯用双手握住自行车的把手，双脚踩在地上并配合用力，自行车动起来了，歆淯对教师说：“张老师，你看。”歆淯回应教师说：“哇歆淯你让自行车动起来了。”歆淯继续骑自行车。

title: 新闻《昂首挺胸走对路》
description:
新闻时事分享时间，教师为幼儿介绍了新闻《昂首阔步走对路》。教师为幼儿介绍了错误的走路姿势会让自己或者膝盖受伤。并列举出了三种错误的姿势：走路不看前方；左右摆动手臂；拖着鞋子走路。然后对鞋子也有一定的要求，鞋子不能太软或者太硬，太硬会磨破皮，太软稳定性不好容易跌倒。最适合走路的鞋子鞋跟与前脚掌的高度不应该超过2厘米。
教师邀请维恩和同伴一起踮脚在课室里行走，让他们感受鞋跟太高对走路带来的影响。两圈后，教师邀请幼儿回到自己的位置，举手分享自己的感受。维恩说：“我这样走好累。”教师告诉她，如果走的太久脚还会痛。教师将便利贴递给她，邀请她记录下来学到的内容。画好后，她来到教师身边，说：“我画的是这样走。”教师问她是不是穿高跟鞋，她踮起脚说：“是这样。”教师告诉她是踮脚走，她复述道：“踮脚走。”
interpretation: 维恩能够针对走路中的错误姿势或者行为进行讨论。能够理解文章内容，绘制出自己所学到的如何走对路。

description:
新闻时事分享时间，教师为幼儿介绍了新闻《昂首阔步走对路》。教师为幼儿介绍了错误的走路姿势会让自己或者膝盖受伤。并列举出了三种错误的姿势：走路不看前方；左右摆动手臂；拖着鞋子走路。然后对鞋子也有一定的要求，鞋子不能太软或者太硬，太硬会磨破皮，太软稳定性不好容易跌倒。最适合走路的鞋子鞋跟与前脚掌的高度不应该超过2厘米。
教师邀请慈恩和同伴一起踮脚在课室里行走，让她们感受鞋跟太高对走路带来的影响。两圈后，教师邀请幼儿回到自己的位置，举手分享自己的感受。慈恩笑着说：“我的脚不痛。”教师邀请她将自己学到的内容记录到便利贴上。她将便利贴的内容展示给教师看，她说：“我画这样，不可以穿高高的鞋。”她一边说，一边踮起脚尖走给教师看。教师问她箭头是代表了什么。她说：“看前面。”
interpretation: 慈恩能够针对走路中的错误姿势或者行为进行讨论。能够理解文章内容，绘制出自己所学到的如何走对路。

title: Patterned Fabric Showcase
description:
Prior to this activity, the children were introduced to different fabric patterns from various cultures, such as stripes, florals, and geometric designs. They compared groups of fabrics based on attributes like “bright-colored with geometric shapes” versus “soft-textured with floral patterns.” The children closely observed these patterns and discussed their characteristics.

Building on these observations, the children were invited to create their own three-dimensional art, using fabric patterns as inspiration to explore textures and layering. They then engaged in making 3D collages, applying what they had learned about patterns and design.

Maia carefully selected the patterned paper scraps she wanted to use for her design, gravitating toward floral patterns. She independently began working on her collage, cutting out different flowers from the scrap paper along with a few rectangular pieces. With an assortment of shapes and cutouts, Maia thoughtfully arranged them on her paper before gluing them down.

She started by placing a single rectangular strip at the top of her paper. After observing her work, Maia decided to change her approach and began arranging the remaining rectangular strips diagonally. Once satisfied with the diagonal pattern, she filled the empty spaces with her floral cutouts. To complete her design, Maia added finishing touches with markers, drawing details such as spirals.
interpretation:
Maia explored creative expression by carefully selecting and arranging patterned materials for her collage. She demonstrated independence in choosing floral patterns and thoughtfully planned her design before gluing the pieces down. Her ability to make decisions about placement and layering shows an emerging understanding of artistic composition.


As Maia arranged her pieces, she experimented with different ways to organise her materials, first placing a rectangular strip at the top before deciding to shift to a diagonal arrangement. This process shows her ability to reflect on her work and make creative choices to achieve her desired outcome.


Maia also added her own artistic details using markers, demonstrating confidence in using different tools to enhance her work. Through this experience, she practiced problem-solving, fine motor skills, and visual planning. Providing further opportunities to explore textures, layering, and new materials will continue to support Maia’s creative thinking and artistic development.

learning_goals.title: Create 2- and 3-dimensional artworks from observation and/or imagination.

title: My Name Is Evan
description:
Evan sat cross-legged on the floor alongside his peers, waiting patiently for his turn. His eyes followed his teacher’s movements as she held up each picture card, distributing them one by one. With each turn, Evan looked attentively at the cards, showing curiosity and anticipation as he attempted to recognize his own picture. He occasionally glanced at his peers, observing their reactions as they received their picture cards.

As Evan continued watching, he suddenly heard his name being called. Instantly, his posture changed—he lifted his head, turned his gaze toward his teacher, and focused on the picture card in her hand. When the teacher asked, "Who is this?" a few of his peers enthusiastically answered, "Evan!" Evan's expression brightened as he leaned forward eagerly, reaching out to retrieve his picture card.

Holding the card in his hands, Evan took a moment to examine the image closely. His fingers gently traced the edges of the card, and his eyes remained fixed on his picture. After a brief pause, he confidently pointed at his image and said, "Evan," clearly recognising himself.

Evan’s participation in this activity reinforced his developing sense of self. His ability to respond to his name, recognised his own picture, and verbally affirm his identity demonstrated emerging self-recognition and personal awareness. By verbally affirming “Evan” while pointing at his picture, he reinforced his understanding of his identity. This activity supported his ability to respond to his name and recognise himself, fostering a stronger sense of self.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (responding to their names) 培养自我意识，如：回应自己的名字等。

title: Handwashing
description:
Evan leaned forward, steadying himself with one hand on the sink as he reached out with the other to turn on the tap. He watched attentively as the water flowed before placing one hand under the running stream. After a few seconds, he switched hands, ensuring both were wet.

Observing his peer beside him, Evan mimicked their actions, reaching for the soap dispenser. Using one hand, he pressed down twice, dispensing the soap onto his palm. He then rubbed both palms together, creating lather, and carefully scrubbed his hands under the running water. His focus remained on his hands as he continued washing until no soap remained.

Once satisfied, Evan reached forward and turned off the tap. He then walked over to the tissue dispenser, pulling out a piece of tissue to dry his hands.

Evan is learning to take care of himself by practicing proper handwashing. He watched his peers and followed each step carefully, showing he is beginning to understand the importance of keeping his hands clean. By turning on the tap, using soap, scrubbing, rinsing, and drying his hands, Evan is developing independence in personal hygiene.

learning_goals.title: Foster awareness of personal hygiene and safety，healthy eating habits (hand washing, cleaning up, dressing，toileting, personal safety, eating a variety of food, etc.) 培养个人自理能力、卫生和基本的安全意识、良好的饮食习惯，如：洗手、穿衣、食用多样化的食物等。

title: 3D Apple Tree
description:
Evan eagerly picked up the recycled tissue box wrapped with bubble wrap, showing excitement to begin the activity. He watched his teacher’s demonstration closely, then immediately mimicked the motion, pressing the box onto his paper. He repeated the stamping process multiple times, carefully lifting and pressing the box, making sure the paint covered the paper. Each time he dropped the box onto the paper, he giggled, seemingly fascinated by the texture and the patterns it created. His laughter and wide eyes indicated a sense of enjoyment and discovery.

After covering the paper with green prints, Evan observed his teacher introducing the next step. He reached for an ice cream stick with his right hand and dipped it into the red paint. Holding it carefully, he tapped the stick onto his paper, creating small red dots to represent apples. He paused occasionally to look at his work, appearing to assess where to place the next apple.

Next, Evan reached for a paintbrush. He dipped it into the brown paint and moved it toward the toilet roll, using short strokes to apply the paint evenly. He turned the roll slightly to cover more areas, concentrating as he spread the paint. At one point, he glanced at his teacher for reassurance, and when encouraged with, "You're doing a great job painting the trunk!" he grinned and continued working.

Evan displayed a strong interest in art through his eagerness to participate, his careful attention to detail, and his sustained engagement throughout the activity. His curiosity and excitement in experimenting with different materials (bubble wrap, ice cream stick, and paintbrush) reflect his growing appreciation for artistic expression. His repeated stamping and giggles suggest he enjoyed exploring texture and printmaking, reinforcing a positive connection to art.

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work etc.) 通过美术活动，如：粗蜡笔涂鸦、水彩画、撕贴画、拼贴等，培养幼儿对艺术的兴趣。

title: My Name is Odelia
description:
Odelia sat with her peers, watching attentively as her teacher distributed the picture cards. Her eyes remained focused on the cards, demonstrating anticipation as she waited patiently for her turn. She observed each child receiving their picture, occasionally glancing at the attendance chart where her friends were placing their cards.

After a moment, Odelia heard her name being called and immediately directed her attention to her teacher. Noticing her own picture card, her expression brightened, and she excitedly stood up. She eagerly reached out for the card, displaying enthusiasm and recognition of the familiar image.

"Who is this?" her teacher asked. Odelia confidently pointed one finger at herself and exclaimed, "Odelia!" Her teacher acknowledged her response, reinforcing her recognition by saying, "Yes, this is your picture." 

Taking the picture card from her teacher, Odelia turned to the attendance chart hanging beside her. She examined the chart, identifying the correct spot for her picture. Carefully, she grasped a clip and attempted to secure her card to the chart. 

Odelia’s participation in the attendance activity demonstrates her growing sense of self and awareness of her identity within the classroom community. Her ability to recognize her name and picture reflects an emerging understanding of self-identification.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (responding to their names) 培养自我意识，如：回应自己的名字等。

title: Let’s Play With The Ball
description:
Odelia squealed in delight as she ran across the field, chasing after the yellow ball. Her legs moved as fast as she could, taking big, purposeful steps with good muscle control and stability. With her arms extended, Odelia prepared to catch the rolling ball. She came to a stop in front of the ball, bent her knees, and picked it up with both hands.

Odelia then moved her arms forward, tossing the ball as high as she could. She watched with excitement as the ball rolled forward and quickly began chasing after it again. This time, she caught the ball and sat down on the grass, taking a moment to catch her breath. After resting briefly, Odelia rolled the ball forward while remaining seated, watching it roll before eventually standing up to continue the activity.

Odelia’s active engagement in chasing, tossing, and rolling the ball demonstrates significant gross motor development. Her ability to run with stability and control, taking purposeful steps, highlights her growing coordination and balance. The use of her arms and hands to catch, pick up, and toss the ball indicates developing hand-eye coordination and upper body strength. Overall, Odelia’s actions reflect her growing confidence in exploring gross motor activities.

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, bend, kick, throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作，如：走、跑、双脚跳、弯腰、踢、丢球等。

title: Music Medley
description: During the music lesson, the children were encouraged to tap their drumsticks in time with the beat of a song they had learned.
interpretation:
Ethan followed the rhythm closely, tapping his drumsticks lightly to the beat as the teacher echoed the words and wrote them on the board, using "ti-ta" and "tam" to represent the rhythm. For example, "to-day" was broken down into two beats, with Ethan tapping in sync with the teacher's cues. He also explored different ways to strike the drumsticks, such as tapping the heads of the sticks sideways against each other or hitting the lollipop drum. As he played, Ethan communicated with his peer Yi Xuan, verbally repeating "ti-ti" and "tam" after the teacher, practicing the rhythm together. 


Their shared enthusiasm and collaboration deepened their connection, as they exchanged smiles and supported each other’s learning. This activity allowed Ethan and the other children to engage with the elements of music through rhythm, voice, and percussion instruments while fostering social competency, teamwork, and effective communication skills.

learning_goals.title: Explore elements of music with voice and/or percussion instruments

title: Exploring the Garden
description:
With slow, deliberate steps, Odelia walked around the garden, her head turning from side to side as she observed her surroundings. As she moved past the plants, she reached out her hands to touch them, feeling their textures. While wandering with her peers, Odelia’s attention was captured by a small flower with pink petals. She paused, carefully examining the flower before touching its delicate petals with her fingers. Her gaze remained focused, with interest and curiosity evident on her face.

After spending a moment captivated by the flower, Odelia resumed her exploration, walking toward other plants. Noticing her peers ahead, she quickened her steps to join them. Standing beside her peers, Odelia observed as they explored the plants and flowers. After a brief moment of watching, she joined in, engaging in shared exploration by touching and smelling the plants and flowers alongside her peers.

This observation highlights Odelia’s natural curiosity and her willingness to explore the world around her. Odelia’s exploration of the garden demonstrates her growing interest and curiosity in the natural environment. Her deliberate movements and focused observation, such as pausing to examine the flower with pink petals, show her ability to notice details in her surroundings. Touching the plants and flowers reflects her sensory engagement, as she uses her hands to explore and understand the natural textures around her.

title: Kayden’s Playtime Conversations
description:
Kayden walked over to the dramatic space and joined his teacher and a few friends who were engaged in pretend play. Sitting down beside his teacher, Kayden observed his teacher as she pretended to pour apple juice into the cups of his peers. Curiously, Kayden leaned forward and picked up two cups, one in each hand. He directed his attention to his teacher, offering her one of the cups, and said, “Drink.”

His teacher smiled and responded, “Would you like to have some apple juice as well?” Kayden nodded and said “juice” clearly. The teacher then pretended to pour apple juice into Kayden’s cup. Kayden watched intently, then raised the cup in his right hand and pretended to take a sip, mimicking the actions of his peers.

“Do you like the apple juice?” his teacher asked. Kayden nodded enthusiastically and replied, “Yes.”

Kayden then looked down at the cups in his hands and began pretending to pour water, continuing to engage in the role play with his teacher and friends. He explored the different materials in the dramatic space, repeating the action of pouring and offering drinks.

In this interaction, Kayden demonstrated his growing ability to engage in pretend play and foster social connections. His interactions with his teacher were especially notable in terms of relationship-building and communication. By offering his cup to his teacher and engaging in the reciprocal exchange of dialogue, Kayden displayed trust and a desire for connection. His teacher’s responsive and supportive engagement further strengthened their attachment, as she not only acknowledged Kayden’s actions but also guided him through the play scenario, helping him expand his language skills and understanding of social interaction.

learning_goals.title: Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。

title: Navigating The Obstacle
description:
Kayden stood in front of the stepping stones and carefully placed one foot on the first stone. He took his time, maintaining his balance with focus and precision as he stepped from one stone to the next. Each step was deliberate, and he seemed intent on ensuring that each foot landed on the stepping stones as he navigated the path.

After completing the stepping stones, Kayden approached the next obstacle, a pole set between two cones. He paused for a moment, evaluating the challenge ahead. Initially, he attempted to lift one foot but lost his balance. Undeterred, he moved closer to the red cone for support. He reached out with one hand and placed it on the cone to steady himself. Kayden then bent his left knee and lifted his foot carefully over the pole. Once one foot was safely across, he shifted his weight, bent his right knee, and successfully lifted it over as well.

Kayden moved quickly to the next set of cones, using the same strategy for balance. This time, he placed his right hand on the purple cone and bent his knee to lift his foot over the pole, repeating the action with his other leg. As he grew more confident, he increased his pace, successfully crossing each obstacle with more fluidity and speed.

Through this activity, Kayden demonstrated key gross motor skills essential for his age, including balance, coordination, and strength. His ability to assess and navigate obstacles with increasing confidence highlights his developing physical skills. By carefully lifting his legs, shifting his weight, and utilizing support for balance, Kayden is strengthening his muscles and enhancing his gross motor abilities.

title: Water and Pipette Transfer
description:
Kayden sat on the floor, considering the different choices in front of him for a moment before selecting the blue dropper. With his right hand, he carefully picked up the dropper and leaned closer to the container in front of him. He seemed to focus intently as he used his fingers to press the dropper, watching the blue liquid drip slowly into the container. His eyes followed the liquid, clearly intrigued as the blue liquid mixed with the other colours already present. He continued to observe attentively, his gaze moving around as the blue liquid swirled and slowly blended with the others.

Fascinated by the changing colours, Kayden returned the blue dropper to its spot before reaching for the next dropper filled with red liquid. He repeated the same careful motions, gently shaking the dropper and pressing it over the container. As the red liquid joined the mix, Kayden’s eyes widened in wonder. He dipped the dropper back into the container and attempted to stir the liquids, watching with curiosity as the colours continued to mix and change.

Kayden’s exploration of the water and pipette transfer activity revealed his developing curiosity and attentiveness to the natural environment. His focused observation of the liquids mixing demonstrated a budding interest in cause-and-effect relationships and a deepening awareness of colour change. Through this hands-on activity, Kayden engaged in purposeful exploration, strengthening his cognitive skills and fostering an early appreciation for the world around him.

title: Time For Music
description:
Arissa sat down on the carpet, holding a yellow shaker in each hand, ready to engage in the music and movement activity. As the music began to play, she paused to listen attentively, watching her teacher with interest. Her teacher demonstrated the actions by gently moving the shakers along to the rhythm of the song "Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes."

Arissa observed closely, and after a short moment, she began to imitate her teacher, moving the shakers gently along to the music. 
At first, she followed the slower tempo of the song, moving the shakers softly in the air. As the song progressed, Arissa used the shakers to tap different parts of her body, such as her head, shoulders, and knees, in sync with the lyrics. She smiled as she tapped her head and shoulders, appearing to delight in the connection between the music and her movements.

When her teacher increased the tempo of the song, Arissa’s eyes widened in excitement. She giggled and began to increase the speed of her shaker movements, matching the quicker pace of the music. She tapped the shakers faster, moving her body with greater energy. Her facial expression reflected a sense of enjoyment and enthusiasm, and she looked to her teacher with a joyful smile.

Arissa displayed a strong interest in music and movement throughout the activity. Her attentiveness to the music, her imitation of her teacher’s actions, and her ability to adjust her movements based on the tempo all demonstrate an increasing awareness of rhythm and musical patterns. By using the shakers to tap various parts of her body, Arissa engaged in purposeful movement, connecting her physical actions to the music and lyrics.

title: Fingerprint Exploration
description: As part of their exploration of body parts and the five senses, the children engaged in an art and craft activity where they used ink pads to create fingerprints on paper. They experimented with different tools, such as their hands and fingers, to draw and print.
interpretation:
Shuo-Yun, although initially hesitant about getting his hands dirty, decided to try a bit of the fingerprint activity. He carefully pressed his finger onto the ink pad, but was cautious about the mess. Despite his reluctance, he was curious and intrigued by the process. His teacher encouraged him, explaining how the ink would wash off, which made Shuo-Yun more comfortable. With some guidance, he pressed his finger onto the paper, watching closely as the imprint appeared. He was fascinated by the shape and texture of the fingerprint, observing the lines formed by his finger. Shuo-Yun began to experiment with different ways of pressing his fingers onto the paper, trying to create unique patterns. After some time, he said, "Don't want".



Although he didn't fully embrace getting his hands covered in ink, he still enjoyed the creative process and was pleased with the prints he made. This activity allowed him to explore the process of printing and painting while experimenting with tools like his fingers and the ink pad, fostering his creativity and fine motor skills.

title: 《这是谁呢》
description: 上午活动时间，老师将幼儿和朋友的照片藏在故事书里请幼儿翻阅，辨认出自己的照片和朋友的照片，并充当“送货员”将照片递给朋友。雨芯翻开桌上的书本，她翻到照片后伸出右手指着自己的照片：“Kayla.”老师：“雨芯在哪里？雨芯看见自己的照片了吗？”雨芯用右手拍拍自己的照片，老师：“老师看见了，雨芯找到自己的照片了。好厉害！雨芯再翻翻看呀！”雨芯继续翻阅直到翻到朋友的照片，雨芯停下来指着照片：“Emma here。”老师：“雨芯这是Emma的照片呀？”雨芯看着照片抬头看着老师点点头，老师：“那Emma在哪里呀？你去把她的照片给她好吗？”雨芯笑着拿着照片在教室里寻找朋友，她来到餐桌前，伸出右手将手里的照片递给站在一旁的朋友，雨芯：“Look Emma here。”朋友双手接过照片，雨芯笑着跑开了。
interpretation: 雨芯能够在活动中指认出自己的照片并且能够说出自己的英文名字，展现她的自我意识同时她也能指认照片中的朋友并且能够说出朋友的名字，将照片递给正确的朋友，展现她对于朋友的认识。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of others (identifying others to their names) 培养对他人的认识，如：指认同伴等。

title: 我和朋友一起玩
description: 在华文拾趣中，Farisya根据主题 “我最常和谁一起玩”进行创作，并通过绘画的方式呈现。Farisya 在画面中画出了两个手牵手的人物，穿着彩虹色的服饰，地上有一个小娃娃，头上有像花一样的线条。当老师请她说一说自己的作品时，她指着左边说：“我”，再指右边说：“Kaycia”。接着，她指着右下角较小的人物说：“我和 Kaycia play doll（洋娃娃）。” 当老师问她是否还想分享更多时，她指着头上的像花一样的线条说：“firework（烟花）。”
interpretation: Farisya 能够运用丰富的颜色进行创作，并尝试使用不同的线条和形状来构图。在过程中，她主要用英文描述自己的作品，但遇到会的词语时，会尽量用华文表达，并愿意与他人分享自己的想法和创意。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：乐意用华语与人交谈。
通过艺术作品表达自己的经历和感受，如：个人活动、实地考察、旅游。

title: 沙包丢字卡游戏
description:
在沙包丢字卡游戏中，幼儿需要了解数字可以用于表示顺序，如第一、第二、第三等。幼儿能够自我决定第一要打中哪个字卡，第二、第三以此类推进行游戏。
  于扬拿着沙包开始游戏，她大声地说：“我第一次要丢“山上”这个词。”她举起沙包用力的丢在山上字卡，她举起第二个沙包说：“这是我的第二次机会，我要丢“追”。”她准确地打到该字卡，接着拿起第三个沙包她说：“第三次我要丢“花园里有朵小花”。”她完成游戏后回到座位上看朋友游戏，她会给与朋友鼓励，与同伴交流分享经验，如“你丢的很准；你在往左边一点就会打到了。”
interpretation: 于扬在游戏中能够自然运用数字表示顺序，她已掌握数字在表示顺序方面的用途。她能够正确使用“第一、第二、第三”来描述回合顺序。她也能够理解游戏规则，并能用完整的句子表达自己的理解并在交流中使用完整句子。

learning_goals.title: 背数1-30或30以上。
一次计算一个物品，准确地累计到20个或以上。
对于一组20个或以上的物品，知道无论计算的起点如何，数量都是相同的。
配对20或以上：数量与名称。
配对20或以上：数量与计算数字。
配对20或以上：数量与大写数字，1个苹果对应“一”。
配对20或以上：大写数字与阿拉伯数字。
以每次加2的方式准确地计算到20或以上。
合并两组物品并指出总的数量（10或以上）。
比较2组物品并指出一组比另一组多/少多少。
当从一组中取走一些物品时，知道剩下的数量。
解决数字故事中出现的简单数字问题。
明白数字可以用于表示顺序，如：第一、第二、第三。

title: Textured Trail Map
description:
In this Math activity, the children were provided with a variety of textured materials such as sandpaper, fabric, foil, and paper. The children were tasked, in groups, with arranging these materials in order from the roughest to the smoothest.

Along with his peers, Kleyzen began picking out an item. Everyone in the group picked up an item, and they started discussing which one was the roughest. Kleyzen shared, "Can I touch your paper? I think mine feels rough, but yours looks like it will be rougher than mine."

Following this, the children began comparing the texture of their items by touch. A friend suggested that her item was rougher. Kleyzen agreed, saying, "Yes! Mine feels rough, but yours is rougher. We’ll put yours first, then mine, okay?" The group continued communicating with each other as they laid down their items, from the roughest to the smoothest.
interpretation:
Kleyzen’s participation in this activity demonstrates his developing ability to compare and classify objects based on their textures. By engaging in thoughtful discussions with his peers, he showed a clear understanding of the concept of texture, using touch to evaluate and compare the roughness of different materials. 


Kleyzen's ability to recognise that one item might be rougher than another reflects his critical thinking skills, as he carefully considered the textures before making a decision. His communication with his group, particularly in suggesting the order of the items from roughest to smoothest, highlights his collaboration skills and understanding of classification. 


Through this activity, Kleyzen has successfully fostered his skills in comparing, ordering, and classifying objects based on their textures.

learning_goals.title: Compare groups of objects and communicate the difference based on two or more attributes.

title: 《这是谁》
description: 上午活动时间，老师将幼儿和朋友的照片藏在故事书里请幼儿翻阅，辨认出自己的照片和朋友的照片，并充当“送货员”将照片递给朋友。悦宁翻开桌上的书本，她翻到照片后伸出双手拿起自己的照片：“Emma Emma！”老师：“Emma 悦宁在哪里？悦宁看见自己的照片了吗？”悦宁双手高举起用自己的照片，笑着看着老师！老师：“好厉害，悦宁找到自己的照片了。你再翻翻看呀！”悦宁继续翻阅直到翻到朋友的照片，悦宁停下来指着照片：“Nadine 。”老师：“悦宁这是Nadine的照片呀？”悦宁看着照片抬头看着老师点点头，老师：“那Nadine在哪里呀？你去把她的照片递给她好吗？”悦宁笑着拿着照片在教室里寻找朋友，她来到玩具柜子前，伸出右手将手里的照片递给站在一旁的朋友，悦宁：“Nadine Nadine。”朋友双手接过照片，悦宁笑着跑开了。
interpretation: 悦宁能够在活动中指认出自己的照片并且能够说出自己的英文名字，展现她的自我意识同时她也能指认照片中的朋友并且能够说出朋友的名字，将照片递给正确的朋友，展现她对于朋友的认识。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of others (identifying others to their names) 培养对他人的认识，如：指认同伴等。

title: 认识我的身体
description:
老师邀请幼儿们参与认识我的身体活动。老师带领幼儿们唱歌问好，并一起跟随音乐找一找身体的位置。老师提供做好的身体部位拼图,示范如何进行拼图游戏。鼓励他们找寻相同的图片粘贴在一起。
老师和他们一起唱歌:“小手拍拍，小手拍拍，手指伸出来。鼻子在哪里用手指出来。”Vikranth 能够跟随老师微笑着拍手，指着自己的鼻子看向老师。老师表扬他：“很棒！”老师出示拼图请他们分组游戏。Vikranth 拿出了带有小脚的照片。老师询问他：“你的脚在哪里？你可以告诉老师吗？”他抬起自己的小脚，看向老师。老师表扬他：“真厉害！知道自己的脚在哪。那你可以找一找和它一样的图片吗？”Vikranth 低头观察图片，在找到一样的图片时，他微笑的拍拍老师示意老师看他。老师表扬他：“做的好！”正确的找到另一只小脚丫。他微笑着低头，继续玩起拼图游戏。
interpretation: Vikranth可以积极的参与认识我的身体活动。他可以尝试使用声音和动作，表达自己的想法。他可以听懂老师的话语，积极和老师进行互动。

learning_goals.title: Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。

title: Textured Trail Map
description:
In this Math activity, the children were provided with a variety of textured materials such as sandpaper, fabric, foil, and paper. The children were tasked, in groups, with arranging these materials in order from the roughest to the smoothest.

Arielle and her peers were asked to pick up an item and sort them after the initial group had placed their items. They were given the opportunity to move an item down if they felt it was not as rough. A friend suggested that the group touch each other’s items to determine if they were smooth or rough. Arielle was observed offering her white paper to compare it with another peer’s. "Bowen, let me touch your paper and you can feel mine... ours feel the same, right?"

The group continued communicating with each other as they laid down their items, from the roughest to the smoothest. They were given an added challenge to compare their item with the items that had already been laid out by another group. Arielle was observed feeling the items from the beginning to the end of the line. As she continued, she was seen comparing the item against her own by touch. Midway through, Arielle paused and remarked, "Bowen, come here. This one feels smooth. I think we can put our foam paper here." Arielle continued to reason, "Ours is the same... it’s just a different colour."
interpretation:
Arielle demonstrated strong critical thinking and classification skills during this activity as she worked with her peers to compare and arrange materials by texture. By engaging in thoughtful discussions and hands-on comparisons, Arielle effectively used touch to assess the roughness and smoothness of the materials. Her approach to collaborating with her peers, such as offering her white paper for comparison, shows her ability to communicate and reason through the task. 


When Arielle paused to reflect and suggested where to place the foam paper, she displayed a clear understanding of the ordering process based on texture. Her ability to compare items with others, as well as with the items already placed, highlights her growing skills in classification. 


Through this activity, Arielle actively developed her ability to think critically and classify objects according to their textures.

learning_goals.title: Create complex patterns (e.g: ABB)

title: Playing with my friends
description:
The children were exploring with loose parts (as shown in the photo), expressing their ideas freely. Initially, Xinyang arranged the cones in a line and shared that they were mountains. 

Later, she overheard her friends discussing beehives, which piqued her curiosity. She observed how they used dome-shaped loose parts to represent the beehive and shared that bees live there. Together, they began to line up the dome-shaped pieces to create a house for the beehive. 

To further encourage their play, Teacher Debra provided a small bee toy. Xinyang pretended to feed the bee honey and ice cream, using other loose parts to represent her idea.“Did you know that bees look for nectar from flowers?” Teacher Debra asked. Xinyang nodded, attentively watching as the teacher created a flower pattern with the loose parts. Once completed, Xinyang imagined flying with the nectar to the flowers and sucking it up.

Meanwhile, her friend decided to imagine himself as Spider-Man. He spread his arms and began jumping around. Xinyang also joined her friend and used her fingers to mimic Spider-Man, pretending to shoot webs.
interpretation:
This observation demonstrated Xinyang's ability to express ideas as she declared the cones to be mountains. This showed her capacity to use language to communicate her thoughts and engage with her friends.


Xinyang's interaction with her friends illustrated her ability to engage in collaborative play. She also engages them through dialogue and holds conversation well, demonstrating her ability to communicate effectively and understand different perspectives.

learning_goals.title: Gain meaning by listening.
Speak clearly enough to be understood without contextual clues.

title: Sorting the Duplo
description:
Xin Yang sat on the classroom carpet, attentively picking up and sorting colored toys with focus and precision. She carefully reached into the basket, selecting each item and placing it into the appropriate hoop with a keen eye for color matching. Her movements were deliberate as she engaged with the materials, demonstrating an emerging understanding of categorization. Despite the presence of her peers observing nearby, Xin Yang remained concentrated, steadily working through the task with confidence.

Throughout the activity, Xin Yang occasionally glanced at her classmates, subtly acknowledging their presence while continuing to sort. When she picked up a yellow fidget toy, she thoughtfully placed it inside the correct hoop, showing her ability to apply logic to the task. Her willingness to engage with the materials and stay focused highlighted her developing independence and problem-solving skills in the learning environment.

Xin Yang exhibited patience and attentiveness while participating in the activity. She acknowledged her peers and worked within the group dynamic, showing an emerging understanding of cooperative play. Her quiet focus and engagement with the task reflected her growing confidence in the classroom, as she adjusted to working alongside others while maintaining concentration to her task.
interpretation: Xin Yang shows her ability to sort and consolidate the different coloured items into its respective colours. She also displays her willingness to collaborate and maintain positive peer relationships within the classroom setting reflects her developing social awareness.

title: Exploring the train in Tiong Bahru Park
description:
During our trip to Tiong Bahru Park, Morgan eagerly approached the playground structure, his eyes lighting up with curiosity as he noticed the bright red and blue handles above him. He reached for the red handle first, testing its movement by swinging it slightly. “Why does this one move more than the blue one?” he asked the teacher, curiously. The teacher explained that the different handles might be due to how they were fixed or used over time.

Morgan paused for a moment, observing how the ropes below him swayed slightly as he shifted his weight. He stomped gently on the rope bridge, saying, “It's moving so fast. Whee” The teacher encouraged him to explore further and find his balance. Morgan bent down briefly to touch the rope, rubbing the material between his fingers and remarking, “It can hold me! It is strong”As he reached for the blue handle, Morgan looked up and asked, “Where does this go? Can we climb higher?” His questions reflected his keen interest in understanding his environment and how the playground was constructed. The teacher smiled and responded, “These handles are for swinging across, like a little challenge. Do you want to try?” Morgan nodded enthusiastically and began swinging, all the while observing how his body moved with the structure.

Morgan demonstrates curiosity, confidence, and problem-solving skills as he explores the playground structure. He shows self-awareness by testing the handles and rope bridge, adjusting to their movement, and expressing excitement. His social awareness is evident in his attempts to interact with the teacher, asking thoughtful questions to understand his environment. Through his curiosity, persistence, and engagement, Morgan showcases growing emotional intelligence and social development.
interpretation: From this observation, Morgan displayed his curiosity as he wondered and observed his environment. As he explored the red and blue handles, he asked different questions to show his budding observations and question techniques. With more guidance from the teachers around him, Morgan will continue to make curious observations to gather data in order to make connections with his surroundings.

learning_goals.title: Observe and talk about living things, non-living things, places and events.
Encourage children to look out for interesting things and the changes occuring in their immediate environment.

title: 作品说明 制作花束
description: 教师提供蛋盒、颜料、蓬蓬球和彩色纸等材料给恺励，鼓励恺励自己选择颜料颜色，然后彩绘装鸡蛋的盒子，待晾干后，在教师的引导协助下将蛋壳花朵，黏贴在彩色纸上，制作成花束。
interpretation: 通过制作花束的美术活动，培养恺励对艺术的兴趣，从而实现婴幼儿是自信、好奇和投入的学习者[持续的参与、注意力、解决问题和语言能力]的学习成果。

title: Colourful Table
description:
XinYang exhibits a keen interest in artistic expression, demonstrating confidence and engagement in her painting activity. She carefully holds her brush, applying strokes with precision and intentionality as she creates lines on her book. Her choice of colours and the way she experiments with different strokes suggest an emerging awareness of artistic elements and a willingness to explore creative techniques. XinYang's focus on detail where she drew a table indicating detailed desire to refine her drawing of the favourite activity of the week. Her ability to translate her thoughts into visual representation showcases her growing artistic skills and her enjoyment in the creative process. "Look! It is the table outside," exclaimed Xinyang as she completed her drawing.

Furthermore, XinYang shows strong fine motor control in handling the brush, adjusting her grip to achieve the desired effects on the page. She washed, dried and cleaned the brush between colours, demonstrating an understanding of how to use watercolours. Her engagement in the activity reflects a sense of independence and confidence in her artistic abilities, reinforcing her capacity to express herself through art.

XinYang displays a focused and determined attitude while engaging in her drawing. She is deeply immersed in her painting, showing a strong sense of concentration and perseverance. Despite being surrounded by peers, she maintains her individual artistic vision, working at her own pace to bring her ideas to life.
interpretation: From this observation, Xinyang displays her curiousity as she experiment with different media to create her drawing. She used shaped and colours to represent her view of her world, like tables and chairs. Her engagement in these tasks highlights her enthusiasm for creative exploration and her ability to execute artistic ideas with intentionality.

title: Textured Trail Map
description:
In this Math activity, the children were provided with a variety of textured materials such as sandpaper, fabric, foil, and paper. The children were tasked, in groups, with arranging these materials in order from the roughest to the smoothest.

Bowen and his peers were asked to pick up an item and sort them after the initial group had placed their items. They were given the opportunity to move an item down if they felt it was not as rough. A friend suggested that the group touch each other’s items to determine if they were smooth or rough. Bowen was observed exchanging his item with another peer’s to compare its texture. Bowen shared, "I think mine is a little bit smooth. Yours is almost smooth, but I can feel something rough over here."

The group continued communicating with each other as they laid down their items, from the roughest to the smoothest. They were given an added challenge to compare their item with the items that had already been laid out by another group. Bowen was observed feeling the items from the beginning to the end of the line. As he continued, he was seen comparing the item against his own by touch. Bowen and his peer decided to place their items next to each other after discovering that they had the same texture.
interpretation:
Bowen demonstrated strong critical thinking and classification skills during this activity as he worked with his peers to compare and arrange materials by texture. By using touch to assess whether an item was rough or smooth, Bowen showed an ability to evaluate the textures of different materials. 


His active participation in the group discussions allowed him to communicate his observations effectively, such as when he compared his item with a peer’s and noted the subtle differences in texture. Bowen’s decision to place his item next to his peer’s item after discovering they had the same texture shows his growing understanding of classification. 


His ability to engage in this hands-on comparison, while considering the items that had already been placed, highlights his developing skills in problem-solving and ordering based on texture. Through this activity, Bowen successfully fostered his mathematical thinking by comparing, sorting, and classifying objects according to their textures.

description:
幼儿正在参与“好奇乐”领域的“观察牙齿模型”的教学活动。教师引导幼儿观察模型，仔细研究牙齿的形状和排列。
宥谌在老师的引导下，他对牙模具表现出浓厚的兴趣，他专注地观察模型，他用手轻轻触摸牙模，认真感受牙齿的质感，并好奇地询问：“这是牙齿，为什么这么大？”当拿起牙刷练习刷牙时，宥谌模仿生活中的刷牙动作，小心翼翼地在牙齿表面刷动，并边刷边说：“要刷干净，没有蛀牙！”他还尝试按照老师的示范，从上到下、从里到外刷牙，并在刷完后大声地说道：“牙齿变干净了！”
interpretation: 宥谌在整个活动过程中，他不仅认真操作，还能用语言表达自己的观察和理解，展现了对牙齿健康的认知。他的好奇心和专注力让这次体验更加生动有趣，也进一步加强了他对刷牙重要性的理解。

title: 观察牙齿
description:
幼儿在参与“好奇乐”领域的《观察牙齿》的教学活动中，教师为幼儿准备“大镜子”和牙模。请幼儿认识了解自己的牙齿，使用镜子来为自己的检查牙齿，看是否有蛀牙。
楷钧坐在桌前，专注地盯着牙齿模型，眼里充满了好奇。他伸出小手，轻轻地指着牙模的上排牙齿，问道：“老师，这是上面的牙齿吗？”老师微笑着点头：“对的，这叫上牙，它们长在我们的上颚。”楷钧又把手指移到下排牙齿，皱着眉头想了想，然后说道：“这是下面的牙齿，对不对？”老师鼓励地点点头：“没错！这些是下牙，它们长在我们的下颚。”楷钧认真地看着牙模，又对着镜子，张开嘴巴，观看自己的牙齿，嘴里念念有词：“这是上牙，这是下牙。”突然，他抬起头，好奇地问：“是一样的吗？”老师拿起牙模，慢慢地打开合上，解释道：“它们是一样的，上牙和下牙是好朋友，我们要好好刷牙，保护牙齿。“他点点头，然后，他用小手指着自己的嘴巴说道：“老师，我有刷牙！”
interpretation: 通过观察和提问，楷钧不仅能准确指认上下牙齿的位置，还能用自己的语言描述牙齿的关系，展现了他对新知识的理解和表达能力。通过观察镜子中的自己，对牙齿有了更深的认识,展现他对牙齿奥秘的好奇心和兴趣，能利用感官和简单的工具“大镜子”进行探索。
