title: Bounce and Catch
description: The teacher began with a demonstration on how to gently push the ball downward to make it bounce and then catch it with both hands. Once the children understood the concept, they practiced bouncing the ball and catching it after each bounce before being challenged to bounce the ball a certain number of times in a row and catch it on the final bounce. Keeping her right palm open, Shanice pushed the ball down with her right hand, Shanice bounced the ball on the ground once and caught the ball with both her hands. The teacher challenged her to bounce the ball 3 times. Pushing the ball down with her right hand again, she bounced the ball on the ground. She bent her knees slightly and moved her body slightly forward. Bouncing on her knees, she bounced the ball by pushing her right hand on the ball every time the ball bounced back. "Teacher Lilian, I can do 12!"
interpretation: Shanice demonstrated her ability to coordinate movement while performing the task by effectively using hand-eye coordination and body awareness. As she pushed the ball with her right hand and caught it after each bounce, she showed precise control over the ball’s trajectory. When the challenge increased to 12 bounces, Shanice adjusted her posture, bending her knees and leaning slightly forward to maintain balance and keep the ball within reach. She was able to manage the task by repeating her movements with consistency. Her ability to regulate the force of her hand to control the bounce also reflected her fine motor skills, which are essential for performing such a task with precision. Through these actions, Shanice successfully demonstrated her coordination and skill development.

learning_goals.title: Coordinate movements to perform tasks.

title: 打保龄球
description:
教师准备6个球瓶和一个球，教师示范如何将球推出去撞倒球瓶，并邀请幼儿们一起来参与。
祺欣在旁边看着其他同伴在玩，老师邀请并将球递给祺欣说：“祺欣我们一起来打保龄球吧！”祺欣微笑的看着老师说：“球”。老师回应道：“对的，打保龄球。”祺欣拿到球后就坐在了地上，接着祺欣用左手握住球，再用左手将球推出去击倒球瓶。老师回应道：“祺欣你真棒，但是还有几个球瓶没有倒，你可以再试一试。”祺欣听到后，她站起来走到球的面前用双手握住球的方式将球捡起来，接着祺欣坐回原位，再用双手将球推出去击倒球瓶。
interpretation: 祺欣在击倒球瓶的活动中能够持续的参与活动，并且表现出快乐、积极的情绪；祺欣能够使用坐、握和用手推球等动作展示了祺欣粗大动作和精细动作的发展。祺欣也可以说出简单的字“球”。

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, bend, kick, throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作，如：走、跑、双脚跳、弯腰、踢、丢球等。

Foster language through encouraging listening skills (what sounds can you hear outside, listening for sounds of birds when playing outdoors, listening when talking with a friend, listening when sitting as part of a small group) 鼓励聆听，辨认外面的声音、小鸟的叫声，与同伴交谈时注意聆听等，培养幼儿聆听和理解能力。

title: Numicon Animal Parade
description: The teacher prepared toy animals and Numicon pieces for the children. First, they grouped the animals based on shared features and then matched the Numicon shapes to the groups. Afterward, the children used cotton buds to paint backgrounds for their animal groups. Jun Yu’s group decided to paint the sea. He began by dipping a cotton bud in purple paint and drawing a line on the paper, then circled the cotton bud back to meet the line from the starting point to create a shape. Using an up-and-down motion, he added purple details inside the shape. When asked, he explained that it was a "fish." Next, Jun Yu took a cotton bud dipped in red paint and drew lines outward from a single focal point. He then circled the cotton bud on the focal point to create a circle and mentioned that it was a "sun."

description: The teacher prepared toy animals and Numicon pieces for the children. First, they grouped the animals based on shared features and then matched the Numicon shapes to the groups. She began by using the cotton bud to draw a red circle, sliding it back and forth to fill the circle with color, demonstrating her exploration of controlled, consistent movements to form shapes. Finally, Shanice experimented with dotting by tapping the green cotton bud on the paper multiple times to create small, distinct dots, revealing her curiosity about texture and how repeated marks could build up a pattern. Through these varied techniques—sliding, circling, and dotting—Shanice was actively experimenting with how different approaches to using the cotton bud could impact her painting’s texture, shape, and overall appearance.

title: 五官在哪里？
description:
教师唱“眼睛在哪里，眼睛在哪里”，接着教师示范并用手指出来说”在这里，在这里。”教师可以唱小朋友的名字，例如“xx小朋友，鼻子在哪里？”可以邀请小朋友用手指出来，也可以小朋友们尝试说“在这里。
祺欣坐在同伴的身边，老师询问道：“祺欣眼睛在哪里？”祺欣用手指了指自己的眼睛。老师回应道：“对的祺欣，你找到了自己的眼睛。”祺欣复述道：“眼睛。”接着老师又询问道：“祺欣的耳朵在哪里？”祺欣用手指了指自己的耳朵说：“here。”老师回应道：“没错祺欣，这是你的耳朵，你可以说在这里。”祺欣复述道：“在这里。”老师接着询问：“祺欣的嘴巴在哪里呀？”祺欣用手指了指自己的嘴巴说：“嘴巴。”老师回应道：“祺欣真棒，可以说出嘴巴。”老师又接着询问剩下的五官在哪里，祺欣都可以一一找到。
interpretation: 祺欣在五官在哪里的活动中能够持续的参与活动，祺欣也能够跟着老师的指令去寻找自己脸上的五官，并指出正确的位置，也可以复述老师的语言还可以自己说出“嘴巴”。

title: Colour Mixing “Family Unity” Experiment
description: The children recalled last week’s experiment by reviewing their pictures. The teacher focused on the colors that represented each family member and facilitated a discussion about the symbol of family unity. River shared “When all the family come together, it make new colour.”  The teacher then encouraged the children to draw a simple drawing of what they saw during the experiment and write a sentence. River drew a triangle before adding a big rectangle on top of it. Then she added 3 small rectangles in the big rectangle and added 2 circles connected with a line on top of each small rectangle. With the teacher’s help, she wrote the sentence “When different family members come together, it makes a new colour.”
interpretation: This experience revealed River's ability to make recordings of her observations through both drawing and writing in a thoughtful and structured way. Her drawing appeared to represent her interpretation of the experiment. When asked, she identified the triangle as “the table”, the big rectangle as “the newspaper”, the 3 small rectangles as the “cups” and the circles and line as “the dropper”. Additionally, River's sentence, “When different family members come together, it makes a new colour,” was a clear and accurate reflection of the concept discussed in the experiment. The sentence was a simple yet meaningful recording of her observation, and it demonstrated her ability to relate her visual representation to the broader concept of family unity and color blending.

learning_goals.title: Make simple recordings of observations through drawing or writing.

title: Balance Beam Dance
description: In this balancing activity, teachers set up three narrow balance beams for the children to walk on. Each beam was designated for a specific action that the children had to perform as they balanced. Standing with both feet on the balancing beam, Audrey stepped forward with her right foot before bringing her feet together. She then bent her knees slightly and swiftly picked up the beanbag left on the beam. Audrey moved to the next balancing beam by stepping with her right foot and followed with a step from her left foot. She wobbled slightly and let out a small scream but quickly regained her balance by bringing her feet together, pausing for a short moment, and lifting her arms to help steady herself. As she continued tiptoeing along the beam, she wobbled again but never lost her balance, using her arms to help maintain control and keep her steady. When she faced the higher balancing beam, Audrey carefully lifted her left foot to rest on the beam. She only moved her right foot up when she felt stable with her left foot. Audrey took two big steps forward and quickly cleared the distance, then jumped off at the end of the beam.
interpretation: This experience demonstrated Audrey's ability to move with balance and control in several key ways. From the start, Audrey showed awareness of her body as she stepped onto the balancing beam, placing her feet together and bending her knees slightly to pick up the beanbag. This controlled movement showcased her ability to maintain stability while performing a task. As she moved to the next beam, Audrey demonstrated resilience and balance control. Although she wobbled, her quick response showed her ability to recover from instability and use her body to regain control. Audrey’s ability to tiptoe along the beam while maintaining balance further illustrated her control. Despite wobbling again, she never lost her balance and used her arms to maintain stability.

learning_goals.title: Move with balance and control.

title: Balance Beam Dance
description: In this balancing activity, teachers set up three narrow balance beams for the children to walk on. Each beam was designated for a specific action that the children had to perform as they balanced. Carl initially expressed doubt, saying, "See, I cannot," as he walked up to the first beam. However, with encouragement from the teacher, Carl stepped onto the beam, took three steps, then put his feet together and squatted down to pick up a beanbag. He lifted his left foot and moved it to the next beam, pausing for a moment to find his balance. Once steady, he lifted his right foot and tiptoed along the beam. He stumbled back and forth but always managed to center himself on the beam without falling off. When facing the higher balancing beam, Carl lifted his left foot to rest it on the beam. He briefly lost his balance but quickly regained it by crouching low and holding onto the beam. Still holding on, Carl moved his right foot up, stood up, and carefully inched forward with his right foot. Finally, he jumped off the end of the beam.
interpretation: This experience clearly demonstrated Carl's ability to move with balance and control, even when faced with challenges. His ability to take three steps before putting his feet together and squatting down to pick up the beanbag showed that he could maintain control and balance even while engaging in a task that required a slight pause. As Carl moved onto the next beam, he demonstrated awareness of his body, pausing to find his balance before lifting his right foot and tiptoeing along the beam. Despite stumbling back and forth, Carl showed resilience by continually returning to the center of the beam without falling off, indicating a strong sense of balance and control over his movements. When approaching the higher beam, Carl showed good problem-solving skills and body control. He briefly lost his balance but quickly regained it by crouching low and holding onto the beam. This quick reaction demonstrated his ability to adjust his body in response to a loss of balance.

learning_goals.title: Move with balance and control.

title: Balance Beam Dance
description: In this balancing activity, teachers set up three narrow balance beams for the children to walk on. Each beam was designated for a specific action that the children had to perform as they balanced. Nikolai started by stepping up the beam with his left foot, walking one step forward before bringing his feet together. He bent his knees slightly, picked up the beanbag in front of him, and smiled at the teacher when he successfully completed the task. After putting the beanbag down, Nikolai crossed over to the next beam with his right foot and began tiptoeing. As he landed on his left toes, he wobbled slightly but quickly regained his balance by placing his feet together and lifting his arms slightly to steady himself. He tiptoed two steps forward before lifting his left foot up to the next beam. Once standing firmly with his left foot, Nikolai moved his right foot up, took two more steps forward, and then jumped off the beam.
interpretation: This experience highlighted Nikolai’s strong balance and control throughout the activity. When he stepped up onto the beam with his left foot, he immediately showed an understanding of how to position his body, taking a step forward and bringing his feet together for stability. Bending his knees to pick up the beanbag while maintaining his balance demonstrated his coordination and ability to control his movements. As Nikolai moved to the next beam, he carefully tiptoed, landing on his left toes. Although he wobbled briefly, he quickly regained his balance by bringing his feet together and lifting his arms to steady himself. This quick adjustment revealed his ability to stay composed and regain control when faced with slight instability. Nikolai’s ability to tiptoe forward and smoothly transition his left foot to the next beam showed his growing confidence in maintaining balance during more challenging movements. When he stood firmly with his left foot before moving his right foot up, he demonstrated control and thoughtful movement. His successful steps forward and confident jump off the beam further emphasized his control and coordination throughout the activity.

learning_goals.title: Move with balance and control.

title: Balance Beam Dance
description: In this balancing activity, teachers set up three narrow balance beams for the children to walk on. Each beam was designated for a specific action that the children had to perform as they balanced. He stood on the first balancing beam for a short moment before twisting his body to the left, making a spin. During the spin, Jun Yu wobbled slightly but maintained his balance by pushing his body forward just enough to steady himself. He then turned to his left again, performing another spin. Although he wobbled once more, he paused briefly to regain his balance and successfully completed the spin. Jun Yu moved to the next beam, where he skillfully kept his feet together and jumped twice on the beam with precision. When he moved on to the final beam, he positioned his body sideways, using his left foot as a guide. Jun Yu moved sideways with great focus, reaching the end of the beam before walking off.
interpretation: Jun Yu moved with balance and control in several ways throughout this experience. When he first stood on the balance beam, he maintained stability by staying grounded and centered. As he performed his spins, Jun Yu showed control by slightly pushing his body forward during a wobble, which helped him regain his balance without falling. His ability to pause for a moment and find his balance after wobbling demonstrated his self-awareness and ability to adjust his body to stay steady. When jumping on the next beam, Jun Yu kept his feet together, a clear sign of balance and control, ensuring a precise and stable landing. On the final beam, he positioned his body sideways and used his left foot as a guide, which allowed him to move with careful, deliberate steps. His ability to move sideways along the beam and finish without losing his balance highlighted his coordination and gross motor skills, ensuring a controlled, steady movement from start to finish.

learning_goals.title: Move with balance and control.

title: Journal: Favourite Game with Family
description: The journal question posed was: "Think of a favorite game or activity you play with your family. Can you use letters or symbols to show its name and draw how it looks?" Damien took a moment to think before answering, "Er, play ball." Holding his pencil with a tripod grasp, he began drawing a circle, ensuring that the end of the line met the start. At the top, bottom, left, and right sides of the circle, he drew short lines pointing towards each other. Then, with a steady motion of his right wrist, Damien filled the circle with black marks, only a few pencil strokes extending beyond the circle. After finishing his drawing of the "ball," Damien proceeded to add a smiley face and drew a line at the bottom of the face. Below the face, he connected the line with two short lines for arms and another two short lines at the bottom for legs. For the figurine's hair, Damien colored in the forehead area. Following this, the teacher wrote the sentence "We like to play ball." on the whiteboard and asked Damien to copy it into his journal. Glancing at the whiteboard from time to time, Damien quickly copied the words onto the lines provided in his book.
interpretation: This experience demonstrated Damien's use of eye-hand coordination as he successfully completed the task of copying words onto the lines in his journal. As he glanced at the whiteboard from time to time, Damien was able to accurately replicate the sentence by coordinating his hand movements with what he saw. Additionally, his drawings required him to coordinate his hand movements with what he was seeing, maintaining control over his pencil as he created the drawing. His coloring of the hair and ball further showed how he could control his hand to stay within the lines to create a focused, precise drawing.

learning_goals.title: Use eye-hand coordination to perform tasks effectively (e.g. dress independently, build specific block structures, maintain control and coordination within a given work space).

title: Ribbon Width Wonders
description: The children arranged various ribbons from the thinnest to the thickest. Once the ribbons were organized, the children collaborated to create an artwork by gluing the ribbons onto paper and painting over them with a variety of mixed paint shades. When the teacher encouraged the children to mix paints, Ernest eagerly asked, "How to mix paints?" With some guidance, Ernest said "red and pink," then dipped his paintbrush into the red watercolor, dabbing it onto the palette cover. He then swirled his paintbrush into the pink watercolor and mixed the two colors together. When asked what color he had made, Ernest smiled and proudly replied, "pink!" He spread the pink paint on his paper, cheering "pink!" as he worked. Next, Ernest washed his paintbrush and muttered, "White and red." He swirled his brush in the white watercolor, dabbed some onto the palette cover, and then moved to the red watercolor, mixing the two together. "It's pink of course!" he exclaimed before painting more on his paper. As he continued, Ernest looked at his artwork and said, "black and blue makes, still black." He then took some blue paint, talked to a friend, and asked her to guess which color he would use next. His friend guessed "orange," but Ernest replied, "no, red. What blue and red make?" He then mixed the red watercolor into the blue to create purple.
interpretation: This experience showcased Ernest's experimentation with elements to create artworks by exploring how different colors and shades can be mixed to achieve new results. When encouraged to mix paints, Ernest actively engaged with the process, combining red and pink watercolors to create a new shade, which he identified as pink. His excitement and understanding grew as he experimented further, mixing white and red to make more pink and later combining blue and red to create purple. Through this, Ernest demonstrated a hands-on exploration of how colors interact and transform when mixed, showcasing his creativity and growing knowledge of color theory.

learning_goals.title: Experiment with elements to create artworks (e.g: mix paints to get different colours or shades of colours, use shapes and lines to create patterns).

title: Ball
description: Davi was playing at the busy wall at the playground, holding more than one ball. As he explored the wall, his friend picked up a ball that had dropped on the ground and gave it back to him. Davi took the ball and kept playing with the busy wall. When the ball dropped again, his friend returned it to him. This time, Davi giggled as he took the ball and continued exploring. As he and his friend looked at each other, they both laughed together, enjoying their time.
interpretation: This shows Davi's developing social skills, such as  responding to others' actions, and enjoying playful moments with a friend.

title: Puppet
description: Declan was shown a spoon puppet by his teacher. He looked at both the teacher and the puppet. The teacher used the puppet to greet him, and Declan smiled in response. He then reached for the puppet, and his teacher handed it to him, engaging in a conversation. "Hi Declan!" his teacher said. Declan smiled, looked at the puppet, and began to explore it, showing his interest and waved the puppet.
interpretation: Declan's actions demonstrate the development of his social skills. He responded to the teacher’s greeting with a smile, showing an awareness of social interaction.

title: 寻字游戏
description:
陈致恺仔细观察自己面前的游戏纸，老师告诉陈致恺，这个字是“书”你需要找到与“书”字相同的文字，并把透明片放在你找到的文字上。陈致恺指了指游戏纸上的“书”并跟随老师重复说：“书”。

陈致恺开始逐行查找目标文字，当他发现自己找到了第一个“书”字的时候，他拿起一个粉色的透明片放在文字上，接下来，他拿起粉色、黄色和紫色的彩色片放在与之临近的文字上，老师问陈致恺：你再仔细看一看你放的黄色透明片是“书”字吗？陈致恺仔细观察了这个字，对老师说：不是，于是，他把黄色的透明片拿了下来，继续寻找更多的“书”字并摆放透明片。
interpretation:
在本次活动中，陈致恺能够主动参与到活动中，并对活动表现出较强的专注性和耐心。


通过活动观察，陈致恺表现出了较强的耐心和专注力。


在与老师的互动过程中，陈致恺也能够认真聆听老师提出的问题，在老师指导后也能够及时的纠正问题，能够与老师用华文进行分享和交流。


最后，在本次活动中，我们也能够看见陈致恺在社交与情绪方面的发展，他正在建立建立正面的自我认知，培养完成简单任务的自信心。

description: Children reflected on a memorable family trip, whether it was an exciting vacation abroad or a special outing within Singapore. They recalled the sights, activities, and moments that made the experience unforgettable. Through their creativity, the children expressed these cherished memories by creating simple drawings that captured the essence of their adventure. The drawings were a reflection of the joy, excitement, and wonder they felt during the trip, allowing them to relive those moments and share their personal experiences with others in a visual way.

These handmade flowers were then added to this garden, creating a beautiful, collaborative masterpiece.

title: 认识我的身体
description:
老师邀请幼儿们参与认识我的身体活动。在活动中老师请他们认识身体的部位和名称，并尝试粘贴身体部位。当老师出示身体粘贴板时，幼儿们围过来低头观察。老师介绍粘贴板上的部位名称，邀请他们观察认识身体部位名称和位置。
老师询问他：“你看这是小朋友的粘贴板，你都认识那些身体部位？”章易拿起了粘贴板上的小手看了看。老师询问他：“你拿的是什么？”章易低头看了看手里拿的小手,伸出手里的小手给老师看。老师鼓励他说:“小手。”章易尝试说出：“手。”老师竖起大拇指，表扬他：“真厉害！”并请他把手粘贴在纸板上。章易准确的把小手粘贴在纸板上小人的手上。老师和他击掌庆祝，章易微笑伸出小手回应老师。老师询问他：“你可以帮小人粘贴他好他的身体吗？”他低下头拿起头发，尝试粘贴在小人的头上。老师询问他：“这是什么？”他按了按头发，指着老师的头发。老师鼓励他说：“头发，你给小人粘贴了漂亮的头发呀！。”他看着老师点点头，低头又拿起了耳朵，准确的粘贴在小人的耳朵处。老师表扬他：“粘贴的耳朵位置刚刚好，真棒！”章易微笑着又低头寻找另一只耳朵，尝试粘贴起来。
interpretation: 章易可以积极参与认识我的五官活动。他可以听懂老师的话语，尝试使用动作和语言表达自己的想法。同时，他可以准确找到五官图片，进行粘贴匹配。

learning_goals.title: Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。

domains.title: Psycho-social Self 心理-社会行为

title: Button drop
description: The teacher introduced a new learning material to the children. Declan grabbed a button with his left hand and shifted it to his right hand, trying to insert it into a small hole. At first, it didn’t go through. However, Declan then tilted the button and tried again, successfully getting it into the hole. He took another button, again using his left hand to grab it and shifting it to his right hand. This time, he succeeded in inserting the button into the hole. Declan continued to explore with the buttons.
interpretation: Declan's actions demonstrate the development of his fine motor skills, which use of small muscles in his hands and fingers. By carefully grasping the buttons, shifting them from one hand to the other, and trying to insert them into a small hol.

learning_goals.title: Foster fine motor development ( pick up objects using pincer grasp, hold crayon to scribble, fasten/unfasten zippers/buttons, screw, unscrew bottle caps, etc.) 发展精细动作，如：用大拇指、食指及中指（三指）抓物品、拉拉链、扣纽扣、拧瓶盖等。

title: Walking Walking
description: At the playground, Declan was invited by his teacher to walk through the hoops. His teacher helped by holding both of his hands to assist him. At first, Declan hesitated and would take one step before sitting down. His teacher encouraged him to keep walking through the hoops. Slowly, Declan took small steps, and after completing the hoops, they walked around a colored cone, continuing with small steps. After walking through the hoops and around the cone twice, Declan sat down on the floor.
interpretation: Declan's actions show that he is developing his gross motor skills, which involve using large muscles to move his body. While initially hesitant, he showed progress by taking small steps with support from his teacher.

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, bend, kick, throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作，如：走、跑、双脚跳、弯腰、踢、丢球等。

title: Sandplay
description: The children were engaged in a sand play experience. Declan immediately touched the sand, grabbing it with his hand. He then took a small shovel to scoop and explore the sand. His teacher encouraged him to find a rose petal hidden under the sand. Declan continued exploring, using another shovel to scoop more sand. As he played, he kept grabbing the sand with his hands, letting it flow down and observing it closely. Declan continued to enjoy the sensation of the sand flowing through his fingers.
interpretation: Declan's actions show curiosity about nature. His eagerness to touch, scoop, and observe the sand demonstrates his interest in exploring the natural world around him.

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in the beauty of the natural environment 通过户外活动和室内散步，培养欣赏周围环境的美。

domains.title: The Thinking and Communicating Self 思考与沟通

title: Story time
description: Declan was invited to participate in storytelling. As the teacher read the storybook, Declan pointed at the pictures and opened his mouth. His teacher would identify the pictures he pointed to. As the teacher continued reading, Declan flipped the page and pointed at more pictures in the storybook. After the teacher finished reading, Declan took another storybook and explored it on his own.
interpretation: From this observation, it is clear that Declan shows a strong interest in storytelling. He actively listened to his teacher and engaged with the story by pointing at the pictures. By doing so, he also demonstrated an early attempt to identify the pictures.

learning_goals.title: Foster language and expression through songs, stories and rhymes 通过歌曲、故事和儿歌，培养幼儿的理解和用简单的字、词表达的能力。

domains.title: The Thinking and Communicating Self 思考与沟通

title: 绘本印象最深刻的画面
description:
在阅读完《朱家故事》后，亮杰根据主题“绘本中印象最深刻的画面”进行创作，并通过绘画的方式呈现。他在画面中用紫色线条画出一个外框，内部用混乱交错的颜色填充，下方有好几个紫色的圆形，外框下面还有一个正方形。

当老师请亮杰分享自己的作品时，他指着中间交错颜色的部分说：“很乱很多人。”老师问他有谁，他回答：“爸爸、弟弟、哥哥。”老师继续问他们在哪里？亮杰指着紫色的外壳回答：“在家里面”。她继续回答：“妈妈不在家，所以很乱。” 老师又问他是否还想分享更多，他指着下面的方形说：“妈妈在外面。”
interpretation: 亮杰用紫色的外框代表房子，房子的形状较为封闭，说明他理解了房子的边界概念。他通过线条和颜色表达了脏乱的情境。在描述作品时，亮杰能用华语清晰地表达自己的想法，逻辑清晰，并愿意与他人分享自己的创意。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能用完整的较连贯的语言说话。
通过绘画或书写作简单的观测记录：用说、画、写的方式来记录他们观察和调查发现的结果。
实践各种绘画技巧，如：蜡笔画、雕塑、棉签绘画、飞溅绘画等。

title: It's me
description: Declan took the "Peek-a-Boo Friends" learning material from the library space and began exploring it. He had some difficulty opening the lid, so his teacher helped him. When he opened the lid, he saw his own picture and smiled. He then opened another lid to reveal a photo of his teacher. Declan pointed at the picture and looked at his teacher, who identified it. Next, Declan opened the lid with his own picture again, pointed at it, smiled, and looked at his teacher. His teacher acknowledged him by naming the picture, and Declan responded with a big smile.
interpretation: Declan's actions show that he is developing a sense of identity. By recognizing his own picture and smiling, he is beginning to understand and connect with his own image.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self-concept and identity 初步培养自我概念和认同感，如：会说自己很棒。

domains.title: Psycho-social Self 心理-社会行为

title: 大鹅，生日快乐
description:
随着幼儿能力的不断增强，老师设置了难度更大的冒险之旅，并为其增添上情景：大鹅的生日到了，于是，老师邀请幼儿来为大鹅送上生日礼物。幼儿需要跳过“阶梯路”，走过曲折的“小桥”、爬过“山洞”，才能抵达大鹅的家，为大鹅送上生日礼物和生日祝福。在活动进行前，老师先引导幼儿观察场地布置，然后进行示范和讲解不同动作的技巧：双脚跳、双手展开保持平衡的走、爬行。然后邀请幼儿轮流进行尝试。
思睿听到老师提问谁要参加后，看着老师，用手轻拍自己，说：“我！”。思睿被邀请为大鹅送礼物，他站在起点，模仿老师的样子，双腿微蹲，双脚起跳，落地时有一点不稳，他控制身体站稳后看向老师，老师鼓励思睿继续尝试，思睿在老师的鼓励下准备再次起跳。很快，他来到了“小桥”前，他站在“小桥”一端，张开手臂保持平衡向前走，他走到转弯上坡处开始左右摇晃，于是他停了下来，伸手请求老师的帮助。老师鼓励思睿：“前面马上就到了，老师相信你一定可以，我在前面等你，你慢慢走过来。”于是，他再次尝试后顺利走过了独木桥。来到由凳子和呼啦圈组成的山洞后，他快速的爬了过来，并且一边爬一边活动头部躲过头顶的呼啦圈。终于来到了目的地，他选择了一个小礼物给大鹅，并在老师的提醒下对大鹅说：“生日快乐！”给完礼物后，他快速的笑着跑向老师。
interpretation: 在活动的过程中，思睿表现出了积极参与的兴趣和热情，同时他通过跳、爬等动作展现出了不断进步的粗大动作和肢体协调能力；通过走平衡木展现出了不断进步的平衡能力和肢体协调能力。

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, climb on playground equipment, bend, kick，throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作：走、跑、攀爬、弯腰、踢、投掷等。
Develop a sense of balance (walk along a non-linear pathway/line/balance beam with little or no support, jump from a low platform and maintain balance) 发展平衡感，如：锻炼手部、腿部肌肉的力量及协调运动能力。

title: Numicon Width Patterns
description: The children used Numicon pieces to compare and arrange them from the thinnest to the thickest, horizontally. After ordering the pieces, they traced the outlines of the tiles onto paper and added lines and additional shapes to make their artwork personal and creative. After Railynn traced her 3 Numicon pieces on her paper, she picked up a blue marker and drew 3 circles inside the first Numicon shape. She then picked up an orange marker and drew straight lines inside the second Numicon outline. As she drew the orange straight lines, she twisted her hand to follow the shape, creating a smaller orange outline within the second Numicon shape. Railynn then used a red marker to draw another line in the same way, creating a red and even smaller Numicon outline within the second shape. Moving to the third Numicon shape, Railynn drew a rectangle and added pink zig-zag and wavy lines. Afterwards, she returned to the first Numicon shape and coloured the 3 circles with a black marker. She then used green, pink, and red markers to colour portions of the shape, starting with green, followed by pink, and then red, creating a watermelon pattern.
interpretation: Railynn’s artwork clearly demonstrated her ability to experiment with various elements to create a unique and vibrant piece. She explored shapes by tracing and manipulating the Numicon pieces, using circles, straight lines, and wavy lines to interact with and transform the outlines. Her use of multiple colours, including blue, orange, red, pink, and green, highlighted her experimentation with how colours could blend and contrast. For example, in the first Numicon shape, she created a watermelon effect by layering green, pink, and red, while in the second shape, she used orange and red markers to create smaller outlines within the shape. Railynn also experimented with texture by adding zig-zag and wavy lines, which gave her artwork dynamic movement. By mixing shapes, lines, and colours, Railynn was able to create a vibrant, personal piece that showed her creativity and understanding of how different elements can work together to form patterns and textures.

learning_goals.title: Experiment with elements to create artworks (e.g: mix paints to get different colours or shades of colours, use shapes and lines to create patterns).

title: Exploring size with leaves
description:
Children were engaged in an activity that involved creating a sensory bin filled with dried fallen leaves. This hands-on exploration provided an opportunity for the children to compare the sizes of the leaves and make use of basic early numeracy vocabulary, such as "big" and "small." By physically handling the leaves and placing them side by side, the children naturally distinguished between different sizes. This activity encouraged sensory exploration and facilitated the development of their understanding of size concepts through first hand experiences.

Vera examined the different leaves laid in front of her. When the teacher asked, “Can you show me which is the big leaf?” Vera picked up the big leaf and brought it closer to the teacher, and pointed at it to indicate her understanding of its size. The teacher then asked, “Where are the small leaves?” Vera immediately picked up several small leaves and placed them on top of the big leaf, arranging them to compare the sizes. As she did this, she said, “Small,” while pointing at the smaller leaves, and “Big,” as she touched the large leaf. The teacher responded, “Yes, that’s right! Great observation, Vera!"
interpretation: Vera demonstrated her understanding of basic numeracy concepts by identifying and comparing big and small leaves. By using size-related vocabulary like "small" and "big," she showed her ability to recognize size differences. This activity supported her development of early numeracy skills and reinforced her understanding of size comparison, aligning with the objective of fostering numeracy concepts and vocabulary.

learning_goals.title: Develop understanding of basic Numeracy concepts and vocabulary by likenesses and differences (in size, shape, texture, etc.) 通过分类与配对的活动，发展对于大小和形状的数学概念，并能用相应的数学词汇表达。

domains.title: The Thinking and Communicating Self 思考与沟通

title: 好饿的毛毛虫
description:
在分享完绘本《好饿的毛毛虫》后，老师邀请幼儿参与到穿线活动中。活动伊始，老师精心准备了绘本中出现的各种食物道具，这些道具的展示立刻吸引了幼儿的注意力。老师通过逐一展示各类食物，并邀请幼儿说出它们的名称，激发了他们对故事内容的回忆和兴趣，进一步加深了他们对绘本情节的理解。随后，老师拿出一条首端为小毛毛虫造型的长绳子，向幼儿展示了毛毛虫吃掉各种水果的过程。在此过程中，老师一边向幼儿展示穿线的动作和技巧，一边引导幼儿用语言描述：“毛毛虫吃了……”鼓励幼儿边穿线边说出毛毛虫所吃过的不同食物。
示范完成后，老师询问：“谁要尝试？”思睿快速来到老师旁边的小椅子上坐下看着老师。老师邀请思睿进行活动，并且将首端为毛毛虫造型的绳子拿给思睿。思睿用右手拿住“毛毛虫”，左手拿取桌面上的食物道具，右手将毛毛虫从食物道具中间的洞穿过去后放手，然后换手，右手绕后拿住“毛毛虫”并将绳子拉出来。穿好一个食物道具后，他立马准备穿下一个，直至桌面上所有的食物道具都被穿起来后看向老师，老师夸奖思睿：“思睿真棒，帮助毛毛虫吃掉了桌子上所有的食物。现在你的毛毛虫已经变成了一只胖胖的毛毛虫了。”思睿将老师拿出的大毛毛虫和自己的小毛毛虫放在一起对比后笑着看向老师。
interpretation: 思睿积极的参与活动，并且在活动中顺利完成了穿绳任务。在穿绳的过程中，他展现出了不断进步的专注能力、手眼协调能力和左右手协调配合的能力，也展现出了完成任务后的成就感。

learning_goals.title: Develop eye-hand coordination  (roll a ball, pick up soft blocks and stack, self-feed, put simple things together and take them apart) 发展手眼协调能力，如：滚球，叠放软积木，喂食，把简单玩具连在一起再拆开等）。

title: Numicon Width Patterns
description: The children used Numicon pieces to compare and arrange them from the thinnest to the thickest, horizontally. After ordering the pieces, they traced the outlines of the tiles onto paper and added lines and additional shapes to make their artwork personal and creative. After Darian traced the Numicon shapes onto his paper, the teacher encouraged him to experiment with different lines and shapes to decorate his craft. Darian began by picking out a blue marker and drawing a square, then adding two circles below the square and two circles inside the square. He then drew a rectangle above the square to form a car. Next, using a black marker, he added a zigzag line, joining the line together to create a unique shape. He pressed the marker quickly twice in the shape to create two dots, then drew a short horizontal line below them. Darian then switched to a brown marker and drew three circles stacked on top of each other. Afterward, he added a triangle, paused for a moment, and then drew a trapezium to complete his tower. Finally, he drew an oval and several smaller ovals around the first one to create a flower. He finished the flower by drawing a vertical line down from the center.
interpretation: Darian’s artwork demonstrated his experimentation with various elements to create a unique and imaginative piece. He explored the use of shapes by combining simple forms in creative ways. For example, he used a square, circles and a rectangle to form a car. This process showed his ability to manipulate basic shapes to create a recognizable object. Darian also experimented with lines in different ways, for example, zig zag lines, curves and pressing the marker quickly to create dots. His use of different line types demonstrated his understanding of how lines can vary in style to produce different effects. Overall, Darian’s use of shapes and lines showed how he was experimenting with artistic elements to build patterns, demonstrating creativity and the ability to manipulate these elements in a variety of ways.

learning_goals.title: Experiment with elements to create artworks (e.g: mix paints to get different colours or shades of colours, use shapes and lines to create patterns).

title: Numicon Width Patterns
description: The children used Numicon pieces to compare and arrange them from the thinnest to the thickest, horizontally. After ordering the pieces, they traced the outlines of the tiles onto paper and added lines and additional shapes to make their artwork personal and creative. After David traced the Numicon shapes onto his paper, the teacher encouraged them to experiment with different lines and shapes to decorate their craft. David began by swirling his pencil round and round on his paper, drawing a circle within his Numicon shape. He then used a yellow pencil to draw zigzag lines and straight lines, joining them together to create a unique shape. Pointing at his creation, he proudly said, "Christmas tree." Next, David took a green marker and added two circles and a short straight line to his "Christmas tree." He then used an orange marker to add a squiggly line. When his teacher asked if he knew any other types of lines, David responded by drawing a swirly line on his paper.
interpretation: David’s artwork highlighted his active experimentation with key elements of art, such as shapes, lines, and colours. By adding zigzag and straight lines, By adding circles, zig zag and straight lines, and colours to his artwork, David experimented with how they could be connected and layered to create new, unique patterns, which he identified as a Christmas tree. He further explored the element of lines when he introduced the squiggly and swirly lines. This process of using shapes and lines in various combinations reflects David’s ability to experiment with artistic elements, combining them to create a dynamic, personal artwork that shows his growing understanding of how these elements can be used to develop patterns and express ideas visually.

learning_goals.title: Experiment with elements to create artworks (e.g: mix paints to get different colours or shades of colours, use shapes and lines to create patterns).

title: Exploring size with leaves
description:
Children were engaged in an activity that involved creating a sensory bin filled with dried fallen leaves. This hands-on exploration provided an opportunity for the children to compare the sizes of the leaves and make use of basic early numeracy vocabulary, such as "big" and "small." By physically handling the leaves and placing them side by side, the children naturally distinguished between different sizes. This activity encouraged sensory exploration and facilitated the development of their understanding of size concepts through first hand experiences.

James picked out the big leaf and laid it in front of him. When the teacher asked, “Can you show me where the small leaf is?” James immediately picked up a smaller leaf and placed it next to the big leaf. He then looked closely at both leaves, comparing their sizes. The teacher said, “That’s right, the small leaf is next to the big one!” James smiled and nodded, continuing to observe the differences in size.
interpretation: James was able to identify and compare the big and small leaves and this reflected on his  understanding of basic numeracy concepts and vocabulary through likenesses and differences in size. By physically placing the small leaf next to the big leaf, he demonstrated his understanding of size comparison.

learning_goals.title: Develop understanding of basic Numeracy concepts and vocabulary by likenesses and differences (in size, shape, texture, etc.) 通过分类与配对的活动，发展对于大小和形状的数学概念，并能用相应的数学词汇表达。

title: 好忙的蜘蛛
description:
老师通过阅读绘本《好忙的蜘蛛》，讲述蜘蛛的生活习性和身体特点，引导幼儿对蜘蛛有初步的认识。随后，老师邀请幼儿通过创意美术活动来表现自己对于蜘蛛的理解。在进行美术活动时，老师首先邀请幼儿使用油画棒绘制蜘蛛网，然后使用水粉颜料进行描绘背景。在这一过程中，老师引导幼儿观察油画棒和水粉的分离反应。接下来，幼儿使用轻粘土、活动眼睛和扭扭棒制作小蜘蛛，体验各种材料的运用。
思睿选择了橙色的蜡笔绘制蜘蛛网，他右手五个手指握在一起，握住油画棒进行圆形涂鸦，尝试将线条画满整张纸。蜘蛛网的部分完成后，他依旧是用右手五指握住毛笔刷，然后在老师的引导下将毛笔刷蘸水，他再次选取了橙色开始上色，并且在老师的引导下发现自己的蛛网并没有被水粉颜色覆盖。他用手指放在纸上，轻轻的描绘自己画出的线条。等到纸张晾干后，思睿被邀请来制作他的蜘蛛。思睿选用了红色的轻粘土，他拿起轻粘土捏了捏，然后放在晾干的蛛网画作上，用手轻压成椭圆形。他选择了五个眼睛按在粘土上，然后选择了六根不同颜色的扭扭棒插到轻粘土里作为蜘蛛的脚。做好后，他笑着将作品展示给老师看，老师鼓励思睿：“思睿真棒，你坚持自己完成了你的好忙的蜘蛛。”完成后，思睿继续在旁边观看其他小朋友进行活动。
interpretation: 思睿对于活动很感兴趣，在创作过程中，他使用不同的绘画工具与不同的材料结合，展现出了不断进步的绘画和创作能力，培养了思睿对于艺术的兴趣。

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work etc.) 通过美术活动，如：粗蜡笔涂鸦、水彩画、撕贴画、拼贴等，培养幼儿对艺术的兴趣。

title: 我最爱的……
description:
老师鼓励幼儿和爸爸妈妈讨论自己最爱的物品，并将其带来学校。来到学校后，老师鼓励幼儿轮流来到台前向朋友展示和介绍自己最喜欢的物品，尝试使用简单的语句：“我是……”、“我最爱的是……”来进行表达。
老师请幼儿坐在毯子上，并邀请坐好的幼儿先进行分享。思睿听到老师的话快速的坐下在前排，将脚盘起来后看向老师。老师邀请思睿进行分享，思睿看着老师没有动，老师询问：“你要等一下吗？”思睿点点头。在其他小朋友们分享的过程中，思睿一直看着分享的朋友，并且会在朋友拿出自己分享的物品时，大声说：“车车”“Umbrella”等，几位朋友分享结束后，思睿接受老师的邀请站到朋友面前，他表情严肃的看着自己携带的车，并将身体贴近老师。经过老师的引导和鼓励，思睿小声的分享：“（我是）思睿”、“（我最爱的是）车”。老师夸奖思睿：“思睿真棒，可以介绍自己和自己最喜欢的物品。”所有朋友分享技术后，思睿拿着他的挖掘机和朋友们一起玩，并主动展示自己挖掘机怎么操作。
interpretation: 通过思睿的分享展现出他对自己的名字、身份和喜欢物品有了初步的认知。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (telling others their names) 培养自我意识，如：说出自己的名字等。

title: Family Tree Creation
description: During a short, supervised nature walk at a nearby safe, green space, the children carefully gathered leaves, small twigs, and other natural materials that caught their attention. Dylan used a pair of tweezers to pick up a rock. He struggled with it for a while, but once he successfully picked it up, he brought it over to the teacher to show her. When the teacher asked what he had picked up, Dylan proudly said, "A rock. The rock so hard to take." When the children created their family tree craft, the teacher asked Dylan if he wanted to use the rock he had picked up or if he preferred other materials. Dylan looked through the bucket of items before selecting four twigs. With the teacher's help, he poked three twigs into his paper cup. When he tried to poke in the fourth twig, he realized there wasn’t enough space. The teacher offered to let him keep the twig, but Dylan replied, "No, I want this." As he continued working, Dylan noticed that his cup kept tipping over and asked, "Why the cup keep falling down?" The teacher explained that the sticks added a lot of weight, and the cup couldn’t hold the extra weight. Dylan thought for a moment before putting the twig back into the basket.
interpretation: This experience showed Dylan's process of examining new objects and his environment in several ways. During the nature walk, Dylan carefully observed and interacted with his surroundings, selecting a rock using tweezers, which demonstrated his attention to detail and curiosity about the natural world. When Dylan asked the teacher about the tipping cup and questioned why it kept falling, it showed his ability to notice and inquire about changes in his environment, prompting him to examine the relationship between the materials and their effects. Ultimately, Dylan's decision to put the twig back and choose to draw his family instead was a result of his reflection on the objects he had gathered and his environment, showing how he explored and adapted to the new materials and concepts he encountered.

learning_goals.title: Examine new objects and environment.

title: Family Tree Creation
description: During a short, supervised nature walk at a nearby safe, green space, the children carefully gathered leaves, small twigs, and other natural materials that caught their attention. Jun Yu walked around the grass patch for a while before squatting down and carefully picking up a short twig with a pair of tweezers. He walked over to the teacher and said, "I got this stick." Later, when the children began making their crafts, the teacher asked if he wanted to use the short twig he had picked up or if he wanted to choose other materials. Jun Yu looked through the bucket before selecting three dried leaves. He then used a black marker to start drawing his family members on the leaves. As he began, he realized the leaves kept breaking, saying, "Teacher Lilian, this one broke already." The teacher handed him another dried leaf, and Jun Yu adjusted his approach by lightly pressing the leaf with three fingers to hold it steady and drawing carefully on the leaf.
interpretation: This experience demonstrated Jun Yu's ability to examine new objects and his environment. During the nature walk, he carefully observed the natural surroundings and chose to pick up a short twig, showing his interest in exploring and interacting with the environment. When the children began their craft, Jun Yu continued to examine the materials available, selecting three dried leaves from the bucket. As he started drawing on the leaves, he noticed they were delicate and began to break, which led him to reassess the materials and adapt his approach. Recognizing the fragility of the leaves, he adjusted his method by gently pressing on the leaf with three fingers to hold it steady, ensuring it didn't break. This showed Jun Yu’s ability to not only examine new objects but also understand their characteristics and adapt his actions accordingly to make the most of his environment.

learning_goals.title: Examine new objects and environment.

title: Under the Rug: A Bug Tale
description:
The children led a storytelling activity using a felt cloth featuring various bugs. They took turns deciding which bug would emerge from under the rug, chanting, "Bugs in a rug" before each reveal. The children used their imagination to create a storyline, developing their creativity, storytelling skills, and vocabulary in the process.

Avery picked out and identified the various bugs hidden under the rug. As she revealed each one, she named them and began to weave a story around why they were hiding. When asked why the bugs were under the rug, Avery thoughtfully responded, "They hide, it's so hot," as she smiled. She then proceeded to hide the bugs under the rug and re-arranged the order of which the bugs were revealed to further explore the story she created.
interpretation: Avery’s explanation of why the bugs were hiding demonstrated her growing ability to create a narrative and use her imagination to connect ideas. This aligns with the objective of fostering language and expression through stories, and divergent thinking. Avery was able to construct a meaningful explanation, enhancing her ability to express thoughts and ideas.

title: I can help
description: The children were invited to participate in an outdoor activity and were encouraged to take their shoes from the shoe cubby. Jamie took her friend’s shoes and gave them to him. She wanted to help him put them on, so she unstrapped the shoes and tried to put them on for him. The teacher called Jamie’s attention and asked what she was doing. Jamie responded, "I can help." The teacher allowed Jamie to assist her friend. After helping, Jamie took her own shoes and put them on by herself.
interpretation: From this observation, Jamie demonstrates good social skills by wanting to help her friend put on his shoes. She shows kindness and taking the initiative to assist him without being asked.

title: button drop
description: Jamie was exploring the button drop learning material. She grabbed a bunch of buttons with her left hand. Using her right hand, she picked up one button with a pincer grasp and dropped it into the hole. Jamie continued to hold the buttons with her left hand, using her right hand to pick up each button one at a time with a pincer grasp, until all the buttons were inside
interpretation: From this observation, Jamie is developing her fine motor skills as she uses both hands effectively. She demonstrates the pincer grasp by picking up each button one at a time, which helps strengthen her hand-eye coordination and dexterity.

title: Family Hop
description: Inspired by traditional hopscotch, the hopscotch squares were labeled with family-related words such as "Mother," "Father," "Brother," "Sister," and more. As the children hopped through these family titles, they called out the words as they landed on each square. Chloe eagerly joined the queue and giggled out loud. The teacher first encouraged the children to jump with both feet. Chloe followed enthusiastically, hopping from square to square, calling out each family word as she landed. When the teacher encouraged her to try hopping on one foot, Chloe was excited to challenge herself further. As she attempted to hop with just one foot, she wobbled a little and burst into even more giggles as she tried to steady herself. She finished hopping with one foot all the way through the squares and eagerly asked if she could try again.
interpretation: This experience reflected Chloe's willingness to try out something new and different in several ways. When the teacher first encouraged the children to hop with both feet, Chloe eagerly joined the activity and followed the instructions. However, when the teacher suggested trying to hop on one foot, Chloe was excited to take on the new challenge, despite it being a different and more difficult task. As she wobbled and giggled, she didn’t give up, showing her openness to trying something unfamiliar. Chloe's determination allowed her to successfully hop on one foot all the way through the squares. This reflected her positive attitude towards trying new things and her willingness to take on new challenges.

James unveiled each character from under the rug. As he pulled out the bugs one by one, he animated them using gestures. James animated the dragonfly to land on his head.  The teacher then asked, "Why did the dragonfly land on your head, James?"

James paused for a moment, thinking, and then responded with a big grin, "It’s resting! So tired!" He gently placed the dragonfly on his head and then pretended to let it rest, making gentle movements as if it was settling down.

The teacher responded, "Ah, so the dragonfly is tired and needs a little rest!" James nodded and continued to animate the bug by moving it around on his head, as if it were flying before resting again.
interpretation: James’s engagement in the activity demonstrated his developing language and creativity skills. By animating the bugs and offering imaginative explanations for their actions, he showcased his understanding of cause and effect. His responses to the teacher's prompts highlighted his growing ability to express ideas and engage in storytelling, supporting the fostering of language development through conversations and stories.

title: Creepy crawlies puppet theatre
description:
The children selected their favourite creepy crawlies from puppet sets and worked together to create exciting stories. They took turns suggesting ideas, invited friends to join in, and collaborated on building unique adventures. This activity encouraged teamwork, communication, and the sharing of ideas as the children brought their stories to life.

Avery selected a bee from the puppet set and watched attentively as her peer picked another insect. She leaned over, closely observing how he animated his character, guiding it through the grass. The peer made his insect hop and move, and Avery, following his lead, began to animate her bee, making it jump and move in sync with his. She smiled as she moved her puppet, occasionally looking at her peer and adjusted her movements.

The teacher prompted, "What is your bee doing, Avery?"

Avery responded, "The bee is jumping, like this!" and made her bee hop through the grass.

Her peer, noticing her actions, said, “Look, the bee is jumping too!” Avery nodded and continued to animate the bee, coordinating with her peer’s movements.

Both children worked together to animate their characters, occasionally laughing and looking to each other for cues.
interpretation: Avery’s engagement in the activity showed her ability to collaborate, follow the lead of a peer, and participate in creating a shared story through animated play. This aligns with the objective of fostering a sense of others, as Avery demonstrated the ability to be attentive to her peer’s actions and adapt her own play to work together in creating a collective narrative.

title: 幼儿作品——金蛇贺岁
description:
蛇年即将到来，老师邀请思睿一起来认识蛇并进行艺术作品创作。首先，老师向思睿展示了玩偶蛇，鼓励思睿仔细观察蛇的身体特征：两只眼睛、长长的舌头、圆圆的头部、细长的身体，没有腿……老师引导思睿通过细致观察，掌握蛇的基本特征。然后，思睿开始创作春节装饰——金蛇贺岁：思睿先使用画刷蘸取金色颜料在红纸上画出蛇的身体，然后捏取眼睛和舌头，并选择合适位置进行黏贴，完成创作。在创作的过程中，思睿锻炼了手部精细动作，提高手眼协调能力，增强了动手能力。
最后老师邀请思睿展示自己的作品，思睿展示并分享：“这是蛇。”

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work etc.) 通过美术活动，如：粗蜡笔涂鸦、水彩画、撕贴画、拼贴等，培养幼儿对艺术的兴趣。

title: 小怪兽盲盒
description:
老师邀请幼儿一起参与探索小怪兽盲盒活动。老师出示小怪兽盲盒，鼓励幼儿通过触摸感知和探索，认识软、硬不同材质的物品。
老师出示小怪兽盲盒，询问函豫：“你能看这是什么？”函豫低头观察。老师介绍小怪兽盲盒的外观。“它有一个双圆圆的眼睛,一张大大的嘴巴。里面装满了各种神奇的物品，你们要不要使用小手摸一摸,探索一下里面都有什么？”函豫看向老师点点头。老师鼓励说：“我要玩。”她伸出小手拍拍自己的胸口说：“我”。老师表扬她：“说的好！”并鼓励她伸出小手,来摸一摸小怪兽里的物品。她低头把手伸进小怪兽纸箱里,摸出了一个黄色的毛球。老师询问她：“你摸到了黄色的毛球,你喜欢吗？”她看着老师点点头，低头观察手里的黄色毛球。老师询问她：“黄色的毛球是软软的、还是硬硬的？”她看向老师。老师鼓励她在低头摸一摸毛球,它是软软的、摸起来很舒服、很柔软，捏起来可以变小,它是软软的。她低头捏了捏黄色的毛球,感受手里柔软的触感。她又低头把手伸进小怪兽箱子里，拿出来了一只绵羊模具。老师询问她：“你摸到了什么小动物？”她皱着小眉头观察手里的绵羊模具。老师鼓励她说：“绵羊。”并引导她用手捏一捏手里的绵羊模具，它是软软的还是硬硬的。她低头捏了一下发现捏不动，又把绵羊模具放回箱子里。老师引导她说：“硬硬的绵羊模具。”她看向老师微笑，又低头摸起来。这次她摸到了一个黄色的小鸡，是软软的可以拉的很长。她微笑着双手抓握黄色小鸡尝试左右拉动。
interpretation: 函豫可以积极参与探索小怪兽盲盒活动。她可以听懂老师的话语，尝试使用动作和语言表达自己的想法。函豫在与老师的交流和互动的过程中，建立了良好的依恋关系。

learning_goals.title: Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。

老师通过阅读绘本《好忙的蜘蛛》，讲述蜘蛛的生活习性和身体特点，引导幼儿对蜘蛛有初步的认识。随后，老师邀请幼儿通过创意美术活动来表现自己对于蜘蛛的理解。在进行美术活动时，老师首先邀请幼儿使用油画棒绘制蜘蛛网，然后使用水粉颜料进行描绘背景。在这一过程中，老师引导幼儿观察油画棒和水粉的分离反应。接下来，幼儿使用轻粘土、活动眼睛和扭扭棒制作小蜘蛛，体验各种材料的运用。
乐璟选择了黑色的蜡笔绘制蜘蛛网，她右手五个手指握在一起，握住油画棒进行圆形涂鸦，尝试将线条画满整张纸。蜘蛛网的部分完成后，她依旧是用右手五指握住毛笔刷，然后在老师的引导下将毛笔刷蘸水，她先选取了蓝色开始上色，然后叠加了粉色。接下来她在老师的引导下发现自己的蛛网并没有被水粉颜色覆盖，她指着自己画出的黑色蛛丝展示给老师看。等到纸张晾干后，乐璟被邀请来制作她的蜘蛛。乐璟选用了红色的轻粘土，她拿起轻粘土捏了捏，然后放在晾干的蛛网画作上，用手轻压成椭圆形。她选择了两个眼睛按在粘土上，然后将扭扭棒一根一根的插入粘土里，一直到插了七根后她停了下来。乐璟完成了作品，她指着作品展示给老师看，老师鼓励乐璟：“乐璟真棒，你坚持自己完成了你的好忙的蜘蛛。”完成后，乐璟继续在旁边观看其她小朋友进行活动。
interpretation: 乐璟对于活动很感兴趣，在创作过程中，她使用不同的绘画工具与不同的材料结合，展现出了不断进步的绘画和创作能力，培养了乐璟对于艺术的兴趣。

老师通过阅读绘本《好忙的蜘蛛》，讲述蜘蛛的生活习性和身体特点，引导幼儿对蜘蛛有初步的认识。随后，老师邀请幼儿通过创意美术活动来表现自己对于蜘蛛的理解。在进行美术活动时，老师首先邀请幼儿使用油画棒绘制蜘蛛网，然后使用水粉颜料进行描绘背景。在这一过程中，老师引导幼儿观察油画棒和水粉的分离反应。接下来，幼儿使用轻粘土、活动眼睛和扭扭棒制作小蜘蛛，体验各种材料的运用。
淮雄选择了蓝色的蜡笔绘制蜘蛛网，他右手五个手指握在一起，握住油画棒快速地涂鸦，尝试将线条画满整张纸。蜘蛛网的部分完成后，他依旧是用右手五指握住毛笔刷，然后在老师的引导下将毛笔刷蘸水，他选取了棕色开始上色。接下来他在老师的引导下发现自己的蛛网并没有被水粉颜色覆盖。等到纸张晾干后，淮雄被邀请来制作他的蜘蛛。淮雄选用了紫色的轻粘土，他拿起轻粘土捏了捏，然后放在晾干的蛛网画作上，用手轻压成椭圆形。他选择了两个眼睛按在粘土上，然后将扭扭棒一根一根的插入粘土里，直至轻粘土上完全插不下了。淮雄完成了作品，他指着作品展示给老师看，老师鼓励淮雄：“淮雄真棒，你坚持自己完成了你的好忙的蜘蛛。”完成后，淮雄向老师要了一块轻粘土，继续揉捏轻粘土。
interpretation: 淮雄对于活动很感兴趣，在创作过程中，他使用不同的绘画工具与不同的材料结合，展现出了不断进步的绘画和创作能力，培养了淮雄对于艺术的兴趣。

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work etc.) 通过美术活动，如：粗蜡笔涂鸦、水彩画、撕贴画、拼贴等，培养幼儿对艺术的兴趣。

title: Creepy crawlies puppet theatre
description:
The children selected their favourite creepy crawlies from puppet sets and worked together to create exciting stories. They took turns suggesting ideas, invited friends to join in, and collaborated on building unique adventures. This activity encouraged teamwork, communication, and the sharing of ideas as the children brought their stories to life.

Stephy picked up the ladybug puppet and began to gently move it, waiting for her peer to suggest what should happen next. She looked over at her peer, watching closely for cues on how to proceed with the story. As her peer animated their own puppet, Stephy paused, and watched over her peer beside her.

Her peer looked at her and said, “The ladybug eat the grass!” Stephy smiled and nodded, then carefully moved the ladybug toward the grass and animate the ladybugs to nibble on the grass. "Eat grass," Stephy reassured.

Throughout the activity, Stephy was observant, taking turns and using her peer's cues to guide the story. She demonstrated patience and attentiveness, allowing her peer to take the lead while actively participating in the collaborative play.
interpretation: Stephy’s actions reflected her growing ability to engage with others, listen, and contribute to a shared story, fostering a sense of cooperation and respect for her peer's input. This aligns with the objective of fostering a sense of others, as Stephy demonstrated attentiveness and patience by waiting for her peer’s suggestions and responding positively.

title: Fruit Face
description: The children were engaged in creating faces using different types of fruits. Jamie was encouraged to make her own fruit creation by choosing fruits and placing them on a plate. Jamie immediately took an orange and ate it. Her teacher explained that fruits are healthy and good for their bodies. After hearing this, Jamie continued to enjoy the orange. The teacher encouraged her to try other fruits, and without hesitation, Jamie tried the apple and enjoyed the banana. Afterwards, she asked for more oranges.
interpretation: It is shown that Jamie demonstrates healthy eating habits, as she ate the fruits without hesitation. She even requested more oranges, which is evidence that it is her favorite fruit among the others.

learning_goals.title: Foster awareness of personal hygiene and safety，healthy eating habits (hand washing, cleaning up, dressing，toileting, personal safety, eating a variety of food, etc.) 培养个人自理能力、卫生和基本的安全意识、良好的饮食习惯，如：洗手、穿衣、食用多样化的食物等。

title: Balancing Airplane Boby Parts
description: During outdoor time, Cavill held a cone in his hands and extended his arms while moving around, imitating an airplane flying. He sang along to “Here Comes Airplane” as he ran across the play area. He then paused, placed the cone on his head, and said, “Airplane on my head.” He adjusted his posture to keep the cone balanced before shifting it to his shoulder. As he continued moving, he placed the cone on his knee and tapped it, saying, “Airplane on my knee.” Cavill repeated this process, deliberately placing the cone on different body parts while naming them.
interpretation: Cavill demonstrated an awareness of body parts and an ability to link movement with language. He actively named each body part as he played. His ability to balance the cone on different body parts and adjust his positioning reflects his focus, coordination, and developing communication skills through play.

title: Balancing Airplane Boby Parts
description: During outdoor play, Talia actively participated in the “Here Comes Airplane” song activity. She picked up a coloured cone of her choice, representing an airplane, and initially tried to balance it on her shoulder while running around. As she moved, the cone kept sliding off, but she did not give up. She paused to observe what was happening and then adjusted her approach by using one hand to hold the cone steady while extending her other arm out like the wing of an airplane. As she continued running, she named different body parts and decided where she wanted the airplane to land. She approached the teacher and said, “I want on my tummy,” before placing the cone on her stomach and running again.
interpretation: Talia demonstrated creativity and problem-solving as she explored different ways to balance the “airplane” while moving. Her ability to name and identify body parts during the activity also showed her growing language skills and understanding of spatial awareness.

title: Chinese New Year Craft
description: During the Chinese New Year craft activity, Talia had a plate filled with various cutout shapes in different colours. She carefully picked up her preferred shapes and colours, scanning the plate before selecting one. As she lifted a shape, she smiled and said, “Triangle.” She then applied glue and transferred the shape onto the paper roll, adjusting its position before pressing it down. While working, she noticed that a red triangle had fallen off and said, “My red triangle dropped.” She then added more glue and carefully secured it back onto the roll.
interpretation: Talia demonstrated her ability to recognise and name basic shapes and colours as she made selections for her craft. She showed persistence in ensuring her shapes stayed in place and adjusted her approach when needed, reflecting her growing spatial awareness and fine motor coordination.

title: Ball Hunt
description: Jing Xi participated in the “Ball Hunt” activity, moving quickly across the field while scanning the ground for balls. She picked up balls as she found them, filling her container with a mix of colours. As her container became full, she stopped, looked inside, and said, “so many.” She then spotted a green ball a few steps away, looked down at the orange ball already in her container, and decided to drop the orange ball back onto the field. She picked up the green ball instead and placed it in her container. As she continued searching, she noticed a friend holding a yellow ball and approached them. She asked, “you like yellow?” and then began looking around the field again, this time specifically searching for yellow balls to help her friend collect them. During cleanup time, Jing Xi remained focused on finding green balls, picking them up and placing them into the ball bag.
interpretation: Jing Xi demonstrated her ability to compare colours, make intentional choices, and group objects of the same colour, reinforcing her understanding of likeness in colours during the ball hunt activity.

learning_goals.title: Develop understanding of basic Numeracy concepts and vocabulary by likenesses and differences (in size, shape, texture, etc.) 通过分类与配对的活动，发展对于大小和形状的数学概念，并能用相应的数学词汇表达。

title: 幼儿作品——金蛇贺岁
description: 蛇年即将到来，老师邀请婧瑜一起来认识蛇并进行艺术作品创作。首先，老师向婧瑜展示了玩偶蛇，鼓励婧瑜仔细观察蛇的身体特征：两只眼睛、长长的舌头、圆圆的头部、细长的身体，没有腿……老师引导婧瑜通过细致观察，掌握蛇的基本特征。然后，婧瑜开始创作春节装饰——金蛇贺岁：婧瑜先使用画刷蘸取金色颜料在红纸上画出蛇的身体，然后捏取眼睛和舌头，并选择合适位置进行黏贴，完成创作。在创作的过程中，婧瑜锻炼了手部精细动作，提高手眼协调能力，增强了动手能力。 最后老师邀请婧瑜展示自己的作品，婧瑜展示并分享：“是蛇。”

title: 我最喜欢的画面
description:
幼儿正在参与“语言斗”领域的“猜猜我有多爱你”的教学活动。教师引导幼儿想象和对故事情感的理解。描绘出大兔子和小兔子的形象，表达书中的经典画面——大兔子深深爱着小兔子。
宥谌宥谌坐在桌前，兴致勃勃地拿起铅笔，在画纸上开始作画。老师问他：“你画的是哪一个场景呢”？他回答说：“ 我要画，大兔子要爱小兔子到月亮那里！”教师说：” 哇！这是个很美的画面！你画了小兔子，它在干什么呢？“他说： " 我画的是大兔子要抱着小兔子。”“ 你画得很棒！你可以给小兔子加上耳朵和尾巴，让它更像小兔子哦！”老师鼓励他说，宥谌点点头，高兴地接受了建议，并认真地继续创作。
interpretation: 宥谌通过绘画和语言表达了他对《猜猜我有多爱你》这个故事的理解。他能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。尝试用华语表达自己的想法。他用自己的方式诠释了大兔子与小兔子之间深厚的爱，也在老师的鼓励下学习了如何更加细致地表达自己的想法。这次绘画不仅锻炼了他的创造力，也增强了他的表达能力和自信心。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：尝试用华语与人交谈。
语言学习成果（写）- 写前准备：喜欢涂涂画画，能画出较直、横的线，基本能控制笔的方向。

title: Walk into hoops
description: Leon was invited to walk into the hoops on the playground, and the teacher demonstrated the experience. Leon walked into the red hoop and stopped when both of his feet were inside. He then continued walking by lifting his left foot first, followed by his right foot. As he walked, he stepped on the hoops, repeating the pattern of left foot first, then right foot. The teacher encouraged him to run back to the red hoop. Leon ran outside the hoops and continued walking with the same pattern, lifting his left foot first, followed by his right.
interpretation: This observation shows that Leon is building his gross motor skills. He was able to walk into the hoops and maintain balance, even when stepping onto them without falling. Additionally, he demonstrated his ability to run, further showing the development of his body coordination.

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, bend, kick, throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作，如：走、跑、双脚跳、弯腰、踢、丢球等。

title: I did it!
description: Leon was exploring the learning materials. He took a pouch, unzipped it, and looked inside. Noticing his teacher watching, Leon proudly showed the empty pouch to her with a smile. He then took another bag, unzipped it, checked inside, and saw it was empty. Again, he raised the bag to show his teacher. Leon continued to explore the bags in the basket.
interpretation: This observation shows that Leon demonstrates a sense of identity, as he was able to unzip the bags independently. It also shows his sense of pride, as he happily shared his accomplishment with his teacher by showing the empty bags.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self-concept and identity 初步培养自我概念和认同感，如：会说自己很棒。

title: If you're happy and you know it!
description: The children were invited to join in music and movement, and the teacher played "Hello Hello" from Super Simple Songs. Reagan participated and danced along, following his teacher's movements. He gave a thumbs up when he felt good and placed his hands behind his back when he didn’t feel good. After the song, the teacher asked if they wanted to hear another one, and Reagan immediately requested "Baby Shark." The teacher played the song, and Reagan quickly showed two fingers for the "baby shark" and danced along.
interpretation: Reagan shows a strong interest in music and movement as he enthusiastically dances along to the songs. He even takes the initiative to request his favorite song, demonstrating his excitement and engagement with the experience.

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest and enjoyment in music and movement (through musical instruments, moving with the music, etc.) 通过使用小的打击乐器，如：沙球、摇铃，培养幼儿对音乐与律动的兴趣和喜好。

title: 上与下
description:
幼儿正在参与“数学脑”领域的“上与下”的教学游戏，教师通过游戏引导幼儿理解并使用“上”和“下”的方位词。通过实际操作和语言表达来理解“上”和“下”的空间关系。
老师叫：“姝雅，我们来玩一个“上下”游戏！请你看看这把椅子，你能告诉我，你现在站在哪里吗？”姝雅看着椅子回答说：“我站在椅子上！老师又问道：“很好！那如果我把玩具小熊放在地板上，你会怎么说呢？”姝雅说：“小熊在椅子下面！”老师说：”现在，我要挑战你了！请你用手指指一指，谁在桌子下？“姝雅指向桌子下的物品说：“书包在桌子下面！”老师夸她说：“太棒了！那你能把这个玩具放在桌子上吗？”她把玩具放在桌子上，看了看说：“玩具在桌子上。”
interpretation: 在这个活动中，姝雅不仅能够准确操作物品，还能用完整的句子描述物体的空间位置，说明她对“上”和“下”的关系理解较为扎实，能灵活运用。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：尝试用华语与人交谈。
描述和解释空间中的相对位置，如：顶部/底部、前/后、旁边。

title: My Body Craft
description: The children worked on a body craft using different shapes, such as circles for the face, large rectangles or triangles for the body, and small rectangles for the arms and legs. They used glue to paste the shapes to the paper, then added details like eyes, nose, and mouth with googly eyes, small circles for the nose, and crescent shapes for the mouth. For the hair, we used strips of newspaper. The children tried tearing the newspaper into small pieces and gluing them onto the head. While doing this activity, the children explored how different shapes can come together to create various things, including a boy and girl body craft, all while learning about shapes.

learning_goals.title: Foster an interest in art (drawing, painting, modelling, collage work etc.) 通过美术活动，如：粗蜡笔涂鸦、水彩画、撕贴画、拼贴等，培养幼儿对艺术的兴趣。

title: I am...
description:
Harrison was introduced to the words in the guided reading book as titled "I am". He identified the sight words of "I" and "am", and read out content words such as eating, drinking, reading, sleeping, and riding using picture cues with the teacher. Harrison also practised his reading skills using the sentence starter "I am" card and picture word cards to complete the sentence.

During the activity, "Alright Harrison, can you read the sentence starter first?" said the teacher. "I am" replied Harrison while placing his right index finger onto the words while reading. "Good job, Harrison. Now can you choose a picture word card to complete the sentence?" said the teacher. Harrison turned his body to the right and picked up the picture word card "drinking", and he placed it on the blank space of the sentence starter card. When asked to read, Harrison pointed along while reading "I am drinking". Harrison repeated what he had done for the other picture word cards such as "I am eating", "I am reading", "I am riding", and "I am sleeping".
interpretation: Harrison displayed his understanding of alphabet knowledge and phonological awareness whereby he was able to identify the sight words of "I" and "am", and read out the word cards by referring to the pictures on the word cards.

learning_goals.title: Alphabet Knowledge: Begin to develop knowledge about letters.
Phonological Awareness: Understand that language is made up of words, syllables, rhymes and individual sounds.

title: 上与下
description:
幼儿正在参与“数学脑”领域的“上与下”的教学游戏，教师通过游戏引导幼儿理解并使用“上”和“下”的方位词。通过实际操作和语言表达来理解“上”和“下”的空间关系。
靖炜小朋友在教室里参与“上下”关系的学习活动。老师准备了一个轻巧的箱子，并鼓励他用身体动作来感受“上”和“下”的概念。老师微笑着问靖炜：“你能把这个箱子举起来吗？”靖炜双手抱住箱子，慢慢地举高，老师引导他说：“靖炜，你现在把箱子放在哪里了？”靖炜看着自己的动作，大声回答：“我把箱子举到上面了！”老师继续鼓励他：“太棒了！那你能把箱子放下来吗？”靖炜缓缓放下箱子，开心地说：“现在箱子在下面了！”
interpretation: 靖炜通过亲身体验尝试，他能很好的掌握“上”和“下”的空间关系。他不仅能用身体动作表达，还能准确地用语言描述，积极参与。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（听）- 听指令：能完全理解1个口头指示并完成任务。
语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：尝试用华语与人交谈。
描述和解释空间中的相对位置，如：顶部/底部、前/后、旁边。

title: World Cup Champ
description: Christopher carefully approached the ball and placed it on the ground, preparing himself for the kick. He bent his knees slightly and positioned his body to face the ball. First, he shifted his weight to his left leg, ensuring stability before he began his kick. With his right leg, he swung it back behind him then swiftly brought his right leg forward, extending it toward the ball. As his foot made contact, he used the momentum to push the ball forward, directing it toward his friend who was standing a few feet away. After he received the ball again, Christopher set the ball down and took a few steps back. He ran towards the ball from a short distance, his arms swinging rhythmically as he gained speed. As he approached the ball, he stopped with a slight distance away from the ball and aimed carefully at the ball, sending it over to his friend again.
interpretation: Christopher demonstrated significant coordination and control over his body movements while engaging in this activity. His ability to approach the ball, shift his weight, and position himself correctly before executing the kick shows a growing awareness of his body’s positioning and balance. The smooth, coordinated motion of swinging his leg back and then forward allowed him to successfully propel the ball towards his friend. When he ran towards the ball, he was able to stop and position himself correctly, showing awareness of how to adjust his movements based on the task. Christopher’s actions reflected the development of both his gross motor skills and his ability to synchronize movements in a purposeful way to complete the task.

learning_goals.title: Coordinate movements to perform tasks.

title: World Cup Champ
description: Caleb ran from a short distance, his arms swinging as he built up speed. As he approached the ball, he stopped just in time, shifted his weight, and swung his right leg back before bringing it forward in one smooth motion to kick the ball directly to his friend, who was waiting across from him. When it was his turn to receive the ball, Caleb positioned himself with his hands out in front of him, ready to catch. As the ball came towards him, he tracked its trajectory carefully and quickly moved into position. As Caleb caught the ball, he then squatted down, adjusting his body to roll the ball forward to his friend. He used just the right amount of force in his arms to roll the ball forward to his friend.
interpretation: Caleb demonstrated strong coordination and body control throughout this activity. His ability to run towards the ball, stop, and then perform a precise kick showed an increasing understanding of how to synchronize his body movements for a specific task. He effectively used his right leg to kick the ball with direction and force, sending it accurately to his friend. After catching the ball, Caleb squatted down and used his arms with just the right amount of force to roll the ball forward to his friend, all without losing his balance. This showcased further coordination and control over his movements. Overall, Caleb’s ability to coordinate his movements—running, stopping, kicking, catching, and rolling—showed continued development of his gross motor skills and his ability to perform tasks with intention and precision.

learning_goals.title: Coordinate movements to perform tasks.

title: World Cup Champ
description: Chloe started as the receiver. When her friend kicked the ball, she moved quickly towards it, squatted down, and extended her arms to catch it. The ball bounced away from her hands, but Chloe reacted quickly, standing up and running toward the ball. She then used her hands to push the ball back to her friend. It was then Chloe’s turn to be the kicker. She carefully set the ball down in front of her and stood in position. Lifting her arms up, she shifted her weight onto her left leg, then raised her right leg and kicked the ball forward with purpose. She sent the ball straight to her friend, who was standing across from her. When her friend passed the ball back to her, Chloe tracked the ball’s movement, moved swiftly to meet it and kicked the ball back to her friend without stopping it.
interpretation: Chloe effectively coordinated her movements to perform each task with precision and control. As the receiver, she demonstrated the ability to move towards the ball, squat down, and extend her arms to catch it, showing an understanding of how to position her body for the task. When the ball bounced away, Chloe quickly adjusted, demonstrating quick reflexes and the ability to adjust her movements to complete the task. Her ability to sequence the movements as a kicker, from moving to the ball, balance to execution, reflected her growing understanding of how to use her body in a controlled and purposeful way to achieve the desired outcome. Chloe's ability to coordinate her actions—moving, squatting, standing, kicking, and adjusting—illustrated her continued development in gross motor skills and her ability to perform tasks with coordination and precision.

learning_goals.title: Coordinate movements to perform tasks.

title: World Cup Champ
description: Arthur began by setting the ball down on the ground, carefully positioning himself to kick. He stood with his legs apart, placing his left foot in front and his right foot at the back, ensuring he was in a balanced stance. Once he was ready, he shifted his weight to his left leg and used his right leg to push the ball forward with a controlled kick. After kicking the ball, Arthur took on the role of the receiver. He stood with his arms slightly out in front of him, watching the ball as it approached. As the ball came closer, Arthur adjusted his position, moving quickly to meet it. He crouched down, preparing himself to catch the ball, and when it reached him, he extended his arms forward to grab it.

His ability to position himself with his feet apart and shift his weight effectively showcased his understanding of balance and body alignment. By using his right foot to push the ball forward with purpose, Arthur displayed coordination in synchronizing his body movements to complete the task. The way he shifted his weight and followed through with the kick highlighted his developing motor skills, such as balance, strength, and control. As the receiver, Arthur demonstrated good spatial awareness and quick reflexes. Moving his body towards the ball and making the successful catch indicated his growing ability to control his movements and maintain balance during dynamic actions. Overall, Arthur’s actions reflected his growing ability to coordinate movements and execute tasks with intention and focus.

title: Sight Word Hopscotch
description:
Mason was introduced to the words from the guided reading books. He identified the sight words of "I", "am", "at", "like", "my", and "me" with the teacher before he participated in a sight word hopscotch game.

"Ms Clarissa, is it my turn to play?" said Mason. "Yes, Mason. It's your turn now." replied the teacher. Mason took a red beanbag with his right hand, and stood at the start of the word hopscotch game. Mason threw the red beanbag, and it landed on the word "am". Mason hopped over to the word "am" after that. When he reached, he picked up the word "am" with his left hand, and looked at it. "Mason, can you tell me what word is this?" asked the teacher. "Errr I am." replied Mason. "Good try, Mason. But do you see the word 'I'?" asked the teacher. "No." said Mason. "Alright, then what word is it?" replied the teacher. "Am." said Mason. "Yes, that's right. Good job, Mason!" said the teacher.
interpretation: Mason displayed his understanding of alphabet knowledge and phonological awareness whereby he was able to guess the sight word based on his prior experiences, and with some prompts from the teacher to identify the word "am" accurately.

learning_goals.title: Alphabet Knowledge: Begin to develop knowledge about letters.
Phonological Awareness: Understand that language is made up of words, syllables, rhymes and individual sounds.

title: Reading A Book
description:
During reading time, Tyrell selected "The Very Hungry Caterpillar" and placed it on the table before sitting down. He flipped to the first page and began narrating, saying, “The warm sun come up and pop out egg a caterpillar.” As he turned the pages, he continued to read aloud, pointing at the illustrations and naming the foods, saying, “He started to eat apple, pear, plum, and strawberries.”

As he progressed through the book, Tyrell reached the section where the caterpillar ate different foods. He pointed to each one and named them in sequence, saying, “Cake, cheese, pickles, watermelon,” as he traced the images with his finger. When he neared the end of the book, he confidently predicted the conclusion, saying, “Become a beautiful butterfly.” As he turned to the final page, he transitioned into singing “Fly Like a Butterfly,” using his hands to mimic fluttering wings.
interpretation: This observation highlights Tyrell’s ability to engage with a familiar story through picture cues and retelling. His recognition of the sequence of events and prediction of the story’s ending demonstrate his comprehension skills and understanding of narrative structure. He used verbal and non-verbal expressions to describe story events, identify characters, and connect with books in their own unique way, highlighting their growing literacy and communication skills.

title: Reading A Book
description:

interpretation: Asher demonstrated early language and communication development by engaging with the book through questioning, role-playing, and expressive gestures. His ability to link real-life actions to images in the book shows his comprehension and connection to familiar objects and people. His pretend play while reading supports imaginative thinking, conversational exchange, and social interaction, all of which contribute to his growing literacy skills.

title: Reading A Book
description:

interpretation: Linus demonstrated early storytelling and comprehension skills by using expressive language, dramatization, and picture cues to narrate key story moments. His ability to predict events, recall familiar phrases, and engage in role-play through voice and gestures shows his understanding of character roles and sequencing within a story. His interactions with books indicate a strong foundation in literacy development, encouraging confidence in reading and verbal expression.

title: My Body Lead Craft
description:
During the “My Body Leaf Craft” activity, Jing Xi actively engaged in creating her artwork using natural materials collected from the park. Her ability to adapt and try new methods reflected her growing confidence in art-making and her keen interest in experimenting with different ways to assemble her artwork.

title: 认照片
description:
教师准备了若干幼儿们的照片，鼓励幼儿在照片中挑选出自己的照片，学习说：“这是我！”并说出其他照片上面有谁，说出同伴的名字。
     恩均坐下来看了看照片，很快就递给老师看自己的照片，老师询问他：“这是谁的照片？”恩均指了指自己，说：“我！（英文）”老师回应说：“恩均跟着老师说，我，这是我！”恩均听后重复道：“我，这是我。”随后老师指向其他的照片询问道：“那这是谁的照片？”恩均回答道：“義腾（英文）的！”老师反问道：“是義腾的吗？”恩均点了点头，说：“是義腾的。”接着他分别认出了赞杰和淑涵的照片，并尝试说：“这是赞杰的！”“这是淑涵的！”随后他将照片贴在了墙上看着自己的照片微笑。
interpretation: 恩均能够在若干照片里辨认出自己的照片，并愿意与老师互动，告知老师是谁的的照片，说出同伴的名字，体现了他有自我意识，能够认识同伴，乐意重复老师学习华语表达。
