title: Paper Quilling
description:
The children were introduced to the paper quilling technique as part of their preparation for K2. They learned how to use the paper quilling tool and attach strips of paper to it. Through this activity, they explored creating different shapes such as teardrops, crescents, and more by carefully manipulating and pressing the paper to form the desired shapes. Once they had mastered these techniques, they were able to place their designs on a piece of paper, creating their own unique artwork.

During this activity, Hector demonstrated his ability to twirl the paper using the quilling tool. Although his rolls were not as tightly wound, he successfully achieved the overall shape with some loose ends. His efforts showed persistence and a growing understanding of the technique.  Demonstrating the technique step by step and encouraging him to practice creating smaller, tighter rolls can help him build confidence and develop greater precision. With this added support, Hector will have the opportunity to strengthen his skills and achieve more defined quilling shapes.

learning_goals.title: Use strength, control and eye-hand coordination to accomplish tasks (e.g: place blocks on a structure withouth knowcking it down, tear paper into specific shapes to make a collage, fit pattern-blocks and tangrams into pre-drawn outlines, etc.).
Use writing & drawing tools with some control (e.g: hold writing materials with a comfortable grip, write a note that is neat, use a ruler with one hand and draw a line along with the other, etc.)

title: 好玩的绒球
description: 下午以关系为本的课程活动时间，教师继续带领班级幼儿一起玩“好玩的绒球”游戏。教师对班级幼儿说：“小朋友们，谁要过来玩这个有趣的游戏，把这些漂亮的绒球塞进彩色洞洞里面呀？”看到这些色彩鲜艳的绒球，献正眼睛瞬间亮了起来，和同伴一起笑着跑到教师身边坐了下来。教师拿了一篮子绒球和一个带有不同颜色洞洞的纸盒给献正。只见献正迫不及待的伸出右手用大拇指、食指及中指伸进篮子捏起一个红色的小绒球，然后笑着把绒球塞进了盒子上的一个洞洞里。教师夸奖他说：“献正做的真棒，你拿起一个红色色的小绒球，把它放到洞洞里了。”献正听到教师夸奖他，他笑着抬起头看向教师，然后继续伸出右手从篮子里抓起一把不同颜色和大小的绒球。绒球太多快要掉下来了，他赶紧又抬起左手和右手握在一起。教师提醒他说：“献正，不要着急，要一个一个把小绒球拿起来塞到洞洞里哦！”献正抬起头看了看教师，又看了看手中的绒球，然后把绒球放回了篮子里。他伸出右手用大拇指、食指及中指精准捏住一个红色色大绒球拿了起来，左手也用同样的方式拿了一个黄色的小绒球。他右手捏着红色的大绒球放到洞洞边上尝试把绒球塞进洞洞里。第一次尝试没有成功，献正的小眉头皱了起来，眼神里透露出一丝疑惑。他没有放弃，而是更加用力地用手指按压绒球。教师鼓励他说：“献正别着急，调整一下绒球的位置再试试看。”献正听到教师的话，小眼睛专注地盯着洞口和绒球，小脑袋微微倾斜，调整着绒球的位置。调整好后，他放开绒球伸出食指用力的按压下去，红色色的大绒球顺利的进入了洞洞里。献正笑着抬起头，指着那个洞洞让给教师看。教师摆手夸奖他：“献正好厉害，成功的把红色大绒球按进洞洞里了！”献正笑着继续把左手里的黄色绒球也塞进一个小洞里。他乐此不疲地重复着抓绒球、塞洞洞的动作，操作越来越熟练，还会一边玩一边发出“嗯嗯”的声音，仿佛在给自己加油鼓劲，直到快把盒子塞满了才停止。
interpretation: 献正能够熟练运用大拇指、食指和中指抓握绒球，这表明他的精细动作和手部小肌肉群已经有了较好的发展，具备了一定的抓握能力。在将绒球塞进洞洞的过程中，他能够根据绒球和洞洞的位置进行尝试和调整，体现了手眼协调能力正在逐步发展。献正能用食指用力将绒球按进洞洞里，可以看出他手指小肌肉力量发展的很好。在活动过程中遇到困难时，献正没有轻易放弃，而是通过自己的努力去尝试解决问题，这反映出他具有一定的坚持性和探索精神。通过这个活动献正的手部精细动作和手眼协调能力都得到了很好的锻炼。同时，整个活动过程中他也表现出了快乐、自信享受与轻松。

learning_goals.title: Foster fine motor development ( pick up objects using pincer grasp, hold crayon to scribble, fasten/unfasten zippers/buttons, screw, unscrew bottle caps, etc.) 发展精细动作，如：用大拇指、食指及中指（三指）抓物品、拉拉链、扣纽扣、拧瓶盖等。
Develop eye-hand coordination (roll a ball, pick up soft blocks and stack, self-feed, put simple things together and take them apart) 发展手眼协调能力，如：滚球，叠放软积木，喂食，把简单玩具连在一起再拆开等。

title: 小水滴找朋友
description:
在本次活动中，老师化身“水精灵”，用趣味手偶和魔法口袋吸引幼儿兴趣，引导他们先触摸感知物品的“软软”和“硬硬”，再将材料轻轻放入水中观察“浮起来”或“沉下去”。孩子们通过直观的感官操作与对比，发现不同材质的特性（如木头浮水、石头下沉、海绵吸水），在玩水游戏中自然建立对材料属性的初步认知，同时激发观察与提问的科学探索兴趣，为后续学习奠定基础。

翰林在活动中表现出极大的兴趣。他首先选择了一个塑料香蕉模型，将其放入水中，发现它沉到了水底。她显得有些惊讶，很快又拿起一个木块玩具放入水里，观察到木块浮在水面。他皱起眉头，疑惑地问：“香蕉沉下去？”随后，他主动尝试更多材料进行测试，发现手指玩偶也能漂浮，而积木则有些沉下去。在教师的引导下，翰林开始思考并提出新的问题：“硬硬的会沉下去？”教师向幼儿介绍浮力和密度的概念，翰林认真听讲，并尝试用自己的语言复述：“硬硬的下面，软软的上面。”他在实验过程中不断尝试不同材质的玩具在水中的状态，并与同伴分享自己的发现，表现出较强的探索精神和学习兴趣。
interpretation: 翰林在活动中展现了良好的自主探索能力，可以选择不同的材料去尝试和观察。较少受到干扰，能投入持续的注意、精力旺盛并坚持不懈的完成。过程中表现出快乐、自信、好奇和积极的互动。主动提出问题，探索后会用自己的语言尝试解释：“香蕉硬硬在下面，玩偶软软在上面。”展现了初步的科学探究能力。

learning_goals.title: Develop an understanding of the physical properties of materials through exploration (e.g. water play to understand how water flows differently through funnels etc.) 通过探索活动，如：观察水流动等，发展幼儿对材料属性的认识。

title: 我们的新朋友-毛毛虫
description:
老师带着毛毛虫和茧来到幼儿园，鼓励幼儿观察这两种生物的特征，并在观察过程中引导幼儿使用工具仔细观察细节。看到毛毛虫后，予诺和其她幼儿纷纷围到老师身边，想要近距离观察。为了确保安全并提供更好的观察体验，老师请幼儿轮流进行观察。
当老师邀请予诺前来观察时，她迅速走到桌前坐下来，首先将视线投向了盒子里一动不动的茧。但身体缩在椅子后方，她看向盒子的茧，想要伸手又缩了回去。经过一段时间的观察和老师的鼓励，她慢慢意识到茧在盒子里不会伤害或者惊吓她。于是她慢慢放松下来，观察茧和毛毛虫。她看到毛毛虫的时候，伸手指向毛毛虫，展示给旁边的朋友看，并尝试使用放大镜进行观察。当老师邀请其他朋友坐下观察的时候，她来到旁边，凑的更近的进行观察。老师赞扬予诺：“予诺真棒，你越来越勇敢了，你没有害怕，找到了毛毛虫，还尝试使用工具放大镜进行观察。”
interpretation: 予诺积极参与活动，在活动中不但展现了她的探索精神和不断提升的探索能力，也展现出了她对自然环境中生物的好奇和兴趣。

title: Paper Quilling
description:
The children were introduced to the paper quilling technique as part of their preparation for K2. They learned how to use the paper quilling tool and attach strips of paper to it. Through this activity, they explored creating different shapes such as teardrops, crescents, and more by carefully manipulating and pressing the paper to form the desired shapes. Once they had mastered these techniques, they were able to place their designs on a piece of paper, creating their own unique artwork.

During this activity, Yi Le was able to create one paper coil. While he only completed one, he managed to coil it tightly and skillfully manipulated it into a cat-eye shape. His focused effort and attention to detail showed his growing understanding of the quilling technique. To further support Yi Le in developing his quilling skills, encouraging him to create multiple coils in one session could help build his confidence and refine his technique. Gradually increasing the number of coils he makes will provide him with more opportunities to practice shaping and improve his overall control with the quilling tool.

title: Fruits and Vegetables Puzzle
description: During activity time, the children were invited to help the teacher assemble pieces of fruits and vegetables. When it was Kayla's turn, she picked up one half slice of a pear and looked for the other half. Once she found it, she carefully attached the pieces together and proudly exclaimed, "Look, I do pear!" Then, she took a half slice of strawberry, found the matching piece, and successfully put them together. Kayla continued with the activity, independently matching and assembling other fruit and vegetable pieces, like lemon and corn.
interpretation: Kayla showed her problem-solving skills by independently matching and assembling the fruit and vegetable pieces. She also displayed her language skills when she correctly identified and named the fruit, saying, "Look, I do pear." Throughout the activity, Kayla displayed enthusiasm and perseverance as she continued on her own, successfully matching and assembling even more fruit and vegetable pieces.

description: The children were invited for a role-playing activity where they select their favourite fruit or vegetable to place on their plate. When the teacher called Kayla to take her favourite fruit or vegetable, she chose a corn first. During the sharing time, Kayla took the corn, showed it to her peers, and said, "I like corn." Then, she happily pretended to eat the corn with her peers and teacher.
interpretation: Kayla expressed a sense of self-identity by selecting her favourite fruit without other's influence. Her joy and enjoyment were evident throughout the activity while she engaged in learning through social interactions with her peers during the role-playing.

title: 小水滴找朋友
description:
在本次活动中，老师化身“水精灵”，用趣味手偶和魔法口袋吸引幼儿兴趣，引导他们先触摸感知物品的“软软”和“硬硬”，再将材料轻轻放入水中观察“浮起来”或“沉下去”。孩子们通过直观的感官操作与对比，发现不同材质的特性（如木头浮水、石头下沉、海绵吸水），在玩水游戏中自然建立对材料属性的初步认知，同时激发观察与提问的科学探索兴趣，为后续学习奠定基础。

𫖮恩在活动中表现出极大的兴趣。她首先选择了一个塑料香蕉模型，将其放入水中，发现它沉到了水底。她显得有些惊讶，很快又拿起一个木块玩具放入水里，观察到木块浮在水面。她皱起眉头，疑惑地问：“香蕉沉下去？”随后，她主动尝试更多材料进行测试，发现手指玩偶也能漂浮，而积木则有些沉下去。在教师的引导下，𫖮恩开始思考并提出新的问题：“硬硬的会沉下去？”教师向幼儿介绍浮力和密度的概念，𫖮恩认真听讲，并尝试用自己的语言复述：“硬硬的下面，软软的上面。”她在实验过程中不断尝试不同材质的玩具在水中的状态，并与同伴分享自己的发现，表现出较强的探索精神和学习兴趣。
interpretation: 𫖮恩在活动中展现了良好的自主探索能力，可以选择不同的材料去尝试和观察。较少受到干扰，能投入持续的注意、精力旺盛并坚持不懈的完成。过程中表现出快乐、自信、好奇和积极的互动。主动提出问题，探索后会用自己的语言尝试解释：“香蕉硬硬在下面，玩偶软软在上面。”展现了初步的科学探究能力。

learning_goals.title: Develop an understanding of the physical properties of materials through exploration (e.g. water play to understand how water flows differently through funnels etc.) 通过探索活动，如：观察水流动等，发展幼儿对材料属性的认识。

title: 帮助形状宝宝找妈妈
description: 下午以关系为本的课程活动时间，教师继续带领班级幼儿玩“帮形状宝宝找妈妈”的游戏。教师把方形宝宝妈妈和圆形宝宝妈妈的纸盒固定在矮柜上，把许多方形宝宝和圆形宝宝的纸皮卡片分散放在地毯上。教师说：“小朋友们，这些形状宝宝找不到妈妈啦，你能帮它们找到自己的妈妈吗？方形宝宝要找方形妈妈，圆形宝宝要找圆形妈妈哦。”献正笑着走过去，蹲在地毯边，小手在卡片中来回拨弄。他先是抓起一张圆形卡片，拿在手里翻来覆去地看，用手指沿着圆形的边缘摸了一圈。教师对他说：“献正，你看看这个卡片是什么形状呀？”献正抬头看着教师。教师说：“是圆形，圆形宝宝。它的妈妈也是圆形哦！”献正点点头，小声说：“圆圆。”发音虽然不太清晰，但能听出他的努力和认真。教师继续引导他说：“那你帮它找圆形妈妈吧！献正点点头，然后他拿着圆形宝宝走向贴有圆形妈妈图案的纸盒，尝试把卡片往洞里塞。一开始，卡片的角度不对，没有塞进去，献正皱了皱眉头，把卡片转了转，再次尝试，这次成功地将卡片塞进了洞里。教师夸奖他：“哇，献正你真棒，成功帮圆形宝宝找到妈妈啦！”献正听到教师的夸奖脸上露出了笑容。接着他走回地毯那里又拿起一张方形卡片，同样仔细地观察着。教师引导他说：“这是方形宝宝，它的妈妈也是方形。”献正看着手里的卡片小声模仿说：“方方”。教师问他说：“献正你要帮方形宝宝找妈妈吗？”他笑着点点头，拿起方形宝宝卡片，走向贴有方形妈妈图案的纸盒，然后把方形宝宝也放了进去。教师笑着为他鼓掌并夸奖他：“献正做的真棒，帮方形宝宝找到妈妈了。来，我们击掌！”听到教师的话献正伸出小手快速和教师击一下掌，然后笑着走回地毯上继续帮形状宝宝找妈妈，这个游戏他玩了很久。
interpretation: 通过观察可以看出献正对“帮形状宝宝找妈妈”的游戏很感兴趣，他对形状宝宝充满了好奇，主动地去拨弄、观察卡片。他用手摸卡片边缘、翻来覆去地看，这种探索行为是幼儿主动学习的表现，说明精心创设的活动环境成功激发了他的探索欲望。献正能够根据卡片的形状，准确地将圆形卡片送到圆形妈妈那里，方形卡片送到方形妈妈那里，这表明他已经能够感知和区分圆形和方形这两种不同的形状。当教师询问卡片形状时，他能模糊地模仿教师说出：“圆圆和方方”，说明他不仅能区分形状，还开始尝试学习用语言来表达对形状的认知，非常棒！通过这个活动，激发了献正的好奇心和探索精神，也促进了他初步建立了关于形状的数学概念。同时在整个活动过程中他也表现出了快乐、享受与轻松。

learning_goals.title: Foster curiosity and interest in a well-planned environment 通过精心创设的环境和互动，培养好奇心和探索精神。

title: 我们的新朋友-毛毛虫
description:
老师带着毛毛虫和茧来到幼儿园，鼓励幼儿观察这两种生物的特征，并在观察过程中引导幼儿使用工具仔细观察细节。看到毛毛虫后，婧瑜和其她幼儿纷纷围到老师身边，想要近距离观察。为了确保安全并提供更好的观察体验，老师请幼儿轮流进行观察。
当老师邀请婧瑜前来观察时，她迅速走到前面，首先将视线投向了盒子里一动不动的茧。为了方便婧瑜进行全方位的观察，老师将装有茧的盒子举起来。老师鼓励婧瑜使用放大镜来观察。婧瑜先将放大镜拿到眼前，老师引导她将放大镜靠近茧。婧瑜观察了一会儿茧后，她将视线转向了旁边装有毛毛虫的盒子。她将头凑近盒子，经过一番寻找后，终于在叶子中找到了毛毛虫。她抬头看向老师，指着毛毛虫说：“毛毛虫。”老师引导婧瑜更仔细地观察毛毛虫的身体特征。婧瑜观察后，与老师分享它的颜色：“绿色。”老师赞扬婧瑜：“你真棒，找到了毛毛虫，还观察到毛毛虫的颜色”。当她发现旁边朋友没看到毛毛虫的时候，她还伸手指出毛毛虫的位置给朋友看，笑着消除朋友的紧张。
interpretation: 婧瑜积极参与活动，在活动中不但展现了她的探索精神和不断提升的探索能力，也展现出了她对自然环境中生物的好奇和兴趣。

title: My Favourite Fruit/Vegetable
description: The children were invited for a role-playing activity where they select their favourite fruit or vegetable to place on their plate. Afterward, they will share or show their choices with peers while sitting at the table and pretending to eat together. When it was Emma's turn to take her favourite fruit or vegetable, she chose the corn first. During the sharing, Emma took the corn, showed it to her peers, and said,"Mmmmm, am am" while pretending to eat the corn. Then, she continued  pretending to eat her fruits and vegetables  with her peers and teacher.
interpretation: Emma expressed a sense of self-identity by selecting her favourite fruit without other's influence. Her joy and enjoyment were evident throughout the activity while she engaged in learning through social interactions with her peers during the role-playing.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self-concept and identity 初步培养自我概念和认同感，如：会说自己很棒。

title: Patterned Fabric Showcase
description:
Prior to this activity, the children were introduced to different fabric patterns from various cultures, such as stripes, florals, and geometric designs. They compared groups of fabrics based on attributes like “bright-colored with geometric shapes” versus “soft-textured with floral patterns.” The children closely observed these patterns and discussed their characteristics.

Building on these observations, the children were invited to create their own three-dimensional art, using fabric patterns as inspiration to explore textures and layering. They then engaged in making 3D collages, applying what they had learned about patterns and design.

Wei En was actively engaged in the collage-making process. She carefully selected pieces of patterned scrap paper for her design. After choosing her materials, Wei En was observed cutting them into long rectangles with the help of a teacher.

At one point, Wei En looked up and shared, “I’m making a pattern of red and green rectangles” Wei En continued working alongside a teacher and carefully placed each piece of cutout rectangles in an alternating pattern. 

Wei En also combined cutout shapes with hand-drawn designs using markers, adding another layer of pattern and detail to her artwork.
interpretation:
Wei En demonstrated confidence and independence in her creative process as she explored patterns, shapes, and textures in her collage. She carefully selected materials and experimented with different ways to arrange her cutout shapes, showing an emerging understanding of design and composition.


As she worked, Wei En experimented with pattern repetition. She extended her exploration and incorporated different elements, showing her ability to make artistic choices and connect different elements in her work.


Wei En combined cutout shapes with hand-drawn details, layering materials to add depth and texture. Through this process, Wei En was observed engaging in problem-solving, fine motor skill development, and creative expression. Providing opportunities to continue exploring textures, layering, and patterns will further support her confidence in artistic expression.

description:

当教师展示小鱼模型时，潩鍇仔细观察后，兴奋地拿起绳子开始尝试绕线。他用一只手拿着小鱼模型，另一只手的食指和拇指捏起绳子一边开始往小鱼身上缠线。刚开始，他的手指动作不太灵活，线容易松开或打结，她皱眉，显得有些困惑。但他并没有放弃，而是耐心地尝试调整，并主动看向教师说：“帮我。”教师微笑道：“试着一只手固定线，另一只手慢慢绕。”在教师的引导下，潩鍇学会了一手固定绳子，一手慢慢绕线，使绳子贴合小鱼的形状。当他成功绕完一圈时，露出自豪的笑容，并继续尝试将绳子绕得更均匀。教师问：“要再绕多一点吗？”他点头回答：“要。”点头继续，最终举起小鱼自豪地说：“我做好了！”
interpretation: 潩鍇在活动中展现了良好的自主探索能力，他能够主动尝试绕线，并在遇到困难时寻找解决办法。过程中能投入持续的注意、精力旺盛并坚持不懈的完成。展现了快乐、活力、好奇和积极的互动。他通过不断调整和实践，提高了自己的绕线技巧，在过程中锻炼了手眼协调能力，能用拇指和食指抓线并调整绕法。她遇到困难时会主动尝试和求助，展现出专注力和耐心，并乐于完成挑战。

title: Paper Quilling
description:
The children were introduced to the paper quilling technique as part of their preparation for K2. They learned how to use the paper quilling tool and attach strips of paper to it. Through this activity, they explored creating different shapes such as teardrops, crescents, and more by carefully manipulating and pressing the paper to form the desired shapes. Once they had mastered these techniques, they were able to place their designs on a piece of paper, creating their own unique artwork.

Jun He initially struggled with using the quilling tool but quickly realised that using his hands gave him better control. Once he made the switch, he was able to create multiple neat coils. He also successfully formed leaf shapes, demonstrating his adaptability and growing skill. To further support Jun He, encouraging him to continue experimenting with different techniques and shapes will help him refine his control and creativity even further. Offering him more opportunities to practice with both the tool and his hands will help him build confidence and skill.

learning_goals.title: Use strength, control and eye-hand coordination to accomplish tasks (e.g: place blocks on a structure withouth knowcking it down, tear paper into specific shapes to make a collage, fit pattern-blocks and tangrams into pre-drawn outlines, etc.).
Use writing & drawing tools with some control (e.g: hold writing materials with a comfortable grip, write a note that is neat, use a ruler with one hand and draw a line along with the other, etc.)

title: 照镜子
description: 早上，教师帮助定廷绑好头发后，定廷迈着欢快的小步子走到镜子前，好奇地盯着镜子里的自己，小手还不时地摸了摸自己绑好的头发。这时，教师走到定廷身边，用手指着镜子中的定廷，温和地问道：“这个漂亮的小女孩谁呀？”定廷转过头，看了看教师，又看了看镜子，然后清晰地说出了自己的名字：“Jamie。”教师说：“是定廷吗？”她用力的点点头，指着镜子中的自己说：“定廷。”接着，教师开始逐一询问定廷学习过的五官的位置。教师问：“定廷，你的眼睛在哪里呀？”定廷迅速地用手指向自己的眼睛说：“眼睛”；教师又问：“那你的鼻子呢？”定廷同样准确地指向了自己的鼻子说：“鼻子”。当教师问到嘴巴和耳朵时，定廷也都能快速且正确地做出回应，也能模仿说出嘴巴和耳朵。她的小脸上洋溢着自信的笑容。在定廷准确指出五官位置后，教师微笑着伸出大拇指夸奖她：“定廷，你太棒啦！能认识镜子中的自己，还能知道自己五官的位置。”定廷听到教师的夸奖，她毫不犹豫地伸出自己的大拇指，大声地说：“很棒！”随后，她又继续观察着镜子中的自己，时不时地动动嘴巴、眨眨眼睛。
interpretation: 定廷能够在教师指着镜子中的自己时，准确说出自己的名字，这表明她已经具备了一定的自我意识。她已经开始区分自己和他人，对自己有了初步的认知和定位。当教师逐一询问定廷五官的位置时，她都能正确指出来，这不仅体现了她对自己身体部位的认知，也进一步强化了她的自我概念。而当教师伸出大拇指夸奖她很棒时，定廷能够笑着伸出大拇指说自己很棒，这是她自我认同感发展的体现。定廷能够接受教师的夸奖并积极回应，表明她开始认可自己的能力和表现。在教师与定廷的互动过程中，她表现出了高度的快乐、自信享受与轻松。

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of self (responding to their names) 培养自我意识，如：回应自己的名字等。
Foster sense of self-concept and identity 初步培养自我概念和认同感，如：会说自己很棒。
Foster interactions, attachment and relationships with adults 通过与成人的互动，建立依恋和良好的关系。

title: My name (watercolor resist technique)
description:
During an art activity, Megan explored color mixing and creative expression. Using a white crayon, the teacher wrote her name on paper, and she painted over it with diluted blue and yellow paint. As Megan painted, her name was revealed, creating excitement and engagement. “See Teacher Michelle,” she exclaimed as she pointed at the letters. Megan was able to identify the colors and observe how they mixed to form green. Megan then questioned, "Got green. Why?" "Like little blue and little yellow?"

This activity fostered her interest in art by encouraging creativity, introducing basic color theory, and developing fine motor skills. It also provided Megan a sense of accomplishment and joy, reinforcing a positive experience with artistic exploration.

title: 插吸管游戏
description: 下午以关系为本的课程活动时间，教师为班级幼儿带来了一篮子各种颜色的吸管喝有很多孔洞的餐具桶。教师为幼儿介绍了插吸管游戏的玩法。教师对班级幼儿说：“小朋友们，谁要过来玩这个有趣的游戏，把这些漂亮的吸管一根一根插进餐具桶的洞洞里面呀？”定廷 被吸引过来，她好奇地看着这些物品。教师将吸管喝餐具同放到定廷面前，她迫不及待的坐下来，伸出右手用大拇指、食指及中指伸进篮子捏起一根蓝色吸管。定廷把吸管放到眼前看了看，然后把吸管对准餐具桶上方的孔，顺利的把吸管插入空洞中。她笑着看向教师说：“赵老师，see！”教师夸奖她：“定廷真棒，成功的把吸管插入餐具桶的孔洞中了！”听到教师的夸奖定廷笑着继续拿起一根吸管，重复刚才的动作。她的动作越来越快，插得越来越熟练。这时朋友也被吸引过来加入游戏。定廷愁起小眉头看着快被插满的餐具桶顶部，然后她握着吸管开始观察侧面的孔铜。定廷开始尝试把吸管插入侧面的孔洞，她的手臂有些晃动，吸管没有准确地对准孔，没有插入孔洞。教师鼓励她说：“定廷，别着急，你可以再调整一下吸管的角度，慢慢来。”定廷继续调整吸管的角度和自己手部的位置。终于，她成功地将吸管从餐具桶上方的孔插入了一点，但没有完全插进去。她又用力按了按，吸管顺利地插入了桶中。教师夸奖她说：“你太厉害了，定廷！不仅能从上面插入吸管，还能从侧面插进去！”定廷脸上露出了开心的笑容，之后，她不断地重复从侧面插入吸管的动作，越来越熟练。
interpretation: 通过观察可以看出定廷能够熟练运用大拇指、食指和中指抓握吸管，这表明她的精细动作和手部小肌肉群已经有了较好的发展，具备了很好的抓握能力。在插吸管的过程中，定廷始终专注地用眼睛观察吸管和餐具桶的孔，不断调整手部的动作和位置，以确保吸管能够准确地插入孔中。她不仅能把吸管从餐具桶顶部插入，还能从侧面插入，非常棒！通过插吸管的游戏，定廷的手部精细动作和手眼协调能力都得到了很好的锻炼。在整个游戏过程中，她也表现出了快乐、自信享受与轻松。

title: Crushing Dry Leaves
description: To help the children explore their environment, they gathered dry leaves during their outdoor walk and were invited to crush them with a pestle in class. During the activity, Emma picked up some dry leaves and placed them in a bowl. Gently, she began crushing them by pounding with a pestle. As she did, the teacher asked if she heard anything. Emma paused, then replied, "Crrrrshhhh." The teacher nodded and explained that dry leaves make a sound when crushed. Then, she encouraged Emma to use her hands to crush the leaves as well. Emma smiled and continued to crush the leaves using her hands and the pestle.
interpretation: Emma showed her interest and curiousity when she eagerly tried crushing the dry leaves with a pestle. She has displayed good observation skills and her ability to listen to sounds when she shared the sound of the leaves. Moreover, she demonstrated her fine motor skills as she used both the pestle and her hands to crush the leaves.

title: 贴五官
description: 下午以关系为本的课程活动时间，教师带领班级幼儿一起玩“贴五官”游戏。教师为幼儿介绍了布置在墙面上空白的娃娃的脸和各种五官图片并示范了游戏玩法。教师对班级幼儿说：“小朋友们，谁要过来玩这个有趣的游戏，为卡通娃娃贴上五官呀？”定廷听到教师的话后，小身子不停地往前凑。教师问她：“定廷你要来试试吗？”定廷笑着点头。她迅速走到放有五官图片的小盒子旁，小手在一堆图片中翻找着。她拿起一张眼睛的图片，仔细地看了看说：“Eyes。”教师询问她：“定廷要给娃娃贴上眼睛吗？”定廷用力地点点头模仿说：“眼睛。”她拿着眼睛图片粘贴到娃娃的脸上。教师夸奖她：“定廷贴的真棒！”她笑着继续找到另外一只眼睛也贴了上去，然后抬头看向教师。教师继续引导她：“定廷真棒，把两只眼睛贴好了！现在我们再来找找鼻子和嘴巴吧。”定廷受到鼓励后，更加积极地投入到活动中。她先在图片堆里翻找出嘴巴的图片，然后把它粘贴上去。紧接着定廷又找到了鼻子的图片粘贴娃娃的脸上。贴好后她她又仔细看了看，发现娃娃的嘴巴歪了，她把嘴巴拿下来调整好位置后重新粘贴上去。定廷笑着指着娃娃的脸看向教师说：“老师，老师，see！”。教师及时表扬她：“定廷真棒，把鼻子和嘴巴都贴好了！”教师继续问她：“那定廷的小鼻子在哪里呢？”定廷笑着指了指自己的鼻子说：“here，鼻子。”教师说：“对了，定廷知道自己的小鼻子在哪里，太厉害了！我们来击掌吧！”定廷笑着跟教师击掌，然后走开看同伴继续玩这个游戏。
interpretation: 在活动中定廷展现出了强烈的好奇心。她先是主动靠近，得到教师的允许后，她又立刻去翻找五官图片开始玩游戏，都表明定廷对这个活动充满了兴趣和探索的欲望。通过参与贴五官活动，她有机会去触摸、观察和摆弄各种图片，进一步激发了她对周围事物的探索热情。定廷能够模仿说出“眼睛”和“鼻子”等词语，并且将对应的图片与词语联系起来，这说明晋僖已经开始理解图片、物体与词语之间的关系。她还能根据教师提问准确的指出自己鼻子正确的位置。在整个活动过程中，定廷表现出高度的自信、快乐和享受，非常棒！

title: Paper Quilling
description:
The children were introduced to the paper quilling technique as part of their preparation for K2. They learned how to use the paper quilling tool and attach strips of paper to it. Through this activity, they explored creating different shapes such as teardrops, crescents, and more by carefully manipulating and pressing the paper to form the desired shapes. Once they had mastered these techniques, they were able to place their designs on a piece of paper, creating their own unique artwork.

Alaric initially struggled with using the quilling tool, so he switched to using his hands, which allowed him to create coils that were neat and well-formed. He also displayed creativity by experimenting with different shapes, including a cone shape. To support Alaric further, encouraging him to continue practicing with the tool while refining his hand movements will help him gain more control. Providing additional opportunities for him to explore different shapes and techniques will further enhance his quilling skills and boost his confidence.

title: 识字游戏
description: 恩绮参与了以绘本《朱家故事》为主题的词语识字游戏。游戏开始时，老师在课室地面上摆放了多个三角锥，每个三角锥上都贴有与绘本《朱家故事》相关的词语卡片。恩绮手持呼啦圈，并将其套在三角锥上的词语卡片上，她成功地套中了“洗衣服”、“一封信”和“收玩具”三张词语卡。她认真地观察三角锥上的词语卡片后，走到字图配区，在该区域中寻找与这些词语卡片相对应的图片。恩绮首先找到了与“收玩具”相关的图片，并将词语卡与图片配对，随后举起卡片说：“我帮弟弟收玩具。”然后，她继续寻找“一封信”和“洗衣服”相关的图片，并将它们配对成功后，举起两张卡片，说：“我帮妈妈洗衣服。”
interpretation: 在活动中，恩绮能够正确的认读绘本《朱家故事》中出现的词语，能够理解词语的含义，并能将词语与对应图片进行配对。恩绮还能结合自己的生活经验使用词语仿造句子。

title: 音乐节奏练习
description:
在日常课程活动中——音乐律动活动中，老师带领小朋友们进行音乐律动的练习，老师播放一段节奏感较强的音乐律动，请小朋友们利用乐器进行节奏节拍的练习。老师为小朋友们准备了沙蛋和响板两种乐器，老师首先向小朋友们介绍乐器名称。老师出示“沙蛋”和“响板”，义凯坐在地板上跟着老师说“沙蛋”，“响板”。
   接着，老师介绍了怎样进行打节奏的方式。然后老师初次播放音乐，请小朋友们自由欣赏，可以拍手可以点头感受节奏节拍，老师手拿响板进行示范。接下来老师分享乐器，请小朋友们利用乐器再次听音乐，打节奏。义凯拿到了响板，老师提问小朋友们拿到了哪些乐器，义凯说：“我拿的是响板。”老师说：“很棒！”老师开始播放音乐，义凯用左手拿着响板，大拇指在响板的上方，其余四根手指在响板的下面，然后义凯跟着音乐的节奏，一边听一边跟着节奏打向响板。接着，老师说：“请小朋友们交换乐器，再来一次。”小朋友们交换乐器后，老师问：“这一次小朋友们拿到的是什么乐器啊？”义凯大声说：“我的乐器是沙蛋。”老师笑着点了点头。老师再次播放音乐，义凯将乐器沙蛋握在手里，一边听音乐，一边跟着节奏上下摇动。
interpretation: 老师观察到义凯小朋友能够听着音乐区分简单的节奏和节拍，能够用不同的乐器尝试演奏不同的韵律形式。能够认识普通打击乐器的名称。

learning_goals.title: 能区分简单的节奏和节拍：复制老师的节奏形式。
能区分简单的节奏和节拍：用3-5种打击乐器尝试演奏不同韵律形式。

title: Talents Through Global Art
description:
Inspired by the story The Dot by Peter Reynolds, the teacher transformed the classroom into an “International Art Museum,” showcasing reproductions of famous artworks from around the world. The children were captivated by the diverse artwork displayed through the Google Arts and Culture App.

A discussion ensued as the teacher introduced the concept of art as a reflection of people’s unique talents and abilities. While exploring the skills required to create different paintings, Abhigyan shared, "They need to know how to draw in detail and paint in small spaces with the detailing brush."

Motivated by the artworks he had observed, Abhigyan created his own art piece on paper. He demonstrated an understanding of positioning by drawing a person in the foreground and adding additional elements in the background. Additionally, he used contrasting colors to make the figures in the foreground stand out, showcasing his awareness of visual composition and artistic techniques.
interpretation:
Abhigyan demonstrates an emerging awareness of global artworks and artistic techniques. Through his engagement with the International Art Museum activity, he observed and reflected on different styles of art, recognising the skills required to create detailed paintings. His comment about using a detailing brush highlights his developing understanding of artistic tools and techniques.


Inspired by the artworks he explored, Abhigyan applied key artistic concepts in his own creation, such as positioning elements in the foreground and background and using contrasting colors for emphasis. This indicates his ability to analyse and incorporate artistic techniques into his work. His engagement with art from different cultures supports his growing appreciation of diverse artistic expressions and fosters his creativity in exploring new styles and methods.

title: Work Sample - Global Art
description:
Learning Objectives:

- Children will explore and create artworks inspired by global cultures, appreciating the talents and skills involved in creating them. 

- Children experiment with different tools to create pieces of art. 

Elements of Art: Colours, Shapes, Lines

Our classroom transformed into an "International Art Museum," where the children explored various art styles from different cultures. title: 我认识我的家人，我很棒！
description: 上午午以关系为本的课程活动时间，教师拿出班级幼儿的家庭照片逐一展示。当出示到义泽的家庭照片时，教师问：“这是谁的家庭照片？”原本安静坐着的义泽脸上露出开心的笑容，他用力地点了点头，然后迅速站起来，跑向教师。教师问：“这是义泽的家庭照片吗？”义泽笑着点点头，然后伸出手抓向照片。教师微笑着把照片交给义泽。义泽拿着照片坐了下来，笑着看着照片。教师开始引导他认识照片里的人物。教师问：“义泽的爸爸在哪里？”义泽笑着用小手指向照片里的爸爸说：“爸爸”。教师又问：“妈妈在哪里？”义泽同样准确地指出了妈妈的位置，还一边笑着指向照片里的妈妈一边模仿说：“妈妈，妈妈”。接着，教师又指着照片里的哥哥问：“义泽这个是谁呀？”义泽笑着说：“Isaiah”。教师继续引导他说：“是你的哥哥义慈吗？”他回答说：“哥哥，义慈。”教师继续问他：“那义泽在哪里呀？”义泽趴下身子仔细看着照片，然后毫不犹豫地用手指向照片中自己的位置，脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容。他笑着看向教师说：“老师，see，here”。这时，教师鼓掌夸奖他：“义泽太棒了，知道自己和自己的家人！”义泽听到夸奖后，也跟着开心地拍手，还模仿教师说：“棒！”
interpretation: 通过观察可以看出义泽乐于参与教师组织的华文课程活动。当教师出示义泽的家庭照片时，他能认出是自己的家庭照片。当教师叫他的名字时，义泽能够通过点头、跑向教师等行为积极回应。这些表明他已经具备了一定的自我意识，能够将自己与家庭照片联系起来，认识到照片中的家庭是自己的家庭，自己是这个家庭中的一员。这种对自身所属关系的认知是自我意识发展的重要体现。义泽能够在照片中准确指出爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和自己的位置，说明他对自己的家庭成员有清晰的认知，这有助于他构建完整的自我概念。而当教师夸奖他很棒时，义泽能够模仿说“棒”，并表现出开心的情绪，说明他初步形成了自我认同感。同时，在整个活动过程中他也表现出了快乐、自信享受与轻松。

title: 探索自然区域-木头堆叠搭建
description: 在区角活动时间，义泽来到自然区域探索。他走向装有石头、贝壳和木头段三种自然物品的篮子，伸出双手将篮子拿了起来，然后走到旁边坐下。他先是静静观察着篮子里的物品。很快，义泽的注意力被木头段吸引住了，小手拿起木头段，开始尝试把它们叠放搭建在一起。教师走到义泽身边问他：“义泽你要把木头叠放在一起堆得高高的吗？”义泽笑着点头说：“高高的！”很快义泽便成功的把两块木头段叠放在一起了。教师夸奖他说：“义泽做的真棒，成功的把两块木头地方在一起了！”义泽笑着继续拿起木头段搭建，当他放第四块后木头却倒塌了。教师温柔地鼓励他：“义泽，没关系，我们再试一次。”听到老师的话，义泽开始继续尝试重新搭建。这次他小心翼翼拿起一段木头，用另外一只手护着慢慢堆叠上去。他做的认真而专注，一段一段的慢慢堆叠。当发现木块不稳摇晃时，他尝试调整木头段放的位置，等平稳后再放下一段木头。经过努力，义泽终于把木头段都搭在一起，搭成了高高的形状。他开心地笑着指着自己的成果向教师展示，说道：“老师！老师！see！”教师笑着为他鼓掌并夸奖他：“义泽，你太棒啦，搭建得好高！”得到教师的夸奖后，义泽也笑着拍手为自己鼓掌。接着义泽把搭建好的木头推倒，又开始重新搭建。这个游戏他玩了好几次，还尝试着把自然区域的其他材料放到搭建好的木头上。
interpretation: 义泽在区角活动中自主选择了自然区域，并对篮子里的自然物品表现出浓厚的兴趣。他主动观察物品，尤其是对木头段产生特别的关注，这体现了他强烈的好奇心和探索欲。义泽在搭建木头段的过程中，尽管遇到了倒塌的挫折，但他并没有放弃，而是在教师的鼓励下重新尝试。他能够长时间专注于搭建活动，不断尝试探索，最终成功搭建出高高的形状。义泽还将搭建好的成品推倒，反复进行搭建活动，还尝试将其他自然材料放到木头上。非常棒！通过这个活动，义泽的专注力和持续参与能力都得到了很好的锻炼。在整个活动过程中，他也表现出高度的自信、快乐和享受，非常棒！

title: 游乐场玩滑梯
description: 上午游乐场时间，教师带领班级幼儿来到游乐场。义泽和同伴一起笑着跑进游乐场，随后他选择了玩滑梯。他快速走到滑梯前，眼睛专注地看着楼梯，双手稳稳地抓住楼梯两侧的扶手。先是抬起右脚，小心翼翼地踩在第一节台阶上，接着左脚也跟了上来。他一步一步，迈着小小的步伐，双手随着脚步的移动有节奏地交替抓着扶手，慢慢向上攀爬。这时，教师走过来问他：“你要爬到滑梯上面去吗？”义泽转过头，脸上露出灿烂的笑容，用力地点了点头，同时模仿着说：“上去。”很快他就成功爬到了滑梯顶部。到达顶部后，他慢慢坐了下来，小屁股稳稳地贴在滑梯面上，双手还下意识地抓着滑梯边缘。教师看到后夸奖他：“义泽真棒，爬到滑梯上面去了。”义泽听到夸奖，开心地笑了笑，但依旧坐着不动。过了一会儿，后面有小朋友也爬了上来。教师鼓励他：“义泽你可以的，放开手滑下去。”义泽犹豫了一下，慢慢松开滑梯边缘，身体顺着滑梯开始下滑。他又伸出一只手抓住滑梯边缘，慢慢的滑下去。教师再次夸奖他：“义泽真棒，你滑下来了。”就在这时，教师看到其他小朋友也要滑下来，便提醒义泽：“快点站起来走开，同伴要滑下来了。”义泽听到后，迅速翻身，双手撑着滑梯，努力让自己站了起来。站稳后，他又笑着跑去滑梯的楼梯口，准备再次攀爬。
interpretation: 义泽在攀爬滑梯的过程中，能够双手抓着扶手，交替使用双脚向上攀爬，这表明他的上肢和下肢肌肉力量以及动作协调性有了一定的发展。在滑滑梯时，他能够听从教师的鼓励，放开手滑下去，并且在下滑过程中保持尝试保持身体的平衡，这进一步体现了他在粗大动作控制方面的能力提升。当教师提醒他站起来走开时，他能够迅速做出反应，翻身并用双手撑着滑梯站起来，这进一步体现了他对身体动作的控制和协调能力。在攀爬到滑梯上和滑下滑梯的过程中，义泽能在教师的引导下感知“上”和“下”的空间概念。通过滑滑梯的活动，义泽的粗大动作、身体各部位的感知协调能力和空间知觉都得到了很好的锻炼。同时，在整个活动过程中，他表现出高度的活力、快乐和享受，非常棒！

learning_goals.title: Foster gross motor development (walk, run, jump, bend, kick, throw, etc.) 发展粗大动作，如：走、跑、双脚跳、弯腰、踢、丢球等。
Develop a sense of body parts and coordination (mimic simple body actions like lifting arms and legs) 发展身体部位的感知和协调能力，如：能模仿简单的身体动作（举手、抬脚）。
Develop spatial awareness (move around an object without knocking onto it, navigate between spaces) 发展空间知觉，如：能绕着障碍物跑，而不会碰到东西。

title: Emotion Garden
description: While exploring the topic of feelings, the class had the opportunity to create emotion-themed flowers by using white crepe paper and choosing a colour to paint their flower to represent a specific emotion (e.g. yellow for happiness) thereafter. After the teacher's demonstration, Ivy showed independence and  meticulousness as she pinched every single layer of crepe paper between her fingers and then slowly raising it upwards to create the flower dome shape. She then shared that she wanted to use a purple colour for her flower as it was her favourite colour. During the painting process, Ivy was dedicated to ensure that most of the white crepe paper flower was covered in purple paint. When asked to share why she chose the colour purple, she mentioned, "It is my favourite colour, it makes me happy."
interpretation: Ivy's active engagement in shaping the crepe paper to resemble a flower, demonstrated her emerging awareness of nature and how organic forms can be recreated through art. Her meticulous approach to lifting each layer reflects her understanding of how flowers bloom and take shape. By selecting purple to represent happiness, Ivy showcased her ability to associate colours with emotions- reinforcing her awareness of how colours are used in both nature and art to convey meaning. Ivy showcased a keen awareness of artistic processes by carefully applying paint to ensure full coverage of her flower. This attention to detail reflects her growing appreciation for how objects, textures, and colours can interwine in artistic creation. Ivy’s decision to use her favourite colour and her explanation of why it made her happy indicate her ability to connect her personal emotions with her artistic choices, illustrating her understanding of how her art is a reflection of her personal thoughts and feelings.

learning_goals.title: Be aware of nature, objects, and art works around them.

title: 词语识字游戏
description: 珺璘参与了以绘本《朱家故事》为主题的词语认字游戏。游戏开始时，老师在课室地面上摆放了多个三角锥，每个三角锥上都贴有与绘本《朱家故事》相关的词语卡片。珺璘手持呼啦圈，并将其套在三角锥上的词语卡片上，她成功地套中了“洗碗”、“做早餐”和“洗衣服”三张词语卡。她认真地观察三角锥上的词语卡片后，走到字图配区，在该区域中寻找与这些词语卡片相对应的图片。珺璘首先找到了与“做早餐”相关的图片，并将词语卡与图片配对，随后举起卡片说：“我帮妈妈做早餐。”然后，她继续寻找“洗碗”和“洗衣服”相关的图片，并将它们配对成功后，举起两张卡片，说：“我帮妈妈洗碗。”
interpretation: 在活动中，珺璘能够正确的认读绘本《朱家故事》中出现的词语，能够理解词语的含义，并能将词语与对应图片进行配对。珺璘还能结合自己的生活经验使用词语仿造句子。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（说）- 交谈：乐意用华语与人交谈。
语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能清楚表达自己的意愿。
语言学习成果（读）- 认字：有认字的积极性。

title: Story Sequencing : Picture and Text Matching
description:
Prior to this Lit Attack activity, the children had been introduced to the story The Hole in the Ground. This time, they were invited to participate in a picture-matching activity based on the book. Ethan and his peer opened an envelope containing several pictures from the story along with corresponding text from the pages. Ethan's task was to match the text to the correct picture.

Ethan examined each picture carefully before placing them in sequence. “Wait, not like that. This one comes first. Let’s put it first,” he remarked as he adjusted the order. He was observed placing the first picture on the left side of the table and positioning the subsequent pictures in a linear sequence. He continued to rearrange them until he was satisfied with the correct order.

Next, it was time to match the text to the pictures. Ethan adopted the strategy of referencing the guided reader book, closely examining the text to find corresponding text cards. He engaged in discussions with his peer, making thoughtful comparisons before proceeding to match the text cards accurately as they worked through the activity.
interpretation:
Ethan continues to demonstrate an understanding of sequencing as he arranges the story pictures in the correct order. His ability to recognise the logical progression of events reflects his growing comprehension of the story. By verbalising his thought process and making adjustments, Ethan shows confidence in organising visual information to construct a coherent story.


Ethan was observed applying problem-solving strategies when matching text to pictures. His approach of referencing the guided reader book indicates an awareness of print concepts and an understanding that text carries meaning.


Through discussions with his peer, Ethan actively engages in collaborative learning, reinforcing his ability to compare visual and textual information. These skills contribute to his overall literacy development, supporting both reading comprehension and early fluency.

learning_goals.title: Comprehension: Use strategies to construct meaning from print.

title: Emotion Garden
description: While exploring the topic of feelings, the class had the opportunity to create emotion-themed flowers by using white crepe paper and choosing a colour to paint their flower to represent a specific emotion (e.g. yellow for happiness) thereafter. After observing the teacher's demonstration, Arielle displayed independence and attention to detail as she carefully pinched each layer of crepe paper between her fingers, slowly lifting them to create a full, dome-shaped flower. Arielle then told the teacher that she wanted to paint her flower pink. She went on to try painting every inch of white space pink and would even carefully hold up the layer of crepe paper to steady it while she painted it concurrently. By selecting pink and associating it with love, Arielle showed an awareness of how colors can convey different feelings. This demonstrates her emerging ability to apply symbolic meanings in her artwork. Her careful effort to paint every inch of her flower pink, as well as her technique of steadying the crepe paper while painting, highlights her attentiveness to the creative process too. Through this hands-on activity, Arielle was able to actively engage with artistic materials and deepen her awareness of how objects, nature (flowers), and artworks serve as forms of creative expression.

title: Work Sample - Global Art
description:
Learning Objectives:

- Children will explore and create artworks inspired by global cultures, appreciating the talents and skills involved in creating them. 

- Children experiment with different tools to create pieces of art. 

Elements of Art: Colours, Shapes, Lines

Our classroom transformed into an "International Art Museum," where the children explored various art styles from different cultures. They were introduced to famous artistic techniques such as Aboriginal dot painting, African tribal masks, Mexican papel picado, European impressionism and Abstract. Through this experience, the children learned that art is not just about creating something beautiful but is also a way to express ideas, emotions, and stories.

Esther tried out the Impressionism technique, and she described her artwork as "This is big fat people house. I draw the sky and the sun."

learning_goals.title: Be aware of a variety of artworks from other parts of the world.
Describe and discuss what they see, think and feel about a variety of artworks.

title: Story Sequencing : Picture and Text Matching
description:
Prior to this Lit Attack activity, the children had been introduced to the story The Hole in the Ground. This time, they were invited to participate in a picture-matching activity based on the book. Maia and her peer opened an envelope containing several picture puzzles from the story. Maia's task was to complete the puzzle while discussing the order of the completed picture puzzles in the story. 

Maia examined each puzzle part carefully before picking up a few matching puzzle pieces. “Arielle, we share ok. I will do two and you can do two also.” Maia was observed working quietly as she proceeded to piece the first puzzle together. Maia checked that the puzzle piece was connected correctly before announcing, "I got it! I got the first one. This is the page where they said, 'They dug a big hole in the ground.' Right? Let me do one more." 

Maia continued to complete the second puzzle. She waited for her partner to complete her puzzle before they went on to discuss about the sequence of these pictures in the story.
interpretation: Maia demonstrates sequencing skills and an understanding of the story structure by organising and matching images from the story. She engages in collaborative problem-solving, taking turns and negotiating roles with her peer, which supports both social and language development. Maia's ability to verbally recall a key phrase from the book while completing the puzzle shows her growing comprehension and memory of story events. Her attention to detail in ensuring the puzzle pieces fit correctly reflects an increasing awareness of visual cues and print concepts. Through this activity, Maia is strengthening her ability to connect images with text, an essential pre-reading skill that supports narrative understanding and early literacy development.

learning_goals.title: Comprehension: Use strategies to construct meaning from print.

title: My name (watercolor resist technique)
description:
During an art activity, Zixi explored color mixing and creative expression. Using a white crayon, the teacher wrote her name on paper, and she painted over it with diluted blue and yellow paint. As Zixi painted, her name was revealed, creating excitement and engagement. “Can you see your name?” asked her teacher. Zixi smiled and nodded as her teacher pointed at the letters. 

This activity fostered her interest in art by encouraging creativity, introducing basic color theory, and developing fine motor skills. It also provided Zixi a sense of accomplishment and joy, reinforcing a positive experience with artistic exploration.

title: Block Play
description:
Talia was actively engaged in block play, working alongside her friends to build different structures. She focused on constructing a boat using Lego blocks, carefully selecting and stacking pieces. As she was building, Aaron noticed her creation and picked up extra blocks to contribute. Talia looked at Aaron and said, “Thank you, Aaron!” as she used the blocks to expand her boat.

While working on her structure, Talia also observed what her friends were doing. She saw Cavill assembling a house using brown blocks. Recognising that he needed more pieces, Talia walked over to the block area, gathered several brown blocks, and brought them to Cavill, saying, “Here, more brown blocks for your house.” She then returned to her boat and continued building.
interpretation: Through this experience, Talia demonstrated collaborative play, social awareness, and an emerging sense of teamwork. She was not only engaged in her own construction but also acknowledged her friends’ work by offering support and materials when needed. Her ability to communicate with her peers and express appreciation reflects her growing confidence in social interactions and her sense of belonging in the group.

learning_goals.title: Foster sense of belonging in a group 发展幼儿的集体归属感，如：能说出自己的小组或班级的名称等。

title: Block Play
description:
Cavill noticed his friends building a boat with Lego blocks and decided to join in. He eagerly sat at the front of the structure and announced, “I am captain!” as he pretended to steer the boat. Looking around, he found some spoons and forks on the floor near the play area. He picked up a spoon and secured it to the front of the boat, moving it side to side like a steering wheel. He said, “Choo choo! The boat is moving!” as he pretended to navigate the boat across the room.

After setting up his “steering wheel,” Cavill turned to his friends and invited them to join, saying, “Jing Xi, seat on the boat” He watched as a few friends climbed onto the structure and laughed together as they pretended to sail away.

His ability to initiate and extend play with friends shows his growing confidence in group interactions and his sense of belonging within the play environment.

title: 制作小书
description:
为了增强晨然用力量控制手眼协调能力来完成任务的技能，所以我们开展了本次的活动。老师在本次活动里老师为晨然提供了白纸、剪刀。
活动中晨然拿到纸以后，老师一边说一边示范到：“我们第一步先对折，将纸的这两边对整齐。”晨然一边看着老师的动作一边将纸的两边靠拢、重叠，这时她问到：“是这样吗？”老师赞扬到：“是这样的，晨然做得很好两条边对折得很整齐。”随后晨然一只手捏着纸张重叠的位置，一只手去按压纸的另一边。通过手指的按压力量让纸连续对折三次后，老师示范到：“现在我们需要用剪刀沿着中间的线去剪，当剪到一半的位置时就停下来。”晨然随后很快用右手的大拇指和右手的食指中指分别放进剪刀的手把处，然后眼睛专注的看着纸上的线条，再将剪刀靠近线条上开始了开合开合的动作，很快晨然便使用小手的力量去控制剪刀，完成了剪纸的任务。完成任务后，老师赞扬到：“晨然的小书做得真好，又可以站又可以关起来。”晨然笑着回应到：“我现在要去画我的小书了。”
interpretation:
在本次的活动中晨然不仅能够用小手的力量将纸对折起来，也能有力的使用剪刀，最后通过手部力量控制手眼协调能力沿着线条将纸剪开。

除此以外，晨然也能够在活动中建立正面的自我认知，培养完成简单任务的自信心。

learning_goals.title: 用力量控制手眼协调能力来完成任务：利用小肌肉技能来使用小设备，如：拉链、扣子、 粗蜡笔和马克笔等。

title: Self-Portrait
description: While exploring the topic of 'Who Am I', the children were given the opportunity to create a simple self-portrait using a variety of art mediums, including pencil, markers, and watercolour paint. After looking at the teacher's drawing of a boy on a whiteboard, Diyansh was able to follow in recreating similar shapes and lines to represent the features of a face and body. He was able to add details such as a separation of a shirt and pants for the body and straight lines on the head to represent hair. Afterwards, Diyansh was able to independently trace his pencil drawing accurately using a zebra marker. During the painting stage, Diyansh used a variety of colours to fill in the different parts of his drawing such as hair, face, shirt, pants and shoes.
interpretation: Diyansh's use of a variety of art suppliesto create his self-portrait showcased that he was willing to explore and experiment with different materials to express his ideas and refine his artwork. By recreating the teacher's drawing and adding details like the separation of a shirt and pants, Diyansh displayed his emerging skill to experiment with different shapes and lines to represent different features of the human form. During the painting stage, Diyansh experimented with different colours for various parts of his portrait, such as his hair, face, shirt, pants, and shoes. This not only exhibited his creativity but also his understanding of how paint can be used to highlight different areas of the artwork and bring it to life.

learning_goals.title: Experiment with a variety of media (e.g. marker, crayon, paint, chalk, play dough)

title: Block Play
description:
Levi noticed his friends singing “Ring a Ring o’ Roses” while stacking blocks and joined in. He picked up scattered blocks and built a tall tower. As the teacher sang “All fall down,” Levi pushed over his structure and said, “Oh no! All fall down”

He quickly gathered the blocks and built again, waiting for the song’s cue to knock them down. Each time, he watched his friends, saying, “All Fall Down” before toppling his tower along with them. Levi repeated this process, enjoying the game and engaging with his peers.
interpretation: Through this experience, Levi demonstrated participation in group play. His actions reflected his sense of belonging as he actively engaged in the game with his friends.

title: 蜗牛与色块
description:
建立在老师与幼儿已经共同阅读过绘本的基础上，幼儿对蜗牛五彩的壳非常感兴趣，因此我们来请幼儿亲身体验，如何创作出蜗牛五彩的壳。老师为幼儿准备了画纸，上面画了蜗牛的身体一部分和不同形状颜色的色块，接下来请幼儿尝试拼贴。老师引导幼儿思考蜗牛的壳是什么形状并且大概在蜗牛身体的什么地方，可以选择自己喜欢的色块，使用胶棒去进行拼贴。
当老师邀请绵胜来体验的时候，绵胜非常主动地去盒子里面寻找自己喜欢的色块，一个一个的放在卡纸上，之后老师提供给绵胜胶棒，绵胜右手大拇指和食指捏住胶棒其余手指进行辅助，左手拿住马上要粘贴的色块卡纸，很准确的将胶棒附到色块卡纸上，使得卡纸具有粘性。于是绵胜将色块卡纸放在自己喜欢的位置，在过程中绵胜选择不同的颜色和不同的位置，逐步创造自己独一无二的蜗牛彩色壳。
interpretation: 在过程中，绵胜很主动很开心地去参与活动内容，绵胜去拼贴的过程中可以发展对颜色的审美和搭配，同时培养绵胜对艺术的兴趣。

title: Story Sequencing : Picture and Text Matching
description:
Prior to this Lit Attack activity, the children had been introduced to the story The Hole in the Ground. This time, they were invited to participate in a picture-matching activity based on the book. Charis and her peer opened an envelope containing several pictures from the story along with corresponding text from the pages. Charis' task was to match the text to the correct picture.

Charis examined each picture carefully before placing them in sequence. She was also observed discussing the sequence of the story with her partner. Charis placed the first picture on the left side of the table and positioning the subsequent pictures in a linear sequence. She continued to rearrange them until she was satisfied with the correct order.

Next, it was time to match the text to the pictures. Charis read the word cards independently. "This one says  'what will it be'." Charis continue engaging in discussions with her partner, making thoughtful comparisons before proceeding to match the text cards accurately as they worked through the activity.
interpretation:
Charis continues to demonstrate an understanding of sequencing as she arranges the story pictures in the correct order. Her ability to recognise the logical progression of events reflects her growing comprehension of the story. By verbalising her thought process and making adjustments, Charis shows confidence in organising visual information to construct a coherent story.

Charis was observed applying problem-solving strategies when matching text to pictures. Her approach of referencing the guided reader book indicates an awareness of print concepts and an understanding that text carries meaning.

Through discussions with her peer, Charis actively engages in collaborative learning, reinforcing her ability to compare visual and textual information. These skills contribute to her overall literacy development, supporting both reading comprehension and early fluency.

learning_goals.title: Comprehension: Use strategies to construct meaning from print.

title: Texured Board
description:
Tyrell was actively engaged with the textured board, exploring the different surfaces, tubes, and boxes. He picked up small objects like banana and carrots, dropping them into the tubes and watching how they traveled from top to bottom. As more children joined in, the space became crowded, and Tyrell was unable to find space to continue playing comfortably.

Tyrell approached the teacher and said, “See, I no space.” The teacher encouraged him to let his friends know that he was still playing and to invite them to return in five minutes. Tyrell followed the teacher’s advice and then returned to the textured board.

As he resumed playing, Tyrell picked up different objects and continued placing them into the tubes, observing how they moved. When his friends returned, he made space and welcomed them back.
interpretation: Through this experience, Tyrell demonstrated his ability to seek help in a social situation. He showed an understanding of express his needs and include his friends in play.

description:
Linus was invited to the self-help skill activity, where he had the opportunity to choose from three bags. After selecting a bag, he unzipped it and looked inside to see what was inside. As he explored the contents, he took an interest in a small fitted sheet designed for practicing bed-making.

Once he was done, he clapped for himself.
interpretation: Through this experience, Linus demonstrated his ability to make independent choices based on his interests. Linus showed a sense of self-concept and identify by expressiong his likes, interests and opinions freely.

title: 环保材料制作机器人
description: 在学习《朱家故事》时，老师引导幼儿讨论如何利用环保废旧材料制作一个机器人。怡恩带来了纸卷筒和不同大小的纸盒。老师询问怡恩想做什么样的机器人时，怡恩表示她要做一个能做草莓蛋糕的机器人。随后，怡恩开始动手制作。她将一个大纸盒立起来，再在上面放上一个小长方体纸盒，并用胶带将两个纸盒固定在一起。怡恩一边用手指着纸盒，一边告诉老师：“这个是机器人的身体，这是机器人的头。”接着，怡恩用纸卷筒粘贴在机器人的身体两侧，表示这是机器人的手，并告诉老师：“我的机器人做好了，这是机器人的手，可以做蛋糕。”老师拍手称赞道“怡恩好有创意啊，用纸盒和纸卷筒做出了一个会做蛋糕的机器人，真是太厉害啦！”怡恩笑着点点头对老师说“你要吃蛋糕吗？我的机器人可以给你做草莓蛋糕。”
interpretation: 在制作机器人的活动中，怡恩不仅能够将环保废旧材料，如纸盒和纸卷筒，巧妙地转化为一个机器人，还能结合自己的想法，为机器人赋予特定功能——能够做草莓蛋糕。这表明怡恩具备很好的想象力，能够将日常生活中的物品与个人兴趣相结合，创造出具有实际意义的物品。同时，在制作过程中，怡恩也能使用华语与老师沟通，分享自己的想法。

learning_goals.title: 语言学习成果（说）- 表达：能清楚表达自己的意愿。
语言学习成果（说）- 说华语：基本能坚持说华语。
使用多种材料以获得感知经验和探索体会。
描述和说明他们在艺术作品中的想法和构思，开始有意识地把各种艺术元素组织在一起，创造出艺术视觉表现，如：用颜色表达情感；用线条营造动感；用模板创作各种图案。

title: 蜗牛与色块
description:
建立在老师与幼儿已经共同阅读过绘本的基础上，幼儿对蜗牛五彩的壳非常感兴趣，因此我们来请幼儿亲身体验，如何创作出蜗牛五彩的壳。老师为幼儿准备了画纸，上面画了蜗牛的身体一部分和不同形状颜色的色块，接下来请幼儿尝试拼贴。老师引导幼儿思考蜗牛的壳是什么形状并且大概在蜗牛身体的什么地方，可以选择自己喜欢的色块，使用胶棒去进行拼贴。
当老师邀请尹熙来体验的时候，尹熙非常主动地去盒子里面寻找自己喜欢的色块，一个一个的放在卡纸上，之后老师提供给尹熙胶棒，尹熙右手大拇指和食指捏住胶棒其余手指进行辅助，左手拿住马上要粘贴的色块卡纸，很准确的将胶棒附到色块卡纸上，使得卡纸具有粘性。于是尹熙将色块卡纸放在自己喜欢的位置，在过程中尹熙选择不同的颜色和不同的位置，逐步创造自己独一无二的蜗牛彩色壳。
interpretation: 在过程中，尹熙很主动地去参与活动内容，在尹熙去拼贴的过程中可以发展尹熙对颜色的审美和搭配，同时培养尹熙对艺术的兴趣。

title: Self Help Skill
description:
Asher was invited to the self-help skill activity and was given the opportunity to choose from three bags. After making his choice, he unzipped the bag and took out the items one by one, exploring what was inside. When he found a shirt with a frog on it, he immediately put it on and showed it to his friends, pointing at the picture and saying, “Frog.”

As he continued exploring, he found a grey jacket and attempted to wear it. After trying for a moment, he said, “I cannot,” and looked to the teacher for help. While observing his friends, Asher noticed someone removing a pink jacket and pants. He pointed and said, “I want pink jacket and pants,” before proceeding to put them on himself. He showed a clear preference for the clothing items he wanted to wear and expressed his choices confidently.
interpretation: Through this experience, Asher demonstrated an understanding of his personal preferences and the ability to communicate his interests to others. His willingness to attempt dressing himself before seeking help reflects his developing independence and self-awareness. He demonstrated a sense of self-concept and identity by expressing his likes, interests, and opinions freely.

title: Self Help Skill
description:
Tyrell was invited to the self-help skill activity and was given the opportunity to choose from three bags. After selecting his bag, he unzipped it and started pulling out different pieces of clothing, examining each one. He picked up two pairs of pants and placed them on the floor. Lifting the pink pair, he said, “Too small,” before attempting to wear the other pair. After realizing they were also too small, he set them aside and continued looking through the bag.

He then found a red hat, held it up, and said, “Christmas hat.” As he looked around the room, he noticed a friend practicing bed-making with a fitted sheet. He became interested and approached the teacher, saying, “I want to do.” Tyrell waited for his turn and then focused on securing the fitted sheet onto the bed, completing the task by himself.
interpretation: Through this experience, Tyrell showed curiosity and engagement by exploring different materials and making choices based on his interests. He demonstrated a sense of self-concept and identity by expressing his likes, interests, and opinions freely.

title: Guided Reader : Picture and Text Matching
description:
Prior to this Lit Attack activity, the children had been introduced to the story Where Are We Going, Grandad? This time, they were invited to participate in a picture-matching activity based on the book. Eden and his peers opened an envelope containing several pictures from the story along with corresponding word cards. Eden's task was to match the text to the correct picture.

Eden picked up a picture of a house. He looked through the word cards and selected one with the word garden. Sounding it out, he said, "g...ar...d...e...n." He then paused and reasoned, "My picture is a house, not a garden."

Coincidentally, Eden's partner had picked up a word card that read house. Eden was observed negotiating with his partner, saying, "Ok, I give you mine."

He actively engaged in discussions with his peer, making thoughtful comparisons before accurately matching the text cards to the correct pictures as they worked through the activity.
interpretation:
Eden demonstrated key literacy skills during this activity, particularly in his ability to decode and make sense of words in context. His attempt to sound out the word garden showed his developing phonetic awareness as he applied his knowledge of letter sounds to break down the word. 


Additionally, Eden displayed emerging comprehension skills by considering the picture he had, recognising that garden did not match the image of a house. This ability to make logical connections between visuals and text is an important part of early literacy development.


Furthermore, Eden’s ability to engage in meaningful discussions and negotiate with his partner exemplified his developing communication and social literacy skills. His thoughtful decision-making, as he exchanged cards with his peer, showed growing confidence in collaborating with others to achieve a shared goal. By working together, Eden and his peer were able to reinforce each other's understanding of the task, highlighting the importance of peer interaction in building literacy skills in a supportive environment.

learning_goals.title: Comprehension: Use strategies to construct meaning from print.

title: My name (watercolor resist technique)
description:
During an art activity, Zhao De explored color mixing and creative expression. Using a white crayon, the teacher wrote his name on paper, and he painted over it with diluted blue and yellow paint. As Zhao De painted, his name was revealed, creating excitement and engagement. “Can you see your name?” asked his teacher. Zhao De nodded as his teacher pointed at the letters. He was able to identify the colors and observe how they mixed to form green. “See Teacher Michelle I use blue and yellow.”

This activity fostered his interest in art by encouraging creativity, introducing basic color theory, and developing fine motor skills. It also provided Zhao De a sense of accomplishment and joy, reinforcing a positive experience with artistic exploration.

title: Reading A Book
description:
During nap time, Aira was invited to choose a book to read before resting. She selected "The Very Hungry Caterpillar". She opened the book and flipped directly to the page with the butterfly, pointing at the illustration and saying, “Butterfly, I like.”

As she continued exploring the book, Aira paused at the page with oranges and said, “Orange.” She then dramatized picking an orange from the book and pretended to feed herself.
interpretation: Through this experience, Aira demonstrated a growing sense of self-comfort and identity. She used “I” in her sentences to express her preferences and interests, showing confidence in making choices. Her ability to engage with the book in a personal and imaginative way reflects her emerging self-awareness and enjoyment of familiar stories.

title: Dramatic Play With Friends
description:
During playtime, Aira observed a group of friends playing at the kitchen area. She approached them and joined in by sitting at the table, carefully selecting her preferred play food, including a banana, carrot, lemon, and apple. Holding a spoon and a container, she attempted to slice the apple using the spoon, mimicking food preparation.

As she was engaged in her play, a friend reached over and took the apple from her. Aira frowned and said, “Give me back apple,” before taking it back. She continued engaging in the activity and noticed a friend stirring and mixing ingredients in a container. Observing this, Aira imitated the action, stirring her own container before holding it up and pretending to drink from it.
interpretation: Through this experience, Aira demonstrated her ability to engage in social play and build relationships with her peers. She actively participated in group play, and responded to social interactions. Her imitation of a friend’s actions highlights her observational learning skills, while her ability to express her needs shows emerging confidence in social settings.

title: Pizza creation
description:
Following her hands-on play experience with felt pizza pieces, Andrea engaged in a fun drawing activity to create her own pizza toppings using markers. This activity helped to develop her fine motor skills by encouraging her to draw different types of lines-straight lines, curved lines, wavy lines and even small dots. While engaging in this activity, Andrea commented, “I draw my jiejie name. I draw blueberry.”

Andrea had the opportunity to enhance her hand control, coordination, and grip strength. In addition to supporting early writing skills, this creative exercise allowed Andrea to express her ideas while strengthening her fine motor abilities in an enjoyable and engaging way.

title: Music and Movement Scarf Play
description:
During music and movement time, Levi was invited to join the teacher in playing with scarves. Initially, he stood at a distance, observing his friends as they selected scarves and moved to the music. When the teacher first invited him, Levi did not approach to choose a scarf but continued watching the activity from afar.

As the song “Wheels on the Bus” began playing, Levi gradually moved closer to the group. The teacher extended another invitation, and this time, he stepped forward, pointed to a red scarf, and said, “Red.” Holding the scarf in his hands, Levi began moving along to the song, waving the scarf up and down while following the rhythm. He carefully observed the teacher’s movements and attempted to mirror them, swaying and waving his hands in coordination with the music.

At the end of the song, Levi jumped up high and attempted to toss his scarf into the air, showing excitement in his participation.
interpretation: Through this experience, Levi demonstrated growing trust in his teacher, responding positively to encouragement and becoming more comfortable engaging in a group activity. His ability to join in at his own pace reflects his emerging confidence in forming relationships with trusted adults and participating in classroom activities based on his interests.

learning_goals.title: Foster a sense of trust in adults 通过回应与互动，培养幼儿对成人的信任感。

title: Music and Movement Scarf Play
description:
During music and movement time, Joshua was invited to join the class in playing with scarves. Initially, he stood at a distance, observing his friends participating in the activity. As he watched his peers selecting scarves, he stepped forward and told the teacher “I want red,” before taking the red scarf from the teacher.

Holding the scarf, Joshua placed it over his head and smiled brightly, saying, “Peekaboo.” He continued exploring the scarf by pulling it off and placing it back over his head. When the teacher tossed a scarf high into the air while saying, “Boooom,” Joshua mirrored the action, tossing his scarf up and watching it float down.

As he moved around the space, Joshua noticed a yellow scarf on the floor. He picked it up, placed it over his head, and started moving rhythmically to the music.
interpretation: Through this experience, Joshua demonstrated his ability to express his preferences and interests. He engaged in the activity in his own time and pace, showing his ability in making choices and participating in ways that felt comfortable to him. His actions reflect his growing self-awareness and sense of identity in a group setting.

title: Playing With A Friend
description:
During playtime, Joshua was seated on the boat he had built, resting. A friend approached him, offering him some food from the play kitchen. Joshua extended his hand, took the pretend pizza, and dramatised eating it by bringing it to his mouth. After finishing, he looked at his friend and said, “More.”

His friend returned with a pretend pear and handed it to him. Joshua took the pear, examined it for a moment, then handed it back and said, “I don’t want.” His friend continued engaging with him, offering different food items.
interpretation: Through this experience, Joshua demonstrated his ability to interact and build relationships with his peers during play. He engaged in back-and-forth exchanges, expressing his preferences and responding appropriately to his friend’s gestures.
